
# VS Code API

**VS Code API**指的是您可以在Visual Studio Code扩展中调用的JavaScriptAPI集合。本页面列出了对扩展作者开放的所有VS Code API。

## API命名空间与类

此列表编译自VS Code仓库的[vscode.d.ts](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/blob/main/src/vscode-dts/vscode.d.ts)文件。

## authentication

<div class="comment"><p>负责验证的命名空间</p>
</div>

    <span class="ts" id=4398 data-target="#details-4398" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false">

#### 函数



<a name="authentication.getAccounts">
</a>
<span class="ts" id=4390 data-target="#details-4390" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false">
  <span class="ident">getAccounts</span>
  <span>(</span>
  <span class="ident">providerId</span>
  <span>: </span>
  <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>
  <span>)</span>
  <span>: </span>
  <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>
  &lt;readonly 
  <a class="type-ref" href="#AuthenticationSessionAccountInformation">AuthenticationSessionAccountInformation</a>
  []&gt;
</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4390">
<div class="comment">
  <p>获取用户的位于某个提供者的所有账户
  
  与<a href="#authentication.getSession">getSession</a>搭配使用来为指定账户获取验证会话。
  
  <p>当前仅有两个内建扩展提供的验证提供者贡献给了编辑器，实现了GitHub和Microsoft验证：它们的providerId为 'github'和'microsoft'。</p>
  <p>注意：获取账户并不代表您的扩展可以访问账户或其验证会话。您可以调用getSession<a href="#authentication.getSession">getSession</a>验证账户的访问。</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>形参</th><th>描述</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">providerId</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>使用提供者的ID</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>返回值</th><th>描述</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#AuthenticationSessionAccountInformation">AuthenticationSessionAccountInformation</a>[]&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>指向仅读验证数组的Thenable对象</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

<a name="authentication.getSession">
</a><span class="ts" id=4373 data-target="#details-4373" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false">
<span class="ident">getSession</span>
<span>(</span>
<span class="ident">providerId</span>
<span>: </span>
<span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, 
<span class="ident">scopeListOrRequest</span>
<span>: </span>readonly
<span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>[] &#124; 
<a class="type-ref" href="#AuthenticationWwwAuthenticateRequest">AuthenticationWwwAuthenticateRequest</a>,
<span class="ident">options</span>
<span>: </span>
<a class="type-ref" href="#AuthenticationGetSessionOptions">AuthenticationGetSessionOptions</a>
&#38; {createIfNone: 
<span class="type-literal">true</span>&#124;
<a class="type-ref" href="#AuthenticationGetSessionPresentationOptions">AuthenticationGetSessionPresentationOptions</a>}
<span>)</span>
<span>: </span>
<span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;
<a class="type-ref" href="#AuthenticationSession">AuthenticationSession</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4373">
<div class="comment">

<p>获取用户匹配期望限制域或满足WWW验证请求的验证会话。如果提供者的providerId未注册，或用户不许可分享验证信息给扩展，则拒绝。如果在同一限制域内有多个会话，用户将展示快速选单选取它们希望使用的账户</p>
<p>内建验证提供者包括：</p>
<ul>
<li>&#39;github&#39; - 来自GitHub.com</li>
<li>&#39;microsoft&#39; 来自个人和组织Microsoft账户</li>
<li>（较少见） &#39;github-enterprise&#39; - 来自其他GitHub主机，GHE.com，GitHub Enterprise Server</li>
<li>（较少见） &#39;microsoft-sovereign-cloud&#39; - 来自其他Microsoft云</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>形参</th><th>描述</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">providerId</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>使用的提供者ID</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">scopeListOrRequest</span><span>: </span>readonly <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>[] &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#AuthenticationWwwAuthenticateRequest">AuthenticationWwwAuthenticateRequest</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>一个请求权限域列表或WWW验证请求。这些根据验证提供者而变化。</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">options</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#AuthenticationGetSessionOptions">AuthenticationGetSessionOptions</a> &#38; {createIfNone: <span class="type-literal">true</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#AuthenticationGetSessionPresentationOptions">AuthenticationGetSessionPresentationOptions</a>}</td><td><div class="comment"><p>使用的<a href="#AuthenticationGetSessionOptions">AuthenticationGetSessionOptions</a></p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>返回值</th><th>描述</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#AuthenticationSession">AuthenticationSession</a>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>一个指向验证请求的Thenable对象</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

## chat

<div class="comment">
<p>聊天功能的命名空间。用户通过在聊天视图与聊天参与者发送消息互动。聊天参与者可以通过<a href="#ChatResponseStream">ChatResponseStream</a>使用Markdown或者其他类型内容回复。</p>
</div>

## commands

<div class="comment"><p>处理命令的命名空间。简而言之，命令是带有唯一标识符的函数。函数在某些时候也叫做<em>命令处理器</em>。</p>
<p>命令可以使用<a href="#commands.registerCommand">registerCommand</a>以及<a href="#commands.registerTextEditorCommand">registerTextEditorCommand</a>函数添加到编辑器中。命令可以通过<a href="#commands.executeCommand">手动</a>或从UI手势执行。包括：</p>
<ul>
<li>palette - 在<code>package.json</code>使用<code>commands</code>字段来使命令显示在[命令面板](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/getstarted/userinterface#_command-palette)中。</li>
<li>keybinding - 在<code>package.json</code>中使用<code>keybindings</code>字段启用扩展的<a href="https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/getstarted/keybindings#_advanced-customization">键盘绑定</a></li>
</ul>
<p>来自其他扩展或编辑器自身的命令可以被扩展访问。然而，在调用命令时不是所有的参数类型都受支持。</p>
<p>这个示例注册了命令处理器，并向面板添加了命令入口。首先，注册带有标识符<code>extension.sayHello</code>的命令处理器。
</p>

```typescript
commands.registerCommand('extension.sayHello', () => {
  window.showInformationMessage('Hello World!');
})
```

<p>随后，将标题绑定给命令标识符，它将会在命令面板（<code>package.json</code>）中显示。</p>

```json
{
  "contributes": {
    "commands": [
      {
        "command": "extension.sayHello",
        "title": "Hello World"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

</div>

#### 函数


<a name="commands.executeCommand"></a><span class="ts" id=2631 data-target="#details-2631" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">executeCommand</span><span>&lt;</span>T<span>&gt;</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">command</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span>...</span><span class="ident">rest</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">any</span>[]<span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2631">
<div class="comment"><p>Executes the command denoted by the given command identifier.</p>
<ul>
<li><em>Note 1:</em> When executing an editor command not all types are allowed to
be passed as arguments. Allowed are the primitive types <code>string</code>, <code>boolean</code>,
<code>number</code>, <code>undefined</code>, and <code>null</code>, as well as <a href="#Position">Position</a>, <a href="#Range">Range</a>, <a href="#Uri">Uri</a> and <a href="#Location">Location</a>.</li>
<li><em>Note 2:</em> There are no restrictions when executing commands that have been contributed
by extensions.</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">command</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Identifier of the command to execute.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span>...</span><span class="ident">rest</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">any</span>[]</td><td><div class="comment"><p>Parameters passed to the command function.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A thenable that resolves to the returned value of the given command. Returns <code>undefined</code> when
the command handler function doesn&#39;t return anything.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="commands.getCommands"></a><span class="ts" id=2636 data-target="#details-2636" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">getCommands</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">filterInternal</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>[]&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2636">
<div class="comment"><p>Retrieve the list of all available commands. Commands starting with an underscore are
treated as internal commands.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">filterInternal</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Set <code>true</code> to not see internal commands (starting with an underscore)</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>[]&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>Thenable that resolves to a list of command ids.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="commands.registerCommand"></a><span class="ts" id=2613 data-target="#details-2613" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">registerCommand</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">command</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">callback</span><span>: </span>(args: <span class="type-intrinsic">any</span>[]) =&gt; <span class="type-intrinsic">any</span>, <span class="ident">thisArg</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">any</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2613">
<div class="comment"><p>Registers a command that can be invoked via a keyboard shortcut,
a menu item, an action, or directly.</p>
<p>Registering a command with an existing command identifier twice
will cause an error.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">command</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A unique identifier for the command.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">callback</span><span>: </span>(args: <span class="type-intrinsic">any</span>[]) =&gt; <span class="type-intrinsic">any</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A command handler function.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">thisArg</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">any</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The <code>this</code> context used when invoking the handler function.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Disposable which unregisters this command on disposal.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="commands.registerTextEditorCommand"></a><span class="ts" id=2621 data-target="#details-2621" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">registerTextEditorCommand</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">command</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">callback</span><span>: </span>(textEditor: <a class="type-ref" href="#TextEditor">TextEditor</a>, edit: <a class="type-ref" href="#TextEditorEdit">TextEditorEdit</a>, args: <span class="type-intrinsic">any</span>[]) =&gt; <span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>, <span class="ident">thisArg</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">any</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2621">
<div class="comment"><p>Registers a text editor command that can be invoked via a keyboard shortcut,
a menu item, an action, or directly.</p>
<p>Text editor commands are different from ordinary <a href="#commands.registerCommand">commands</a> as
they only execute when there is an active editor when the command is called. Also, the
command handler of an editor command has access to the active editor and to an
<a href="#TextEditorEdit">edit</a>-builder. Note that the edit-builder is only valid while the
callback executes.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">command</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A unique identifier for the command.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">callback</span><span>: </span>(textEditor: <a class="type-ref" href="#TextEditor">TextEditor</a>, edit: <a class="type-ref" href="#TextEditorEdit">TextEditorEdit</a>, args: <span class="type-intrinsic">any</span>[]) =&gt; <span class="type-intrinsic">void</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A command handler function with access to an <a href="#TextEditor">editor</a> and an <a href="#TextEditorEdit">edit</a>.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">thisArg</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">any</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The <code>this</code> context used when invoking the handler function.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Disposable which unregisters this command on disposal.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

## debug



<div class="comment"><p>Namespace for debug functionality.</p>
</div>

#### Variables



<a name="debug.activeDebugConsole"></a><span class="ts" id=4236 data-target="#details-4236" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">activeDebugConsole</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DebugConsole">DebugConsole</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4236">
<div class="comment"><p>The currently active <a href="#DebugConsole">debug console</a>.
If no debug session is active, output sent to the debug console is not shown.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="debug.activeDebugSession"></a><span class="ts" id=4235 data-target="#details-4235" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">activeDebugSession</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DebugSession">DebugSession</a> &#124; <span class="type-intrinsic">undefined</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4235">
<div class="comment"><p>The currently active <a href="#DebugSession">debug session</a> or <code>undefined</code>. The active debug session is the one
represented by the debug action floating window or the one currently shown in the drop down menu of the debug action floating window.
If no debug session is active, the value is <code>undefined</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="debug.activeStackItem"></a><span class="ts" id=4243 data-target="#details-4243" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">activeStackItem</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DebugThread">DebugThread</a> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#DebugStackFrame">DebugStackFrame</a> &#124; <span class="type-intrinsic">undefined</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4243">
<div class="comment"><p>The currently focused thread or stack frame, or <code>undefined</code> if no
thread or stack is focused. A thread can be focused any time there is
an active debug session, while a stack frame can only be focused when
a session is paused and the call stack has been retrieved.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="debug.breakpoints"></a><span class="ts" id=4237 data-target="#details-4237" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">breakpoints</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#Breakpoint">Breakpoint</a>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4237">
<div class="comment"><p>List of breakpoints.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Events



<a name="debug.onDidChangeActiveDebugSession"></a><span class="ts" id=4238 data-target="#details-4238" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeActiveDebugSession</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#DebugSession">DebugSession</a> &#124; <span class="type-intrinsic">undefined</span>&gt;</span>

has changed. <em>Note</em> that the event also fires when the active debug session changes
to <code>undefined</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="debug.onDidChangeActiveStackItem"></a><span class="ts" id=4244 data-target="#details-4244" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeActiveStackItem</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#DebugThread">DebugThread</a> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#DebugStackFrame">DebugStackFrame</a> &#124; <span class="type-intrinsic">undefined</span>&gt;</span>

<div class="comment"><p>An event which fires when the <a href="#debug.activeStackItem">debug.activeStackItem</a> has changed.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="debug.onDidChangeBreakpoints"></a><span class="ts" id=4242 data-target="#details-4242" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeBreakpoints</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#BreakpointsChangeEvent">BreakpointsChangeEvent</a>&gt;</span>

</div>



<a name="debug.onDidReceiveDebugSessionCustomEvent"></a><span class="ts" id=4240 data-target="#details-4240" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidReceiveDebugSessionCustomEvent</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#DebugSessionCustomEvent">DebugSessionCustomEvent</a>&gt;</span>

</div>



<a name="debug.onDidStartDebugSession"></a><span class="ts" id=4239 data-target="#details-4239" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidStartDebugSession</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#DebugSession">DebugSession</a>&gt;</span>

</div>
</div>



<a name="debug.onDidTerminateDebugSession"></a><span class="ts" id=4241 data-target="#details-4241" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidTerminateDebugSession</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#DebugSession">DebugSession</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4241">
<div class="comment"><p>An <a href="#Event">Event</a> which fires when a <a href="#DebugSession">debug session</a> has terminated.</p>
</div>
</div>

<a name="debug.asDebugSourceUri"></a><span class="ts" id=4232 data-target="#details-4232" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">asDebugSourceUri</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">source</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DebugProtocolSource">DebugProtocolSource</a>, <span class="ident">session</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DebugSession">DebugSession</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4232">
<div class="comment"><p>Converts a &quot;Source&quot; descriptor object received via the Debug Adapter Protocol into a Uri that can be used to load its contents.
If the source descriptor is based on a path, a file Uri is returned.
If the source descriptor uses a reference number, a specific debug Uri (scheme &#39;debug&#39;) is constructed that requires a corresponding ContentProvider and a running debug session</p>
<p>If the &quot;Source&quot; descriptor has insufficient information for creating the Uri, an error is thrown.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">source</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DebugProtocolSource">DebugProtocolSource</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>An object conforming to the <a href="https://microsoft.github.io/debug-adapter-protocol/specification#Types_Source">Source</a> type defined in the Debug Adapter Protocol.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">session</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DebugSession">DebugSession</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>An optional debug session that will be used when the source descriptor uses a reference number to load the contents from an active debug session.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A uri that can be used to load the contents of the source.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="debug.registerDebugAdapterDescriptorFactory"></a><span class="ts" id=4210 data-target="#details-4210" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">registerDebugAdapterDescriptorFactory</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">debugType</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">factory</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DebugAdapterDescriptorFactory">DebugAdapterDescriptorFactory</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4210">
<div class="comment"><p>Register a <a href="#DebugAdapterDescriptorFactory">debug adapter descriptor factory</a> for a specific debug type.
An extension is only allowed to register a DebugAdapterDescriptorFactory for the debug type(s) defined by the extension. Otherwise an error is thrown.
Registering more than one DebugAdapterDescriptorFactory for a debug type results in an error.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">debugType</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The debug type for which the factory is registered.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">factory</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DebugAdapterDescriptorFactory">DebugAdapterDescriptorFactory</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The <a href="#DebugAdapterDescriptorFactory">debug adapter descriptor factory</a> to register.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A <a href="#Disposable">Disposable</a> that unregisters this factory when being disposed.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="debug.registerDebugAdapterTrackerFactory"></a><span class="ts" id=4214 data-target="#details-4214" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">registerDebugAdapterTrackerFactory</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">debugType</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">factory</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DebugAdapterTrackerFactory">DebugAdapterTrackerFactory</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4214">
<div class="comment"><p>Register a debug adapter tracker factory for the given debug type.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">debugType</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The debug type for which the factory is registered or &#39;*&#39; for matching all debug types.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">factory</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DebugAdapterTrackerFactory">DebugAdapterTrackerFactory</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The <a href="#DebugAdapterTrackerFactory">debug adapter tracker factory</a> to register.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A <a href="#Disposable">Disposable</a> that unregisters this factory when being disposed.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="debug.registerDebugConfigurationProvider"></a><span class="ts" id=4205 data-target="#details-4205" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">registerDebugConfigurationProvider</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">debugType</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">provider</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DebugConfigurationProvider">DebugConfigurationProvider</a>, <span class="ident">triggerKind</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DebugConfigurationProviderTriggerKind">DebugConfigurationProviderTriggerKind</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4205">
<div class="comment"><p>Register a <a href="#DebugConfigurationProvider">debug configuration provider</a> for a specific debug type.
The optional <a href="#DebugConfigurationProviderTriggerKind">triggerKind</a> can be used to specify when the <code>provideDebugConfigurations</code> method of the provider is triggered.
Currently two trigger kinds are possible: with the value <code>Initial</code> (or if no trigger kind argument is given) the <code>provideDebugConfigurations</code> method is used to provide the initial debug configurations to be copied into a newly created launch.json.
With the trigger kind <code>Dynamic</code> the <code>provideDebugConfigurations</code> method is used to dynamically determine debug configurations to be presented to the user (in addition to the static configurations from the launch.json).
Please note that the <code>triggerKind</code> argument only applies to the <code>provideDebugConfigurations</code> method: so the <code>resolveDebugConfiguration</code> methods are not affected at all.
Registering a single provider with resolve methods for different trigger kinds, results in the same resolve methods called multiple times.
More than one provider can be registered for the same type.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">debugType</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The debug type for which the provider is registered.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">provider</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DebugConfigurationProvider">DebugConfigurationProvider</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The <a href="#DebugConfigurationProvider">debug configuration provider</a> to register.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">triggerKind</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DebugConfigurationProviderTriggerKind">DebugConfigurationProviderTriggerKind</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The <a href="#DebugConfigurationProviderTriggerKind">trigger</a> for which the &#39;provideDebugConfiguration&#39; method of the provider is registered. If <code>triggerKind</code> is missing, the value <code>DebugConfigurationProviderTriggerKind.Initial</code> is assumed.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A <a href="#Disposable">Disposable</a> that unregisters this provider when being disposed.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="debug.removeBreakpoints"></a><span class="ts" id=4229 data-target="#details-4229" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">removeBreakpoints</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">breakpoints</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#Breakpoint">Breakpoint</a>[]<span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span></span>

</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>

<a name="debug.startDebugging"></a><span class="ts" id=4218 data-target="#details-4218" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">startDebugging</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">folder</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#WorkspaceFolder">WorkspaceFolder</a>, <span class="ident">nameOrConfiguration</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#DebugConfiguration">DebugConfiguration</a>, <span class="ident">parentSessionOrOptions</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DebugSession">DebugSession</a> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#DebugSessionOptions">DebugSessionOptions</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4218">
<div class="comment"><p>Start debugging by using either a named launch or named compound configuration,
or by directly passing a <a href="#DebugConfiguration">DebugConfiguration</a>.
The named configurations are looked up in &#39;.vscode/launch.json&#39; found in the given folder.
Before debugging starts, all unsaved files are saved and the launch configurations are brought up-to-date.
Folder specific variables used in the configuration (e.g. &#39;${workspaceFolder}&#39;) are resolved against the given folder.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">folder</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#WorkspaceFolder">WorkspaceFolder</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The <a href="#WorkspaceFolder">workspace folder</a> for looking up named configurations and resolving variables or <code>undefined</code> for a non-folder setup.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">nameOrConfiguration</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#DebugConfiguration">DebugConfiguration</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Either the name of a debug or compound configuration or a <a href="#DebugConfiguration">DebugConfiguration</a> object.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">parentSessionOrOptions</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DebugSession">DebugSession</a> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#DebugSessionOptions">DebugSessionOptions</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Debug session options. When passed a parent <a href="#DebugSession">debug session</a>, assumes options with just this parent session.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A thenable that resolves when debugging could be successfully started.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="debug.stopDebugging"></a><span class="ts" id=4223 data-target="#details-4223" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">stopDebugging</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">session</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DebugSession">DebugSession</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4223">
<div class="comment"><p>Stop the given debug session or stop all debug sessions if session is omitted.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">

<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>

</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A thenable that resolves when the session(s) have been stopped.</p>
</div></td></tr>

</div>
</div>

## env



<div class="comment"><p>Namespace describing the environment the editor runs in.</p>
</div>

#### Variables



<a name="env.appHost"></a><span class="ts" id=2595 data-target="#details-2595" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">appHost</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2595">
<div class="comment"><p>The hosted location of the application
On desktop this is &#39;desktop&#39;
In the web this is the specified embedder i.e. &#39;github.dev&#39;, &#39;codespaces&#39;, or &#39;web&#39; if the embedder
does not provide that information</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="env.appName"></a><span class="ts" id=2593 data-target="#details-2593" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">appName</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2593">
<div class="comment"><p>The application name of the editor, like &#39;VS Code&#39;.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="env.appRoot"></a><span class="ts" id=2594 data-target="#details-2594" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">appRoot</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2594">
<div class="comment"><p>The application root folder from which the editor is running.</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that the value is the empty string when running in an
environment that has no representation of an application root folder.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="env.clipboard"></a><span class="ts" id=2598 data-target="#details-2598" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">clipboard</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Clipboard">Clipboard</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2598">
<div class="comment"><p>The system clipboard.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="env.isAppPortable"></a><span class="ts" id=2602 data-target="#details-2602" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">isAppPortable</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2602">
<div class="comment"><p>Indicates whether the application is running in portable mode.</p>
<p>Portable mode is enabled when the application is run from a folder that contains
a <code>data</code> directory, allowing for self-contained installations.</p>
<p>Learn more about <a href="https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/portable">Portable Mode</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="env.isNewAppInstall"></a><span class="ts" id=2601 data-target="#details-2601" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">isNewAppInstall</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2601">
<div class="comment"><p>Indicates that this is a fresh install of the application.
<code>true</code> if within the first day of installation otherwise <code>false</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="env.isTelemetryEnabled"></a><span class="ts" id=2603 data-target="#details-2603" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">isTelemetryEnabled</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2603">
<div class="comment"><p>Indicates whether the users has telemetry enabled.
Can be observed to determine if the extension should send telemetry.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="env.language"></a><span class="ts" id=2597 data-target="#details-2597" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">language</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2597">
<div class="comment"><p>Represents the preferred user-language, like <code>de-CH</code>, <code>fr</code>, or <code>en-US</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="env.logLevel"></a><span class="ts" id=2609 data-target="#details-2609" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">logLevel</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#LogLevel">LogLevel</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2609">
<div class="comment"><p>The current log level of the editor.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="env.machineId"></a><span class="ts" id=2599 data-target="#details-2599" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">machineId</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2599">
<div class="comment"><p>A unique identifier for the computer.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="env.remoteName"></a><span class="ts" id=2606 data-target="#details-2606" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">remoteName</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <span class="type-intrinsic">undefined</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2606">
<div class="comment"><p>The name of a remote. Defined by extensions, popular samples are <code>wsl</code> for the Windows
Subsystem for Linux or <code>ssh-remote</code> for remotes using a secure shell.</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that the value is <code>undefined</code> when there is no remote extension host but that the
value is defined in all extension hosts (local and remote) in case a remote extension host
exists. Use <a href="#Extension.extensionKind">Extension.extensionKind</a> to know if
a specific extension runs remote or not.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="env.sessionId"></a><span class="ts" id=2600 data-target="#details-2600" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">sessionId</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2600">
<div class="comment"><p>A unique identifier for the current session.
Changes each time the editor is started.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="env.shell"></a><span class="ts" id=2607 data-target="#details-2607" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">shell</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2607">
<div class="comment"><p>The detected default shell for the extension host, this is overridden by the
<code>terminal.integrated.defaultProfile</code> setting for the extension host&#39;s platform. Note that in
environments that do not support a shell the value is the empty string.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="env.uiKind"></a><span class="ts" id=2608 data-target="#details-2608" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">uiKind</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#UIKind">UIKind</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2608">
<div class="comment"><p>The UI kind property indicates from which UI extensions
are accessed from. For example, extensions could be accessed
from a desktop application or a web browser.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="env.uriScheme"></a><span class="ts" id=2596 data-target="#details-2596" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">uriScheme</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2596">
<div class="comment"><p>The custom uri scheme the editor registers to in the operating system.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Events



<a name="env.onDidChangeLogLevel"></a><span class="ts" id=2610 data-target="#details-2610" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeLogLevel</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#LogLevel">LogLevel</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2610">
<div class="comment"><p>An <a href="#Event">Event</a> which fires when the log level of the editor changes.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="env.onDidChangeShell"></a><span class="ts" id=2605 data-target="#details-2605" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeShell</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2605">
<div class="comment"><p>An <a href="#Event">Event</a> which fires when the default shell changes. This fires with the new
shell path.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="env.onDidChangeTelemetryEnabled"></a><span class="ts" id=2604 data-target="#details-2604" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeTelemetryEnabled</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2604">
<div class="comment"><p>An <a href="#Event">Event</a> which fires when the user enabled or disables telemetry.
<code>true</code> if the user has enabled telemetry or <code>false</code> if the user has disabled telemetry.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Functions



<a name="env.asExternalUri"></a><span class="ts" id=2591 data-target="#details-2591" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">asExternalUri</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">target</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2591">
<div class="comment"><p>Resolves a uri to a form that is accessible externally.</p>
<h4 id="http-or-https-scheme"><code>http:</code> or <code>https:</code> scheme</h4>
<p>Resolves an <em>external</em> uri, such as a <code>http:</code> or <code>https:</code> link, from where the extension is running to a
uri to the same resource on the client machine.</p>
<p>This is a no-op if the extension is running on the client machine.</p>
<p>If the extension is running remotely, this function automatically establishes a port forwarding tunnel
from the local machine to <code>target</code> on the remote and returns a local uri to the tunnel. The lifetime of
the port forwarding tunnel is managed by the editor and the tunnel can be closed by the user.</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that uris passed through <code>openExternal</code> are automatically resolved and you should not call <code>asExternalUri</code> on them.</p>
<h4 id="vscodeenvurischeme"><code>vscode.env.uriScheme</code></h4>
<p>Creates a uri that - if opened in a browser (e.g. via <code>openExternal</code>) - will result in a registered <a href="#UriHandler">UriHandler</a>
to trigger.</p>
<p>Extensions should not make any assumptions about the resulting uri and should not alter it in any way.
Rather, extensions can e.g. use this uri in an authentication flow, by adding the uri as callback query
argument to the server to authenticate to.</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that if the server decides to add additional query parameters to the uri (e.g. a token or secret), it
will appear in the uri that is passed to the <a href="#UriHandler">UriHandler</a>.</p>
<p><strong>Example</strong> of an authentication flow:</p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="typescript" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">vscode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">window</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">registerUriHandler</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">({</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">  handleUri</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">uri</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">: </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0;--shiki-light:#267F99">vscode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0;--shiki-light:#267F99">Uri</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">): </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0;--shiki-light:#267F99">vscode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0;--shiki-light:#267F99">ProviderResult</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">&#x3C;</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0;--shiki-light:#267F99">void</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#C586C0;--shiki-light:#AF00DB">    if</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> (</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">uri</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">path</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> === </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'/did-authenticate'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">      console</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">log</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">uri</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">toString</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">());</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">});</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">const</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4FC1FF;--shiki-light:#0070C1"> callableUri</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> = </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#C586C0;--shiki-light:#AF00DB">await</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080"> vscode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">env</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">asExternalUri</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">  vscode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">Uri</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">parse</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">vscode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">env</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">uriScheme</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> + </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'://my.extension/did-authenticate'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#C586C0;--shiki-light:#AF00DB">await</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080"> vscode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">env</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">openExternal</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">callableUri</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span></code></pre>
<p><em>Note</em> that extensions should not cache the result of <code>asExternalUri</code> as the resolved uri may become invalid due to
a system or user action — for example, in remote cases, a user may close a port forwarding tunnel that was opened by
<code>asExternalUri</code>.</p>
<h4 id="any-other-scheme">Any other scheme</h4>
<p>Any other scheme will be handled as if the provided URI is a workspace URI. In that case, the method will return
a URI which, when handled, will make the editor open the workspace.</p>
</div>

</table>
</div>
</div>

</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">options</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TelemetryLoggerOptions">TelemetryLoggerOptions</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Options for the telemetry logger.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#TelemetryLogger">TelemetryLogger</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A new telemetry logger</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>

<a name="env.openExternal"></a><span class="ts" id=2588 data-target="#details-2588" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">openExternal</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">target</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2588">
<div class="comment"><p>Opens a link externally using the default application. Depending on the
used scheme this can be:</p>
<ul>
<li>a browser (<code>http:</code>, <code>https:</code>)</li>
<li>a mail client (<code>mailto:</code>)</li>
<li>VSCode itself (<code>vscode:</code> from <code>vscode.env.uriScheme</code>)</li>
</ul>
<p><em>Note</em> that <a href="#window.showTextDocument">showTextDocument</a> is the right
way to open a text document inside the editor, not this function.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">target</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The uri that should be opened.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A promise indicating if open was successful.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

## extensions



<div class="comment"><p>Namespace for dealing with installed extensions. Extensions are represented
by an <a href="#Extension">Extension</a>-interface which enables reflection on them.</p>
<p>Extension writers can provide APIs to other extensions by returning their API public
surface from the <code>activate</code>-call.</p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="javascript" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#C586C0;--shiki-light:#AF00DB">export</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF"> function</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26"> activate</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">context</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">: </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0;--shiki-light:#267F99">vscode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0;--shiki-light:#267F99">ExtensionContext</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">) {</span></span>

## l10n



<div class="comment"><p>Namespace for localization-related functionality in the extension API. To use this properly,
you must have <code>l10n</code> defined in your extension manifest and have bundle.l10n.<language>.json files.
For more information on how to generate bundle.l10n.<language>.json files, check out the
<a href="https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-l10n">vscode-l10n repo</a>.</p>
<p>Note: Built-in extensions (for example, Git, TypeScript Language Features, GitHub Authentication)
are excluded from the <code>l10n</code> property requirement. In other words, they do not need to specify
a <code>l10n</code> in the extension manifest because their translated strings come from Language Packs.</p>
</div>

#### Variables



<a name="l10n.bundle"></a><span class="ts" id=4413 data-target="#details-4413" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">bundle</span><span>: </span> &#124; <span class="type-intrinsic">undefined</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4413">
<div class="comment"><p>The bundle of localized strings that have been loaded for the extension.
It&#39;s undefined if no bundle has been loaded. The bundle is typically not loaded if
there was no bundle found or when we are running with the default language.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="l10n.uri"></a><span class="ts" id=4417 data-target="#details-4417" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">uri</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a> &#124; <span class="type-intrinsic">undefined</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4417">
<div class="comment"><p>The URI of the localization bundle that has been loaded for the extension.
It&#39;s undefined if no bundle has been loaded. The bundle is typically not loaded if
there was no bundle found or when we are running with the default language.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Functions



<a name="l10n.t"></a><span class="ts" id=4401 data-target="#details-4401" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">t</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">message</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span>...</span><span class="ident">args</span><span>: </span>Array&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <span class="type-intrinsic">number</span> &#124; <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>&gt;<span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4401">
<div class="comment"><p>Marks a string for localization. If a localized bundle is available for the language specified by
<a href="#env.language">env.language</a> and the bundle has a localized value for this message, then that localized
value will be returned (with injected <a href="#l10n.t.args">args</a> values for any templated values).</p>
<p><strong>Example</strong></p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="ts" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">l10n</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">t</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'Hello {0}!'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">, </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'World'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span></code></pre>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">message</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The message to localize. Supports index templating where strings like <code>{0}</code> and <code>{1}</code> are
replaced by the item at that index in the <a href="#l10n.t.args">args</a> array.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span>...</span><span class="ident">args</span><span>: </span>Array&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <span class="type-intrinsic">number</span> &#124; <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>The arguments to be used in the localized string. The index of the argument is used to
match the template placeholder in the localized string.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>localized string with injected arguments.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="l10n.t"></a><span class="ts" id=4404 data-target="#details-4404" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">t</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">message</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">args</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref-ts">Record</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <span class="type-intrinsic">number</span> &#124; <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>&gt;<span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>

<p><strong>Example</strong></p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="ts" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">l10n</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">t</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'Hello {name}'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">, { </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">name:</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515"> 'Erich'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> });</span></span>
<span class="line"></span></code></pre>
</div>

<tr><td><span class="ident">args</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref-ts">Record</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <span class="type-intrinsic">number</span> &#124; <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>The arguments to be used in the localized string. The name of the key in the record is used to

## languages



<div class="comment"><p>Namespace for participating in language-specific editor <a href="https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/editingevolved">features</a>,
like IntelliSense, code actions, diagnostics etc.</p>
<p>Many programming languages exist and there is huge variety in syntaxes, semantics, and paradigms. Despite that, features
like automatic word-completion, code navigation, or code checking have become popular across different tools for different
programming languages.</p>
<p>The editor provides an API that makes it simple to provide such common features by having all UI and actions already in place and
by allowing you to participate by providing data only. For instance, to contribute a hover all you have to do is provide a function
that can be called with a <a href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a> and a <a href="#Position">Position</a> returning hover info. The rest, like tracking the
mouse, positioning the hover, keeping the hover stable etc. is taken care of by the editor.</p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="javascript" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">languages</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">registerHoverProvider</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'javascript'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">, {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">  provideHover</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">document</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">, </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">position</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">, </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">token</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#C586C0;--shiki-light:#AF00DB">    return</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF"> new</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26"> Hover</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'I am a hover!'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">});</span></span>
<span class="line"></span></code></pre>
<p>Registration is done using a <a href="#DocumentSelector">document selector</a> which is either a language id, like <code>javascript</code> or
a more complex <a href="#DocumentFilter">filter</a> like <code>{ language: &#39;typescript&#39;, scheme: &#39;file&#39; }</code>. Matching a document against such
a selector will result in a <a href="#languages.match">score</a> that is used to determine if and how a provider shall be used. When
scores are equal the provider that came last wins. For features that allow full arity, like <a href="#languages.registerHoverProvider">hover</a>,
the score is only checked to be <code>&gt;0</code>, for other features, like <a href="#languages.registerCompletionItemProvider">IntelliSense</a> the
score is used for determining the order in which providers are asked to participate.</p>
</div>

#### Events



<a name="languages.onDidChangeDiagnostics"></a><span class="ts" id=3663 data-target="#details-3663" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeDiagnostics</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#DiagnosticChangeEvent">DiagnosticChangeEvent</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3663">
<div class="comment"><p>An <a href="#Event">Event</a> which fires when the global set of diagnostics changes. This is
newly added and removed diagnostics.</p>
</div>

<a name="languages.match"></a><span class="ts" id=3504 data-target="#details-3504" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">match</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">selector</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentSelector">DocumentSelector</a>, <span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3504">
<div class="comment"><p>Compute the match between a document <a href="#DocumentSelector">selector</a> and a document. Values
greater than zero mean the selector matches the document.</p>
<p>A match is computed according to these rules:</p>
<ol>
<li>When <a href="#DocumentSelector">DocumentSelector</a> is an array, compute the match for each contained <code>DocumentFilter</code> or language identifier and take the maximum value.</li>
<li>A string will be desugared to become the <code>language</code>-part of a <a href="#DocumentFilter">DocumentFilter</a>, so <code>&quot;fooLang&quot;</code> is like <code>{ language: &quot;fooLang&quot; }</code>.</li>
<li>A <a href="#DocumentFilter">DocumentFilter</a> will be matched against the document by comparing its parts with the document. The following rules apply:<ol>
<li>When the <code>DocumentFilter</code> is empty (<code>{}</code>) the result is <code>0</code></li>
<li>When <code>scheme</code>, <code>language</code>, <code>pattern</code>, or <code>notebook</code> are defined but one doesn&#39;t match, the result is <code>0</code></li>
<li>Matching against <code>*</code> gives a score of <code>5</code>, matching via equality or via a glob-pattern gives a score of <code>10</code></li>
<li>The result is the maximum value of each match</li>
</ol>
</li>
</ol>
<p>Samples:</p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="js" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#6A9955;--shiki-light:#008000">// default document from disk (file-scheme)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">doc</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">uri</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">; </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#6A9955;--shiki-light:#008000">//'file:///my/file.js'</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">doc</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">languageId</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">; </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#6A9955;--shiki-light:#008000">// 'javascript'</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">match</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'javascript'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">, </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">doc</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">); </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#6A9955;--shiki-light:#008000">// 10;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">match</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">({ </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">language:</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515"> 'javascript'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> }, </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">doc</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">); </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#6A9955;--shiki-light:#008000">// 10;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">match</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">({ </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">language:</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515"> 'javascript'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">, </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">scheme:</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515"> 'file'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> }, </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">doc</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">); </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#6A9955;--shiki-light:#008000">// 10;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">match</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'*'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">, </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">doc</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">); </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#6A9955;--shiki-light:#008000">// 5</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">match</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'fooLang'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">, </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">doc</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">); </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#6A9955;--shiki-light:#008000">// 0</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#6A9955;--shiki-light:#008000">// virtual document, e.g. from git-index</span></span>

<a name="languages.registerCallHierarchyProvider"></a><span class="ts" id=3638 data-target="#details-3638" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">registerCallHierarchyProvider</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">selector</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentSelector">DocumentSelector</a>, <span class="ident">provider</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CallHierarchyProvider">CallHierarchyProvider</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></span>

<a name="languages.registerCodeActionsProvider"></a><span class="ts" id=3528 data-target="#details-3528" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">registerCodeActionsProvider</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">selector</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentSelector">DocumentSelector</a>, <span class="ident">provider</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CodeActionProvider&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">CodeActionProvider</a>, <span class="ident">metadata</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CodeActionProviderMetadata">CodeActionProviderMetadata</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3528">
<div class="comment"><p>Register a code action provider.</p>
<p>Multiple providers can be registered for a language. In that case providers are asked in
parallel and the results are merged. A failing provider (rejected promise or exception) will
not cause a failure of the whole operation.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">selector</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentSelector">DocumentSelector</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A selector that defines the documents this provider is applicable to.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">provider</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CodeActionProvider&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">CodeActionProvider</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A code action provider.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">metadata</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CodeActionProviderMetadata">CodeActionProviderMetadata</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Metadata about the kind of code actions the provider provides.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A <a href="#Disposable">Disposable</a> that unregisters this provider when being disposed.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="languages.registerCodeLensProvider"></a><span class="ts" id=3533 data-target="#details-3533" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">registerCodeLensProvider</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">selector</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentSelector">DocumentSelector</a>, <span class="ident">provider</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CodeLensProvider&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">CodeLensProvider</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></span>

<p>Multiple providers can be registered for a language. In that case providers are asked in
parallel and the results are merged. A failing provider (rejected promise or exception) will
not cause a failure of the whole operation.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">selector</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentSelector">DocumentSelector</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A selector that defines the documents this provider is applicable to.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">provider</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CodeLensProvider&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">CodeLensProvider</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A code lens provider.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A <a href="#Disposable">Disposable</a> that unregisters this provider when being disposed.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

<div class="details collapse" id="details-3622">

<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">selector</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentSelector">DocumentSelector</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A selector that defines the documents this provider is applicable to.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">provider</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentColorProvider">DocumentColorProvider</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A color provider.</p>
</div></td></tr>
