<a name="languages.registerCompletionItemProvider"></a><span class="ts" id=3519 data-target="#details-3519" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">registerCompletionItemProvider</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">selector</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentSelector">DocumentSelector</a>, <span class="ident">provider</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CompletionItemProvider&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">CompletionItemProvider</a>, <span>...</span><span class="ident">triggerCharacters</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>[]<span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3519">
<div class="comment"><p>Register a completion provider.</p>
<p>Multiple providers can be registered for a language. In that case providers are sorted
by their <a href="#languages.match">score</a> and groups of equal score are sequentially asked for
completion items. The process stops when one or many providers of a group return a
result. A failing provider (rejected promise or exception) will not fail the whole
operation.</p>
<p>A completion item provider can be associated with a set of <code>triggerCharacters</code>. When trigger
characters are being typed, completions are requested but only from providers that registered
the typed character. Because of that trigger characters should be different than <a href="#LanguageConfiguration.wordPattern">word characters</a>,
a common trigger character is <code>.</code> to trigger member completions.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">selector</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentSelector">DocumentSelector</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A selector that defines the documents this provider is applicable to.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">provider</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CompletionItemProvider&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">CompletionItemProvider</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A completion provider.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span>...</span><span class="ident">triggerCharacters</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>[]</td><td><div class="comment"><p>Trigger completion when the user types one of the characters.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A <a href="#Disposable">Disposable</a> that unregisters this provider when being disposed.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="languages.registerDeclarationProvider"></a><span class="ts" id=3549 data-target="#details-3549" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">registerDeclarationProvider</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">selector</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentSelector">DocumentSelector</a>, <span class="ident">provider</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DeclarationProvider">DeclarationProvider</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></span>

<tr><td><span class="ident">provider</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DeclarationProvider">DeclarationProvider</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A declaration provider.</p>
</div></td></tr>

<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A <a href="#Disposable">Disposable</a> that unregisters this provider when being disposed.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="languages.registerDefinitionProvider"></a><span class="ts" id=3537 data-target="#details-3537" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">registerDefinitionProvider</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">selector</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentSelector">DocumentSelector</a>, <span class="ident">provider</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DefinitionProvider">DefinitionProvider</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></span>

parallel and the results are merged. A failing provider (rejected promise or exception) will
not cause a failure of the whole operation.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">selector</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentSelector">DocumentSelector</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A selector that defines the documents this provider is applicable to.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">provider</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DefinitionProvider">DefinitionProvider</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A definition provider.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A <a href="#Disposable">Disposable</a> that unregisters this provider when being disposed.</p>

<a name="languages.registerDocumentDropEditProvider"></a><span class="ts" id=3650 data-target="#details-3650" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">registerDocumentDropEditProvider</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">selector</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentSelector">DocumentSelector</a>, <span class="ident">provider</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentDropEditProvider&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">DocumentDropEditProvider</a>, <span class="ident">metadata</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentDropEditProviderMetadata">DocumentDropEditProviderMetadata</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3650">
<div class="comment"><p>Registers a new <a href="#DocumentDropEditProvider">DocumentDropEditProvider</a>.</p>
<p>Multiple drop providers can be registered for a language. When dropping content into an editor, all
registered providers for the editor&#39;s language will be invoked based on the mimetypes they handle
as specified by their <a href="#DocumentDropEditProviderMetadata">DocumentDropEditProviderMetadata</a>.</p>
<p>Each provider can return one or more <a href="#DocumentDropEdit">DocumentDropEdits</a>. The edits are sorted
using the <a href="#DocumentDropEdit.yieldTo">DocumentDropEdit.yieldTo</a> property. By default the first edit will be applied. If there
are any additional edits, these will be shown to the user as selectable drop options in the drop widget.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">selector</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentSelector">DocumentSelector</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A selector that defines the documents this provider applies to.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">provider</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentDropEditProvider&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">DocumentDropEditProvider</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A drop provider.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">metadata</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentDropEditProviderMetadata">DocumentDropEditProviderMetadata</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Additional metadata about the provider.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A <a href="#Disposable">Disposable</a> that unregisters this provider when disposed of.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="languages.registerDocumentFormattingEditProvider"></a><span class="ts" id=3595 data-target="#details-3595" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">registerDocumentFormattingEditProvider</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">selector</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentSelector">DocumentSelector</a>, <span class="ident">provider</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentFormattingEditProvider">DocumentFormattingEditProvider</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3595">
<div class="comment"><p>Register a formatting provider for a document.</p>
<p>Multiple providers can be registered for a language. In that case providers are sorted
by their <a href="#languages.match">score</a> and the best-matching provider is used. Failure
of the selected provider will cause a failure of the whole operation.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">selector</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentSelector">DocumentSelector</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A selector that defines the documents this provider is applicable to.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">provider</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentFormattingEditProvider">DocumentFormattingEditProvider</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A document formatting edit provider.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A <a href="#Disposable">Disposable</a> that unregisters this provider when being disposed.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="languages.registerDocumentHighlightProvider"></a><span class="ts" id=3565 data-target="#details-3565" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">registerDocumentHighlightProvider</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">selector</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentSelector">DocumentSelector</a>, <span class="ident">provider</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentHighlightProvider">DocumentHighlightProvider</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3565">
<div class="comment"><p>Register a document highlight provider.</p>
<p>By default, multiple providers can be registered for a language. In that case providers are sorted
by their <a href="#languages.match">score</a> and groups sequentially asked for document highlights.
The process stops when a provider returns a <code>non-falsy</code> or <code>non-failure</code> result.
When <code>editor.occurrencesHighlightFromAllProviders</code> is enabled, matching providers are asked in parallel
and their results are merged, preserving the highest-priority provider&#39;s kind for duplicate ranges.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">selector</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentSelector">DocumentSelector</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A selector that defines the documents this provider is applicable to.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">provider</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentHighlightProvider">DocumentHighlightProvider</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A document highlight provider.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A <a href="#Disposable">Disposable</a> that unregisters this provider when being disposed.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="languages.registerDocumentLinkProvider"></a><span class="ts" id=3618 data-target="#details-3618" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">registerDocumentLinkProvider</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">selector</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentSelector">DocumentSelector</a>, <span class="ident">provider</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentLinkProvider&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">DocumentLinkProvider</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></span>

<div class="comment"><p>Register a document link provider.</p>
<p>Multiple providers can be registered for a language. In that case providers are asked in
parallel and the results are merged. A failing provider (rejected promise or exception) will
not cause a failure of the whole operation.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">selector</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentSelector">DocumentSelector</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A selector that defines the documents this provider is applicable to.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">provider</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentLinkProvider&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">DocumentLinkProvider</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A document link provider.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A <a href="#Disposable">Disposable</a> that unregisters this provider when being disposed.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="languages.registerDocumentPasteEditProvider"></a><span class="ts" id=3655 data-target="#details-3655" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">registerDocumentPasteEditProvider</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">selector</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentSelector">DocumentSelector</a>, <span class="ident">provider</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentPasteEditProvider&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">DocumentPasteEditProvider</a>, <span class="ident">metadata</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentPasteProviderMetadata">DocumentPasteProviderMetadata</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3655">
<div class="comment"><p>Registers a new <a href="#DocumentPasteEditProvider">DocumentPasteEditProvider</a>.</p>
<p>Multiple providers can be registered for a language. All registered providers for a language will be invoked
for copy and paste operations based on their handled mimetypes as specified by the <a href="#DocumentPasteProviderMetadata">DocumentPasteProviderMetadata</a>.</p>
<p>For <a href="#DocumentPasteEditProvider.prepareDocumentPaste">copy operations</a>, changes to the <a href="#DataTransfer">DataTransfer</a>
made by each provider will be merged into a single <a href="#DataTransfer">DataTransfer</a> that is used to populate the clipboard.</p>
<p>For [DocumentPasteEditProvider.providerDocumentPasteEdits paste operations](#DocumentPasteEditProvider.providerDocumentPasteEdits paste operations), each provider will be invoked
and can return one or more <a href="#DocumentPasteEdit">DocumentPasteEdits</a>. The edits are sorted using
the <a href="#DocumentPasteEdit.yieldTo">DocumentPasteEdit.yieldTo</a> property. By default the first edit will be applied
and the rest of the edits will be shown to the user as selectable paste options in the paste widget.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">selector</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentSelector">DocumentSelector</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A selector that defines the documents this provider applies to.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">provider</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentPasteEditProvider&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">DocumentPasteEditProvider</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A paste editor provider.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">metadata</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentPasteProviderMetadata">DocumentPasteProviderMetadata</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Additional metadata about the provider.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A <a href="#Disposable">Disposable</a> that unregisters this provider when disposed of.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="languages.registerDocumentRangeFormattingEditProvider"></a><span class="ts" id=3599 data-target="#details-3599" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">registerDocumentRangeFormattingEditProvider</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">selector</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentSelector">DocumentSelector</a>, <span class="ident">provider</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentRangeFormattingEditProvider">DocumentRangeFormattingEditProvider</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3599">
<div class="comment"><p>Register a formatting provider for a document range.</p>
<p><em>Note:</em> A document range provider is also a <a href="#DocumentFormattingEditProvider">document formatter</a>
which means there is no need to <a href="#languages.registerDocumentFormattingEditProvider">register</a> a document
formatter when also registering a range provider.</p>
<p>Multiple providers can be registered for a language. In that case providers are sorted
by their <a href="#languages.match">score</a> and the best-matching provider is used. Failure
of the selected provider will cause a failure of the whole operation.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">selector</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentSelector">DocumentSelector</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A selector that defines the documents this provider is applicable to.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">provider</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentRangeFormattingEditProvider">DocumentRangeFormattingEditProvider</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A document range formatting edit provider.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A <a href="#Disposable">Disposable</a> that unregisters this provider when being disposed.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="languages.registerDocumentRangeSemanticTokensProvider"></a><span class="ts" id=3590 data-target="#details-3590" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">registerDocumentRangeSemanticTokensProvider</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">selector</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentSelector">DocumentSelector</a>, <span class="ident">provider</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentRangeSemanticTokensProvider">DocumentRangeSemanticTokensProvider</a>, <span class="ident">legend</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#SemanticTokensLegend">SemanticTokensLegend</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3590">
<div class="comment"><p>Register a semantic tokens provider for a document range.</p>
<p><em>Note:</em> If a document has both a <code>DocumentSemanticTokensProvider</code> and a <code>DocumentRangeSemanticTokensProvider</code>,
the range provider will be invoked only initially, for the time in which the full document provider takes
to resolve the first request. Once the full document provider resolves the first request, the semantic tokens
provided via the range provider will be discarded and from that point forward, only the document provider
will be used.</p>
<p>Multiple providers can be registered for a language. In that case providers are sorted
by their <a href="#languages.match">score</a> and the best-matching provider is used. Failure
of the selected provider will cause a failure of the whole operation.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">selector</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentSelector">DocumentSelector</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A selector that defines the documents this provider is applicable to.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">provider</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentRangeSemanticTokensProvider">DocumentRangeSemanticTokensProvider</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A document range semantic tokens provider.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">legend</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#SemanticTokensLegend">SemanticTokensLegend</a></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>

<a name="languages.registerFoldingRangeProvider"></a><span class="ts" id=3630 data-target="#details-3630" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">registerFoldingRangeProvider</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">selector</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentSelector">DocumentSelector</a>, <span class="ident">provider</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#FoldingRangeProvider">FoldingRangeProvider</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3630">
<div class="comment"><p>Register a folding range provider.</p>
<p>Multiple providers can be registered for a language. In that case providers are asked in
parallel and the results are merged.
If multiple folding ranges start at the same position, only the range of the first registered provider is used.
If a folding range overlaps with an other range that has a smaller position, it is also ignored.</p>
<p>A failing provider (rejected promise or exception) will
not cause a failure of the whole operation.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">selector</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentSelector">DocumentSelector</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A selector that defines the documents this provider is applicable to.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">provider</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#FoldingRangeProvider">FoldingRangeProvider</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A folding range provider.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A <a href="#Disposable">Disposable</a> that unregisters this provider when being disposed.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

<div class="details collapse" id="details-3634">

<p>Multiple providers can be registered for a language. In that case providers are asked in
parallel and the results are merged. A failing provider (rejected promise or exception) will
not cause a failure of the whole operation.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">selector</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentSelector">DocumentSelector</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A selector that defines the documents this provider is applicable to.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">provider</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#SelectionRangeProvider">SelectionRangeProvider</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A selection range provider.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A <a href="#Disposable">Disposable</a> that unregisters this provider when being disposed.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

<tr><td><span>...</span><span class="ident">triggerCharacters</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>[]</td><td><div class="comment"><p>Trigger signature help when the user types one of the characters, like <code>,</code> or <code>(</code>.</p>
</div></td></tr>

</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

<a name="languages.setTextDocumentLanguage"></a><span class="ts" id=3500 data-target="#details-3500" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">setTextDocumentLanguage</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a>, <span class="ident">languageId</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a>&gt;</span>

## lm



<div class="comment"><p>Namespace for language model related functionality.</p>
</div>

#### Variables



<a name="lm.tools"></a><span class="ts" id=5098 data-target="#details-5098" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">tools</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#LanguageModelToolInformation">LanguageModelToolInformation</a>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-5098">
<div class="comment"><p>A list of all available tools that were registered by all extensions using <a href="#lm.registerTool">lm.registerTool</a>. They can be called
with <a href="#lm.invokeTool">lm.invokeTool</a> with input that match their declared <code>inputSchema</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Events



<a name="lm.onDidChangeChatModels"></a><span class="ts" id=5097 data-target="#details-5097" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeChatModels</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-5097">
<div class="comment"><p>An event that is fired when the set of available chat models changes.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Functions



<a name="lm.invokeTool"></a><span class="ts" id=5085 data-target="#details-5085" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">invokeTool</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">name</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">options</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#LanguageModelToolInvocationOptions&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">LanguageModelToolInvocationOptions</a>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">object</span>&gt;, <span class="ident">token</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#LanguageModelToolResult">LanguageModelToolResult</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-5085">
<div class="comment"><p>Invoke a tool listed in <a href="#lm.tools">lm.tools</a> by name with the given input. The input will be validated against
the schema declared by the tool</p>
<p>A tool can be invoked by a chat participant, in the context of handling a chat request, or globally by any extension in
any custom flow.</p>
<p>In the former case, the caller shall pass the
<a href="#LanguageModelToolInvocationOptions.toolInvocationToken">toolInvocationToken</a>, which comes from a
<a href="#ChatRequest.toolInvocationToken">chat request</a>. This makes sure the chat UI shows the tool invocation for the
correct conversation.</p>
<p>A tool <a href="#LanguageModelToolResult">result</a> is an array of <a href="#LanguageModelTextPart">text-</a> and
<a href="#LanguageModelPromptTsxPart">prompt-tsx</a>-parts. If the tool caller is using <code>vscode/prompt-tsx</code>, it can
incorporate the response parts into its prompt using a <code>ToolResult</code>. If not, the parts can be passed along to the
<a href="#LanguageModelChat">LanguageModelChat</a> via a user message with a <a href="#LanguageModelToolResultPart">LanguageModelToolResultPart</a>.</p>
<p>If a chat participant wants to preserve tool results for requests across multiple turns, it can store tool results in
the <a href="#ChatResult.metadata">ChatResult.metadata</a> returned from the handler and retrieve them on the next turn from
<a href="#ChatResponseTurn.result">ChatResponseTurn.result</a>.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">name</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The name of the tool to call.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">options</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#LanguageModelToolInvocationOptions&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">LanguageModelToolInvocationOptions</a>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">object</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>The options to use when invoking the tool.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token. See <a href="#CancellationTokenSource">CancellationTokenSource</a> for how to create one.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#LanguageModelToolResult">LanguageModelToolResult</a>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>The result of the tool invocation.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="lm.registerLanguageModelChatProvider"></a><span class="ts" id=5094 data-target="#details-5094" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">registerLanguageModelChatProvider</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">vendor</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">provider</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#LanguageModelChatProvider&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">LanguageModelChatProvider</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-5094">
<div class="comment"><p>Registers a <a href="#LanguageModelChatProvider">LanguageModelChatProvider</a>
Note: You must also define the language model chat provider via the <code>languageModelChatProviders</code> contribution point in package.json</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">vendor</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The vendor for this provider. Must be globally unique. An example is <code>copilot</code> or <code>openai</code>.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">provider</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#LanguageModelChatProvider&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">LanguageModelChatProvider</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The provider to register</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A disposable that unregisters the provider when disposed</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="lm.registerMcpServerDefinitionProvider"></a><span class="ts" id=5090 data-target="#details-5090" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">registerMcpServerDefinitionProvider</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">id</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">provider</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#McpServerDefinitionProvider&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">McpServerDefinitionProvider</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-5090">
<div class="comment"><p>Registers a provider that publishes Model Context Protocol servers for the editor to
consume. This allows MCP servers to be dynamically provided to the editor in
addition to those the user creates in their configuration files.</p>
<p>Before calling this method, extensions must register the <code>contributes.mcpServerDefinitionProviders</code>
extension point with the corresponding <a href="#lm.registerMcpServerDefinitionProvider.id">id</a>, for example:</p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="js" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">    "contributes"</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">: {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">        "mcpServerDefinitionProviders"</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">:</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> [</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">            {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">                "id"</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">:</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515"> "cool-cloud-registry.mcp-servers"</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">                "label"</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">:</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515"> "Cool Cloud Registry"</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">            }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">        ]</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">    }</span></span></code></pre>
<p>When a new McpServerDefinitionProvider is available, the editor will, by default,
automatically invoke it to discover new servers and tools when a chat message is
submitted. To enable this flow, extensions should call
<code>registerMcpServerDefinitionProvider</code> during activation.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">id</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The ID of the provider, which is unique to the extension.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">provider</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#McpServerDefinitionProvider&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">McpServerDefinitionProvider</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The provider to register</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A disposable that unregisters the provider when disposed.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="lm.registerTool"></a><span class="ts" id=5080 data-target="#details-5080" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">registerTool</span><span>&lt;</span>T<span>&gt;</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">name</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">tool</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#LanguageModelTool&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">LanguageModelTool</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt;<span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-5080">
<div class="comment"><p>Register a LanguageModelTool. The tool must also be registered in the package.json <code>languageModelTools</code> contribution
point. A registered tool is available in the <a href="#lm.tools">lm.tools</a> list for any extension to see. But in order for it to
be seen by a language model, it must be passed in the list of available tools in <a href="#LanguageModelChatRequestOptions.tools">LanguageModelChatRequestOptions.tools</a>.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">name</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">tool</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#LanguageModelTool&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">LanguageModelTool</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>

<a name="lm.selectChatModels"></a><span class="ts" id=5077 data-target="#details-5077" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">selectChatModels</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">selector</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#LanguageModelChatSelector">LanguageModelChatSelector</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#LanguageModelChat">LanguageModelChat</a>[]&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-5077">
<div class="comment"><p>Select chat models by a <a href="#LanguageModelChatSelector">selector</a>. This can yield multiple or no chat models and
extensions must handle these cases, esp. when no chat model exists, gracefully.</p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="ts" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">const</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4FC1FF;--shiki-light:#0070C1"> models</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> = </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#C586C0;--shiki-light:#AF00DB">await</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080"> vscode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">lm</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">selectChatModels</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">({ </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">family:</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515"> 'gpt-3.5-turbo'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#C586C0;--shiki-light:#AF00DB">if</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> (</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">models</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">length</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> > </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#B5CEA8;--shiki-light:#098658">0</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">    const</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> [</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4FC1FF;--shiki-light:#0070C1">first</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">] = </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">models</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">    const</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4FC1FF;--shiki-light:#0070C1"> response</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> = </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#C586C0;--shiki-light:#AF00DB">await</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080"> first</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">sendRequest</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(...)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#6A9955;--shiki-light:#008000">    // ...</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">} </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#C586C0;--shiki-light:#AF00DB">else</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#6A9955;--shiki-light:#008000">    // NO chat models available</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">}</span></span></code></pre>
<p>A selector can be written to broadly match all models of a given vendor or family, or it can narrowly select one model by ID.
Keep in mind that the available set of models will change over time, but also that prompts may perform differently in
different models.</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that extensions can hold on to the results returned by this function and use them later. However, when the
<a href="#lm.onDidChangeChatModels">onDidChangeChatModels</a>-event is fired the list of chat models might have changed and extensions should re-query.</p>
</div>

<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">selector</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#LanguageModelChatSelector">LanguageModelChatSelector</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A chat model selector. When omitted all chat models are returned.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#LanguageModelChat">LanguageModelChat</a>[]&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>An array of chat models, can be empty!</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

## notebooks



<div class="comment"><p>Namespace for notebooks.</p>
<p>The notebooks functionality is composed of three loosely coupled components:</p>
<ol>
<li><a href="#NotebookSerializer">NotebookSerializer</a> enable the editor to open, show, and save notebooks</li>
<li><a href="#NotebookController">NotebookController</a> own the execution of notebooks, e.g they create output from code cells.</li>
<li>NotebookRenderer present notebook output in the editor. They run in a separate context.</li>
</ol>
</div>

#### Functions



<a name="notebooks.createNotebookController"></a><span class="ts" id=3939 data-target="#details-3939" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">createNotebookController</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">id</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">notebookType</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">label</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">handler</span><span>?</span><span>: </span>(cells: <a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookCell">NotebookCell</a>[], notebook: <a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookDocument">NotebookDocument</a>, controller: <a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookController">NotebookController</a>) =&gt; <span class="type-intrinsic">void</span> &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;<span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookController">NotebookController</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3939">
<div class="comment"><p>Creates a new notebook controller.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">id</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Identifier of the controller. Must be unique per extension.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">notebookType</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A notebook type for which this controller is for.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">label</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The label of the controller.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">handler</span><span>?</span><span>: </span>(cells: <a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookCell">NotebookCell</a>[], notebook: <a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookDocument">NotebookDocument</a>, controller: <a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookController">NotebookController</a>) =&gt; <span class="type-intrinsic">void</span> &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>The execute-handler of the controller.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookController">NotebookController</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A new notebook controller.</p>
</div></td></tr>

</div>
</div>

## window



<div class="comment"><p>Namespace for dealing with the current window of the editor. That is visible

#### Variables



<a name="window.activeColorTheme"></a><span class="ts" id=2895 data-target="#details-2895" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">activeColorTheme</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ColorTheme">ColorTheme</a></span>

<div class="comment"><p>The currently active color theme as configured in the settings. The active
theme can be changed via the <code>workbench.colorTheme</code> setting.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="window.activeNotebookEditor"></a><span class="ts" id=2880 data-target="#details-2880" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">activeNotebookEditor</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookEditor">NotebookEditor</a> &#124; <span class="type-intrinsic">undefined</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2880">
<div class="comment"><p>The currently active <a href="#NotebookEditor">notebook editor</a> or <code>undefined</code>. The active editor is the one
that currently has focus or, when none has focus, the one that has changed
input most recently.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="window.activeTerminal"></a><span class="ts" id=2885 data-target="#details-2885" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">activeTerminal</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Terminal">Terminal</a> &#124; <span class="type-intrinsic">undefined</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2885">
<div class="comment"><p>The currently active terminal or <code>undefined</code>. The active terminal is the one that
currently has focus or most recently had focus.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="window.activeTextEditor"></a><span class="ts" id=2870 data-target="#details-2870" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">activeTextEditor</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextEditor">TextEditor</a> &#124; <span class="type-intrinsic">undefined</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2870">
<div class="comment"><p>The currently active editor or <code>undefined</code>. The active editor is the one
that currently has focus or, when none has focus, the one that has changed
input most recently.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="window.state"></a><span class="ts" id=2893 data-target="#details-2893" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">state</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#WindowState">WindowState</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2893">
<div class="comment"><p>Represents the current window&#39;s state.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="window.tabGroups"></a><span class="ts" id=2869 data-target="#details-2869" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">tabGroups</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TabGroups">TabGroups</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2869">
<div class="comment"><p>Represents the grid widget within the main editor area</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="window.terminals"></a><span class="ts" id=2884 data-target="#details-2884" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">terminals</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#Terminal">Terminal</a>[]</span>

</div>
</div>



<a name="window.visibleNotebookEditors"></a><span class="ts" id=2878 data-target="#details-2878" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">visibleNotebookEditors</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookEditor">NotebookEditor</a>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2878">
<div class="comment"><p>The currently visible <a href="#NotebookEditor">notebook editors</a> or an empty array.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="window.visibleTextEditors"></a><span class="ts" id=2871 data-target="#details-2871" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">visibleTextEditors</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#TextEditor">TextEditor</a>[]</span>

</div>
</div>

<a name="window.onDidChangeActiveColorTheme"></a><span class="ts" id=2896 data-target="#details-2896" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeActiveColorTheme</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#ColorTheme">ColorTheme</a>&gt;</span>

</div>
</div>



<a name="window.onDidChangeActiveNotebookEditor"></a><span class="ts" id=2881 data-target="#details-2881" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeActiveNotebookEditor</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookEditor">NotebookEditor</a> &#124; <span class="type-intrinsic">undefined</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2881">
<div class="comment"><p>An <a href="#Event">Event</a> which fires when the <a href="#window.activeNotebookEditor">active notebook editor</a>
has changed. <em>Note</em> that the event also fires when the active editor changes
to <code>undefined</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="window.onDidChangeActiveTerminal"></a><span class="ts" id=2886 data-target="#details-2886" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeActiveTerminal</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#Terminal">Terminal</a> &#124; <span class="type-intrinsic">undefined</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2886">
<div class="comment"><p>An <a href="#Event">Event</a> which fires when the <a href="#window.activeTerminal">active terminal</a>
has changed. <em>Note</em> that the event also fires when the active terminal changes
to <code>undefined</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="window.onDidChangeActiveTextEditor"></a><span class="ts" id=2872 data-target="#details-2872" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeActiveTextEditor</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#TextEditor">TextEditor</a> &#124; <span class="type-intrinsic">undefined</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2872">
<div class="comment"><p>An <a href="#Event">Event</a> which fires when the <a href="#window.activeTextEditor">active editor</a>
has changed. <em>Note</em> that the event also fires when the active editor changes
to <code>undefined</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="window.onDidChangeNotebookEditorSelection"></a><span class="ts" id=2882 data-target="#details-2882" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeNotebookEditorSelection</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookEditorSelectionChangeEvent">NotebookEditorSelectionChangeEvent</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2882">
<div class="comment"><p>An <a href="#Event">Event</a> which fires when the <a href="#NotebookEditor.selections">notebook editor selections</a>
have changed.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="window.onDidChangeNotebookEditorVisibleRanges"></a><span class="ts" id=2883 data-target="#details-2883" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeNotebookEditorVisibleRanges</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookEditorVisibleRangesChangeEvent">NotebookEditorVisibleRangesChangeEvent</a>&gt;</span>

</div>



<a name="window.onDidChangeTerminalShellIntegration"></a><span class="ts" id=2890 data-target="#details-2890" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeTerminalShellIntegration</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#TerminalShellIntegrationChangeEvent">TerminalShellIntegrationChangeEvent</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2890">
<div class="comment"><p>Fires when shell integration activates or one of its properties changes in a terminal.</p>

<a name="window.onDidChangeTerminalState"></a><span class="ts" id=2889 data-target="#details-2889" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeTerminalState</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#Terminal">Terminal</a>&gt;</span>

</div>



<a name="window.onDidChangeTextEditorOptions"></a><span class="ts" id=2876 data-target="#details-2876" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeTextEditorOptions</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#TextEditorOptionsChangeEvent">TextEditorOptionsChangeEvent</a>&gt;</span>

<div class="comment"><p>An <a href="#Event">Event</a> which fires when the options of an editor have changed.</p>

</div>



<a name="window.onDidChangeTextEditorSelection"></a><span class="ts" id=2874 data-target="#details-2874" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeTextEditorSelection</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#TextEditorSelectionChangeEvent">TextEditorSelectionChangeEvent</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2874">
<div class="comment"><p>An <a href="#Event">Event</a> which fires when the selection in an editor has changed.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="window.onDidChangeTextEditorViewColumn"></a><span class="ts" id=2877 data-target="#details-2877" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeTextEditorViewColumn</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#TextEditorViewColumnChangeEvent">TextEditorViewColumnChangeEvent</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2877">
<div class="comment"><p>An <a href="#Event">Event</a> which fires when the view column of an editor has changed.</p>

<a name="window.onDidChangeTextEditorVisibleRanges"></a><span class="ts" id=2875 data-target="#details-2875" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeTextEditorVisibleRanges</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#TextEditorVisibleRangesChangeEvent">TextEditorVisibleRangesChangeEvent</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2875">
<div class="comment"><p>An <a href="#Event">Event</a> which fires when the visible ranges of an editor has changed.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="window.onDidChangeVisibleNotebookEditors"></a><span class="ts" id=2879 data-target="#details-2879" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeVisibleNotebookEditors</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookEditor">NotebookEditor</a>[]&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2879">

<a name="window.onDidChangeVisibleTextEditors"></a><span class="ts" id=2873 data-target="#details-2873" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeVisibleTextEditors</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#TextEditor">TextEditor</a>[]&gt;</span>

<div class="comment"><p>An <a href="#Event">Event</a> which fires when the array of <a href="#window.visibleTextEditors">visible editors</a>

<a name="window.onDidChangeWindowState"></a><span class="ts" id=2894 data-target="#details-2894" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeWindowState</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#WindowState">WindowState</a>&gt;</span>

<div class="comment"><p>An <a href="#Event">Event</a> which fires when the focus or activity state of the current window
changes. The value of the event represents whether the window is focused.</p>

<a name="window.onDidCloseTerminal"></a><span class="ts" id=2888 data-target="#details-2888" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidCloseTerminal</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#Terminal">Terminal</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2888">
<div class="comment"><p>An <a href="#Event">Event</a> which fires when a terminal is disposed.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="window.onDidEndTerminalShellExecution"></a><span class="ts" id=2892 data-target="#details-2892" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidEndTerminalShellExecution</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#TerminalShellExecutionEndEvent">TerminalShellExecutionEndEvent</a>&gt;</span>

</div>
</div>



<a name="window.onDidOpenTerminal"></a><span class="ts" id=2887 data-target="#details-2887" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidOpenTerminal</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#Terminal">Terminal</a>&gt;</span>

<a href="#window.createTerminal">createTerminal</a> API or commands.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="window.onDidStartTerminalShellExecution"></a><span class="ts" id=2891 data-target="#details-2891" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidStartTerminalShellExecution</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#TerminalShellExecutionStartEvent">TerminalShellExecutionStartEvent</a>&gt;</span>

<div class="comment"><p>This will be fired when a terminal command is started. This event will fire only when

</div>
</div>

#### Functions



<a name="window.createInputBox"></a><span class="ts" id=2761 data-target="#details-2761" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">createInputBox</span><span>(</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#InputBox">InputBox</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2761">
<div class="comment"><p>Creates a <a href="#InputBox">InputBox</a> to let the user enter some text input.</p>
<p>Note that in many cases the more convenient <a href="#window.showInputBox">window.showInputBox</a> is easier to use.
<a href="#window.createInputBox">window.createInputBox</a> should be used when <a href="#window.showInputBox">window.showInputBox</a> does not offer
the required flexibility.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#InputBox">InputBox</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A new <a href="#InputBox">InputBox</a>.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="window.createOutputChannel"></a><span class="ts" id=2763 data-target="#details-2763" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">createOutputChannel</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">name</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">languageId</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#OutputChannel">OutputChannel</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2763">
<div class="comment"><p>Creates a new <a href="#OutputChannel">output channel</a> with the given name and language id
If language id is not provided, then <strong>Log</strong> is used as default language id.</p>
<p>You can access the visible or active output channel as a <a href="#TextDocument">text document</a> from <a href="#window.visibleTextEditors">visible editors</a> or <a href="#window.activeTextEditor">active editor</a>
and use the language id to contribute language features like syntax coloring, code lens etc.,</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">name</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Human-readable string which will be used to represent the channel in the UI.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">languageId</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The identifier of the language associated with the channel.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#OutputChannel">OutputChannel</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A new output channel.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="window.createOutputChannel"></a><span class="ts" id=2766 data-target="#details-2766" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">createOutputChannel</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">name</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">options</span><span>: </span>{log: <span class="type-literal">true</span>}<span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#LogOutputChannel">LogOutputChannel</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2766">

</div>

<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">name</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Human-readable string which will be used to represent the channel in the UI.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">options</span><span>: </span>{log: <span class="type-literal">true</span>}</td><td><div class="comment"><p>Options for the log output channel.</p>

<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#LogOutputChannel">LogOutputChannel</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A new log output channel.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="window.createQuickPick"></a><span class="ts" id=2758 data-target="#details-2758" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">createQuickPick</span><span>&lt;</span>T extends <a class="type-ref" href="#QuickPickItem">QuickPickItem</a><span>&gt;</span><span>(</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#QuickPick&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">QuickPick</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt;</span>

<a href="#window.createQuickPick">window.createQuickPick</a> should be used when <a href="#window.showQuickPick">window.showQuickPick</a> does not offer
the required flexibility.</p>

</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="window.createStatusBarItem"></a><span class="ts" id=2809 data-target="#details-2809" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">createStatusBarItem</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">id</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">alignment</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#StatusBarAlignment">StatusBarAlignment</a>, <span class="ident">priority</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#StatusBarItem">StatusBarItem</a></span>

<a name="window.createTerminal"></a><span class="ts" id=2817 data-target="#details-2817" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">createTerminal</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">name</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">shellPath</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">shellArgs</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; readonly <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>[]<span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Terminal">Terminal</a></span>

</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">shellPath</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Optional path to a custom shell executable to be used in the terminal.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">shellArgs</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; readonly <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>[]</td><td><div class="comment"><p>Optional args for the custom shell executable. A string can be used on Windows only which

<a href="https://msdn.microsoft.com/en-au/08dfcab2-eb6e-49a4-80eb-87d4076c98c6">command-line format</a>.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#Terminal">Terminal</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A new Terminal.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

<a name="window.registerCustomEditorProvider"></a><span class="ts" id=2852 data-target="#details-2852" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">registerCustomEditorProvider</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">viewType</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">provider</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CustomTextEditorProvider">CustomTextEditorProvider</a> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#CustomReadonlyEditorProvider&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">CustomReadonlyEditorProvider</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#CustomDocument">CustomDocument</a>&gt; &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#CustomEditorProvider&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">CustomEditorProvider</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#CustomDocument">CustomDocument</a>&gt;, <span class="ident">options</span><span>?</span><span>: </span>{supportsMultipleEditorsPerDocument: <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>, webviewOptions: <a class="type-ref" href="#WebviewPanelOptions">WebviewPanelOptions</a>}<span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2852">
<div class="comment"><p>Register a provider for custom editors for the <code>viewType</code> contributed by the <code>customEditors</code> extension point.</p>
<p>When a custom editor is opened, an <code>onCustomEditor:viewType</code> activation event is fired. Your extension
must register a <a href="#CustomTextEditorProvider">CustomTextEditorProvider</a>, <a href="#CustomReadonlyEditorProvider">CustomReadonlyEditorProvider</a>,
<a href="#CustomEditorProvider">CustomEditorProvider</a>for <code>viewType</code> as part of activation.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">viewType</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Unique identifier for the custom editor provider. This should match the <code>viewType</code> from the
  <code>customEditors</code> contribution point.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">provider</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CustomTextEditorProvider">CustomTextEditorProvider</a> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#CustomReadonlyEditorProvider&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">CustomReadonlyEditorProvider</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#CustomDocument">CustomDocument</a>&gt; &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#CustomEditorProvider&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">CustomEditorProvider</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#CustomDocument">CustomDocument</a>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>Provider that resolves custom editors.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">options</span><span>?</span><span>: </span>{supportsMultipleEditorsPerDocument: <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>, webviewOptions: <a class="type-ref" href="#WebviewPanelOptions">WebviewPanelOptions</a>}</td><td><div class="comment"><p>Options for the provider.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Disposable that unregisters the provider.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

<a name="window.registerTreeDataProvider"></a><span class="ts" id=2826 data-target="#details-2826" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">registerTreeDataProvider</span><span>&lt;</span>T<span>&gt;</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">viewId</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">treeDataProvider</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TreeDataProvider&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">TreeDataProvider</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt;<span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></span>

This will allow you to contribute data to the <a href="#TreeView">TreeView</a> and update if the data changes.</p>

</div>

</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">treeDataProvider</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TreeDataProvider&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">TreeDataProvider</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A <a href="#TreeDataProvider">TreeDataProvider</a> that provides tree data for the view</p>
</div></td></tr>

</div></td></tr>

</div>

<a name="window.registerUriHandler"></a><span class="ts" id=2836 data-target="#details-2836" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">registerUriHandler</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">handler</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#UriHandler">UriHandler</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2836">
<div class="comment"><p>Registers a <a href="#UriHandler">uri handler</a> capable of handling system-wide <a href="#Uri">uris</a>.
In case there are multiple windows open, the topmost window will handle the uri.
A uri handler is scoped to the extension it is contributed from; it will only
be able to handle uris which are directed to the extension itself. A uri must respect
the following rules:</p>
<ul>
<li>The uri-scheme must be <code>vscode.env.uriScheme</code>;</li>
<li>The uri-authority must be the extension id (e.g. <code>my.extension</code>);</li>
<li>The uri-path, -query and -fragment parts are arbitrary.</li>
</ul>
<p>For example, if the <code>my.extension</code> extension registers a uri handler, it will only
be allowed to handle uris with the prefix <code>product-name://my.extension</code>.</p>
<p>An extension can only register a single uri handler in its entire activation lifetime.</p>
<ul>
<li><em>Note:</em> There is an activation event <code>onUri</code> that fires when a uri directed for
the current extension is about to be handled.</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">handler</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#UriHandler">UriHandler</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The uri handler to register for this extension.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A <a href="#Disposable">disposable</a> that unregisters the handler.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="window.registerWebviewPanelSerializer"></a><span class="ts" id=2839 data-target="#details-2839" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">registerWebviewPanelSerializer</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">viewType</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">serializer</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#WebviewPanelSerializer&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">WebviewPanelSerializer</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2839">
<div class="comment"><p>Registers a webview panel serializer.</p>
<p>Extensions that support reviving should have an <code>&quot;onWebviewPanel:viewType&quot;</code> activation event and
make sure that <code>registerWebviewPanelSerializer</code> is called during activation.</p>
<p>Only a single serializer may be registered at a time for a given <code>viewType</code>.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">viewType</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Type of the webview panel that can be serialized.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">serializer</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#WebviewPanelSerializer&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">WebviewPanelSerializer</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Webview serializer.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A <a href="#Disposable">disposable</a> that unregisters the serializer.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>

<a name="window.showInputBox"></a><span class="ts" id=2754 data-target="#details-2754" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">showInputBox</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">options</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#InputBoxOptions">InputBoxOptions</a>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>&gt;</span>

<p>The returned value will be <code>undefined</code> if the input box was canceled (e.g., pressing ESC). Otherwise the

anything but dismissed the input box with OK.</p>
</div>

<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A thenable that resolves to a string the user provided or to <code>undefined</code> in case of dismissal.</p>
</div></td></tr>
