<a name="window.showTextDocument"></a><span class="ts" id=2647 data-target="#details-2647" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">showTextDocument</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a>, <span class="ident">column</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ViewColumn">ViewColumn</a>, <span class="ident">preserveFocus</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#TextEditor">TextEditor</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2647">
<div class="comment"><p>Show the given document in a text editor. A <a href="#ViewColumn">column</a> can be provided
to control where the editor is being shown. Might change the <a href="#window.activeTextEditor">active editor</a>.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A text document to be shown.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">column</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ViewColumn">ViewColumn</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A view column in which the <a href="#TextEditor">editor</a> should be shown. The default is the <a href="#ViewColumn.Active">active</a>.
Columns that do not exist will be created as needed up to the maximum of <a href="#ViewColumn.Nine">ViewColumn.Nine</a>. Use <a href="#ViewColumn.Beside">ViewColumn.Beside</a>
to open the editor to the side of the currently active one.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">preserveFocus</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>When <code>true</code> the editor will not take focus.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#TextEditor">TextEditor</a>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A promise that resolves to an <a href="#TextEditor">editor</a>.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="window.showTextDocument"></a><span class="ts" id=2651 data-target="#details-2651" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">showTextDocument</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a>, <span class="ident">options</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocumentShowOptions">TextDocumentShowOptions</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#TextEditor">TextEditor</a>&gt;</span>

<tr><td><span class="ident">options</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#MessageOptions">MessageOptions</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Configures the behaviour of the message.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span>...</span><span class="ident">items</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span>[]</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A set of items that will be rendered as actions in the message.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A thenable that resolves to the selected item or <code>undefined</code> when being dismissed.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="window.showWorkspaceFolderPick"></a><span class="ts" id=2745 data-target="#details-2745" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">showWorkspaceFolderPick</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">options</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#WorkspaceFolderPickOptions">WorkspaceFolderPickOptions</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#WorkspaceFolder">WorkspaceFolder</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2745">
<div class="comment"><p>Shows a selection list of <a href="#workspace.workspaceFolders">workspace folders</a> to pick from.
Returns <code>undefined</code> if no folder is open.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">options</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#WorkspaceFolderPickOptions">WorkspaceFolderPickOptions</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Configures the behavior of the workspace folder list.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#WorkspaceFolder">WorkspaceFolder</a>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A promise that resolves to the workspace folder or <code>undefined</code>.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="window.withProgress"></a><span class="ts" id=2797 data-target="#details-2797" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">withProgress</span><span>&lt;</span>R<span>&gt;</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">options</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProgressOptions">ProgressOptions</a>, <span class="ident">task</span><span>: </span>(progress: <a class="type-ref" href="#Progress&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Progress</a>&lt;{increment: <span class="type-intrinsic">number</span>, message: <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>}&gt;, token: <a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a>) =&gt; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#R">R</a>&gt;<span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#R">R</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2797">
<div class="comment"><p>Show progress in the editor. Progress is shown while running the given callback
and while the promise it returned isn&#39;t resolved nor rejected. The location at which
progress should show (and other details) is defined via the passed <a href="#ProgressOptions">ProgressOptions</a>.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">options</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProgressOptions">ProgressOptions</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A <a href="#ProgressOptions">ProgressOptions</a>-object describing the options to use for showing progress, like its location</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">task</span><span>: </span>(progress: <a class="type-ref" href="#Progress&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Progress</a>&lt;{increment: <span class="type-intrinsic">number</span>, message: <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>}&gt;, token: <a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a>) =&gt; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#R">R</a>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A callback returning a promise. Progress state can be reported with
the provided <a href="#Progress">Progress</a>-object.</p>
<p>To report discrete progress, use <code>increment</code> to indicate how much work has been completed. Each call with
a <code>increment</code> value will be summed up and reflected as overall progress until 100% is reached (a value of
e.g. <code>10</code> accounts for <code>10%</code> of work done).
Note that currently only <code>ProgressLocation.Notification</code> is capable of showing discrete progress.</p>
<p>To monitor if the operation has been cancelled by the user, use the provided <a href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a>.
Note that currently only <code>ProgressLocation.Notification</code> is supporting to show a cancel button to cancel the
long running operation.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#R">R</a>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>The thenable the task-callback returned.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="window.withScmProgress"></a><span class="ts" id=2790 data-target="#details-2790" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">withScmProgress</span><span>&lt;</span>R<span>&gt;</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">task</span><span>: </span>(progress: <a class="type-ref" href="#Progress&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Progress</a>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">number</span>&gt;) =&gt; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#R">R</a>&gt;<span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#R">R</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2790">
<div class="comment"><p>Show progress in the Source Control viewlet while running the given callback and while
its returned promise isn&#39;t resolve or rejected.</p>
<ul>
<li><em>deprecated</em> - Use <code>withProgress</code> instead.</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">task</span><span>: </span>(progress: <a class="type-ref" href="#Progress&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Progress</a>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">number</span>&gt;) =&gt; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#R">R</a>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A callback returning a promise. Progress increments can be reported with
the provided <a href="#Progress">Progress</a>-object.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#R">R</a>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>The thenable the task did return.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

## workspace



<div class="comment"><p>Namespace for dealing with the current workspace. A workspace is the collection of one
or more folders that are opened in an editor window (instance).</p>
<p>It is also possible to open an editor without a workspace. For example, when you open a
new editor window by selecting a file from your platform&#39;s File menu, you will not be
inside a workspace. In this mode, some of the editor&#39;s capabilities are reduced but you can
still open text files and edit them.</p>
<p>Refer to <a href="https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/workspaces">https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/workspaces</a> for more information on
the concept of workspaces.</p>
<p>The workspace offers support for <a href="#workspace.createFileSystemWatcher">listening</a> to fs
events and for <a href="#workspace.findFiles">finding</a> files. Both perform well and run <em>outside</em>
the editor-process so that they should be always used instead of nodejs-equivalents.</p>
</div>

#### Variables



<a name="workspace.fs"></a><span class="ts" id=3460 data-target="#details-3460" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">fs</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#FileSystem">FileSystem</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3460">
<div class="comment"><p>A <a href="#FileSystem">file system</a> instance that allows to interact with local and remote
files, e.g. <code>vscode.workspace.fs.readDirectory(someUri)</code> allows to retrieve all entries
of a directory or <code>vscode.workspace.fs.stat(anotherUri)</code> returns the meta data for a
file.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="workspace.isTrusted"></a><span class="ts" id=3485 data-target="#details-3485" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">isTrusted</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3485">
<div class="comment"><p>When true, the user has explicitly trusted the contents of the workspace.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="workspace.name"></a><span class="ts" id=3463 data-target="#details-3463" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">name</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <span class="type-intrinsic">undefined</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3463">
<div class="comment"><p>The name of the workspace. <code>undefined</code> when no workspace
has been opened.</p>
<p>Refer to <a href="https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/workspaces">https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/workspaces</a> for more information on
the concept of workspaces.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="workspace.notebookDocuments"></a><span class="ts" id=3472 data-target="#details-3472" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">notebookDocuments</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookDocument">NotebookDocument</a>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3472">
<div class="comment"><p>All notebook documents currently known to the editor.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="workspace.rootPath"></a><span class="ts" id=3461 data-target="#details-3461" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">rootPath</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <span class="type-intrinsic">undefined</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3461">
<div class="comment"><p>The uri of the first entry of <a href="#workspace.workspaceFolders">workspaceFolders</a>
as <code>string</code>. <code>undefined</code> if there is no first entry.</p>
<p>Refer to <a href="https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/workspaces">https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/workspaces</a> for more information
on workspaces.</p>
<ul>
<li><em>deprecated</em> - Use <a href="#workspace.workspaceFolders">workspaceFolders</a> instead.</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>



<a name="workspace.textDocuments"></a><span class="ts" id=3466 data-target="#details-3466" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">textDocuments</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3466">
<div class="comment"><p>All text documents currently known to the editor.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="workspace.workspaceFile"></a><span class="ts" id=3464 data-target="#details-3464" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">workspaceFile</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a> &#124; <span class="type-intrinsic">undefined</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3464">
<div class="comment"><p>The location of the workspace file, for example:</p>
<p><code>file:///Users/name/Development/myProject.code-workspace</code></p>
<p>or</p>
<p><code>untitled:1555503116870</code></p>
<p>for a workspace that is untitled and not yet saved.</p>
<p>Depending on the workspace that is opened, the value will be:</p>
<ul>
<li><code>undefined</code> when no workspace is opened</li>
<li>the path of the workspace file as <code>Uri</code> otherwise. if the workspace
is untitled, the returned URI will use the <code>untitled:</code> scheme</li>
</ul>
<p>The location can e.g. be used with the <code>vscode.openFolder</code> command to
open the workspace again after it has been closed.</p>
<p><strong>Example:</strong></p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="typescript" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">vscode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">commands</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">executeCommand</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'vscode.openFolder'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">, </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">uriOfWorkspace</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span></code></pre>
<p>Refer to <a href="https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/workspaces">https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/workspaces</a> for more information on
the concept of workspaces.</p>
<p><strong>Note:</strong> it is not advised to use <code>workspace.workspaceFile</code> to write
configuration data into the file. You can use <code>workspace.getConfiguration().update()</code>
for that purpose which will work both when a single folder is opened as
well as an untitled or saved workspace.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="workspace.workspaceFolders"></a><span class="ts" id=3462 data-target="#details-3462" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">workspaceFolders</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#WorkspaceFolder">WorkspaceFolder</a>[] &#124; <span class="type-intrinsic">undefined</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3462">
<div class="comment"><p>List of workspace folders (0-N) that are open in the editor. <code>undefined</code> when no workspace
has been opened.</p>
<p>Refer to <a href="https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/workspaces">https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/workspaces</a> for more information
on workspaces.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Events



<a name="workspace.onDidChangeConfiguration"></a><span class="ts" id=3484 data-target="#details-3484" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeConfiguration</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#ConfigurationChangeEvent">ConfigurationChangeEvent</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3484">
<div class="comment"><p>An event that is emitted when the <a href="#WorkspaceConfiguration">configuration</a> changed.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="workspace.onDidChangeNotebookDocument"></a><span class="ts" id=3473 data-target="#details-3473" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeNotebookDocument</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookDocumentChangeEvent">NotebookDocumentChangeEvent</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3473">
<div class="comment"><p>An event that is emitted when a <a href="#NotebookDocument">notebook</a> has changed.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="workspace.onDidChangeTextDocument"></a><span class="ts" id=3469 data-target="#details-3469" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeTextDocument</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocumentChangeEvent">TextDocumentChangeEvent</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3469">
<div class="comment"><p>An event that is emitted when a <a href="#TextDocument">text document</a> is changed. This usually happens
when the <a href="#TextDocument.getText">contents</a> changes but also when other things like the
<a href="#TextDocument.isDirty">dirty</a>-state changes.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="workspace.onDidChangeWorkspaceFolders"></a><span class="ts" id=3465 data-target="#details-3465" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeWorkspaceFolders</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#WorkspaceFoldersChangeEvent">WorkspaceFoldersChangeEvent</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3465">
<div class="comment"><p>An event that is emitted when a workspace folder is added or removed.</p>
<p><strong>Note:</strong> this event will not fire if the first workspace folder is added, removed or changed,
because in that case the currently executing extensions (including the one that listens to this
event) will be terminated and restarted so that the (deprecated) <code>rootPath</code> property is updated
to point to the first workspace folder.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="workspace.onDidCloseNotebookDocument"></a><span class="ts" id=3477 data-target="#details-3477" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidCloseNotebookDocument</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookDocument">NotebookDocument</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3477">
<div class="comment"><p>An event that is emitted when a <a href="#NotebookDocument">notebook</a> is disposed.</p>
<p><em>Note 1:</em> There is no guarantee that this event fires when an editor tab is closed.</p>
<p><em>Note 2:</em> A notebook can be open but not shown in an editor which means this event can fire
for a notebook that has not been shown in an editor.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="workspace.onDidCloseTextDocument"></a><span class="ts" id=3468 data-target="#details-3468" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidCloseTextDocument</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3468">
<div class="comment"><p>An event that is emitted when a <a href="#TextDocument">text document</a> is disposed or when the language id
of a text document <a href="#languages.setTextDocumentLanguage">has been changed</a>.</p>
<p><em>Note 1:</em> There is no guarantee that this event fires when an editor tab is closed, use the
<a href="#window.onDidChangeVisibleTextEditors">onDidChangeVisibleTextEditors</a>-event to know when editors change.</p>
<p><em>Note 2:</em> A document can be open but not shown in an editor which means this event can fire
for a document that has not been shown in an editor.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="workspace.onDidCreateFiles"></a><span class="ts" id=3479 data-target="#details-3479" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidCreateFiles</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#FileCreateEvent">FileCreateEvent</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3479">
<div class="comment"><p>An event that is emitted when files have been created.</p>
<p><em>Note:</em> This event is triggered by user gestures, like creating a file from the
explorer, or from the <a href="#workspace.applyEdit">workspace.applyEdit</a>-api, but this event is <em>not</em> fired when
files change on disk, e.g triggered by another application, or when using the
<a href="#FileSystem">workspace.fs</a>-api.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="workspace.onDidDeleteFiles"></a><span class="ts" id=3481 data-target="#details-3481" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidDeleteFiles</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#FileDeleteEvent">FileDeleteEvent</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3481">
<div class="comment"><p>An event that is emitted when files have been deleted.</p>
<p><em>Note 1:</em> This event is triggered by user gestures, like deleting a file from the
explorer, or from the <a href="#workspace.applyEdit">workspace.applyEdit</a>-api, but this event is <em>not</em> fired when
files change on disk, e.g triggered by another application, or when using the
<a href="#FileSystem">workspace.fs</a>-api.</p>
<p><em>Note 2:</em> When deleting a folder with children only one event is fired.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="workspace.onDidGrantWorkspaceTrust"></a><span class="ts" id=3486 data-target="#details-3486" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidGrantWorkspaceTrust</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3486">
<div class="comment"><p>Event that fires when the current workspace has been trusted.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="workspace.onDidOpenNotebookDocument"></a><span class="ts" id=3476 data-target="#details-3476" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidOpenNotebookDocument</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookDocument">NotebookDocument</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3476">
<div class="comment"><p>An event that is emitted when a <a href="#NotebookDocument">notebook</a> is opened.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="workspace.onDidOpenTextDocument"></a><span class="ts" id=3467 data-target="#details-3467" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidOpenTextDocument</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3467">
<div class="comment"><p>An event that is emitted when a <a href="#TextDocument">text document</a> is opened or when the language id
of a text document <a href="#languages.setTextDocumentLanguage">has been changed</a>.</p>
<p>To add an event listener when a visible text document is opened, use the <a href="#TextEditor">TextEditor</a> events in the
<a href="#window">window</a> namespace. Note that:</p>
<ul>
<li>The event is emitted before the <a href="#TextDocument">document</a> is updated in the
<a href="#window.activeTextEditor">active text editor</a></li>
<li>When a <a href="#TextDocument">text document</a> is already open (e.g.: open in another <a href="#window.visibleTextEditors">visible text editor</a>) this event is not emitted</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>



<a name="workspace.onDidRenameFiles"></a><span class="ts" id=3483 data-target="#details-3483" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidRenameFiles</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#FileRenameEvent">FileRenameEvent</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3483">
<div class="comment"><p>An event that is emitted when files have been renamed.</p>
<p><em>Note 1:</em> This event is triggered by user gestures, like renaming a file from the
explorer, and from the <a href="#workspace.applyEdit">workspace.applyEdit</a>-api, but this event is <em>not</em> fired when
files change on disk, e.g triggered by another application, or when using the
<a href="#FileSystem">workspace.fs</a>-api.</p>
<p><em>Note 2:</em> When renaming a folder with children only one event is fired.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="workspace.onDidSaveNotebookDocument"></a><span class="ts" id=3475 data-target="#details-3475" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidSaveNotebookDocument</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookDocument">NotebookDocument</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3475">
<div class="comment"><p>An event that is emitted when a <a href="#NotebookDocument">notebook</a> is saved.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="workspace.onDidSaveTextDocument"></a><span class="ts" id=3471 data-target="#details-3471" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidSaveTextDocument</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3471">
<div class="comment"><p>An event that is emitted when a <a href="#TextDocument">text document</a> is saved to disk.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="workspace.onWillCreateFiles"></a><span class="ts" id=3478 data-target="#details-3478" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onWillCreateFiles</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#FileWillCreateEvent">FileWillCreateEvent</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3478">
<div class="comment"><p>An event that is emitted when files are being created.</p>
<p><em>Note 1:</em> This event is triggered by user gestures, like creating a file from the
explorer, or from the <a href="#workspace.applyEdit">workspace.applyEdit</a>-api. This event is <em>not</em> fired when
files change on disk, e.g triggered by another application, or when using the
<a href="#FileSystem">workspace.fs</a>-api.</p>
<p><em>Note 2:</em> When this event is fired, edits to files that are are being created cannot be applied.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="workspace.onWillDeleteFiles"></a><span class="ts" id=3480 data-target="#details-3480" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onWillDeleteFiles</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#FileWillDeleteEvent">FileWillDeleteEvent</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3480">
<div class="comment"><p>An event that is emitted when files are being deleted.</p>
<p><em>Note 1:</em> This event is triggered by user gestures, like deleting a file from the
explorer, or from the <a href="#workspace.applyEdit">workspace.applyEdit</a>-api, but this event is <em>not</em> fired when
files change on disk, e.g triggered by another application, or when using the
<a href="#FileSystem">workspace.fs</a>-api.</p>
<p><em>Note 2:</em> When deleting a folder with children only one event is fired.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="workspace.onWillRenameFiles"></a><span class="ts" id=3482 data-target="#details-3482" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onWillRenameFiles</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#FileWillRenameEvent">FileWillRenameEvent</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3482">
<div class="comment"><p>An event that is emitted when files are being renamed.</p>
<p><em>Note 1:</em> This event is triggered by user gestures, like renaming a file from the
explorer, and from the <a href="#workspace.applyEdit">workspace.applyEdit</a>-api, but this event is <em>not</em> fired when
files change on disk, e.g triggered by another application, or when using the
<a href="#FileSystem">workspace.fs</a>-api.</p>
<p><em>Note 2:</em> When renaming a folder with children only one event is fired.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="workspace.onWillSaveNotebookDocument"></a><span class="ts" id=3474 data-target="#details-3474" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onWillSaveNotebookDocument</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookDocumentWillSaveEvent">NotebookDocumentWillSaveEvent</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3474">
<div class="comment"><p>An event that is emitted when a <a href="#NotebookDocument">notebook document</a> will be saved to disk.</p>
<p><em>Note 1:</em> Subscribers can delay saving by registering asynchronous work. For the sake of data integrity the editor
might save without firing this event. For instance when shutting down with dirty files.</p>
<p><em>Note 2:</em> Subscribers are called sequentially and they can <a href="#NotebookDocumentWillSaveEvent.waitUntil">delay</a> saving
by registering asynchronous work. Protection against misbehaving listeners is implemented as such:</p>
<ul>
<li>there is an overall time budget that all listeners share and if that is exhausted no further listener is called</li>
<li>listeners that take a long time or produce errors frequently will not be called anymore</li>
</ul>
<p>The current thresholds are 1.5 seconds as overall time budget and a listener can misbehave 3 times before being ignored.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="workspace.onWillSaveTextDocument"></a><span class="ts" id=3470 data-target="#details-3470" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onWillSaveTextDocument</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocumentWillSaveEvent">TextDocumentWillSaveEvent</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3470">
<div class="comment"><p>An event that is emitted when a <a href="#TextDocument">text document</a> will be saved to disk.</p>
<p><em>Note 1:</em> Subscribers can delay saving by registering asynchronous work. For the sake of data integrity the editor
might save without firing this event. For instance when shutting down with dirty files.</p>
<p><em>Note 2:</em> Subscribers are called sequentially and they can <a href="#TextDocumentWillSaveEvent.waitUntil">delay</a> saving
by registering asynchronous work. Protection against misbehaving listeners is implemented as such:</p>
<ul>
<li>there is an overall time budget that all listeners share and if that is exhausted no further listener is called</li>
<li>listeners that take a long time or produce errors frequently will not be called anymore</li>
</ul>
<p>The current thresholds are 1.5 seconds as overall time budget and a listener can misbehave 3 times before being ignored.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Functions



<a name="workspace.applyEdit"></a><span class="ts" id=3383 data-target="#details-3383" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">applyEdit</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">edit</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#WorkspaceEdit">WorkspaceEdit</a>, <span class="ident">metadata</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#WorkspaceEditMetadata">WorkspaceEditMetadata</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3383">
<div class="comment"><p>Make changes to one or many resources or create, delete, and rename resources as defined by the given
<a href="#WorkspaceEdit">workspace edit</a>.</p>
<p>All changes of a workspace edit are applied in the same order in which they have been added. If
multiple textual inserts are made at the same position, these strings appear in the resulting text
in the order the &#39;inserts&#39; were made, unless that are interleaved with resource edits. Invalid sequences
like &#39;delete file a&#39; -&gt; &#39;insert text in file a&#39; cause failure of the operation.</p>
<p>When applying a workspace edit that consists only of text edits an &#39;all-or-nothing&#39;-strategy is used.
A workspace edit with resource creations or deletions aborts the operation, e.g. consecutive edits will
not be attempted, when a single edit fails.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">edit</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#WorkspaceEdit">WorkspaceEdit</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A workspace edit.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">metadata</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#WorkspaceEditMetadata">WorkspaceEditMetadata</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Optional <a href="#WorkspaceEditMetadata">metadata</a> for the edit.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A thenable that resolves when the edit could be applied.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="workspace.asRelativePath"></a><span class="ts" id=3350 data-target="#details-3350" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">asRelativePath</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">pathOrUri</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a>, <span class="ident">includeWorkspaceFolder</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3350">
<div class="comment"><p>Returns a path that is relative to the workspace folder or folders.</p>
<p>When there are no <a href="#workspace.workspaceFolders">workspace folders</a> or when the path
is not contained in them, the input is returned.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">pathOrUri</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A path or uri. When a uri is given its <a href="#Uri.fsPath">fsPath</a> is used.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">includeWorkspaceFolder</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>When <code>true</code> and when the given path is contained inside a
workspace folder the name of the workspace is prepended. Defaults to <code>true</code> when there are
multiple workspace folders and <code>false</code> otherwise.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A path relative to the root or the input.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="workspace.createFileSystemWatcher"></a><span class="ts" id=3362 data-target="#details-3362" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">createFileSystemWatcher</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">globPattern</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#GlobPattern">GlobPattern</a>, <span class="ident">ignoreCreateEvents</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>, <span class="ident">ignoreChangeEvents</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>, <span class="ident">ignoreDeleteEvents</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#FileSystemWatcher">FileSystemWatcher</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3362">
<div class="comment"><p>Creates a file system watcher that is notified on file events (create, change, delete)
depending on the parameters provided.</p>
<p>By default, all opened <a href="#workspace.workspaceFolders">workspace folders</a> will be watched
for file changes recursively.</p>
<p>Additional paths can be added for file watching by providing a <a href="#RelativePattern">RelativePattern</a> with
a <code>base</code> path to watch. If the path is a folder and the <code>pattern</code> is complex (e.g. contains
<code>**</code> or path segments), it will be watched recursively and otherwise will be watched
non-recursively (i.e. only changes to the first level of the path will be reported).</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that paths that do not exist in the file system will be monitored with a delay until
created and then watched depending on the parameters provided. If a watched path is deleted,
the watcher will suspend and not report any events until the path is created again.</p>
<p>If possible, keep the use of recursive watchers to a minimum because recursive file watching
is quite resource intense.</p>
<p>Providing a <code>string</code> as <code>globPattern</code> acts as convenience method for watching file events in
all opened workspace folders. It cannot be used to add more folders for file watching, nor will
it report any file events from folders that are not part of the opened workspace folders.</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that case-sensitivity of the <a href="#workspace.createFileSystemWatcher.globPattern">globPattern</a> parameter will depend on the file system
where the watcher is running: on Windows and macOS the matching will be case-insensitive and
on Linux it will be case-sensitive.</p>
<p>Optionally, flags to ignore certain kinds of events can be provided.</p>
<p>To stop listening to events the watcher must be disposed.</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that file events from deleting a folder may not include events for the contained files.
For example, when a folder is moved to the trash, only one event is reported because technically
this is a rename/move operation and not a delete operation for each files within.
On top of that, performance optimizations are in place to fold multiple events that all belong
to the same parent operation (e.g. delete folder) into one event for that parent. As such, if
you need to know about all deleted files, you have to watch with <code>**</code> and deal with all file
events yourself.</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that file events from recursive file watchers may be excluded based on user configuration.
The setting <code>files.watcherExclude</code> helps to reduce the overhead of file events from folders
that are known to produce many file changes at once (such as <code>.git</code> folders). As such,
it is highly recommended to watch with simple patterns that do not require recursive watchers
where the exclude settings are ignored and you have full control over the events.</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that symbolic links are not automatically followed for file watching unless the path to
watch itself is a symbolic link.</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that the file paths that are reported for having changed may have a different path casing
compared to the actual casing on disk on case-insensitive platforms (typically macOS and Windows
but not Linux). We allow a user to open a workspace folder with any desired path casing and try
to preserve that. This means:</p>
<ul>
<li>if the path is within any of the workspace folders, the path will match the casing of the
workspace folder up to that portion of the path and match the casing on disk for children</li>
<li>if the path is outside of any of the workspace folders, the casing will match the case of the
path that was provided for watching
In the same way, symbolic links are preserved, i.e. the file event will report the path of the
symbolic link as it was provided for watching and not the target.</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="examples">Examples</h3>
<p>The basic anatomy of a file watcher is as follows:</p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="ts" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">const</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4FC1FF;--shiki-light:#0070C1"> watcher</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> = </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">vscode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">workspace</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">createFileSystemWatcher</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">new</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080"> vscode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">RelativePattern</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(&#x3C;</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0;--shiki-light:#267F99">folder</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">>, &#x3C;</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0;--shiki-light:#267F99">pattern</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">>));</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">watcher</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">onDidChange</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">uri</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF"> =></span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> { ... }); </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#6A9955;--shiki-light:#008000">// listen to files being changed</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">watcher</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">onDidCreate</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">uri</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF"> =></span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> { ... }); </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#6A9955;--shiki-light:#008000">// listen to files/folders being created</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">watcher</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">onDidDelete</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">uri</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF"> =></span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> { ... }); </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#6A9955;--shiki-light:#008000">// listen to files/folders getting deleted</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">watcher</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">dispose</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(); </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#6A9955;--shiki-light:#008000">// dispose after usage</span></span></code></pre>
<h4 id="workspace-file-watching">Workspace file watching</h4>
<p>If you only care about file events in a specific workspace folder:</p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="ts" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">vscode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">workspace</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">createFileSystemWatcher</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">  new</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080"> vscode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">RelativePattern</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">vscode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">workspace</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">workspaceFolders</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">[</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#B5CEA8;--shiki-light:#098658">0</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">], </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'**/*.js'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span></code></pre>
<p>If you want to monitor file events across all opened workspace folders:</p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="ts" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">vscode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">workspace</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">createFileSystemWatcher</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'**/*.js'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span></code></pre>
<p><em>Note:</em> the array of workspace folders can be empty if no workspace is opened (empty window).</p>
<h4 id="out-of-workspace-file-watching">Out of workspace file watching</h4>
<p>To watch a folder for changes to *.js files outside the workspace (non recursively), pass in a <code>Uri</code> to such
a folder:</p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="ts" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">vscode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">workspace</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">createFileSystemWatcher</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">new</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080"> vscode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">RelativePattern</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">vscode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">Uri</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">file</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(&#x3C;</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0;--shiki-light:#267F99">path</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0;--shiki-light:#267F99"> to</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0;--shiki-light:#267F99"> folder</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0;--shiki-light:#267F99"> outside</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0;--shiki-light:#267F99"> workspace</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">>), </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'*.js'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">));</span></span></code></pre>
<p>And use a complex glob pattern to watch recursively:</p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="ts" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">vscode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">workspace</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">createFileSystemWatcher</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">new</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080"> vscode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">RelativePattern</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">vscode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">Uri</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">file</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(&#x3C;</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0;--shiki-light:#267F99">path</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0;--shiki-light:#267F99"> to</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0;--shiki-light:#267F99"> folder</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0;--shiki-light:#267F99"> outside</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0;--shiki-light:#267F99"> workspace</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">>), </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'**/*.js'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">));</span></span></code></pre>
<p>Here is an example for watching the active editor for file changes:</p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="ts" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">vscode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">workspace</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">createFileSystemWatcher</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">  new</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080"> vscode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">RelativePattern</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">vscode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">window</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">activeTextEditor</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">document</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">uri</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">, </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'*'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span></code></pre>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">globPattern</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#GlobPattern">GlobPattern</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A <a href="#GlobPattern">glob pattern</a> that controls which file events the watcher should report.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">ignoreCreateEvents</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Ignore when files have been created.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">ignoreChangeEvents</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Ignore when files have been changed.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">ignoreDeleteEvents</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Ignore when files have been deleted.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#FileSystemWatcher">FileSystemWatcher</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A new file system watcher instance. Must be disposed when no longer needed.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>

<a name="workspace.decode"></a><span class="ts" id=3435 data-target="#details-3435" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">decode</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">content</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref-ts">Uint8Array</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3435">
<div class="comment"><p>Decodes the content from a <code>Uint8Array</code> to a <code>string</code>. You MUST
provide the entire content at once to ensure that the encoding
can properly apply. Do not use this method to decode content
in chunks, as that may lead to incorrect results.</p>
<p>Will pick an encoding based on settings and the content of the
buffer (for example byte order marks).</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that if you decode content that is unsupported by the
encoding, the result may contain substitution characters as
appropriate.</p>
<ul>
<li><em>throws</em> - This method will throw an error when the content is binary.</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">content</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref-ts">Uint8Array</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The text content to decode as a <code>Uint8Array</code>.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A thenable that resolves to the decoded <code>string</code>.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">options</span><span>: </span>{encoding: <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>}</td><td><div class="comment"><p>Additional context for picking the encoding.</p>
