<a name="workspace.findFiles"></a><span class="ts" id=3368 data-target="#details-3368" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">findFiles</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">include</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#GlobPattern">GlobPattern</a>, <span class="ident">exclude</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#GlobPattern">GlobPattern</a>, <span class="ident">maxResults</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a>[]&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3368">
<div class="comment"><p>Find files across all <a href="#workspace.workspaceFolders">workspace folders</a> in the workspace.</p>
<p><strong>Example</strong></p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="ts" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">findFiles</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'**/*.js'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">, </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'**/node_modules/**'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">, </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#B5CEA8;--shiki-light:#098658">10</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span></code></pre>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">include</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#GlobPattern">GlobPattern</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A <a href="#GlobPattern">glob pattern</a> that defines the files to search for. The glob pattern
will be matched against the file paths of resulting matches relative to their workspace. Use a <a href="#RelativePattern">relative pattern</a>
to restrict the search results to a <a href="#WorkspaceFolder">workspace folder</a>.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">exclude</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#GlobPattern">GlobPattern</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A <a href="#GlobPattern">glob pattern</a> that defines files and folders to exclude. The glob pattern
will be matched against the file paths of resulting matches relative to their workspace. When <code>undefined</code>, default file-excludes (e.g. the <code>files.exclude</code>-setting
but not <code>search.exclude</code>) will apply. When <code>null</code>, no excludes will apply.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">maxResults</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>An upper-bound for the result.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A token that can be used to signal cancellation to the underlying search engine.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a>[]&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A thenable that resolves to an array of resource identifiers. Will return no results if no
<a href="#workspace.workspaceFolders">workspace folders</a> are opened.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="workspace.getConfiguration"></a><span class="ts" id=3419 data-target="#details-3419" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">getConfiguration</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">section</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">scope</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ConfigurationScope">ConfigurationScope</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#WorkspaceConfiguration">WorkspaceConfiguration</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3419">
<div class="comment"><p>Get a workspace configuration object.</p>
<p>When a section-identifier is provided only that part of the configuration
is returned. Dots in the section-identifier are interpreted as child-access,
like <code>{ myExt: { setting: { doIt: true }}}</code> and <code>getConfiguration(&#39;myExt.setting&#39;).get(&#39;doIt&#39;) === true</code>.</p>
<p>When a scope is provided configuration confined to that scope is returned. Scope can be a resource or a language identifier or both.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">section</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A dot-separated identifier.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">scope</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ConfigurationScope">ConfigurationScope</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A scope for which the configuration is asked for.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#WorkspaceConfiguration">WorkspaceConfiguration</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The full configuration or a subset.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="workspace.getWorkspaceFolder"></a><span class="ts" id=3347 data-target="#details-3347" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">getWorkspaceFolder</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">uri</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#WorkspaceFolder">WorkspaceFolder</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3347">
<div class="comment"><p>Returns the <a href="#WorkspaceFolder">workspace folder</a> that contains a given uri.</p>
<ul>
<li>returns <code>undefined</code> when the given uri doesn&#39;t match any workspace folder</li>
<li>returns the <em>input</em> when the given uri is a workspace folder itself</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">uri</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>An uri.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#WorkspaceFolder">WorkspaceFolder</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A workspace folder or <code>undefined</code></p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="workspace.openNotebookDocument"></a><span class="ts" id=3408 data-target="#details-3408" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">openNotebookDocument</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">uri</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookDocument">NotebookDocument</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3408">
<div class="comment"><p>Open a notebook. Will return early if this notebook is already <a href="#workspace.notebookDocuments">loaded</a>. Otherwise
the notebook is loaded and the <a href="#workspace.onDidOpenNotebookDocument">onDidOpenNotebookDocument</a>-event fires.</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that the lifecycle of the returned notebook is owned by the editor and not by the extension. That means an
<a href="#workspace.onDidCloseNotebookDocument">onDidCloseNotebookDocument</a>-event can occur at any time after.</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that opening a notebook does not show a notebook editor. This function only returns a notebook document which
can be shown in a notebook editor but it can also be used for other things.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">uri</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The resource to open.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookDocument">NotebookDocument</a>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A promise that resolves to a <a href="#NotebookDocument">notebook</a></p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="workspace.openNotebookDocument"></a><span class="ts" id=3410 data-target="#details-3410" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">openNotebookDocument</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">notebookType</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">content</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookData">NotebookData</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookDocument">NotebookDocument</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3410">
<div class="comment"><p>Open an untitled notebook. The editor will prompt the user for a file
path when the document is to be saved.</p>
<p><em>See also</em>
<a href="#workspace.openNotebookDocument">workspace.openNotebookDocument</a></p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">notebookType</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The notebook type that should be used.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">content</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookData">NotebookData</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The initial contents of the notebook.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookDocument">NotebookDocument</a>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A promise that resolves to a <a href="#NotebookDocument">notebook</a>.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="workspace.openTextDocument"></a><span class="ts" id=3387 data-target="#details-3387" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">openTextDocument</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">uri</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a>, <span class="ident">options</span><span>?</span><span>: </span>{encoding: <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>}<span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3387">
<div class="comment"><p>Opens a document. Will return early if this document is already open. Otherwise
the document is loaded and the <a href="#workspace.onDidOpenTextDocument">didOpen</a>-event fires.</p>
<p>The document is denoted by an <a href="#Uri">Uri</a>. Depending on the <a href="#Uri.scheme">scheme</a> the
following rules apply:</p>
<ul>
<li><code>file</code>-scheme: Open a file on disk (<code>openTextDocument(Uri.file(path))</code>). Will be rejected if the file
does not exist or cannot be loaded.</li>
<li><code>untitled</code>-scheme: Open a blank untitled file with associated path (<code>openTextDocument(Uri.file(path).with({ scheme: &#39;untitled&#39; }))</code>).
The language will be derived from the file name.</li>
<li>For all other schemes contributed <a href="#TextDocumentContentProvider">text document content providers</a> and
<a href="#FileSystemProvider">file system providers</a> are consulted.</li>
</ul>
<p><em>Note</em> that the lifecycle of the returned document is owned by the editor and not by the extension. That means an
<a href="#workspace.onDidCloseTextDocument">onDidClose</a>-event can occur at any time after opening it.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">uri</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Identifies the resource to open.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">options</span><span>?</span><span>: </span>{encoding: <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>}</td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A promise that resolves to a <a href="#TextDocument">document</a>.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="workspace.openTextDocument"></a><span class="ts" id=3392 data-target="#details-3392" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">openTextDocument</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">path</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">options</span><span>?</span><span>: </span>{encoding: <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>}<span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3392">
<div class="comment"><p>A short-hand for <code>openTextDocument(Uri.file(path))</code>.</p>
<p><em>See also</em>
<a href="#workspace.openTextDocument">workspace.openTextDocument</a></p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">path</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A path of a file on disk.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">options</span><span>?</span><span>: </span>{encoding: <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>}</td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A promise that resolves to a <a href="#TextDocument">document</a>.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="workspace.openTextDocument"></a><span class="ts" id=3397 data-target="#details-3397" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">openTextDocument</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">options</span><span>?</span><span>: </span>{content: <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, encoding: <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, language: <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>}<span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3397">
<div class="comment"><p>Opens an untitled text document. The editor will prompt the user for a file
path when the document is to be saved. The <code>options</code> parameter allows to
specify the <em>language</em> and/or the <em>content</em> of the document.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">options</span><span>?</span><span>: </span>{content: <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, encoding: <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, language: <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>}</td><td><div class="comment"><p>Options to control how the document will be created.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A promise that resolves to a <a href="#TextDocument">document</a>.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="workspace.registerFileSystemProvider"></a><span class="ts" id=3427 data-target="#details-3427" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">registerFileSystemProvider</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">scheme</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">provider</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#FileSystemProvider">FileSystemProvider</a>, <span class="ident">options</span><span>?</span><span>: </span>{isCaseSensitive: <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>, isReadonly: <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#MarkdownString">MarkdownString</a>}<span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3427">
<div class="comment"><p>Register a filesystem provider for a given scheme, e.g. <code>ftp</code>.</p>
<p>There can only be one provider per scheme and an error is being thrown when a scheme
has been claimed by another provider or when it is reserved.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">scheme</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The uri-<a href="#Uri.scheme">scheme</a> the provider registers for.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">provider</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#FileSystemProvider">FileSystemProvider</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The filesystem provider.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">options</span><span>?</span><span>: </span>{isCaseSensitive: <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>, isReadonly: <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#MarkdownString">MarkdownString</a>}</td><td><div class="comment"><p>Immutable metadata about the provider.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A <a href="#Disposable">Disposable</a> that unregisters this provider when being disposed.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="workspace.registerNotebookSerializer"></a><span class="ts" id=3414 data-target="#details-3414" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">registerNotebookSerializer</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">notebookType</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">serializer</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookSerializer">NotebookSerializer</a>, <span class="ident">options</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookDocumentContentOptions">NotebookDocumentContentOptions</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3414">
<div class="comment"><p>Register a <a href="#NotebookSerializer">notebook serializer</a>.</p>
<p>A notebook serializer must be contributed through the <code>notebooks</code> extension point. When opening a notebook file, the editor will send
the <code>onNotebook:&lt;notebookType&gt;</code> activation event, and extensions must register their serializer in return.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">notebookType</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A notebook.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">serializer</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookSerializer">NotebookSerializer</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A notebook serializer.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">options</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookDocumentContentOptions">NotebookDocumentContentOptions</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Optional context options that define what parts of a notebook should be persisted</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A <a href="#Disposable">Disposable</a> that unregisters this serializer when being disposed.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="workspace.registerTaskProvider"></a><span class="ts" id=3423 data-target="#details-3423" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">registerTaskProvider</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">type</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">provider</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TaskProvider&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">TaskProvider</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3423">
<div class="comment"><p>Register a task provider.</p>
<ul>
<li><em>deprecated</em> - Use the corresponding function on the <code>tasks</code> namespace instead</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">type</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The task kind type this provider is registered for.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">provider</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TaskProvider&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">TaskProvider</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A task provider.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A <a href="#Disposable">Disposable</a> that unregisters this provider when being disposed.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="workspace.registerTextDocumentContentProvider"></a><span class="ts" id=3404 data-target="#details-3404" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">registerTextDocumentContentProvider</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">scheme</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">provider</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocumentContentProvider">TextDocumentContentProvider</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3404">
<div class="comment"><p>Register a text document content provider.</p>
<p>Only one provider can be registered per scheme.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">scheme</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The uri-scheme to register for.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">provider</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocumentContentProvider">TextDocumentContentProvider</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A content provider.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A <a href="#Disposable">Disposable</a> that unregisters this provider when being disposed.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="workspace.save"></a><span class="ts" id=3374 data-target="#details-3374" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">save</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">uri</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3374">
<div class="comment"><p>Saves the editor identified by the given resource and returns the resulting resource or <code>undefined</code>
if save was not successful or no editor with the given resource was found.</p>
<p><strong>Note</strong> that an editor with the provided resource must be opened in order to be saved.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">uri</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>the associated uri for the opened editor to save.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A thenable that resolves when the save operation has finished.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="workspace.saveAll"></a><span class="ts" id=3380 data-target="#details-3380" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">saveAll</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">includeUntitled</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3380">
<div class="comment"><p>Save all dirty files.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">includeUntitled</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Also save files that have been created during this session.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A thenable that resolves when the files have been saved. Will return <code>false</code>
for any file that failed to save.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="workspace.saveAs"></a><span class="ts" id=3377 data-target="#details-3377" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">saveAs</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">uri</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3377">
<div class="comment"><p>Saves the editor identified by the given resource to a new file name as provided by the user and
returns the resulting resource or <code>undefined</code> if save was not successful or cancelled or no editor
with the given resource was found.</p>
<p><strong>Note</strong> that an editor with the provided resource must be opened in order to be saved as.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">uri</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>the associated uri for the opened editor to save as.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A thenable that resolves when the save-as operation has finished.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="workspace.updateWorkspaceFolders"></a><span class="ts" id=3354 data-target="#details-3354" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">updateWorkspaceFolders</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">start</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span>, <span class="ident">deleteCount</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span>, <span>...</span><span class="ident">workspaceFoldersToAdd</span><span>: </span>Array&lt;{name: <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, uri: <a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a>}&gt;<span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3354">
<div class="comment"><p>This method replaces <code>deleteCount</code> <a href="#workspace.workspaceFolders">workspace folders</a> starting at index <code>start</code>
by an optional set of <code>workspaceFoldersToAdd</code> on the <code>vscode.workspace.workspaceFolders</code> array. This &quot;splice&quot;
behavior can be used to add, remove and change workspace folders in a single operation.</p>
<p><strong>Note:</strong> in some cases calling this method may result in the currently executing extensions (including the
one that called this method) to be terminated and restarted. For example when the first workspace folder is
added, removed or changed the (deprecated) <code>rootPath</code> property is updated to point to the first workspace
folder. Another case is when transitioning from an empty or single-folder workspace into a multi-folder
workspace (see also: <a href="https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/workspaces">https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/workspaces</a>).</p>
<p>Use the <a href="#workspace.onDidChangeWorkspaceFolders">onDidChangeWorkspaceFolders()</a> event to get notified when the
workspace folders have been updated.</p>
<p><strong>Example:</strong> adding a new workspace folder at the end of workspace folders</p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="typescript" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">workspace</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">updateWorkspaceFolders</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">workspace</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">workspaceFolders</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> ? </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">workspace</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">workspaceFolders</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">length</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> : </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#B5CEA8;--shiki-light:#098658">0</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">, </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">null</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">, { </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">uri:</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> ...});</span></span></code></pre>
<p><strong>Example:</strong> removing the first workspace folder</p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="typescript" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">workspace</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">updateWorkspaceFolders</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#B5CEA8;--shiki-light:#098658">0</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">, </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#B5CEA8;--shiki-light:#098658">1</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span></code></pre>
<p><strong>Example:</strong> replacing an existing workspace folder with a new one</p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="typescript" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">workspace</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">updateWorkspaceFolders</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#B5CEA8;--shiki-light:#098658">0</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">, </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#B5CEA8;--shiki-light:#098658">1</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">, { </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">uri:</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> ...});</span></span></code></pre>
<p>It is valid to remove an existing workspace folder and add it again with a different name
to rename that folder.</p>
<p><strong>Note:</strong> it is not valid to call <a href="#workspace.updateWorkspaceFolders">updateWorkspaceFolders()</a> multiple times
without waiting for the <a href="#workspace.onDidChangeWorkspaceFolders">onDidChangeWorkspaceFolders()</a> to fire.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">start</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>the zero-based location in the list of currently opened <a href="#WorkspaceFolder">workspace folders</a>
from which to start deleting workspace folders.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">deleteCount</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>the optional number of workspace folders to remove.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span>...</span><span class="ident">workspaceFoldersToAdd</span><span>: </span>Array&lt;{name: <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, uri: <a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a>}&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>the optional variable set of workspace folders to add in place of the deleted ones.
Each workspace is identified with a mandatory URI and an optional name.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>true if the operation was successfully started and false otherwise if arguments were used that would result
in invalid workspace folder state (e.g. 2 folders with the same URI).</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="AccessibilityInformation"></a><span class="code-item" id=1907>AccessibilityInformation</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Accessibility information which controls screen reader behavior.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="AccessibilityInformation.label"></a><span class="ts" id=1908 data-target="#details-1908" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">label</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1908">
<div class="comment"><p>Label to be read out by a screen reader once the item has focus.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="AccessibilityInformation.role"></a><span class="ts" id=1909 data-target="#details-1909" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">role</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1909">
<div class="comment"><p>Role of the widget which defines how a screen reader interacts with it.
The role should be set in special cases when for example a tree-like element behaves like a checkbox.
If role is not specified the editor will pick the appropriate role automatically.
More about aria roles can be found here <a href="https://w3c.github.io/aria/#widget_roles">https://w3c.github.io/aria/#widget_roles</a></p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="AuthenticationForceNewSessionOptions"></a><span class="code-item" id=4335>AuthenticationForceNewSessionOptions</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Optional options to be used when calling <a href="#authentication.getSession">authentication.getSession</a> with the flag <code>forceNewSession</code>.</p>
<ul>
<li><em>deprecated</em> - Use <a href="#AuthenticationGetSessionPresentationOptions">AuthenticationGetSessionPresentationOptions</a> instead.</li>
</ul>
</div>



<a name="AuthenticationForceNewSessionOptions"></a><span class="ts" id=4335 data-target="#details-4335" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">AuthenticationForceNewSessionOptions</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#AuthenticationGetSessionPresentationOptions">AuthenticationGetSessionPresentationOptions</a></span>

### <a name="AuthenticationGetSessionOptions"></a><span class="code-item" id=4336>AuthenticationGetSessionOptions</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Options to be used when getting an <a href="#AuthenticationSession">AuthenticationSession</a> from an <a href="#AuthenticationProvider">AuthenticationProvider</a>.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="AuthenticationGetSessionOptions.account"></a><span class="ts" id=4341 data-target="#details-4341" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">account</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#AuthenticationSessionAccountInformation">AuthenticationSessionAccountInformation</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4341">
<div class="comment"><p>The account that you would like to get a session for. This is passed down to the Authentication Provider to be used for creating the correct session.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="AuthenticationGetSessionOptions.clearSessionPreference"></a><span class="ts" id=4337 data-target="#details-4337" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">clearSessionPreference</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4337">
<div class="comment"><p>Whether the existing session preference should be cleared.</p>
<p>For authentication providers that support being signed into multiple accounts at once, the user will be
prompted to select an account to use when <a href="#authentication.getSession">getSession</a> is called. This preference
is remembered until <a href="#authentication.getSession">getSession</a> is called with this flag.</p>
<p>Note:
The preference is extension specific. So if one extension calls <a href="#authentication.getSession">getSession</a>, it will not
affect the session preference for another extension calling <a href="#authentication.getSession">getSession</a>. Additionally,
the preference is set for the current workspace and also globally. This means that new workspaces will use the &quot;global&quot;
value at first and then when this flag is provided, a new value can be set for that workspace. This also means
that pre-existing workspaces will not lose their preference if a new workspace sets this flag.</p>
<p>Defaults to false.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="AuthenticationGetSessionOptions.createIfNone"></a><span class="ts" id=4338 data-target="#details-4338" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">createIfNone</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#AuthenticationGetSessionPresentationOptions">AuthenticationGetSessionPresentationOptions</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4338">
<div class="comment"><p>Whether login should be performed if there is no matching session.</p>
<p>If true, a modal dialog will be shown asking the user to sign in. If false, a numbered badge will be shown
on the accounts activity bar icon. An entry for the extension will be added under the menu to sign in. This
allows quietly prompting the user to sign in.</p>
<p>If you provide options, you will also see the dialog but with the additional context provided.</p>
<p>If there is a matching session but the extension has not been granted access to it, setting this to true
will also result in an immediate modal dialog, and false will add a numbered badge to the accounts icon.</p>
<p>Defaults to false.</p>
<p>Note: you cannot use this option with <a href="#AuthenticationGetSessionOptions.silent">silent</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="AuthenticationGetSessionOptions.forceNewSession"></a><span class="ts" id=4339 data-target="#details-4339" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">forceNewSession</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#AuthenticationGetSessionPresentationOptions">AuthenticationGetSessionPresentationOptions</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4339">
<div class="comment"><p>Whether we should attempt to reauthenticate even if there is already a session available.</p>
<p>If true, a modal dialog will be shown asking the user to sign in again. This is mostly used for scenarios
where the token needs to be re minted because it has lost some authorization.</p>
<p>If you provide options, you will also see the dialog but with the additional context provided.</p>
<p>If there are no existing sessions and forceNewSession is true, it will behave identically to
<a href="#AuthenticationGetSessionOptions.createIfNone">createIfNone</a>.</p>
<p>This defaults to false.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="AuthenticationGetSessionOptions.silent"></a><span class="ts" id=4340 data-target="#details-4340" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">silent</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4340">
<div class="comment"><p>Whether we should show the indication to sign in in the Accounts menu.</p>
<p>If false, the user will be shown a badge on the Accounts menu with an option to sign in for the extension.
If true, no indication will be shown.</p>
<p>Defaults to false.</p>
<p>Note: you cannot use this option with any other options that prompt the user like <a href="#AuthenticationGetSessionOptions.createIfNone">createIfNone</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="AuthenticationGetSessionPresentationOptions"></a><span class="code-item" id=4333>AuthenticationGetSessionPresentationOptions</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Optional options to be used when calling <a href="#authentication.getSession">authentication.getSession</a> with interactive options <code>forceNewSession</code> &amp; <code>createIfNone</code>.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="AuthenticationGetSessionPresentationOptions.detail"></a><span class="ts" id=4334 data-target="#details-4334" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">detail</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4334">
<div class="comment"><p>An optional message that will be displayed to the user when we ask to re-authenticate. Providing additional context
as to why you are asking a user to re-authenticate can help increase the odds that they will accept.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="AuthenticationProvider"></a><span class="code-item" id=4358>AuthenticationProvider</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A provider for performing authentication to a service.</p>
</div>

#### Events



<a name="AuthenticationProvider.onDidChangeSessions"></a><span class="ts" id=4359 data-target="#details-4359" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeSessions</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#AuthenticationProviderAuthenticationSessionsChangeEvent">AuthenticationProviderAuthenticationSessionsChangeEvent</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4359">
<div class="comment"><p>An <a href="#Event">Event</a> which fires when the array of sessions has changed, or data
within a session has changed.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="AuthenticationProvider.createSession"></a><span class="ts" id=4365 data-target="#details-4365" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">createSession</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">scopes</span><span>: </span>readonly <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>[], <span class="ident">options</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#AuthenticationProviderSessionOptions">AuthenticationProviderSessionOptions</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#AuthenticationSession">AuthenticationSession</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4365">
<div class="comment"><p>Prompts a user to login.</p>
<p>If login is successful, the onDidChangeSessions event should be fired.</p>
<p>If login fails, a rejected promise should be returned.</p>
<p>If the provider has specified that it does not support multiple accounts,
then this should never be called if there is already an existing session matching these
scopes.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">scopes</span><span>: </span>readonly <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>[]</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A list of scopes, permissions, that the new session should be created with.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">options</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#AuthenticationProviderSessionOptions">AuthenticationProviderSessionOptions</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Additional options for creating a session.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#AuthenticationSession">AuthenticationSession</a>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A promise that resolves to an authentication session.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="AuthenticationProvider.getSessions"></a><span class="ts" id=4361 data-target="#details-4361" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">getSessions</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">scopes</span><span>: </span>readonly <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>[], <span class="ident">options</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#AuthenticationProviderSessionOptions">AuthenticationProviderSessionOptions</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#AuthenticationSession">AuthenticationSession</a>[]&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4361">
<div class="comment"><p>Get a list of sessions.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">scopes</span><span>: </span>readonly <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>[]</td><td><div class="comment"><p>An optional list of scopes. If provided, the sessions returned should match
these permissions, otherwise all sessions should be returned.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">options</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#AuthenticationProviderSessionOptions">AuthenticationProviderSessionOptions</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Additional options for getting sessions.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#AuthenticationSession">AuthenticationSession</a>[]&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A promise that resolves to an array of authentication sessions.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="AuthenticationProvider.removeSession"></a><span class="ts" id=4369 data-target="#details-4369" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">removeSession</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">sessionId</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4369">
<div class="comment"><p>Removes the session corresponding to session id.</p>
<p>If the removal is successful, the onDidChangeSessions event should be fired.</p>
<p>If a session cannot be removed, the provider should reject with an error message.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">sessionId</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The id of the session to remove.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="AuthenticationProviderAuthenticationSessionsChangeEvent"></a><span class="code-item" id=4352>AuthenticationProviderAuthenticationSessionsChangeEvent</span>



<div class="comment"><p>An <a href="#Event">Event</a> which fires when an <a href="#AuthenticationSession">AuthenticationSession</a> is added, removed, or changed.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="AuthenticationProviderAuthenticationSessionsChangeEvent.added"></a><span class="ts" id=4353 data-target="#details-4353" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">added</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#AuthenticationSession">AuthenticationSession</a>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4353">
<div class="comment"><p>The <a href="#AuthenticationSession">AuthenticationSessions</a> of the <a href="#AuthenticationProvider">AuthenticationProvider</a> that have been added.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="AuthenticationProviderAuthenticationSessionsChangeEvent.changed"></a><span class="ts" id=4355 data-target="#details-4355" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">changed</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#AuthenticationSession">AuthenticationSession</a>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4355">
<div class="comment"><p>The <a href="#AuthenticationSession">AuthenticationSessions</a> of the <a href="#AuthenticationProvider">AuthenticationProvider</a> that have been changed.
A session changes when its data excluding the id are updated. An example of this is a session refresh that results in a new
access token being set for the session.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="AuthenticationProviderAuthenticationSessionsChangeEvent.removed"></a><span class="ts" id=4354 data-target="#details-4354" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">removed</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#AuthenticationSession">AuthenticationSession</a>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4354">
<div class="comment"><p>The <a href="#AuthenticationSession">AuthenticationSessions</a> of the <a href="#AuthenticationProvider">AuthenticationProvider</a> that have been removed.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="AuthenticationProviderInformation"></a><span class="code-item" id=4345>AuthenticationProviderInformation</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Basic information about an <a href="#AuthenticationProvider">AuthenticationProvider</a></p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="AuthenticationProviderInformation.id"></a><span class="ts" id=4346 data-target="#details-4346" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">id</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4346">
<div class="comment"><p>The unique identifier of the authentication provider.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="AuthenticationProviderInformation.label"></a><span class="ts" id=4347 data-target="#details-4347" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">label</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4347">
<div class="comment"><p>The human-readable name of the authentication provider.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="AuthenticationProviderOptions"></a><span class="code-item" id=4350>AuthenticationProviderOptions</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Options for creating an <a href="#AuthenticationProvider">AuthenticationProvider</a>.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="AuthenticationProviderOptions.supportsMultipleAccounts"></a><span class="ts" id=4351 data-target="#details-4351" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">supportsMultipleAccounts</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4351">
<div class="comment"><p>Whether it is possible to be signed into multiple accounts at once with this provider.
If not specified, will default to false.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="AuthenticationProviderSessionOptions"></a><span class="code-item" id=4356>AuthenticationProviderSessionOptions</span>



<div class="comment"><p>The options passed in to the <a href="#AuthenticationProvider.getSessions">AuthenticationProvider.getSessions</a> and
<a href="#AuthenticationProvider.createSession">AuthenticationProvider.createSession</a> call.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="AuthenticationProviderSessionOptions.account"></a><span class="ts" id=4357 data-target="#details-4357" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">account</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#AuthenticationSessionAccountInformation">AuthenticationSessionAccountInformation</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4357">
<div class="comment"><p>The account that is being asked about. If this is passed in, the provider should
attempt to return the sessions that are only related to this account.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="AuthenticationSession"></a><span class="code-item" id=4324>AuthenticationSession</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Represents a session of a currently logged in user.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="AuthenticationSession.accessToken"></a><span class="ts" id=4326 data-target="#details-4326" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">accessToken</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4326">
<div class="comment"><p>The access token. This token should be used to authenticate requests to a service. Popularized by OAuth.</p>
<ul>
<li><em>reference</em> - <a href="https://oauth.net/2/access-tokens/">https://oauth.net/2/access-tokens/</a></li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>



<a name="AuthenticationSession.account"></a><span class="ts" id=4328 data-target="#details-4328" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">account</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#AuthenticationSessionAccountInformation">AuthenticationSessionAccountInformation</a></span>

### <a name="AuthenticationWwwAuthenticateRequest"></a><span class="code-item" id=4342>AuthenticationWwwAuthenticateRequest</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Represents parameters for creating a session based on a WWW-Authenticate header value.
This is used when an API returns a 401 with a WWW-Authenticate header indicating
that additional authentication is required. The details of which will be passed down
to the authentication provider to create a session.</p>
<ul>
<li><em>note</em> - The authorization provider must support handling challenges and specifically
the challenges in this WWW-Authenticate value.</li>
</ul>
<ul>
<li><em>note</em> - For more information on WWW-Authenticate please see <a href="https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/HTTP/Reference/Headers/WWW-Authenticate">https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/HTTP/Reference/Headers/WWW-Authenticate</a></li>
</ul>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="AuthenticationWwwAuthenticateRequest.fallbackScopes"></a><span class="ts" id=4344 data-target="#details-4344" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">fallbackScopes</span><span>?</span><span>: </span>readonly <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4344">
<div class="comment"><p>The fallback scopes to use if no scopes are found in the WWW-Authenticate header.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="AuthenticationWwwAuthenticateRequest.wwwAuthenticate"></a><span class="ts" id=4343 data-target="#details-4343" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">wwwAuthenticate</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4343">
<div class="comment"><p>The raw WWW-Authenticate header value that triggered this challenge.
This will be parsed by the authentication provider to extract the necessary
challenge information.</p>
</div>
</div>

</div>

### <a name="CallHierarchyOutgoingCall"></a><span class="code-item" id=1492>CallHierarchyOutgoingCall</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Represents an outgoing call, e.g. calling a getter from a method or a method from a constructor etc.</p>
</div>

#### Constructors



<a name="CallHierarchyOutgoingCall.CallHierarchyOutgoingCall"></a><span class="ts" id=1494 data-target="#details-1494" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">CallHierarchyOutgoingCall</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">item</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CallHierarchyItem">CallHierarchyItem</a>, <span class="ident">fromRanges</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a>[]<span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CallHierarchyOutgoingCall">CallHierarchyOutgoingCall</a></span>

</div>

<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">item</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CallHierarchyItem">CallHierarchyItem</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The item being called</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">fromRanges</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a>[]</td><td><div class="comment"><p>The ranges at which the calls appear.</p>

<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>

<a name="CallHierarchyOutgoingCall.fromRanges"></a><span class="ts" id=1498 data-target="#details-1498" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">fromRanges</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a>[]</span>

### <a name="CallHierarchyProvider"></a><span class="code-item" id=1499>CallHierarchyProvider</span>



<div class="comment"><p>The call hierarchy provider interface describes the contract between extensions
and the call hierarchy feature which allows to browse calls and caller of function,
methods, constructor etc.</p>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="CallHierarchyProvider.prepareCallHierarchy"></a><span class="ts" id=1501 data-target="#details-1501" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">prepareCallHierarchy</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a>, <span class="ident">position</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#CallHierarchyItem">CallHierarchyItem</a> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#CallHierarchyItem">CallHierarchyItem</a>[]&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1501">
<div class="comment"><p>Bootstraps call hierarchy by returning the item that is denoted by the given document
and position. This item will be used as entry into the call graph. Providers should
return <code>undefined</code> or <code>null</code> when there is no item at the given location.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The document in which the command was invoked.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">position</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The position at which the command was invoked.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#CallHierarchyItem">CallHierarchyItem</a> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#CallHierarchyItem">CallHierarchyItem</a>[]&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>One or multiple call hierarchy items or a thenable that resolves to such. The lack of a result can be
signaled by returning <code>undefined</code>, <code>null</code>, or an empty array.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="CallHierarchyProvider.provideCallHierarchyIncomingCalls"></a><span class="ts" id=1506 data-target="#details-1506" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">provideCallHierarchyIncomingCalls</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">item</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CallHierarchyItem">CallHierarchyItem</a>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#CallHierarchyIncomingCall">CallHierarchyIncomingCall</a>[]&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1506">
<div class="comment"><p>Provide all incoming calls for an item, e.g all callers for a method. In graph terms this describes directed
and annotated edges inside the call graph, e.g the given item is the starting node and the result is the nodes
that can be reached.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">item</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CallHierarchyItem">CallHierarchyItem</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The hierarchy item for which incoming calls should be computed.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#CallHierarchyIncomingCall">CallHierarchyIncomingCall</a>[]&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A set of incoming calls or a thenable that resolves to such. The lack of a result can be
signaled by returning <code>undefined</code> or <code>null</code>.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="CallHierarchyProvider.provideCallHierarchyOutgoingCalls"></a><span class="ts" id=1510 data-target="#details-1510" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">provideCallHierarchyOutgoingCalls</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">item</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CallHierarchyItem">CallHierarchyItem</a>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#CallHierarchyOutgoingCall">CallHierarchyOutgoingCall</a>[]&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1510">
<div class="comment"><p>Provide all outgoing calls for an item, e.g call calls to functions, methods, or constructors from the given item. In
graph terms this describes directed and annotated edges inside the call graph, e.g the given item is the starting
node and the result is the nodes that can be reached.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">item</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CallHierarchyItem">CallHierarchyItem</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The hierarchy item for which outgoing calls should be computed.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#CallHierarchyOutgoingCall">CallHierarchyOutgoingCall</a>[]&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A set of outgoing calls or a thenable that resolves to such. The lack of a result can be
signaled by returning <code>undefined</code> or <code>null</code>.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="CancellationError"></a><span class="code-item" id=450>CancellationError</span>



<div class="comment"><p>An error type that should be used to signal cancellation of an operation.</p>
<p>This type can be used in response to a <a href="#CancellationToken">cancellation token</a>
being cancelled or when an operation is being cancelled by the
executor of that operation.</p>
</div>

#### Constructors



<a name="CancellationError.CancellationError"></a><span class="ts" id=452 data-target="#details-452" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">CancellationError</span><span>(</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationError">CancellationError</a></span>

</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="CancellationToken"></a><span class="code-item" id=439>CancellationToken</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token is passed to an asynchronous or long running
operation to request cancellation, like cancelling a request
for completion items because the user continued to type.</p>
<p>To get an instance of a <code>CancellationToken</code> use a
<a href="#CancellationTokenSource">CancellationTokenSource</a>.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="CancellationToken.isCancellationRequested"></a><span class="ts" id=440 data-target="#details-440" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">isCancellationRequested</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-440">
<div class="comment"><p>Is <code>true</code> when the token has been cancelled, <code>false</code> otherwise.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="CancellationToken.onCancellationRequested"></a><span class="ts" id=441 data-target="#details-441" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onCancellationRequested</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">any</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-441">
<div class="comment"><p>An <a href="#Event">Event</a> which fires upon cancellation.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="ChatFollowup"></a><span class="code-item" id=4818>ChatFollowup</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A followup question suggested by the participant.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="ChatFollowup.command"></a><span class="ts" id=4822 data-target="#details-4822" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">command</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4822">
<div class="comment"><p>By default, the followup goes to the same participant/command. But this property can be set to invoke a different command.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="ChatFollowup.label"></a><span class="ts" id=4820 data-target="#details-4820" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">label</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4820">
<div class="comment"><p>A title to show the user. The prompt will be shown by default, when this is unspecified.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="ChatFollowup.participant"></a><span class="ts" id=4821 data-target="#details-4821" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">participant</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4821">
<div class="comment"><p>By default, the followup goes to the same participant/command. But this property can be set to invoke a different participant by ID.
Followups can only invoke a participant that was contributed by the same extension.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="ChatFollowup.prompt"></a><span class="ts" id=4819 data-target="#details-4819" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">prompt</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>

</div>
</div>

### <a name="ChatFollowupProvider"></a><span class="code-item" id=4823>ChatFollowupProvider</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Will be invoked once after each request to get suggested followup questions to show the user. The user can click the followup to send it to the chat.</p>
</div>

<a name="ChatFollowupProvider.provideFollowups"></a><span class="ts" id=4825 data-target="#details-4825" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">provideFollowups</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">result</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ChatResult">ChatResult</a>, <span class="ident">context</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ChatContext">ChatContext</a>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#ChatFollowup">ChatFollowup</a>[]&gt;</span>

</div>

<tr><td><span class="ident">result</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ChatResult">ChatResult</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>This object has the same properties as the result returned from the participant callback, including <code>metadata</code>, but is not the same instance.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">context</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ChatContext">ChatContext</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Extra context passed to a participant.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token.</p>

</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="ChatLanguageModelToolReference"></a><span class="code-item" id=5197>ChatLanguageModelToolReference</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A reference to a tool that the user manually attached to their request, either using the <code>#</code>-syntax inline, or as an
attachment via the paperclip button.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="ChatLanguageModelToolReference.name"></a><span class="ts" id=5198 data-target="#details-5198" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">name</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-5198">
<div class="comment"><p>The tool name. Refers to a tool listed in <a href="#lm.tools">lm.tools</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="ChatLanguageModelToolReference.range"></a><span class="ts" id=5199 data-target="#details-5199" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">range</span><span>?</span><span>: </span>[start: <span class="type-intrinsic">number</span>, end: <span class="type-intrinsic">number</span>]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-5199">
<div class="comment"><p>The start and end index of the reference in the <a href="#ChatRequest.prompt">prompt</a>. When undefined, the reference was
not part of the prompt text.</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that the indices take the leading <code>#</code>-character into account which means they can be used to modify the prompt
as-is.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="ChatParticipant"></a><span class="code-item" id=4836>ChatParticipant</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A chat participant can be invoked by the user in a chat session, using the <code></code> prefix. When it is invoked, it handles the chat request and is solely
responsible for providing a response to the user. A ChatParticipant is created using <a href="#chat.createChatParticipant">chat.createChatParticipant</a>.</p>
</div>

#### Events



<a name="ChatParticipant.onDidReceiveFeedback"></a><span class="ts" id=4841 data-target="#details-4841" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidReceiveFeedback</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#ChatResultFeedback">ChatResultFeedback</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4841">
<div class="comment"><p>An event that fires whenever feedback for a result is received, e.g. when a user up- or down-votes
a result.</p>
<p>The passed <a href="#ChatResultFeedback.result">result</a> is guaranteed to have the same properties as the result that was
previously returned from this chat participant&#39;s handler.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Properties

<a name="ChatPromptReference.range"></a><span class="ts" id=4846 data-target="#details-4846" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">range</span><span>?</span><span>: </span>[start: <span class="type-intrinsic">number</span>, end: <span class="type-intrinsic">number</span>]</span>

used to modify the prompt as-is.</p>
</div>
</div>
