### <a name="ChatRequest"></a><span class="code-item" id=4849>ChatRequest</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A request to a chat participant.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="ChatRequest.command"></a><span class="ts" id=4851 data-target="#details-4851" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">command</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4851">
<div class="comment"><p>The name of the [ChatCommand command](#ChatCommand command) that was selected for this request.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="ChatRequest.model"></a><span class="ts" id=4855 data-target="#details-4855" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">model</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#LanguageModelChat">LanguageModelChat</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4855">
<div class="comment"><p>This is the model that is currently selected in the UI. Extensions can use this or use <a href="#lm.selectChatModels">lm.selectChatModels</a> to
pick another model. Don&#39;t hold onto this past the lifetime of the request.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="ChatRequest.prompt"></a><span class="ts" id=4850 data-target="#details-4850" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">prompt</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4850">
<div class="comment"><p>The prompt as entered by the user.</p>
<p>Information about references used in this request is stored in <a href="#ChatRequest.references">ChatRequest.references</a>.</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that the [ChatParticipant.name name](#ChatParticipant.name name) of the participant and the [ChatCommand.name command](#ChatCommand.name command)
are not part of the prompt.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="ChatRequest.references"></a><span class="ts" id=4852 data-target="#details-4852" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">references</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#ChatPromptReference">ChatPromptReference</a>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4852">
<div class="comment"><p>The list of references and their values that are referenced in the prompt.</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that the prompt contains references as authored and that it is up to the participant
to further modify the prompt, for instance by inlining reference values or creating links to
headings which contain the resolved values. References are sorted in reverse by their range
in the prompt. That means the last reference in the prompt is the first in this list. This simplifies
string-manipulation of the prompt.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="ChatRequest.toolInvocationToken"></a><span class="ts" id=4854 data-target="#details-4854" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">toolInvocationToken</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">never</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4854">
<div class="comment"><p>A token that can be passed to <a href="#lm.invokeTool">lm.invokeTool</a> when invoking a tool inside the context of handling a chat request.
This associates the tool invocation to a chat session.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="ChatRequest.toolReferences"></a><span class="ts" id=4853 data-target="#details-4853" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">toolReferences</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#ChatLanguageModelToolReference">ChatLanguageModelToolReference</a>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4853">
<div class="comment"><p>The list of tools that the user attached to their request.</p>
<p>When a tool reference is present, the chat participant should make a chat request using
<a href="#LanguageModelChatToolMode.Required">LanguageModelChatToolMode.Required</a> to force the language model to generate input for the tool. Then, the
participant can use <a href="#lm.invokeTool">lm.invokeTool</a> to use the tool attach the result to its request for the user&#39;s prompt. The
tool may contribute useful extra context for the user&#39;s request.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="ChatRequestHandler"></a><span class="code-item" id=4829>ChatRequestHandler</span>

### <a name="ChatResponseStream"></a><span class="code-item" id=4856>ChatResponseStream</span>



<div class="comment"><p>The ChatResponseStream is how a participant is able to return content to the chat view. It provides several methods for streaming different types of content
which will be rendered in an appropriate way in the chat view. A participant can use the helper method for the type of content it wants to return, or it
can instantiate a <a href="#ChatResponsePart">ChatResponsePart</a> and use the generic <a href="#ChatResponseStream.push">ChatResponseStream.push</a> method to return it.</p>
</div>

### <a name="CodeAction"></a><span class="code-item" id=622>CodeAction</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A code action represents a change that can be performed in code, e.g. to fix a problem or
to refactor code.</p>
<p>A CodeAction must set either <a href="#CodeAction.edit">edit</a> and/or a <a href="#CodeAction.command">command</a>. If both are supplied, the <code>edit</code> is applied first, then the command is executed.</p>
</div>

#### Constructors



<a name="CodeAction.CodeAction"></a><span class="ts" id=624 data-target="#details-624" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">CodeAction</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">title</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">kind</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CodeActionKind">CodeActionKind</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CodeAction">CodeAction</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-624">
<div class="comment"><p>Creates a new code action.</p>
<p>A code action must have at least a <a href="#CodeAction.title">title</a> and <a href="#CodeAction.edit">edits</a>
and/or a <a href="#CodeAction.command">command</a>.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">title</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The title of the code action.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">kind</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CodeActionKind">CodeActionKind</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The kind of the code action.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#CodeAction">CodeAction</a></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="CodeAction.command"></a><span class="ts" id=630 data-target="#details-630" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">command</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Command">Command</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-630">
<div class="comment"><p>A <a href="#Command">Command</a> this code action executes.</p>
<p>If this command throws an exception, the editor displays the exception message to users in the editor at the
current cursor position.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="CodeAction.diagnostics"></a><span class="ts" id=629 data-target="#details-629" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">diagnostics</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Diagnostic">Diagnostic</a>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-629">
<div class="comment"><p><a href="#Diagnostic">Diagnostics</a> that this code action resolves.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="CodeAction.disabled"></a><span class="ts" id=633 data-target="#details-633" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">disabled</span><span>?</span><span>: </span>{reason: <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>}</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-633">
<div class="comment"><p>Marks that the code action cannot currently be applied.</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Disabled code actions are not shown in automatic <a href="https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/editingevolved#_code-action">lightbulb</a>
code action menu.</p>
</li>
<li><p>Disabled actions are shown as faded out in the code action menu when the user request a more specific type
of code action, such as refactorings.</p>
</li>
<li><p>If the user has a <a href="https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/refactoring#_keybindings-for-code-actions">keybinding</a>
that auto applies a code action and only a disabled code actions are returned, the editor will show the user an
error message with <code>reason</code> in the editor.</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>

<a name="CodeAction.isPreferred"></a><span class="ts" id=632 data-target="#details-632" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">isPreferred</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>

<div class="comment"><p>Marks this as a preferred action. Preferred actions are used by the <code>auto fix</code> command and can be targeted
by keybindings.</p>
<p>A quick fix should be marked preferred if it properly addresses the underlying error.
A refactoring should be marked preferred if it is the most reasonable choice of actions to take.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="CodeActionKind"></a><span class="code-item" id=590>CodeActionKind</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Kind of a code action.</p>
<p>Kinds are a hierarchical list of identifiers separated by <code>.</code>, e.g. <code>&quot;refactor.extract.function&quot;</code>.</p>
<p>Code action kinds are used by the editor for UI elements such as the refactoring context menu. Users
can also trigger code actions with a specific kind with the <code>editor.action.codeAction</code> command.</p>
</div>

#### Static



<a name="CodeActionKind.Empty"></a><span class="ts" id=591 data-target="#details-591" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Empty</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CodeActionKind">CodeActionKind</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-591">
<div class="comment"><p>Empty kind.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="CodeActionKind.Notebook"></a><span class="ts" id=601 data-target="#details-601" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Notebook</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CodeActionKind">CodeActionKind</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-601">
<div class="comment"><p>Base kind for all code actions applying to the entire notebook&#39;s scope. CodeActionKinds using
this should always begin with <code>notebook.</code></p>
<p>This requires that new CodeActions be created for it and contributed via extensions.
Pre-existing kinds can not just have the new <code>notebook.</code> prefix added to them, as the functionality
is unique to the full-notebook scope.</p>
<p>Notebook CodeActionKinds can be initialized as either of the following (both resulting in <code>notebook.source.xyz</code>):</p>
<ul>
<li><code>const newKind =  CodeActionKind.Notebook.append(CodeActionKind.Source.append(&#39;xyz&#39;).value)</code></li>
<li><code>const newKind =  CodeActionKind.Notebook.append(&#39;source.xyz&#39;)</code></li>
</ul>
<p>Example Kinds/Actions:</p>
<ul>
<li><code>notebook.source.organizeImports</code> (might move all imports to a new top cell)</li>
<li><code>notebook.source.normalizeVariableNames</code> (might rename all variables to a standardized casing format)</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>



<a name="CodeActionKind.QuickFix"></a><span class="ts" id=592 data-target="#details-592" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">QuickFix</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CodeActionKind">CodeActionKind</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-592">
<div class="comment"><p>Base kind for quickfix actions: <code>quickfix</code>.</p>
<p>Quick fix actions address a problem in the code and are shown in the normal code action context menu.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="CodeActionKind.Refactor"></a><span class="ts" id=593 data-target="#details-593" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Refactor</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CodeActionKind">CodeActionKind</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-593">
<div class="comment"><p>Base kind for refactoring actions: <code>refactor</code></p>
<p>Refactoring actions are shown in the refactoring context menu.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="CodeActionKind.RefactorExtract"></a><span class="ts" id=594 data-target="#details-594" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">RefactorExtract</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CodeActionKind">CodeActionKind</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-594">
<div class="comment"><p>Base kind for refactoring extraction actions: <code>refactor.extract</code></p>
<p>Example extract actions:</p>
<ul>
<li>Extract method</li>
<li>Extract function</li>
<li>Extract variable</li>
<li>Extract interface from class</li>
<li>...</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>



<a name="CodeActionKind.RefactorInline"></a><span class="ts" id=595 data-target="#details-595" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">RefactorInline</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CodeActionKind">CodeActionKind</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-595">
<div class="comment"><p>Base kind for refactoring inline actions: <code>refactor.inline</code></p>
<p>Example inline actions:</p>
<ul>
<li>Inline function</li>
<li>Inline variable</li>
<li>Inline constant</li>
<li>...</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>



<a name="CodeActionKind.RefactorMove"></a><span class="ts" id=596 data-target="#details-596" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">RefactorMove</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CodeActionKind">CodeActionKind</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-596">
<div class="comment"><p>Base kind for refactoring move actions: <code>refactor.move</code></p>
<p>Example move actions:</p>
<ul>
<li>Move a function to a new file</li>
<li>Move a property between classes</li>
<li>Move method to base class</li>
<li>...</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>



<a name="CodeActionKind.RefactorRewrite"></a><span class="ts" id=597 data-target="#details-597" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">RefactorRewrite</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CodeActionKind">CodeActionKind</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-597">
<div class="comment"><p>Base kind for refactoring rewrite actions: <code>refactor.rewrite</code></p>
<p>Example rewrite actions:</p>
<ul>
<li>Convert JavaScript function to class</li>
<li>Add or remove parameter</li>
<li>Encapsulate field</li>
<li>Make method static</li>
<li>...</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>



<a name="CodeActionKind.Source"></a><span class="ts" id=598 data-target="#details-598" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Source</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CodeActionKind">CodeActionKind</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-598">
<div class="comment"><p>Base kind for source actions: <code>source</code></p>
<p>Source code actions apply to the entire file. They must be explicitly requested and will not show in the
normal <a href="https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/editingevolved#_code-action">lightbulb</a> menu. Source actions
can be run on save using <code>editor.codeActionsOnSave</code> and are also shown in the <code>source</code> context menu.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="CodeActionKind.SourceFixAll"></a><span class="ts" id=600 data-target="#details-600" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">SourceFixAll</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CodeActionKind">CodeActionKind</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-600">
<div class="comment"><p>Base kind for auto-fix source actions: <code>source.fixAll</code>.</p>
<p>Fix all actions automatically fix errors that have a clear fix that do not require user input.
They should not suppress errors or perform unsafe fixes such as generating new types or classes.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="CodeActionKind.SourceOrganizeImports"></a><span class="ts" id=599 data-target="#details-599" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">SourceOrganizeImports</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CodeActionKind">CodeActionKind</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-599">
<div class="comment"><p>Base kind for an organize imports source action: <code>source.organizeImports</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>

<a name="CodeActionKind.contains"></a><span class="ts" id=613 data-target="#details-613" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">contains</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">other</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CodeActionKind">CodeActionKind</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>

### <a name="CodeActionProvider"></a><span class="code-item" id=636>CodeActionProvider&lt;T&gt;</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Provides contextual actions for code. Code actions typically either fix problems or beautify/refactor code.</p>
<p>Code actions are surfaced to users in a few different ways:</p>
<ul>
<li>The <a href="https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/editingevolved#_code-action">lightbulb</a> feature, which shows
a list of code actions at the current cursor position. The lightbulb&#39;s list of actions includes both quick fixes
and refactorings.</li>
<li>As commands that users can run, such as <code>Refactor</code>. Users can run these from the command palette or with keybindings.</li>
<li>As source actions, such <code>Organize Imports</code>.</li>
<li><a href="#CodeActionKind.QuickFix">Quick fixes</a> are shown in the problems view.</li>
<li>Change applied on save by the <code>editor.codeActionsOnSave</code> setting.</li>
</ul>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="CodeActionProvider.provideCodeActions"></a><span class="ts" id=639 data-target="#details-639" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">provideCodeActions</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a>, <span class="ident">range</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#Selection">Selection</a>, <span class="ident">context</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CodeActionContext">CodeActionContext</a>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;Array&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#Command">Command</a> &#124; <span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt;&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-639">
<div class="comment"><p>Get code actions for a given range in a document.</p>
<p>Only return code actions that are relevant to user for the requested range. Also keep in mind how the
returned code actions will appear in the UI. The lightbulb widget and <code>Refactor</code> commands for instance show
returned code actions as a list, so do not return a large number of code actions that will overwhelm the user.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The document in which the command was invoked.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">range</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#Selection">Selection</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The selector or range for which the command was invoked. This will always be a
<a href="#Selection">selection</a> if the actions are being requested in the currently active editor.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">context</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CodeActionContext">CodeActionContext</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Provides additional information about what code actions are being requested. You can use this
to see what specific type of code actions are being requested by the editor in order to return more relevant
actions and avoid returning irrelevant code actions that the editor will discard.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;Array&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#Command">Command</a> &#124; <span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt;&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>An array of code actions, such as quick fixes or refactorings. The lack of a result can be signaled
by returning <code>undefined</code>, <code>null</code>, or an empty array.</p>
<p>We also support returning <code>Command</code> for legacy reasons, however all new extensions should return
<code>CodeAction</code> object instead.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="CodeActionProvider.resolveCodeAction"></a><span class="ts" id=645 data-target="#details-645" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">resolveCodeAction</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">codeAction</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-645">
<div class="comment"><p>Given a code action fill in its <a href="#CodeAction.edit">edit</a>-property. Changes to
all other properties, like title, are ignored. A code action that has an edit
will not be resolved.</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that a code action provider that returns commands, not code actions, cannot successfully
implement this function. Returning commands is deprecated and instead code actions should be
returned.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">codeAction</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A code action.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>The resolved code action or a thenable that resolves to such. It is OK to return the given
<code>item</code>. When no result is returned, the given <code>item</code> will be used.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="CodeActionProviderMetadata"></a><span class="code-item" id=648>CodeActionProviderMetadata</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Metadata about the type of code actions that a <a href="#CodeActionProvider">CodeActionProvider</a> provides.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="CodeActionProviderMetadata.documentation"></a><span class="ts" id=650 data-target="#details-650" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">documentation</span><span>?</span><span>: </span>ReadonlyArray&lt;{command: <a class="type-ref" href="#Command">Command</a>, kind: <a class="type-ref" href="#CodeActionKind">CodeActionKind</a>}&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-650">
<div class="comment"><p>Static documentation for a class of code actions.</p>
<p>Documentation from the provider is shown in the code actions menu if either:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Code actions of <code>kind</code> are requested by the editor. In this case, the editor will show the documentation that
most closely matches the requested code action kind. For example, if a provider has documentation for
both <code>Refactor</code> and <code>RefactorExtract</code>, when the user requests code actions for <code>RefactorExtract</code>,
the editor will use the documentation for <code>RefactorExtract</code> instead of the documentation for <code>Refactor</code>.</p>
</li>
<li><p>Any code actions of <code>kind</code> are returned by the provider.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>At most one documentation entry will be shown per provider.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="CodeActionProviderMetadata.providedCodeActionKinds"></a><span class="ts" id=649 data-target="#details-649" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">providedCodeActionKinds</span><span>?</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#CodeActionKind">CodeActionKind</a>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-649">
<div class="comment"><p>List of <a href="#CodeActionKind">CodeActionKinds</a> that a <a href="#CodeActionProvider">CodeActionProvider</a> may return.</p>
<p>This list is used to determine if a given <code>CodeActionProvider</code> should be invoked or not.
To avoid unnecessary computation, every <code>CodeActionProvider</code> should list use <code>providedCodeActionKinds</code>. The
list of kinds may either be generic, such as <code>[CodeActionKind.Refactor]</code>, or list out every kind provided,
such as <code>[CodeActionKind.Refactor.Extract.append(&#39;function&#39;), CodeActionKind.Refactor.Extract.append(&#39;constant&#39;), ...]</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="CodeActionTriggerKind"></a><span class="code-item" id=615>CodeActionTriggerKind</span>



<div class="comment"><p>The reason why code actions were requested.</p>
</div>

#### Enumeration Members



<a name="CodeActionTriggerKind.Invoke"></a><span class="ts" id=616 data-target="#details-616" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Invoke</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">1</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-616">
<div class="comment"><p>Code actions were explicitly requested by the user or by an extension.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="CodeActionTriggerKind.Automatic"></a><span class="ts" id=617 data-target="#details-617" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Automatic</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">2</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-617">
<div class="comment"><p>Code actions were requested automatically.</p>
<p>This typically happens when current selection in a file changes, but can
also be triggered when file content changes.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="CodeLens"></a><span class="code-item" id=654>CodeLens</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A code lens represents a <a href="#Command">Command</a> that should be shown along with
source text, like the number of references, a way to run tests, etc.</p>
<p>A code lens is <em>unresolved</em> when no command is associated to it. For performance
reasons the creation of a code lens and resolving should be done to two stages.</p>
<p><em>See also</em></p>
<ul>
<li><a href="#CodeLensProvider.provideCodeLenses">CodeLensProvider.provideCodeLenses</a></li>
<li><a href="#CodeLensProvider.resolveCodeLens">CodeLensProvider.resolveCodeLens</a></li>
</ul>
</div>

#### Constructors



<a name="CodeLens.CodeLens"></a><span class="ts" id=656 data-target="#details-656" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">CodeLens</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">range</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a>, <span class="ident">command</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Command">Command</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CodeLens">CodeLens</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-656">
<div class="comment"><p>Creates a new code lens object.</p>
</div>

<tr><td><span class="ident">range</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The range to which this code lens applies.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">command</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Command">Command</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The command associated to this code lens.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#CodeLens">CodeLens</a></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

#### Properties

<a name="CodeLens.isResolved"></a><span class="ts" id=661 data-target="#details-661" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">isResolved</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>

<a name="CodeLens.range"></a><span class="ts" id=659 data-target="#details-659" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">range</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a></span>

</div>
</div>

### <a name="CodeLensProvider"></a><span class="code-item" id=662>CodeLensProvider&lt;T&gt;</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A code lens provider adds <a href="#Command">commands</a> to source text. The commands will be shown
as dedicated horizontal lines in between the source text.</p>
</div>

#### Events



<a name="CodeLensProvider.onDidChangeCodeLenses"></a><span class="ts" id=664 data-target="#details-664" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeCodeLenses</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-664">
<div class="comment"><p>An optional event to signal that the code lenses from this provider have changed.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="CodeLensProvider.provideCodeLenses"></a><span class="ts" id=666 data-target="#details-666" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">provideCodeLenses</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>[]&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-666">
<div class="comment"><p>Compute a list of <a href="#CodeLens">lenses</a>. This call should return as fast as possible and if
computing the commands is expensive implementors should only return code lens objects with the
range set and implement <a href="#CodeLensProvider.resolveCodeLens">resolve</a>.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The document in which the command was invoked.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>[]&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>An array of code lenses or a thenable that resolves to such. The lack of a result can be
signaled by returning <code>undefined</code>, <code>null</code>, or an empty array.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="CodeLensProvider.resolveCodeLens"></a><span class="ts" id=670 data-target="#details-670" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">resolveCodeLens</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">codeLens</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-670">
<div class="comment"><p>This function will be called for each visible code lens, usually when scrolling and after
calls to <a href="#CodeLensProvider.provideCodeLenses">compute</a>-lenses.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">codeLens</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Code lens that must be resolved.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>The given, resolved code lens or thenable that resolves to such.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="ColorPresentation"></a><span class="code-item" id=1379>ColorPresentation</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A color presentation object describes how a <a href="#Color">Color</a> should be represented as text and what
edits are required to refer to it from source code.</p>
<p>For some languages one color can have multiple presentations, e.g. css can represent the color red with
the constant <code>Red</code>, the hex-value <code>#ff0000</code>, or in rgba and hsla forms. In csharp other representations
apply, e.g. <code>System.Drawing.Color.Red</code>.</p>
</div>

#### Constructors



<a name="ColorPresentation.ColorPresentation"></a><span class="ts" id=1381 data-target="#details-1381" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">ColorPresentation</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">label</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ColorPresentation">ColorPresentation</a></span>

</div>

<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">label</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The label of this color presentation.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ColorPresentation">ColorPresentation</a></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

<div class="details collapse" id="details-1385">

</div>
</div>



<a name="ColorPresentation.label"></a><span class="ts" id=1383 data-target="#details-1383" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">label</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>

</div>
</div>



<a name="ColorPresentation.textEdit"></a><span class="ts" id=1384 data-target="#details-1384" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">textEdit</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextEdit">TextEdit</a></span>

is used.</p>
</div>
</div>

<div class="comment"><p>A comment is displayed within the editor or the Comments Panel, depending on how it is provided.</p>
</div>

#### Properties

<div class="details collapse" id="details-4281">
<div class="comment"><p>The human-readable comment body</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="Comment.contextValue"></a><span class="ts" id=4284 data-target="#details-4284" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">contextValue</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4284">
<div class="comment"><p>Context value of the comment. This can be used to contribute comment specific actions.
For example, a comment is given a context value as <code>editable</code>. When contributing actions to <code>comments/comment/title</code>
using <code>menus</code> extension point, you can specify context value for key <code>comment</code> in <code>when</code> expression like <code>comment == editable</code>.</p>

### <a name="CommentController"></a><span class="code-item" id=4302>CommentController</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A comment controller is able to provide <a href="#CommentThread">comments</a> support to the editor and
provide users various ways to interact with comments.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="CommentController.commentingRangeProvider"></a><span class="ts" id=4306 data-target="#details-4306" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">commentingRangeProvider</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CommentingRangeProvider">CommentingRangeProvider</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4306">
<div class="comment"><p>Optional commenting range provider. Provide a list <a href="#Range">ranges</a> which support commenting to any given resource uri.</p>
<p>If not provided, users cannot leave any comments.</p>
</div>
</div>

<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#0451A5">        "command"</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">: </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">"extension.deleteCommentThread"</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#0451A5">        "when"</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">: </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">"commentThread == editable"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">      }</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">}</span></span></code></pre>
<p>This will show action <code>extension.deleteCommentThread</code> only for comment threads with <code>contextValue</code> is <code>editable</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="CommentThread.label"></a><span class="ts" id=4268 data-target="#details-4268" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">label</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>

<a name="CommentThread.range"></a><span class="ts" id=4263 data-target="#details-4263" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">range</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a></span>

<div class="comment"><p>The range the comment thread is located within the document. The thread icon will be shown
at the last line of the range. When set to undefined, the comment will be associated with the
file, and not a specific range.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="CommentThread.state"></a><span class="ts" id=4269 data-target="#details-4269" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">state</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CommentThreadState">CommentThreadState</a></span>

</div>
</div>

</div>

### <a name="CompletionContext"></a><span class="code-item" id=1297>CompletionContext</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Contains additional information about the context in which
<a href="#CompletionItemProvider.provideCompletionItems">completion provider</a> is triggered.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="CompletionContext.triggerCharacter"></a><span class="ts" id=1299 data-target="#details-1299" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">triggerCharacter</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>

<div class="comment"><p>Character that triggered the completion item provider.</p>
<p><code>undefined</code> if the provider was not triggered by a character.</p>
<p>The trigger character is already in the document when the completion provider is triggered.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="CompletionContext.triggerKind"></a><span class="ts" id=1298 data-target="#details-1298" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">triggerKind</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CompletionTriggerKind">CompletionTriggerKind</a></span>

</div>

### <a name="CompletionItem"></a><span class="code-item" id=1261>CompletionItem</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A completion item represents a text snippet that is proposed to complete text that is being typed.</p>
<p>It is sufficient to create a completion item from just a <a href="#CompletionItem.label">label</a>. In that
case the completion item will replace the <a href="#TextDocument.getWordRangeAtPosition">word</a>
until the cursor with the given label or <a href="#CompletionItem.insertText">insertText</a>. Otherwise the
given <a href="#CompletionItem.textEdit">edit</a> is used.</p>
<p>When selecting a completion item in the editor its defined or synthesized text edit will be applied
to <em>all</em> cursors/selections whereas <a href="#CompletionItem.additionalTextEdits">additionalTextEdits</a> will be
applied as provided.</p>
<p><em>See also</em></p>
<ul>
<li><a href="#CompletionItemProvider.provideCompletionItems">CompletionItemProvider.provideCompletionItems</a></li>
<li><a href="#CompletionItemProvider.resolveCompletionItem">CompletionItemProvider.resolveCompletionItem</a></li>
</ul>
</div>

#### Constructors



<a name="CompletionItem.CompletionItem"></a><span class="ts" id=1263 data-target="#details-1263" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">CompletionItem</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">label</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#CompletionItemLabel">CompletionItemLabel</a>, <span class="ident">kind</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CompletionItemKind">CompletionItemKind</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CompletionItem">CompletionItem</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1263">
<div class="comment"><p>Creates a new completion item.</p>
<p>Completion items must have at least a <a href="#CompletionItem.label">label</a> which then
will be used as insert text as well as for sorting and filtering.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">label</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#CompletionItemLabel">CompletionItemLabel</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The label of the completion.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">kind</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CompletionItemKind">CompletionItemKind</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The <a href="#CompletionItemKind">kind</a> of the completion.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#CompletionItem">CompletionItem</a></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="CompletionItem.additionalTextEdits"></a><span class="ts" id=1282 data-target="#details-1282" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">additionalTextEdits</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextEdit">TextEdit</a>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1282">
<div class="comment"><p>An optional array of additional <a href="#TextEdit">text edits</a> that are applied when
selecting this completion. Edits must not overlap with the main <a href="#CompletionItem.textEdit">edit</a>
nor with themselves.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="CompletionItem.command"></a><span class="ts" id=1283 data-target="#details-1283" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">command</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Command">Command</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1283">
<div class="comment"><p>An optional <a href="#Command">Command</a> that is executed <em>after</em> inserting this completion. <em>Note</em> that
additional modifications to the current document should be described with the
<a href="#CompletionItem.additionalTextEdits">additionalTextEdits</a>-property.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="CompletionItem.commitCharacters"></a><span class="ts" id=1279 data-target="#details-1279" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">commitCharacters</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1279">
<div class="comment"><p>An optional set of characters that when pressed while this completion is active will accept it first and
then type that character. <em>Note</em> that all commit characters should have <code>length=1</code> and that superfluous
characters will be ignored.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="CompletionItem.detail"></a><span class="ts" id=1269 data-target="#details-1269" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">detail</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1269">
<div class="comment"><p>A human-readable string with additional information
about this item, like type or symbol information.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="CompletionItem.documentation"></a><span class="ts" id=1270 data-target="#details-1270" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">documentation</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#MarkdownString">MarkdownString</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1270">
<div class="comment"><p>A human-readable string that represents a doc-comment.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="CompletionItem.filterText"></a><span class="ts" id=1272 data-target="#details-1272" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">filterText</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1272">
<div class="comment"><p>A string that should be used when filtering a set of
completion items. When <code>falsy</code> the <a href="#CompletionItem.label">label</a>
is used.</p>
<p>Note that the filter text is matched against the leading word (prefix) which is defined
by the <a href="#CompletionItem.range">range</a>-property.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="CompletionItem.insertText"></a><span class="ts" id=1274 data-target="#details-1274" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">insertText</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#SnippetString">SnippetString</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1274">
<div class="comment"><p>A string or snippet that should be inserted in a document when selecting
this completion. When <code>falsy</code> the <a href="#CompletionItem.label">label</a>
is used.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="CompletionItem.keepWhitespace"></a><span class="ts" id=1280 data-target="#details-1280" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">keepWhitespace</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1280">
<div class="comment"><p>Keep whitespace of the <a href="#CompletionItem.insertText">insertText</a> as is. By default, the editor adjusts leading
whitespace of new lines so that they match the indentation of the line for which the item is accepted - setting
this to <code>true</code> will prevent that.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="CompletionItem.kind"></a><span class="ts" id=1267 data-target="#details-1267" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">kind</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CompletionItemKind">CompletionItemKind</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1267">
<div class="comment"><p>The kind of this completion item. Based on the kind
an icon is chosen by the editor.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="CompletionItem.label"></a><span class="ts" id=1266 data-target="#details-1266" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">label</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#CompletionItemLabel">CompletionItemLabel</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1266">
<div class="comment"><p>The label of this completion item. By default
this is also the text that is inserted when selecting
this completion.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="CompletionItem.preselect"></a><span class="ts" id=1273 data-target="#details-1273" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">preselect</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1273">
<div class="comment"><p>Select this item when showing. <em>Note</em> that only one completion item can be selected and
that the editor decides which item that is. The rule is that the <em>first</em> item of those
that match best is selected.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="CompletionItem.range"></a><span class="ts" id=1275 data-target="#details-1275" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">range</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a> &#124; {inserting: <a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a>, replacing: <a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a>}</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1275">
<div class="comment"><p>A range or a insert and replace range selecting the text that should be replaced by this completion item.</p>
<p>When omitted, the range of the <a href="#TextDocument.getWordRangeAtPosition">current word</a> is used as replace-range
and as insert-range the start of the <a href="#TextDocument.getWordRangeAtPosition">current word</a> to the
current position is used.</p>
<p><em>Note 1:</em> A range must be a <a href="#Range.isSingleLine">single line</a> and it must
<a href="#Range.contains">contain</a> the position at which completion has been <a href="#CompletionItemProvider.provideCompletionItems">requested</a>.
<em>Note 2:</em> A insert range must be a prefix of a replace range, that means it must be contained and starting at the same position.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="CompletionItem.sortText"></a><span class="ts" id=1271 data-target="#details-1271" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">sortText</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1271">
<div class="comment"><p>A string that should be used when comparing this item
with other items. When <code>falsy</code> the <a href="#CompletionItem.label">label</a>
is used.</p>
<p>Note that <code>sortText</code> is only used for the initial ordering of completion
items. When having a leading word (prefix) ordering is based on how
well completions match that prefix and the initial ordering is only used
when completions match equally well. The prefix is defined by the
<a href="#CompletionItem.range">range</a>-property and can therefore be different
for each completion.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="CompletionItem.tags"></a><span class="ts" id=1268 data-target="#details-1268" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">tags</span><span>?</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#CompletionItemTag">CompletionItemTag</a>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1268">
<div class="comment"><p>Tags for this completion item.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="CompletionItem.textEdit"></a><span class="ts" id=1281 data-target="#details-1281" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">textEdit</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextEdit">TextEdit</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1281">
<div class="comment"><ul>
<li><em>deprecated</em> - Use <code>CompletionItem.insertText</code> and <code>CompletionItem.range</code> instead.</li>
</ul>
<p>An <a href="#TextEdit">edit</a> which is applied to a document when selecting
this completion. When an edit is provided the value of
<a href="#CompletionItem.insertText">insertText</a> is ignored.</p>
<p>The <a href="#Range">Range</a> of the edit must be single-line and on the same
line completions were <a href="#CompletionItemProvider.provideCompletionItems">requested</a> at.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="CompletionItemProvider"></a><span class="code-item" id=1300>CompletionItemProvider&lt;T&gt;</span>



<div class="comment"><p>The completion item provider interface defines the contract between extensions and
<a href="https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/intellisense">IntelliSense</a>.</p>
<p>Providers can delay the computation of the <a href="#CompletionItem.detail">detail</a>
and <a href="#CompletionItem.documentation">documentation</a> properties by implementing the
<a href="#CompletionItemProvider.resolveCompletionItem">resolveCompletionItem</a>-function. However, properties that
are needed for the initial sorting and filtering, like <code>sortText</code>, <code>filterText</code>, <code>insertText</code>, and <code>range</code>, must
not be changed during resolve.</p>
<p>Providers are asked for completions either explicitly by a user gesture or -depending on the configuration-
implicitly when typing words or trigger characters.</p>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="CompletionItemProvider.provideCompletionItems"></a><span class="ts" id=1303 data-target="#details-1303" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">provideCompletionItems</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a>, <span class="ident">position</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a>, <span class="ident">context</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CompletionContext">CompletionContext</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#CompletionList&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">CompletionList</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt; &#124; <span class="type-ref">T</span>[]&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1303">
<div class="comment"><p>Provide completion items for the given position and document.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The document in which the command was invoked.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">position</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The position at which the command was invoked.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">context</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CompletionContext">CompletionContext</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>How the completion was triggered.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#CompletionList&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">CompletionList</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt; &#124; <span class="type-ref">T</span>[]&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>An array of completions, a <a href="#CompletionList">completion list</a>, or a thenable that resolves to either.
The lack of a result can be signaled by returning <code>undefined</code>, <code>null</code>, or an empty array.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="CompletionItemProvider.resolveCompletionItem"></a><span class="ts" id=1309 data-target="#details-1309" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">resolveCompletionItem</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">item</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1309">
<div class="comment"><p>Given a completion item fill in more data, like <a href="#CompletionItem.documentation">doc-comment</a>
or <a href="#CompletionItem.detail">details</a>.</p>
<p>The editor will only resolve a completion item once.</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that this function is called when completion items are already showing in the UI or when an item has been
selected for insertion. Because of that, no property that changes the presentation (label, sorting, filtering etc)
or the (primary) insert behaviour (<a href="#CompletionItem.insertText">insertText</a>) can be changed.</p>
<p>This function may fill in <a href="#CompletionItem.additionalTextEdits">additionalTextEdits</a>. However, that means an item might be
inserted <em>before</em> resolving is done and in that case the editor will do a best effort to still apply those additional
text edits.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">item</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A completion item currently active in the UI.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>The resolved completion item or a thenable that resolves to of such. It is OK to return the given
<code>item</code>. When no result is returned, the given <code>item</code> will be used.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

<div class="comment"><p>The configuration scope which can be:</p>

<li>a <a href="#Uri">Uri</a> representing a resource</li>
<li>a <a href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a> representing an open text document</li>
<li>a <a href="#WorkspaceFolder">WorkspaceFolder</a> representing a workspace folder</li>
<li>an object containing:<ul>
<li><code>uri</code>: an optional <a href="#Uri">Uri</a> of a text document</li>
<li><code>languageId</code>: the language identifier of a text document</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</div>

### <a name="CustomDocument"></a><span class="code-item" id=2499>CustomDocument</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Represents a custom document used by a <a href="#CustomEditorProvider">CustomEditorProvider</a>.</p>
<p>Custom documents are only used within a given <code>CustomEditorProvider</code>. The lifecycle of a <code>CustomDocument</code> is
managed by the editor. When no more references remain to a <code>CustomDocument</code>, it is disposed of.</p>
</div>

<a name="CustomDocumentBackupContext.destination"></a><span class="ts" id=2519 data-target="#details-2519" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">destination</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2519">
<div class="comment"><p>Suggested file location to write the new backup.</p>
<p>Note that your extension is free to ignore this and use its own strategy for backup.</p>
<p>If the editor is for a resource from the current workspace, <code>destination</code> will point to a file inside
<code>ExtensionContext.storagePath</code>. The parent folder of <code>destination</code> may not exist, so make sure to created it
before writing the backup to this location.</p>
</div>
</div>

has changed.</p>

### <a name="CustomDocumentEditEvent"></a><span class="code-item" id=2503>CustomDocumentEditEvent&lt;T&gt;</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Event triggered by extensions to signal to the editor that an edit has occurred on an <a href="#CustomDocument">CustomDocument</a>.</p>
<p><em>See also</em>
<a href="#CustomEditorProvider.onDidChangeCustomDocument">CustomEditorProvider.onDidChangeCustomDocument</a>.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="CustomDocumentEditEvent.document"></a><span class="ts" id=2505 data-target="#details-2505" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2505">

<a name="CustomDocumentEditEvent.label"></a><span class="ts" id=2510 data-target="#details-2510" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">label</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2510">
<div class="comment"><p>Display name describing the edit.</p>

</div>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="CustomDocumentEditEvent.redo"></a><span class="ts" id=2509 data-target="#details-2509" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">redo</span><span>(</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span> &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2509">
<div class="comment"><p>Redo the edit operation.</p>
<p>This is invoked by the editor when the user redoes this edit. To implement <code>redo</code>, your
extension should restore the document and editor to the state they were in just after this
edit was added to the editor&#39;s internal edit stack by <a href="#CustomEditorProvider.onDidChangeCustomDocument">CustomEditorProvider.onDidChangeCustomDocument</a>.</p>
</div>

<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span> &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="CustomDocumentEditEvent.undo"></a><span class="ts" id=2507 data-target="#details-2507" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">undo</span><span>(</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span> &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2507">
<div class="comment"><p>Undo the edit operation.</p>
<p>This is invoked by the editor when the user undoes this edit. To implement <code>undo</code>, your
extension should restore the document and editor to the state they were in just before this
edit was added to the editor&#39;s internal edit stack by <a href="#CustomEditorProvider.onDidChangeCustomDocument">CustomEditorProvider.onDidChangeCustomDocument</a>.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">

</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="CustomDocumentOpenContext"></a><span class="code-item" id=2520>CustomDocumentOpenContext</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Additional information about the opening custom document.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="CustomDocumentOpenContext.backupId"></a><span class="ts" id=2521 data-target="#details-2521" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">backupId</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2521">
<div class="comment"><p>The id of the backup to restore the document from or <code>undefined</code> if there is no backup.</p>

</div>
