<a name="CustomDocumentOpenContext.untitledDocumentData"></a><span class="ts" id=2522 data-target="#details-2522" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">untitledDocumentData</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref-ts">Uint8Array</span>&lt;<span class="type-ref-ts">ArrayBufferLike</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2522">
<div class="comment"><p>If the URI is an untitled file, this will be populated with the byte data of that file</p>
<p>If this is provided, your extension should utilize this byte data rather than executing fs APIs on the URI passed in</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="CustomEditorProvider"></a><span class="code-item" id=2535>CustomEditorProvider&lt;T&gt;</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Provider for editable custom editors that use a custom document model.</p>
<p>Custom editors use <a href="#CustomDocument">CustomDocument</a> as their document model instead of a <a href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a>.
This gives extensions full control over actions such as edit, save, and backup.</p>
<p>You should use this type of custom editor when dealing with binary files or more complex scenarios. For simple
text based documents, use <a href="#CustomTextEditorProvider">CustomTextEditorProvider</a> instead.</p>
</div>

#### Events



<a name="CustomEditorProvider.onDidChangeCustomDocument"></a><span class="ts" id=2537 data-target="#details-2537" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeCustomDocument</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#CustomDocumentEditEvent&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">CustomDocumentEditEvent</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt;&gt; &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#CustomDocumentContentChangeEvent&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">CustomDocumentContentChangeEvent</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt;&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2537">
<div class="comment"><p>Signal that an edit has occurred inside a custom editor.</p>
<p>This event must be fired by your extension whenever an edit happens in a custom editor. An edit can be
anything from changing some text, to cropping an image, to reordering a list. Your extension is free to
define what an edit is and what data is stored on each edit.</p>
<p>Firing <a href="#CustomEditorProvider.onDidChangeCustomDocument">onDidChangeCustomDocument</a> causes the
editors to be marked as being dirty. This is cleared when the user either saves or reverts the file.</p>
<p>Editors that support undo/redo must fire a <a href="#CustomDocumentEditEvent">CustomDocumentEditEvent</a> whenever an edit happens. This allows
users to undo and redo the edit using the editor&#39;s standard keyboard shortcuts. The editor will also mark
the editor as no longer being dirty if the user undoes all edits to the last saved state.</p>
<p>Editors that support editing but cannot use the editor&#39;s standard undo/redo mechanism must fire a <a href="#CustomDocumentContentChangeEvent">CustomDocumentContentChangeEvent</a>.
The only way for a user to clear the dirty state of an editor that does not support undo/redo is to either
<code>save</code> or <code>revert</code> the file.</p>
<p>An editor should only ever fire <a href="#CustomDocumentEditEvent">CustomDocumentEditEvent</a> events, or only ever fire <a href="#CustomDocumentContentChangeEvent">CustomDocumentContentChangeEvent</a> events.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="CustomEditorProvider.backupCustomDocument"></a><span class="ts" id=2552 data-target="#details-2552" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">backupCustomDocument</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span>, <span class="ident">context</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CustomDocumentBackupContext">CustomDocumentBackupContext</a>, <span class="ident">cancellation</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#CustomDocumentBackup">CustomDocumentBackup</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2552">
<div class="comment"><p>Back up a dirty custom document.</p>
<p>Backups are used for hot exit and to prevent data loss. Your <a href="#CustomEditorProvider.backupCustomDocument">backupCustomDocument</a> method should persist the resource in
its current state, i.e. with the edits applied. Most commonly this means saving the resource to disk in
the <code>ExtensionContext.storagePath</code>. When the editor reloads and your custom editor is opened for a resource,
your extension should first check to see if any backups exist for the resource. If there is a backup, your
extension should load the file contents from there instead of from the resource in the workspace.</p>
<p><a href="#CustomEditorProvider.backupCustomDocument">backupCustomDocument</a> is triggered approximately one second after the user stops editing the document. If the user
rapidly edits the document, <a href="#CustomEditorProvider.backupCustomDocument">backupCustomDocument</a> will not be invoked until the editing stops.</p>
<p><a href="#CustomEditorProvider.backupCustomDocument">backupCustomDocument</a> is not invoked when <code>auto save</code> is enabled (since auto save already persists the resource).</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Document to backup.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">context</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CustomDocumentBackupContext">CustomDocumentBackupContext</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Information that can be used to backup the document.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">cancellation</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Token that signals the current backup since a new backup is coming in. It is up to your
extension to decided how to respond to cancellation. If for example your extension is backing up a large file
in an operation that takes time to complete, your extension may decide to finish the ongoing backup rather
than cancelling it to ensure that the editor has some valid backup.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#CustomDocumentBackup">CustomDocumentBackup</a>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A <a href="#Thenable">Thenable</a> signaling that the backup has completed.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="CustomEditorProvider.openCustomDocument"></a><span class="ts" id=2557 data-target="#details-2557" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">openCustomDocument</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">uri</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a>, <span class="ident">openContext</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CustomDocumentOpenContext">CustomDocumentOpenContext</a>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span> &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2557">
<div class="comment"><p>Create a new document for a given resource.</p>
<p><code>openCustomDocument</code> is called when the first time an editor for a given resource is opened. The opened
document is then passed to <a href="#CustomReadonlyEditorProvider.resolveCustomEditor">resolveCustomEditor</a> so that the editor can be shown to the user.</p>
<p>Already opened <a href="#CustomDocument">CustomDocuments</a> are re-used if the user opened additional editors. When all editors for a
given resource are closed, the <a href="#CustomDocument">CustomDocuments</a> is disposed of. Opening an editor at this point will
trigger another call to <code>openCustomDocument</code>.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">uri</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Uri of the document to open.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">openContext</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CustomDocumentOpenContext">CustomDocumentOpenContext</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Additional information about the opening custom document.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token that indicates the result is no longer needed.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">T</span> &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>The custom document.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="CustomEditorProvider.resolveCustomEditor"></a><span class="ts" id=2562 data-target="#details-2562" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">resolveCustomEditor</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span>, <span class="ident">webviewPanel</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#WebviewPanel">WebviewPanel</a>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span> &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2562">
<div class="comment"><p>Resolve a custom editor for a given resource.</p>
<p>This is called whenever the user opens a new editor for this <code>CustomEditorProvider</code>.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Document for the resource being resolved.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">webviewPanel</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#WebviewPanel">WebviewPanel</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The webview panel used to display the editor UI for this resource.</p>
<p>During resolve, the provider must fill in the initial html for the content webview panel and hook up all
the event listeners on it that it is interested in. The provider can also hold onto the <code>WebviewPanel</code> to
use later for example in a command. See <a href="#WebviewPanel">WebviewPanel</a> for additional details.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token that indicates the result is no longer needed.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span> &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>Optional thenable indicating that the custom editor has been resolved.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="CustomEditorProvider.revertCustomDocument"></a><span class="ts" id=2548 data-target="#details-2548" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">revertCustomDocument</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span>, <span class="ident">cancellation</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2548">
<div class="comment"><p>Revert a custom document to its last saved state.</p>
<p>This method is invoked by the editor when the user triggers <code>File: Revert File</code> in a custom editor. (Note that
this is only used using the editor&#39;s <code>File: Revert File</code> command and not on a <code>git revert</code> of the file).</p>
<p>The implementer must make sure all editor instances (webviews) for <a href="#CustomEditorProvider.revertCustomDocument.document">document</a>
are displaying the document in the same state is saved in. This usually means reloading the file from the
workspace.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Document to revert.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">cancellation</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Token that signals the revert is no longer required.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A <a href="#Thenable">Thenable</a> signaling that the revert has completed.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="CustomEditorProvider.saveCustomDocument"></a><span class="ts" id=2539 data-target="#details-2539" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">saveCustomDocument</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span>, <span class="ident">cancellation</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2539">
<div class="comment"><p>Save a custom document.</p>
<p>This method is invoked by the editor when the user saves a custom editor. This can happen when the user
triggers save while the custom editor is active, by commands such as <code>save all</code>, or by auto save if enabled.</p>
<p>The implementer must persist the custom editor. This usually means writing the
file data for the custom document to disk. After <a href="#CustomEditorProvider.saveCustomDocument">saveCustomDocument</a> completes, any associated
editor instances will no longer be marked as dirty.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Document to save.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">cancellation</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Token that signals the save is no longer required (for example, if another save was triggered).</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A <a href="#Thenable">Thenable</a> that saving has completed.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="CustomEditorProvider.saveCustomDocumentAs"></a><span class="ts" id=2543 data-target="#details-2543" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">saveCustomDocumentAs</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span>, <span class="ident">destination</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a>, <span class="ident">cancellation</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2543">
<div class="comment"><p>Save a custom document to a different location.</p>
<p>This method is invoked by the editor when the user triggers &#39;save as&#39; on a custom editor. The implementer must
persist the custom editor to <a href="#CustomEditorProvider.saveCustomDocumentAs.destination">destination</a>.</p>
<p>When the user accepts save as, the current editor is be replaced by an non-dirty editor for the newly saved file.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Document to save.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">destination</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Location to save to.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">cancellation</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Token that signals the save is no longer required.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A <a href="#Thenable">Thenable</a> signaling that saving has completed.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="CustomExecution"></a><span class="code-item" id=2211>CustomExecution</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Class used to execute an extension callback as a task.</p>
</div>

#### Constructors



<a name="CustomExecution.CustomExecution"></a><span class="ts" id=2213 data-target="#details-2213" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">CustomExecution</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">callback</span><span>: </span>(resolvedDefinition: <a class="type-ref" href="#TaskDefinition">TaskDefinition</a>) =&gt; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#Pseudoterminal">Pseudoterminal</a>&gt;<span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CustomExecution">CustomExecution</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2213">
<div class="comment"><p>Constructs a CustomExecution task object. The callback will be executed when the task is run, at which point the
extension should return the Pseudoterminal it will &quot;run in&quot;. The task should wait to do further execution until
<a href="#Pseudoterminal.open">Pseudoterminal.open</a> is called. Task cancellation should be handled using
<a href="#Pseudoterminal.close">Pseudoterminal.close</a>. When the task is complete fire
<a href="#Pseudoterminal.onDidClose">Pseudoterminal.onDidClose</a>.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">callback</span><span>: </span>(resolvedDefinition: <a class="type-ref" href="#TaskDefinition">TaskDefinition</a>) =&gt; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#Pseudoterminal">Pseudoterminal</a>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>The callback that will be called when the task is started by a user. Any ${} style variables that
were in the task definition will be resolved and passed into the callback as <code>resolvedDefinition</code>.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#CustomExecution">CustomExecution</a></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="CustomReadonlyEditorProvider"></a><span class="code-item" id=2523>CustomReadonlyEditorProvider&lt;T&gt;</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Provider for readonly custom editors that use a custom document model.</p>
<p>Custom editors use <a href="#CustomDocument">CustomDocument</a> as their document model instead of a <a href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a>.</p>
<p>You should use this type of custom editor when dealing with binary files or more complex scenarios. For simple
text based documents, use <a href="#CustomTextEditorProvider">CustomTextEditorProvider</a> instead.</p>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="CustomReadonlyEditorProvider.openCustomDocument"></a><span class="ts" id=2526 data-target="#details-2526" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">openCustomDocument</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">uri</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a>, <span class="ident">openContext</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CustomDocumentOpenContext">CustomDocumentOpenContext</a>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span> &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2526">
<div class="comment"><p>Create a new document for a given resource.</p>
<p><code>openCustomDocument</code> is called when the first time an editor for a given resource is opened. The opened
document is then passed to <a href="#CustomReadonlyEditorProvider.resolveCustomEditor">resolveCustomEditor</a> so that the editor can be shown to the user.</p>
<p>Already opened <a href="#CustomDocument">CustomDocuments</a> are re-used if the user opened additional editors. When all editors for a
given resource are closed, the <a href="#CustomDocument">CustomDocuments</a> is disposed of. Opening an editor at this point will
trigger another call to <code>openCustomDocument</code>.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">uri</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Uri of the document to open.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">openContext</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CustomDocumentOpenContext">CustomDocumentOpenContext</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Additional information about the opening custom document.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token that indicates the result is no longer needed.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">T</span> &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>The custom document.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="CustomReadonlyEditorProvider.resolveCustomEditor"></a><span class="ts" id=2531 data-target="#details-2531" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">resolveCustomEditor</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span>, <span class="ident">webviewPanel</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#WebviewPanel">WebviewPanel</a>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span> &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2531">
<div class="comment"><p>Resolve a custom editor for a given resource.</p>
<p>This is called whenever the user opens a new editor for this <code>CustomEditorProvider</code>.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Document for the resource being resolved.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">webviewPanel</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#WebviewPanel">WebviewPanel</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The webview panel used to display the editor UI for this resource.</p>
<p>During resolve, the provider must fill in the initial html for the content webview panel and hook up all
the event listeners on it that it is interested in. The provider can also hold onto the <code>WebviewPanel</code> to
use later for example in a command. See <a href="#WebviewPanel">WebviewPanel</a> for additional details.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token that indicates the result is no longer needed.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span> &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>Optional thenable indicating that the custom editor has been resolved.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="CustomTextEditorProvider"></a><span class="code-item" id=2493>CustomTextEditorProvider</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Provider for text based custom editors.</p>
<p>Text based custom editors use a <a href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a> as their data model. This considerably simplifies
implementing a custom editor as it allows the editor to handle many common operations such as
undo and backup. The provider is responsible for synchronizing text changes between the webview and the <a href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a>.</p>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="CustomTextEditorProvider.resolveCustomTextEditor"></a><span class="ts" id=2495 data-target="#details-2495" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">resolveCustomTextEditor</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a>, <span class="ident">webviewPanel</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#WebviewPanel">WebviewPanel</a>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span> &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2495">
<div class="comment"><p>Resolve a custom editor for a given text resource.</p>
<p>This is called when a user first opens a resource for a <code>CustomTextEditorProvider</code>, or if they reopen an
existing editor using this <code>CustomTextEditorProvider</code>.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Document for the resource to resolve.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">webviewPanel</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#WebviewPanel">WebviewPanel</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The webview panel used to display the editor UI for this resource.</p>
<p>During resolve, the provider must fill in the initial html for the content webview panel and hook up all
the event listeners on it that it is interested in. The provider can also hold onto the <a href="#WebviewPanel">WebviewPanel</a> to
use later for example in a command. See <a href="#WebviewPanel">WebviewPanel</a> for additional details.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token that indicates the result is no longer needed.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span> &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>Thenable indicating that the custom editor has been resolved.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="DataTransfer"></a><span class="code-item" id=2926>DataTransfer</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A map containing a mapping of the mime type of the corresponding transferred data.</p>
<p>Drag and drop controllers that implement <a href="#TreeDragAndDropController.handleDrag"><code>handleDrag</code></a> can add additional mime types to the
data transfer. These additional mime types will only be included in the <code>handleDrop</code> when the drag was initiated from
an element in the same drag and drop controller.</p>
</div>

<a name="DataTransfer.get"></a><span class="ts" id=2930 data-target="#details-2930" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">get</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">mimeType</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DataTransferItem">DataTransferItem</a></span>

### <a name="DebugAdapter"></a><span class="code-item" id=4080>DebugAdapter</span>

</div>



<a name="DebugAdapterDescriptor"></a><span class="ts" id=4091 data-target="#details-4091" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">DebugAdapterDescriptor</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DebugAdapterExecutable">DebugAdapterExecutable</a> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#DebugAdapterServer">DebugAdapterServer</a> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#DebugAdapterNamedPipeServer">DebugAdapterNamedPipeServer</a> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#DebugAdapterInlineImplementation">DebugAdapterInlineImplementation</a></span>

### <a name="DebugAdapterDescriptorFactory"></a><span class="code-item" id=4092>DebugAdapterDescriptorFactory</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A debug adapter factory that creates <a href="#DebugAdapterDescriptor">debug adapter descriptors</a>.</p>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="DebugAdapterDescriptorFactory.createDebugAdapterDescriptor"></a><span class="ts" id=4094 data-target="#details-4094" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">createDebugAdapterDescriptor</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">session</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DebugSession">DebugSession</a>, <span class="ident">executable</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DebugAdapterExecutable">DebugAdapterExecutable</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#DebugAdapterDescriptor">DebugAdapterDescriptor</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4094">
<div class="comment"><p>&#39;createDebugAdapterDescriptor&#39; is called at the start of a debug session to provide details about the debug adapter to use.
These details must be returned as objects of type <a href="#DebugAdapterDescriptor">DebugAdapterDescriptor</a>.
Currently two types of debug adapters are supported:</p>
<ul>
<li>a debug adapter executable is specified as a command path and arguments (see <a href="#DebugAdapterExecutable">DebugAdapterExecutable</a>),</li>
<li>a debug adapter server reachable via a communication port (see <a href="#DebugAdapterServer">DebugAdapterServer</a>).
If the method is not implemented the default behavior is this:
createDebugAdapter(session: DebugSession, executable: DebugAdapterExecutable) {
   if (typeof session.configuration.debugServer === &#39;number&#39;) {
  return new DebugAdapterServer(session.configuration.debugServer);
   }
   return executable;
}</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">session</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DebugSession">DebugSession</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The <a href="#DebugSession">debug session</a> for which the debug adapter will be used.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">executable</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DebugAdapterExecutable">DebugAdapterExecutable</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The debug adapter&#39;s executable information as specified in the package.json (or undefined if no such information exists).</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#DebugAdapterDescriptor">DebugAdapterDescriptor</a>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>a <a href="#DebugAdapterDescriptor">debug adapter descriptor</a> or undefined.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="DebugConfigurationProvider"></a><span class="code-item" id=4038>DebugConfigurationProvider</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A debug configuration provider allows to add debug configurations to the debug service
and to resolve launch configurations before they are used to start a debug session.
A debug configuration provider is registered via <a href="#debug.registerDebugConfigurationProvider">debug.registerDebugConfigurationProvider</a>.</p>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="DebugConfigurationProvider.provideDebugConfigurations"></a><span class="ts" id=4040 data-target="#details-4040" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">provideDebugConfigurations</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">folder</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#WorkspaceFolder">WorkspaceFolder</a>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#DebugConfiguration">DebugConfiguration</a>[]&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4040">
<div class="comment"><p>Provides <a href="#DebugConfiguration">debug configuration</a> to the debug service. If more than one debug configuration provider is
registered for the same type, debug configurations are concatenated in arbitrary order.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">folder</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#WorkspaceFolder">WorkspaceFolder</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The workspace folder for which the configurations are used or <code>undefined</code> for a folderless setup.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#DebugConfiguration">DebugConfiguration</a>[]&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>An array of <a href="#DebugConfiguration">debug configurations</a>.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DebugConfigurationProvider.resolveDebugConfiguration"></a><span class="ts" id=4044 data-target="#details-4044" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">resolveDebugConfiguration</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">folder</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#WorkspaceFolder">WorkspaceFolder</a>, <span class="ident">debugConfiguration</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DebugConfiguration">DebugConfiguration</a>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#DebugConfiguration">DebugConfiguration</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4044">
<div class="comment"><p>Resolves a <a href="#DebugConfiguration">debug configuration</a> by filling in missing values or by adding/changing/removing attributes.
If more than one debug configuration provider is registered for the same type, the resolveDebugConfiguration calls are chained
in arbitrary order and the initial debug configuration is piped through the chain.
Returning the value &#39;undefined&#39; prevents the debug session from starting.
Returning the value &#39;null&#39; prevents the debug session from starting and opens the underlying debug configuration instead.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">folder</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#WorkspaceFolder">WorkspaceFolder</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The workspace folder from which the configuration originates from or <code>undefined</code> for a folderless setup.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">debugConfiguration</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DebugConfiguration">DebugConfiguration</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The <a href="#DebugConfiguration">debug configuration</a> to resolve.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#DebugConfiguration">DebugConfiguration</a>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>The resolved debug configuration or undefined or null.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DebugConfigurationProvider.resolveDebugConfigurationWithSubstitutedVariables"></a><span class="ts" id=4049 data-target="#details-4049" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">resolveDebugConfigurationWithSubstitutedVariables</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">folder</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#WorkspaceFolder">WorkspaceFolder</a>, <span class="ident">debugConfiguration</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DebugConfiguration">DebugConfiguration</a>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#DebugConfiguration">DebugConfiguration</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4049">
<div class="comment"><p>This hook is directly called after &#39;resolveDebugConfiguration&#39; but with all variables substituted.
It can be used to resolve or verify a <a href="#DebugConfiguration">debug configuration</a> by filling in missing values or by adding/changing/removing attributes.
If more than one debug configuration provider is registered for the same type, the &#39;resolveDebugConfigurationWithSubstitutedVariables&#39; calls are chained
in arbitrary order and the initial debug configuration is piped through the chain.
Returning the value &#39;undefined&#39; prevents the debug session from starting.
Returning the value &#39;null&#39; prevents the debug session from starting and opens the underlying debug configuration instead.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">folder</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#WorkspaceFolder">WorkspaceFolder</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The workspace folder from which the configuration originates from or <code>undefined</code> for a folderless setup.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">debugConfiguration</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DebugConfiguration">DebugConfiguration</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The <a href="#DebugConfiguration">debug configuration</a> to resolve.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#DebugConfiguration">DebugConfiguration</a>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>The resolved debug configuration or undefined or null.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="DebugConfigurationProviderTriggerKind"></a><span class="code-item" id=4184>DebugConfigurationProviderTriggerKind</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A DebugConfigurationProviderTriggerKind specifies when the <code>provideDebugConfigurations</code> method of a <code>DebugConfigurationProvider</code> is triggered.
Currently there are two situations: to provide the initial debug configurations for a newly created launch.json or
to provide dynamically generated debug configurations when the user asks for them through the UI (e.g. via the &quot;Select and Start Debugging&quot; command).
A trigger kind is used when registering a <code>DebugConfigurationProvider</code> with <a href="#debug.registerDebugConfigurationProvider">debug.registerDebugConfigurationProvider</a>.</p>
</div>

#### Enumeration Members



<a name="DebugConfigurationProviderTriggerKind.Initial"></a><span class="ts" id=4185 data-target="#details-4185" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Initial</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">1</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4185">
<div class="comment"><p><code>DebugConfigurationProvider.provideDebugConfigurations</code> is called to provide the initial debug configurations for a newly created launch.json.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DebugConfigurationProviderTriggerKind.Dynamic"></a><span class="ts" id=4186 data-target="#details-4186" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Dynamic</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">2</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4186">
<div class="comment"><p><code>DebugConfigurationProvider.provideDebugConfigurations</code> is called to provide dynamically generated debug configurations when the user asks for them through the UI (e.g. via the &quot;Select and Start Debugging&quot; command).</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="DebugConsoleMode"></a><span class="code-item" id=4170>DebugConsoleMode</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Debug console mode used by debug session, see <a href="#DebugSessionOptions">options</a>.</p>
</div>

#### Enumeration Members



<a name="DebugConsoleMode.Separate"></a><span class="ts" id=4171 data-target="#details-4171" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Separate</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">0</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4171">
<div class="comment"><p>Debug session should have a separate debug console.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DebugConsoleMode.MergeWithParent"></a><span class="ts" id=4172 data-target="#details-4172" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">MergeWithParent</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">1</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4172">
<div class="comment"><p>Debug session should share debug console with its parent session.
This value has no effect for sessions which do not have a parent session.</p>
</div>
</div>

<div class="comment"><p>A DebugProtocolMessage is an opaque stand-in type for the <a href="https://microsoft.github.io/debug-adapter-protocol/specification#Base_Protocol_ProtocolMessage">ProtocolMessage</a> type defined in the Debug Adapter Protocol.</p>
</div>

### <a name="DebugProtocolSource"></a><span class="code-item" id=4012>DebugProtocolSource</span>

### <a name="DebugSession"></a><span class="code-item" id=4020>DebugSession</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A debug session.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="DebugSession.configuration"></a><span class="ts" id=4026 data-target="#details-4026" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">configuration</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DebugConfiguration">DebugConfiguration</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4026">
<div class="comment"><p>The &quot;resolved&quot; <a href="#DebugConfiguration">debug configuration</a> of this session.
&quot;Resolved&quot; means that</p>
<ul>
<li>all variables have been substituted and</li>
<li>platform specific attribute sections have been &quot;flattened&quot; for the matching platform and removed for non-matching platforms.</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DebugSession.id"></a><span class="ts" id=4021 data-target="#details-4021" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">id</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4021">
<div class="comment"><p>The unique ID of this debug session.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DebugSession.name"></a><span class="ts" id=4024 data-target="#details-4024" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">name</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4024">
<div class="comment"><p>The debug session&#39;s name is initially taken from the <a href="#DebugConfiguration">debug configuration</a>.
Any changes will be properly reflected in the UI.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DebugSession.parentSession"></a><span class="ts" id=4023 data-target="#details-4023" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">parentSession</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DebugSession">DebugSession</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4023">
<div class="comment"><p>The parent session of this debug session, if it was created as a child.</p>
<p><em>See also</em>
DebugSessionOptions.parentSession</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DebugSession.type"></a><span class="ts" id=4022 data-target="#details-4022" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">type</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4022">
<div class="comment"><p>The debug session&#39;s type from the <a href="#DebugConfiguration">debug configuration</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DebugSession.workspaceFolder"></a><span class="ts" id=4025 data-target="#details-4025" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">workspaceFolder</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#WorkspaceFolder">WorkspaceFolder</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4025">
<div class="comment"><p>The workspace folder of this session or <code>undefined</code> for a folderless setup.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="DebugSession.customRequest"></a><span class="ts" id=4028 data-target="#details-4028" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">customRequest</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">command</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">args</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">any</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">any</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4028">
<div class="comment"><p>Send a custom request to the debug adapter.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">command</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">args</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">any</span></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">any</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DebugSession.getDebugProtocolBreakpoint"></a><span class="ts" id=4032 data-target="#details-4032" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">getDebugProtocolBreakpoint</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">breakpoint</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Breakpoint">Breakpoint</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#DebugProtocolBreakpoint">DebugProtocolBreakpoint</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4032">
<div class="comment"><p>Maps a breakpoint in the editor to the corresponding Debug Adapter Protocol (DAP) breakpoint that is managed by the debug adapter of the debug session.
If no DAP breakpoint exists (either because the editor breakpoint was not yet registered or because the debug adapter is not interested in the breakpoint), the value <code>undefined</code> is returned.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">breakpoint</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Breakpoint">Breakpoint</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A <a href="#Breakpoint">Breakpoint</a> in the editor.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#DebugProtocolBreakpoint">DebugProtocolBreakpoint</a>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A promise that resolves to the Debug Adapter Protocol breakpoint or <code>undefined</code>.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="DebugSessionCustomEvent"></a><span class="code-item" id=4034>DebugSessionCustomEvent</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A custom Debug Adapter Protocol event received from a <a href="#DebugSession">debug session</a>.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="DebugSessionCustomEvent.body"></a><span class="ts" id=4037 data-target="#details-4037" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">body</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">any</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4037">
<div class="comment"><p>Event specific information.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DebugSessionCustomEvent.event"></a><span class="ts" id=4036 data-target="#details-4036" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">event</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4036">
<div class="comment"><p>Type of event.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DebugSessionCustomEvent.session"></a><span class="ts" id=4035 data-target="#details-4035" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">session</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DebugSession">DebugSession</a></span>

### <a name="DebugSessionOptions"></a><span class="code-item" id=4173>DebugSessionOptions</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Options for <a href="#debug.startDebugging">starting a debug session</a>.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="DebugSessionOptions.compact"></a><span class="ts" id=4178 data-target="#details-4178" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">compact</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4178">
<div class="comment"><p>Controls if the debug session&#39;s parent session is shown in the CALL STACK view even if it has only a single child.
By default, the debug session will never hide its parent.
If compact is true, debug sessions with a single child are hidden in the CALL STACK view to make the tree more compact.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DebugSessionOptions.consoleMode"></a><span class="ts" id=4176 data-target="#details-4176" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">consoleMode</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DebugConsoleMode">DebugConsoleMode</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4176">
<div class="comment"><p>Controls whether this session should have a separate debug console or share it
with the parent session. Has no effect for sessions which do not have a parent session.
Defaults to Separate.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DebugSessionOptions.lifecycleManagedByParent"></a><span class="ts" id=4175 data-target="#details-4175" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">lifecycleManagedByParent</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4175">
<div class="comment"><p>Controls whether lifecycle requests like &#39;restart&#39; are sent to the newly created session or its parent session.
By default (if the property is false or missing), lifecycle requests are sent to the new session.
This property is ignored if the session has no parent session.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DebugSessionOptions.noDebug"></a><span class="ts" id=4177 data-target="#details-4177" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">noDebug</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4177">
<div class="comment"><p>Controls whether this session should run without debugging, thus ignoring breakpoints.
When this property is not specified, the value from the parent session (if there is one) is used.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DebugSessionOptions.parentSession"></a><span class="ts" id=4174 data-target="#details-4174" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">parentSession</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DebugSession">DebugSession</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4174">
<div class="comment"><p>When specified the newly created debug session is registered as a &quot;child&quot; session of this
&quot;parent&quot; debug session.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DebugSessionOptions.suppressDebugStatusbar"></a><span class="ts" id=4181 data-target="#details-4181" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">suppressDebugStatusbar</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4181">
<div class="comment"><p>When true, the window statusbar color will not be changed for this session.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DebugSessionOptions.suppressDebugToolbar"></a><span class="ts" id=4180 data-target="#details-4180" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">suppressDebugToolbar</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4180">
<div class="comment"><p>When true, the debug toolbar will not be shown for this session.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DebugSessionOptions.suppressDebugView"></a><span class="ts" id=4182 data-target="#details-4182" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">suppressDebugView</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4182">
<div class="comment"><p>When true, the debug viewlet will not be automatically revealed for this session.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DebugSessionOptions.suppressSaveBeforeStart"></a><span class="ts" id=4179 data-target="#details-4179" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">suppressSaveBeforeStart</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4179">
<div class="comment"><p>When true, a save will not be triggered for open editors when starting a debug session, regardless of the value of the <code>debug.saveBeforeStart</code> setting.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DebugSessionOptions.testRun"></a><span class="ts" id=4183 data-target="#details-4183" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">testRun</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TestRun">TestRun</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4183">
<div class="comment"><p>Signals to the editor that the debug session was started from a test run
request. This is used to link the lifecycle of the debug session and
test run in UI actions.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="DebugStackFrame"></a><span class="code-item" id=4194>DebugStackFrame</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Represents a stack frame in a debug session.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="DebugStackFrame.frameId"></a><span class="ts" id=4202 data-target="#details-4202" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">frameId</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4202">
<div class="comment"><p>ID of the stack frame in the debug protocol.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DebugStackFrame.session"></a><span class="ts" id=4200 data-target="#details-4200" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">session</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DebugSession">DebugSession</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4200">
<div class="comment"><p>Debug session for thread.</p>

### <a name="DeclarationCoverage"></a><span class="code-item" id=4653>DeclarationCoverage</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Contains coverage information for a declaration. Depending on the reporter
and language, this may be types such as functions, methods, or namespaces.</p>
</div>

#### Constructors



<a name="DeclarationCoverage.DeclarationCoverage"></a><span class="ts" id=4655 data-target="#details-4655" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">DeclarationCoverage</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">name</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">executed</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span> &#124; <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>, <span class="ident">location</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DeclarationCoverage">DeclarationCoverage</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4655">
<div class="comment"></div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">name</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">executed</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span> &#124; <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The number of times this declaration was executed, or a
boolean indicating  whether it was executed if the exact count is
unknown. If zero or false, the declaration will be marked as un-covered.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">location</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The declaration position.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>

### <a name="DecorationRangeBehavior"></a><span class="code-item" id=217>DecorationRangeBehavior</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Describes the behavior of decorations when typing/editing at their edges.</p>

<a name="DecorationRangeBehavior.OpenOpen"></a><span class="ts" id=218 data-target="#details-218" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">OpenOpen</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">0</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-218">
<div class="comment"><p>The decoration&#39;s range will widen when edits occur at the start or end.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DecorationRangeBehavior.ClosedClosed"></a><span class="ts" id=219 data-target="#details-219" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">ClosedClosed</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">1</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-219">
<div class="comment"><p>The decoration&#39;s range will not widen when edits occur at the start or end.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DecorationRangeBehavior.OpenClosed"></a><span class="ts" id=220 data-target="#details-220" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">OpenClosed</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">2</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-220">
<div class="comment"><p>The decoration&#39;s range will widen when edits occur at the start, but not at the end.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DecorationRangeBehavior.ClosedOpen"></a><span class="ts" id=221 data-target="#details-221" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">ClosedOpen</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">3</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-221">
<div class="comment"><p>The decoration&#39;s range will widen when edits occur at the end, but not at the start.</p>
</div>
</div>

<div class="details collapse" id="details-302">
<div class="comment"><p>CSS styling property that will be applied to text enclosed by a decoration.
Better use &#39;outline&#39; for setting one or more of the individual outline properties.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DecorationRenderOptions.outlineWidth"></a><span class="ts" id=303 data-target="#details-303" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">outlineWidth</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-303">
<div class="comment"><p>CSS styling property that will be applied to text enclosed by a decoration.
Better use &#39;outline&#39; for setting one or more of the individual outline properties.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DecorationRenderOptions.overviewRulerColor"></a><span class="ts" id=319 data-target="#details-319" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">overviewRulerColor</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#ThemeColor">ThemeColor</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-319">

<a name="DecorationRenderOptions.overviewRulerLane"></a><span class="ts" id=296 data-target="#details-296" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">overviewRulerLane</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#OverviewRulerLane">OverviewRulerLane</a></span>

<a name="DecorationRenderOptions.rangeBehavior"></a><span class="ts" id=295 data-target="#details-295" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">rangeBehavior</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DecorationRangeBehavior">DecorationRangeBehavior</a></span>

</div>



<a name="DecorationRenderOptions.textDecoration"></a><span class="ts" id=312 data-target="#details-312" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">textDecoration</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>

</div>

### <a name="Definition"></a><span class="code-item" id=674>Definition</span>



<div class="comment"><p>The definition of a symbol represented as one or many <a href="#Location">locations</a>.
For most programming languages there is only one location at which a symbol is
defined.</p>
</div>



<a name="Definition"></a><span class="ts" id=674 data-target="#details-674" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Definition</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Location">Location</a> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#Location">Location</a>[]</span>

### <a name="DefinitionLink"></a><span class="code-item" id=673>DefinitionLink</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Information about where a symbol is defined.</p>
<p>Provides additional metadata over normal <a href="#Location">Location</a> definitions, including the range of
the defining symbol</p>
</div>



<a name="DefinitionLink"></a><span class="ts" id=673 data-target="#details-673" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">DefinitionLink</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#LocationLink">LocationLink</a></span>

### <a name="DefinitionProvider"></a><span class="code-item" id=675>DefinitionProvider</span>



<div class="comment"><p>The definition provider interface defines the contract between extensions and
the <a href="https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/editingevolved#_go-to-definition">go to definition</a>
and peek definition features.</p>
</div>

#### Methods

<div class="details collapse" id="details-677">

</div>

<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>

</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">position</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The position at which the command was invoked.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#Definition">Definition</a> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#LocationLink">LocationLink</a>[]&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A definition or a thenable that resolves to such. The lack of a result can be
signaled by returning <code>undefined</code> or <code>null</code>.</p>
</div></td></tr>

</div>
</div>

### <a name="Diagnostic"></a><span class="code-item" id=1765>Diagnostic</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Represents a diagnostic, such as a compiler error or warning. Diagnostic objects
are only valid in the scope of a file.</p>
</div>

#### Constructors



<a name="Diagnostic.Diagnostic"></a><span class="ts" id=1767 data-target="#details-1767" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Diagnostic</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">range</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a>, <span class="ident">message</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">severity</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DiagnosticSeverity">DiagnosticSeverity</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Diagnostic">Diagnostic</a></span>

</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">range</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The range to which this diagnostic applies.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">message</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The human-readable message.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">severity</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DiagnosticSeverity">DiagnosticSeverity</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The severity, default is <a href="#DiagnosticSeverity.Error">error</a>.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>

</table>
</div>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="Diagnostic.code"></a><span class="ts" id=1775 data-target="#details-1775" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">code</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <span class="type-intrinsic">number</span> &#124; {target: <a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a>, value: <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <span class="type-intrinsic">number</span>}</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1775">
<div class="comment"><p>A code or identifier for this diagnostic.
Should be used for later processing, e.g. when providing <a href="#CodeActionContext">code actions</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="Diagnostic.message"></a><span class="ts" id=1772 data-target="#details-1772" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">message</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1772">
<div class="comment"><p>The human-readable message.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="Diagnostic.range"></a><span class="ts" id=1771 data-target="#details-1771" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">range</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1771">
<div class="comment"><p>The range to which this diagnostic applies.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="Diagnostic.relatedInformation"></a><span class="ts" id=1779 data-target="#details-1779" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">relatedInformation</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DiagnosticRelatedInformation">DiagnosticRelatedInformation</a>[]</span>

<div class="comment"><p>An array of related diagnostic information, e.g. when symbol-names within
a scope collide all definitions can be marked via this property.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="Diagnostic.severity"></a><span class="ts" id=1773 data-target="#details-1773" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">severity</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DiagnosticSeverity">DiagnosticSeverity</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1773">
<div class="comment"><p>The severity, default is <a href="#DiagnosticSeverity.Error">error</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="Diagnostic.source"></a><span class="ts" id=1774 data-target="#details-1774" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">source</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>

<div class="comment"><p>A human-readable string describing the source of this

</div>

</div>
</div>

### <a name="DiagnosticChangeEvent"></a><span class="code-item" id=1748>DiagnosticChangeEvent</span>



<div class="comment"><p>The event that is fired when diagnostics change.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="DiagnosticChangeEvent.uris"></a><span class="ts" id=1749 data-target="#details-1749" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">uris</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1749">
<div class="comment"><p>An array of resources for which diagnostics have changed.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="DiagnosticCollection"></a><span class="code-item" id=1781>DiagnosticCollection</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A diagnostics collection is a container that manages a set of
<a href="#Diagnostic">diagnostics</a>. Diagnostics are always scopes to a
diagnostics collection and a resource.</p>
<p>To get an instance of a <code>DiagnosticCollection</code> use
<a href="#languages.createDiagnosticCollection">createDiagnosticCollection</a>.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="DiagnosticCollection.name"></a><span class="ts" id=1782 data-target="#details-1782" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">name</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1782">
<div class="comment"><p>The name of this diagnostic collection, for instance <code>typescript</code>. Every diagnostic
from this collection will be associated with this name. Also, the task framework uses this
name when defining <a href="https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/tasks#_defining-a-problem-matcher">problem matchers</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Methods

</table>
</div>
</div>

<a name="DiagnosticCollection.set"></a><span class="ts" id=1784 data-target="#details-1784" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">set</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">uri</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a>, <span class="ident">diagnostics</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#Diagnostic">Diagnostic</a>[]<span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span></span>

<a name="DiagnosticCollection.set"></a><span class="ts" id=1787 data-target="#details-1787" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">set</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">entries</span><span>: </span>ReadonlyArray&lt;[<a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a>, readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#Diagnostic">Diagnostic</a>[]]&gt;<span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1787">
<div class="comment"><p>Replace diagnostics for multiple resources in this collection.</p>
<p> <em>Note</em> that multiple tuples of the same uri will be merged, e.g
<code>[[file1, [d1]], [file1, [d2]]]</code> is equivalent to <code>[[file1, [d1, d2]]]</code>.
If a diagnostics item is <code>undefined</code> as in <code>[file1, undefined]</code>
all previous but not subsequent diagnostics are removed.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>

</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="DiagnosticRelatedInformation"></a><span class="code-item" id=1755>DiagnosticRelatedInformation</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Represents a related message and source code location for a diagnostic. This should be
used to point to code locations that cause or related to a diagnostics, e.g. when duplicating
a symbol in a scope.</p>
</div>

#### Constructors



<a name="DiagnosticRelatedInformation.DiagnosticRelatedInformation"></a><span class="ts" id=1757 data-target="#details-1757" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">DiagnosticRelatedInformation</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">location</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Location">Location</a>, <span class="ident">message</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DiagnosticRelatedInformation">DiagnosticRelatedInformation</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1757">
<div class="comment"><p>Creates a new related diagnostic information object.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
