### <a name="DiagnosticTag"></a><span class="code-item" id=1762>DiagnosticTag</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Additional metadata about the type of a diagnostic.</p>
</div>

#### Enumeration Members



<a name="DiagnosticTag.Unnecessary"></a><span class="ts" id=1763 data-target="#details-1763" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Unnecessary</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">1</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1763">
<div class="comment"><p>Unused or unnecessary code.</p>
<p>Diagnostics with this tag are rendered faded out. The amount of fading
is controlled by the <code>&quot;editorUnnecessaryCode.opacity&quot;</code> theme color. For
example, <code>&quot;editorUnnecessaryCode.opacity&quot;: &quot;#000000c0&quot;</code> will render the
code with 75% opacity. For high contrast themes, use the
<code>&quot;editorUnnecessaryCode.border&quot;</code> theme color to underline unnecessary code
instead of fading it out.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DiagnosticTag.Deprecated"></a><span class="ts" id=1764 data-target="#details-1764" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Deprecated</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">2</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1764">
<div class="comment"><p>Deprecated or obsolete code.</p>
<p>Diagnostics with this tag are rendered with a strike through.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="Disposable"></a><span class="code-item" id=453>Disposable</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Represents a type which can release resources, such
as event listening or a timer.</p>
</div>

#### Static



<a name="Disposable.from"></a><span class="ts" id=455 data-target="#details-455" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">from</span><span>(</span><span>...</span><span class="ident">disposableLikes</span><span>: </span>Array&lt;{dispose: () =&gt; <span class="type-intrinsic">any</span>}&gt;<span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-455">
<div class="comment"><p>Combine many disposable-likes into one. You can use this method when having objects with
a dispose function which aren&#39;t instances of <code>Disposable</code>.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span>...</span><span class="ident">disposableLikes</span><span>: </span>Array&lt;{dispose: () =&gt; <span class="type-intrinsic">any</span>}&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>Objects that have at least a <code>dispose</code>-function member. Note that asynchronous
dispose-functions aren&#39;t awaited.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Returns a new disposable which, upon dispose, will
dispose all provided disposables.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

<a name="Disposable.Disposable"></a><span class="ts" id=462 data-target="#details-462" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Disposable</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">callOnDispose</span><span>: </span>() =&gt; <span class="type-intrinsic">any</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></span>

<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>

</div>

### <a name="DocumentDropEditProvider"></a><span class="code-item" id=1584>DocumentDropEditProvider&lt;T&gt;</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Provider which handles dropping of resources into a text editor.</p>
<p>This allows users to drag and drop resources (including resources from external apps) into the editor. While dragging
and dropping files, users can hold down <code>shift</code> to drop the file into the editor instead of opening it.
Requires <code>editor.dropIntoEditor.enabled</code> to be on.</p>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="DocumentDropEditProvider.provideDocumentDropEdits"></a><span class="ts" id=1587 data-target="#details-1587" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">provideDocumentDropEdits</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a>, <span class="ident">position</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a>, <span class="ident">dataTransfer</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DataTransfer">DataTransfer</a>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span> &#124; <span class="type-ref">T</span>[]&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1587">
<div class="comment"><p>Provide edits which inserts the content being dragged and dropped into the document.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The document in which the drop occurred.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">position</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The position in the document where the drop occurred.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">dataTransfer</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DataTransfer">DataTransfer</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A <a href="#DataTransfer">DataTransfer</a> object that holds data about what is being dragged and dropped.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span> &#124; <span class="type-ref">T</span>[]&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A <a href="#DocumentDropEdit">DocumentDropEdit</a> or a thenable that resolves to such. The lack of a result can be
signaled by returning <code>undefined</code> or <code>null</code>.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DocumentDropEditProvider.resolveDocumentDropEdit"></a><span class="ts" id=1593 data-target="#details-1593" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">resolveDocumentDropEdit</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">edit</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1593">
<div class="comment"><p>Optional method which fills in the <a href="#DocumentDropEdit.additionalEdit">DocumentDropEdit.additionalEdit</a> before the edit is applied.</p>
<p>This is called once per edit and should be used if generating the complete edit may take a long time.
Resolve can only be used to change <a href="#DocumentDropEdit.additionalEdit">DocumentDropEdit.additionalEdit</a>.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">edit</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The <a href="#DocumentDropEdit">DocumentDropEdit</a> to resolve.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>The resolved edit or a thenable that resolves to such. It is OK to return the given
<code>edit</code>. If no result is returned, the given <code>edit</code> is used.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="DocumentDropEditProviderMetadata"></a><span class="code-item" id=1596>DocumentDropEditProviderMetadata</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Provides additional metadata about how a <a href="#DocumentDropEditProvider">DocumentDropEditProvider</a> works.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="DocumentDropEditProviderMetadata.dropMimeTypes"></a><span class="ts" id=1598 data-target="#details-1598" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">dropMimeTypes</span><span>: </span>readonly <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1598">
<div class="comment"><p>List of <a href="#DataTransfer">DataTransfer</a> mime types that the provider can handle.</p>
<p>This can either be an exact mime type such as <code>image/png</code>, or a wildcard pattern such as <code>image/*</code>.</p>
<p>Use <code>text/uri-list</code> for resources dropped from the explorer or other tree views in the workbench.</p>
<p>Use <code>files</code> to indicate that the provider should be invoked if any <a href="#DataTransferFile">files</a> are present in the <a href="#DataTransfer">DataTransfer</a>.
Note that <a href="#DataTransferFile">DataTransferFile</a> entries are only created when dropping content from outside the editor, such as
from the operating system.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DocumentDropEditProviderMetadata.providedDropEditKinds"></a><span class="ts" id=1597 data-target="#details-1597" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">providedDropEditKinds</span><span>?</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentDropOrPasteEditKind">DocumentDropOrPasteEditKind</a>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1597">
<div class="comment"><p>List of <a href="#DocumentDropOrPasteEditKind">kinds</a> that the provider may return in <a href="#DocumentDropEditProvider.provideDocumentDropEdits">provideDocumentDropEdits</a>.</p>
<p>This is used to filter out providers when a specific <a href="#DocumentDropOrPasteEditKind">kind</a> of edit is requested.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="DocumentDropOrPasteEditKind"></a><span class="code-item" id=1556>DocumentDropOrPasteEditKind</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Identifies a <a href="#DocumentDropEdit">DocumentDropEdit</a> or <a href="#DocumentPasteEdit">DocumentPasteEdit</a></p>
</div>

#### Static



<a name="DocumentDropOrPasteEditKind.Empty"></a><span class="ts" id=1557 data-target="#details-1557" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Empty</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentDropOrPasteEditKind">DocumentDropOrPasteEditKind</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1557">
</div>



<a name="DocumentDropOrPasteEditKind.Text"></a><span class="ts" id=1558 data-target="#details-1558" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Text</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentDropOrPasteEditKind">DocumentDropOrPasteEditKind</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1558">
<div class="comment"><p>The root kind for basic text edits.</p>
<p>This kind should be used for edits that insert basic text into the document. A good example of this is
an edit that pastes the clipboard text while also updating imports in the file based on the pasted text.
For this we could use a kind such as <code>text.updateImports.someLanguageId</code>.</p>
<p>Even though most drop/paste edits ultimately insert text, you should not use <a href="#DocumentDropOrPasteEditKind.Text">Text</a> as the base kind
for every edit as this is redundant. Instead a more specific kind that describes the type of content being
inserted should be used instead. For example, if the edit adds a Markdown link, use <code>markdown.link</code> since even
though the content being inserted is text, it&#39;s more important to know that the edit inserts Markdown syntax.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DocumentDropOrPasteEditKind.TextUpdateImports"></a><span class="ts" id=1559 data-target="#details-1559" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">TextUpdateImports</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentDropOrPasteEditKind">DocumentDropOrPasteEditKind</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1559">
<div class="comment"><p>Root kind for edits that update imports in a document in addition to inserting text.</p>
</div>
</div>

<div class="details collapse" id="details-1563">

<a name="DocumentDropOrPasteEditKind.contains"></a><span class="ts" id=1571 data-target="#details-1571" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">contains</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">other</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentDropOrPasteEditKind">DocumentDropOrPasteEditKind</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>

<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DocumentDropOrPasteEditKind.intersects"></a><span class="ts" id=1568 data-target="#details-1568" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">intersects</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">other</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentDropOrPasteEditKind">DocumentDropOrPasteEditKind</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>

### <a name="DocumentFilter"></a><span class="code-item" id=582>DocumentFilter</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A document filter denotes a document by different properties like
the <a href="#TextDocument.languageId">language</a>, the <a href="#Uri.scheme">scheme</a> of
its resource, or a glob-pattern that is applied to the <a href="#TextDocument.fileName">path</a>.</p>
<p><strong>Example</strong></p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="ts" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">{ </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#C8C8C8;--shiki-light:#000000">language</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">: </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'typescript'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">, </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#C8C8C8;--shiki-light:#000000">scheme</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">: </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'file'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> }</span></span></code></pre>
<p><strong>Example</strong></p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="ts" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">{ </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#C8C8C8;--shiki-light:#000000">language</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">: </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'json'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">, </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#C8C8C8;--shiki-light:#000000">pattern</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">: </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'**/package.json'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> }</span></span></code></pre>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="DocumentFilter.language"></a><span class="ts" id=583 data-target="#details-583" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">language</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-583">
<div class="comment"><p>A language id, like <code>typescript</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DocumentFilter.notebookType"></a><span class="ts" id=584 data-target="#details-584" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">notebookType</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-584">
<div class="comment"><p>The <a href="#NotebookDocument.notebookType">type</a> of a notebook, like <code>jupyter-notebook</code>. This allows
to narrow down on the type of a notebook that a <a href="#NotebookCell.document">cell document</a> belongs to.</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that setting the <code>notebookType</code>-property changes how <code>scheme</code> and <code>pattern</code> are interpreted. When set
they are evaluated against the <a href="#NotebookDocument.uri">notebook uri</a>, not the document uri.</p>
<p><strong>Example</strong></p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="ts" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">{ </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#C8C8C8;--shiki-light:#000000">language</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">: </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'python'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">, </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#C8C8C8;--shiki-light:#000000">notebookType</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">: </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'jupyter-notebook'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">, </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#C8C8C8;--shiki-light:#000000">scheme</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">: </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'untitled'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> }</span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DocumentFilter.pattern"></a><span class="ts" id=586 data-target="#details-586" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">pattern</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#GlobPattern">GlobPattern</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-586">
<div class="comment"><p>A <a href="#GlobPattern">glob pattern</a> that is matched on the absolute path of the document. Use a <a href="#RelativePattern">relative pattern</a>
to filter documents to a <a href="#WorkspaceFolder">workspace folder</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DocumentFilter.scheme"></a><span class="ts" id=585 data-target="#details-585" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">scheme</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-585">
<div class="comment"><p>A Uri <a href="#Uri.scheme">scheme</a>, like <code>file</code> or <code>untitled</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="DocumentHighlight"></a><span class="code-item" id=791>DocumentHighlight</span>

</div>

#### Methods



<a name="DocumentLinkProvider.provideDocumentLinks"></a><span class="ts" id=1354 data-target="#details-1354" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">provideDocumentLinks</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>[]&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1354">
<div class="comment"><p>Provide links for the given document. Note that the editor ships with a default provider that detects
<code>http(s)</code> and <code>file</code> links.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The document in which the command was invoked.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>[]&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>An array of <a href="#DocumentLink">document links</a> or a thenable that resolves to such. The lack of a result
can be signaled by returning <code>undefined</code>, <code>null</code>, or an empty array.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DocumentLinkProvider.resolveDocumentLink"></a><span class="ts" id=1358 data-target="#details-1358" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">resolveDocumentLink</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">link</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1358">
<div class="comment"><p>Given a link fill in its <a href="#DocumentLink.target">target</a>. This method is called when an incomplete
link is selected in the UI. Providers can implement this method and return incomplete links
(without target) from the <a href="#DocumentLinkProvider.provideDocumentLinks">provideDocumentLinks</a> method which
often helps to improve performance.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">

</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="DocumentPasteEdit"></a><span class="code-item" id=1624>DocumentPasteEdit</span>



<div class="comment"><p>An edit the applies a paste operation.</p>
</div>

#### Constructors



<a name="DocumentPasteEdit.DocumentPasteEdit"></a><span class="ts" id=1626 data-target="#details-1626" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">DocumentPasteEdit</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">insertText</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#SnippetString">SnippetString</a>, <span class="ident">title</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">kind</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentDropOrPasteEditKind">DocumentDropOrPasteEditKind</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentPasteEdit">DocumentPasteEdit</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1626">
<div class="comment"><p>Create a new paste edit.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">insertText</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#SnippetString">SnippetString</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The text or snippet to insert at the pasted locations.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">title</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Human readable label that describes the edit.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">kind</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentDropOrPasteEditKind">DocumentDropOrPasteEditKind</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p><a href="#DocumentDropOrPasteEditKind">Kind</a> of the edit.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentPasteEdit">DocumentPasteEdit</a></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="DocumentPasteEdit.additionalEdit"></a><span class="ts" id=1633 data-target="#details-1633" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">additionalEdit</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#WorkspaceEdit">WorkspaceEdit</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1633">
<div class="comment"><p>An optional additional edit to apply on paste.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DocumentPasteEdit.insertText"></a><span class="ts" id=1632 data-target="#details-1632" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">insertText</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#SnippetString">SnippetString</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1632">
<div class="comment"><p>The text or snippet to insert at the pasted locations.</p>
<p>If your edit requires more advanced insertion logic, set this to an empty string and provide an <a href="#DocumentPasteEdit.additionalEdit">additional edit</a> instead.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DocumentPasteEdit.kind"></a><span class="ts" id=1631 data-target="#details-1631" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">kind</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentDropOrPasteEditKind">DocumentDropOrPasteEditKind</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1631">
<div class="comment"><p><a href="#DocumentDropOrPasteEditKind">Kind</a> of the edit.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DocumentPasteEdit.title"></a><span class="ts" id=1630 data-target="#details-1630" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">title</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1630">
<div class="comment"><p>Human readable label that describes the edit.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DocumentPasteEdit.yieldTo"></a><span class="ts" id=1634 data-target="#details-1634" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">yieldTo</span><span>?</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentDropOrPasteEditKind">DocumentDropOrPasteEditKind</a>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1634">
<div class="comment"><p>Controls ordering when multiple paste edits can potentially be applied.</p>
<p>If this edit yields to another, it will be shown lower in the list of possible paste edits shown to the user.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="DocumentPasteEditContext"></a><span class="code-item" id=1602>DocumentPasteEditContext</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Additional information about the paste operation.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="DocumentPasteEditContext.only"></a><span class="ts" id=1603 data-target="#details-1603" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">only</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentDropOrPasteEditKind">DocumentDropOrPasteEditKind</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1603">
<div class="comment"><p>Requested kind of paste edits to return.</p>
<p>When a explicit kind if requested by <a href="#DocumentPasteTriggerKind.PasteAs">PasteAs</a>, providers are
encourage to be more flexible when generating an edit of the requested kind.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DocumentPasteEditContext.triggerKind"></a><span class="ts" id=1604 data-target="#details-1604" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">triggerKind</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentPasteTriggerKind">DocumentPasteTriggerKind</a></span>

<div class="comment"><p>The reason why paste edits were requested.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="DocumentPasteEditProvider"></a><span class="code-item" id=1605>DocumentPasteEditProvider&lt;T&gt;</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Provider invoked when the user copies or pastes in a <a href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a>.</p>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="DocumentPasteEditProvider.prepareDocumentPaste"></a><span class="ts" id=1608 data-target="#details-1608" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">prepareDocumentPaste</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a>, <span class="ident">ranges</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a>[], <span class="ident">dataTransfer</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DataTransfer">DataTransfer</a>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span> &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1608">
<div class="comment"><p>Optional method invoked after the user copies from a <a href="#TextEditor">text editor</a>.</p>
<p>This allows the provider to attach metadata about the copied text to the <a href="#DataTransfer">DataTransfer</a>. This data
transfer is then passed back to providers in <a href="#DocumentPasteEditProvider.provideDocumentPasteEdits">provideDocumentPasteEdits</a>.</p>
<p>Note that currently any changes to the <a href="#DataTransfer">DataTransfer</a> are isolated to the current editor window.
This means that any added metadata cannot be seen by other editor windows or by other applications.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Text document where the copy took place.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">ranges</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a>[]</td><td><div class="comment"><p>Ranges being copied in <a href="#DocumentPasteEditProvider.prepareDocumentPaste.document">document</a>.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">dataTransfer</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DataTransfer">DataTransfer</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The data transfer associated with the copy. You can store additional values on this for
later use in <a href="#DocumentPasteEditProvider.provideDocumentPasteEdits">provideDocumentPasteEdits</a>. This object is only valid for the duration of this method.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span> &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>Optional thenable that resolves when all changes to the <code>dataTransfer</code> are complete.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DocumentPasteEditProvider.provideDocumentPasteEdits"></a><span class="ts" id=1614 data-target="#details-1614" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">provideDocumentPasteEdits</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a>, <span class="ident">ranges</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a>[], <span class="ident">dataTransfer</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DataTransfer">DataTransfer</a>, <span class="ident">context</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentPasteEditContext">DocumentPasteEditContext</a>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>[]&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1614">
<div class="comment"><p>Invoked before the user pastes into a <a href="#TextEditor">text editor</a>.</p>
<p>Returned edits can replace the standard pasting behavior.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Document being pasted into</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">ranges</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a>[]</td><td><div class="comment"><p>Range in the <a href="#DocumentPasteEditProvider.provideDocumentPasteEdits.document">document</a> to paste into.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">dataTransfer</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DataTransfer">DataTransfer</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The <a href="#DataTransfer">data transfer</a> associated with the paste. This object is only
valid for the duration of the paste operation.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">context</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentPasteEditContext">DocumentPasteEditContext</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Additional context for the paste.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>[]&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>Set of potential <a href="#DocumentPasteEdit">edits</a> that can apply the paste. Only a single returned
<a href="#DocumentPasteEdit">DocumentPasteEdit</a> is applied at a time. If multiple edits are returned from all providers, then
the first is automatically applied and a widget is shown that lets the user switch to the other edits.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DocumentPasteEditProvider.resolveDocumentPasteEdit"></a><span class="ts" id=1621 data-target="#details-1621" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">resolveDocumentPasteEdit</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">pasteEdit</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1621">
<div class="comment"><p>Optional method which fills in the <a href="#DocumentPasteEdit.additionalEdit">DocumentPasteEdit.additionalEdit</a> before the edit is applied.</p>
<p>This is called once per edit and should be used if generating the complete edit may take a long time.
Resolve can only be used to change <a href="#DocumentPasteEdit.insertText">DocumentPasteEdit.insertText</a> or <a href="#DocumentPasteEdit.additionalEdit">DocumentPasteEdit.additionalEdit</a>.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">pasteEdit</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The <a href="#DocumentPasteEdit">DocumentPasteEdit</a> to resolve.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>The resolved paste edit or a thenable that resolves to such. It is OK to return the given
<code>pasteEdit</code>. If no result is returned, the given <code>pasteEdit</code> is used.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="DocumentPasteProviderMetadata"></a><span class="code-item" id=1635>DocumentPasteProviderMetadata</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Provides additional metadata about how a <a href="#DocumentPasteEditProvider">DocumentPasteEditProvider</a> works.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="DocumentPasteProviderMetadata.copyMimeTypes"></a><span class="ts" id=1637 data-target="#details-1637" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">copyMimeTypes</span><span>?</span><span>: </span>readonly <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1637">
<div class="comment"><p>Mime types that <a href="#DocumentPasteEditProvider.prepareDocumentPaste">prepareDocumentPaste</a> may add on copy.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DocumentPasteProviderMetadata.pasteMimeTypes"></a><span class="ts" id=1638 data-target="#details-1638" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">pasteMimeTypes</span><span>?</span><span>: </span>readonly <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1638">
<div class="comment"><p>Mime types that <a href="#DocumentPasteEditProvider.provideDocumentPasteEdits">provideDocumentPasteEdits</a> should be invoked for.</p>
<p>This can either be an exact mime type such as <code>image/png</code>, or a wildcard pattern such as <code>image/*</code>.</p>
<p>Use <code>text/uri-list</code> for resources dropped from the explorer or other tree views in the workbench.</p>
<p>Use <code>files</code> to indicate that the provider should be invoked if any <a href="#DataTransferFile">files</a> are present in the <a href="#DataTransfer">DataTransfer</a>.
Note that <a href="#DataTransferFile">DataTransferFile</a> entries are only created when pasting content from outside the editor, such as
from the operating system.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DocumentPasteProviderMetadata.providedPasteEditKinds"></a><span class="ts" id=1636 data-target="#details-1636" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">providedPasteEditKinds</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentDropOrPasteEditKind">DocumentDropOrPasteEditKind</a>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1636">
<div class="comment"><p>List of <a href="#DocumentDropOrPasteEditKind">kinds</a> that the provider may return in <a href="#DocumentPasteEditProvider.provideDocumentPasteEdits">provideDocumentPasteEdits</a>.</p>
<p>This is used to filter out providers when a specific <a href="#DocumentDropOrPasteEditKind">kind</a> of edit is requested.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="DocumentPasteTriggerKind"></a><span class="code-item" id=1599>DocumentPasteTriggerKind</span>



<div class="comment"><p>The reason why paste edits were requested.</p>
</div>

#### Enumeration Members



<a name="DocumentPasteTriggerKind.Automatic"></a><span class="ts" id=1600 data-target="#details-1600" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Automatic</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">0</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1600">

<a name="DocumentPasteTriggerKind.PasteAs"></a><span class="ts" id=1601 data-target="#details-1601" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">PasteAs</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">1</span></span>

### <a name="DocumentRangeFormattingEditProvider"></a><span class="code-item" id=1165>DocumentRangeFormattingEditProvider</span>



<div class="comment"><p>The document formatting provider interface defines the contract between extensions and
the formatting-feature.</p>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="DocumentRangeFormattingEditProvider.provideDocumentRangeFormattingEdits"></a><span class="ts" id=1167 data-target="#details-1167" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">provideDocumentRangeFormattingEdits</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a>, <span class="ident">range</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a>, <span class="ident">options</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#FormattingOptions">FormattingOptions</a>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#TextEdit">TextEdit</a>[]&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1167">
<div class="comment"><p>Provide formatting edits for a range in a document.</p>
<p>The given range is a hint and providers can decide to format a smaller
or larger range. Often this is done by adjusting the start and end
of the range to full syntax nodes.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The document in which the command was invoked.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">range</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The range which should be formatted.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">options</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#FormattingOptions">FormattingOptions</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Options controlling formatting.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#TextEdit">TextEdit</a>[]&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A set of text edits or a thenable that resolves to such. The lack of a result can be
signaled by returning <code>undefined</code>, <code>null</code>, or an empty array.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DocumentRangeFormattingEditProvider.provideDocumentRangesFormattingEdits"></a><span class="ts" id=1173 data-target="#details-1173" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">provideDocumentRangesFormattingEdits</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a>, <span class="ident">ranges</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a>[], <span class="ident">options</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#FormattingOptions">FormattingOptions</a>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#TextEdit">TextEdit</a>[]&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1173">
<div class="comment"><p>Provide formatting edits for multiple ranges in a document.</p>
<p>This function is optional but allows a formatter to perform faster when formatting only modified ranges or when
formatting a large number of selections.</p>
<p>The given ranges are hints and providers can decide to format a smaller
or larger range. Often this is done by adjusting the start and end
of the range to full syntax nodes.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The document in which the command was invoked.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">ranges</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a>[]</td><td><div class="comment"><p>The ranges which should be formatted.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">options</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#FormattingOptions">FormattingOptions</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Options controlling formatting.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#TextEdit">TextEdit</a>[]&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A set of text edits or a thenable that resolves to such. The lack of a result can be
signaled by returning <code>undefined</code>, <code>null</code>, or an empty array.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="DocumentRangeSemanticTokensProvider"></a><span class="code-item" id=1147>DocumentRangeSemanticTokensProvider</span>



<div class="comment"><p>The document range semantic tokens provider interface defines the contract between extensions and
semantic tokens.</p>
</div>

#### Events



<a name="DocumentRangeSemanticTokensProvider.onDidChangeSemanticTokens"></a><span class="ts" id=1148 data-target="#details-1148" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeSemanticTokens</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1148">

</div>
</div>

#### Methods

### <a name="DocumentSelector"></a><span class="code-item" id=587>DocumentSelector</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A language selector is the combination of one or many language identifiers
and <a href="#DocumentFilter">language filters</a>.</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that a document selector that is just a language identifier selects <em>all</em>
documents, even those that are not saved on disk. Only use such selectors when
a feature works without further context, e.g. without the need to resolve related
&#39;files&#39;.</p>
<p><strong>Example</strong></p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="ts" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">let</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080"> sel</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">: </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0;--shiki-light:#267F99">DocumentSelector</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> = { </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">scheme:</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515"> 'file'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">, </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">language:</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515"> 'typescript'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> };</span></span>
<span class="line"></span></code></pre>
</div>



<a name="DocumentSelector"></a><span class="ts" id=587 data-target="#details-587" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">DocumentSelector</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentFilter">DocumentFilter</a> &#124; <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <span class="type-ref-ts">ReadonlyArray</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentFilter">DocumentFilter</a> &#124; <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>&gt;</span>

### <a name="DocumentSemanticTokensProvider"></a><span class="code-item" id=1136>DocumentSemanticTokensProvider</span>



<div class="comment"><p>The document semantic tokens provider interface defines the contract between extensions and
semantic tokens.</p>
</div>

#### Events



<a name="DocumentSemanticTokensProvider.onDidChangeSemanticTokens"></a><span class="ts" id=1137 data-target="#details-1137" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeSemanticTokens</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1137">
<div class="comment"><p>An optional event to signal that the semantic tokens from this provider have changed.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="DocumentSemanticTokensProvider.provideDocumentSemanticTokens"></a><span class="ts" id=1139 data-target="#details-1139" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">provideDocumentSemanticTokens</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#SemanticTokens">SemanticTokens</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1139">
<div class="comment"><p>Tokens in a file are represented as an array of integers. The position of each token is expressed relative to
the token before it, because most tokens remain stable relative to each other when edits are made in a file.</p>
<hr>
<p>In short, each token takes 5 integers to represent, so a specific token <code>i</code> in the file consists of the following array indices:</p>
<ul>
<li>at index <code>5*i</code>   - <code>deltaLine</code>: token line number, relative to the previous token</li>
<li>at index <code>5*i+1</code> - <code>deltaStart</code>: token start character, relative to the previous token (relative to 0 or the previous token&#39;s start if they are on the same line)</li>
<li>at index <code>5*i+2</code> - <code>length</code>: the length of the token. A token cannot be multiline.</li>
<li>at index <code>5*i+3</code> - <code>tokenType</code>: will be looked up in <code>SemanticTokensLegend.tokenTypes</code>. We currently ask that <code>tokenType</code> &lt; 65536.</li>
<li>at index <code>5*i+4</code> - <code>tokenModifiers</code>: each set bit will be looked up in <code>SemanticTokensLegend.tokenModifiers</code></li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3 id="how-to-encode-tokens">How to encode tokens</h3>
<p>Here is an example for encoding a file with 3 tokens in a uint32 array:</p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="text" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span>   { line: 2, startChar:  5, length: 3, tokenType: "property",  tokenModifiers: ["private", "static"] },</span></span>
<span class="line"><span>   { line: 2, startChar: 10, length: 4, tokenType: "type",      tokenModifiers: [] },</span></span>
<span class="line"><span>   { line: 5, startChar:  2, length: 7, tokenType: "class",     tokenModifiers: [] }</span></span></code></pre>
<ol>
<li>First of all, a legend must be devised. This legend must be provided up-front and capture all possible token types.
For this example, we will choose the following legend which must be passed in when registering the provider:</li>
</ol>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="text" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span>   tokenTypes: ['property', 'type', 'class'],</span></span>
<span class="line"><span>   tokenModifiers: ['private', 'static']</span></span></code></pre>
<ol start="2">
<li>The first transformation step is to encode <code>tokenType</code> and <code>tokenModifiers</code> as integers using the legend. Token types are looked
up by index, so a <code>tokenType</code> value of <code>1</code> means <code>tokenTypes[1]</code>. Multiple token modifiers can be set by using bit flags,
so a <code>tokenModifier</code> value of <code>3</code> is first viewed as binary <code>0b00000011</code>, which means <code>[tokenModifiers[0], tokenModifiers[1]]</code> because
bits 0 and 1 are set. Using this legend, the tokens now are:</li>
</ol>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="text" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span>   { line: 2, startChar:  5, length: 3, tokenType: 0, tokenModifiers: 3 },</span></span>
<span class="line"><span>   { line: 2, startChar: 10, length: 4, tokenType: 1, tokenModifiers: 0 },</span></span>
<span class="line"><span>   { line: 5, startChar:  2, length: 7, tokenType: 2, tokenModifiers: 0 }</span></span></code></pre>
<ol start="3">
<li>The next step is to represent each token relative to the previous token in the file. In this case, the second token
is on the same line as the first token, so the <code>startChar</code> of the second token is made relative to the <code>startChar</code>
of the first token, so it will be <code>10 - 5</code>. The third token is on a different line than the second token, so the
<code>startChar</code> of the third token will not be altered:</li>
</ol>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="text" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span>   { deltaLine: 2, deltaStartChar: 5, length: 3, tokenType: 0, tokenModifiers: 3 },</span></span>
<span class="line"><span>   { deltaLine: 0, deltaStartChar: 5, length: 4, tokenType: 1, tokenModifiers: 0 },</span></span>
<span class="line"><span>   { deltaLine: 3, deltaStartChar: 2, length: 7, tokenType: 2, tokenModifiers: 0 }</span></span></code></pre>
<ol start="4">
<li>Finally, the last step is to inline each of the 5 fields for a token in a single array, which is a memory friendly representation:</li>
</ol>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="text" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span>   // 1st token,  2nd token,  3rd token</span></span>
<span class="line"><span>   [  2,5,3,0,3,  0,5,4,1,0,  3,2,7,2,0 ]</span></span></code></pre>
<p><em>See also</em>
<a href="#SemanticTokensBuilder">SemanticTokensBuilder</a> for a helper to encode tokens as integers.
<em>NOTE</em>: When doing edits, it is possible that multiple edits occur until the editor decides to invoke the semantic tokens provider.
<em>NOTE</em>: If the provider cannot temporarily compute semantic tokens, it can indicate this by throwing an error with the message &#39;Busy&#39;.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#SemanticTokens">SemanticTokens</a>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DocumentSemanticTokensProvider.provideDocumentSemanticTokensEdits"></a><span class="ts" id=1143 data-target="#details-1143" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">provideDocumentSemanticTokensEdits</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a>, <span class="ident">previousResultId</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#SemanticTokens">SemanticTokens</a> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#SemanticTokensEdits">SemanticTokensEdits</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1143">
<div class="comment"><p>Instead of always returning all the tokens in a file, it is possible for a <code>DocumentSemanticTokensProvider</code> to implement
this method (<code>provideDocumentSemanticTokensEdits</code>) and then return incremental updates to the previously provided semantic tokens.</p>
<hr>
<h3 id="how-tokens-change-when-the-document-changes">How tokens change when the document changes</h3>
<p>Suppose that <code>provideDocumentSemanticTokens</code> has previously returned the following semantic tokens:</p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="text" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span>   // 1st token,  2nd token,  3rd token</span></span>
<span class="line"><span>   [  2,5,3,0,3,  0,5,4,1,0,  3,2,7,2,0 ]</span></span></code></pre>
<p>Also suppose that after some edits, the new semantic tokens in a file are:</p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="text" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span>   // 1st token,  2nd token,  3rd token</span></span>
<span class="line"><span>   [  3,5,3,0,3,  0,5,4,1,0,  3,2,7,2,0 ]</span></span></code></pre>
<p>It is possible to express these new tokens in terms of an edit applied to the previous tokens:</p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="text" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span>   [  2,5,3,0,3,  0,5,4,1,0,  3,2,7,2,0 ] // old tokens</span></span>
<span class="line"><span>   [  3,5,3,0,3,  0,5,4,1,0,  3,2,7,2,0 ] // new tokens</span></span>
<span class="line"><span></span></span>
<span class="line"><span>   edit: { start:  0, deleteCount: 1, data: [3] } // replace integer at offset 0 with 3</span></span></code></pre>
<p><em>NOTE</em>: If the provider cannot compute <code>SemanticTokensEdits</code>, it can &quot;give up&quot; and return all the tokens in the document again.
<em>NOTE</em>: All edits in <code>SemanticTokensEdits</code> contain indices in the old integers array, so they all refer to the previous result state.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">previousResultId</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#SemanticTokens">SemanticTokens</a> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#SemanticTokensEdits">SemanticTokensEdits</a>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="DocumentSymbol"></a><span class="code-item" id=851>DocumentSymbol</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Represents programming constructs like variables, classes, interfaces etc. that appear in a document. Document
symbols can be hierarchical and they have two ranges: one that encloses its definition and one that points to
its most interesting range, e.g. the range of an identifier.</p>
</div>

#### Constructors



<a name="DocumentSymbol.DocumentSymbol"></a><span class="ts" id=853 data-target="#details-853" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">DocumentSymbol</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">name</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">detail</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">kind</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#SymbolKind">SymbolKind</a>, <span class="ident">range</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a>, <span class="ident">selectionRange</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentSymbol">DocumentSymbol</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-853">
<div class="comment"><p>Creates a new document symbol.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">name</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The name of the symbol.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">detail</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Details for the symbol.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">kind</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#SymbolKind">SymbolKind</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The kind of the symbol.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">range</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The full range of the symbol.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">selectionRange</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The range that should be reveal.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentSymbol">DocumentSymbol</a></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="DocumentSymbol.children"></a><span class="ts" id=865 data-target="#details-865" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">children</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentSymbol">DocumentSymbol</a>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-865">
<div class="comment"><p>Children of this symbol, e.g. properties of a class.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DocumentSymbol.detail"></a><span class="ts" id=860 data-target="#details-860" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">detail</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-860">
<div class="comment"><p>More detail for this symbol, e.g. the signature of a function.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DocumentSymbol.kind"></a><span class="ts" id=861 data-target="#details-861" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">kind</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#SymbolKind">SymbolKind</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-861">
<div class="comment"><p>The kind of this symbol.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DocumentSymbol.name"></a><span class="ts" id=859 data-target="#details-859" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">name</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-859">
<div class="comment"><p>The name of this symbol.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="DocumentSymbol.range"></a><span class="ts" id=863 data-target="#details-863" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">range</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-863">
<div class="comment"><p>The range enclosing this symbol not including leading/trailing whitespace but everything else, e.g. comments and code.</p>

### <a name="EnvironmentVariableCollection"></a><span class="code-item" id=3104>EnvironmentVariableCollection</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A collection of mutations that an extension can apply to a process environment.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="EnvironmentVariableCollection.description"></a><span class="ts" id=3106 data-target="#details-3106" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">description</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#MarkdownString">MarkdownString</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3106">

</div>
</div>



<a name="EnvironmentVariableCollection.persistent"></a><span class="ts" id=3105 data-target="#details-3105" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">persistent</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3105">
<div class="comment"><p>Whether the collection should be cached for the workspace and applied to the terminal
across window reloads. When true the collection will be active immediately such when the
window reloads. Additionally, this API will return the cached version if it exists. The
collection will be invalidated when the extension is uninstalled or when the collection
is cleared. Defaults to true.</p>
</div>
</div>

</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">value</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The value to append to the variable.</p>
</div></td></tr>

default to <code>{ applyAtProcessCreation: true }</code>.</p>

</table>
</div>
</div>
