### <a name="EvaluatableExpression"></a><span class="code-item" id=739>EvaluatableExpression</span>



<div class="comment"><p>An EvaluatableExpression represents an expression in a document that can be evaluated by an active debugger or runtime.
The result of this evaluation is shown in a tooltip-like widget.
If only a range is specified, the expression will be extracted from the underlying document.
An optional expression can be used to override the extracted expression.
In this case the range is still used to highlight the range in the document.</p>
</div>

#### Constructors



<a name="EvaluatableExpression.EvaluatableExpression"></a><span class="ts" id=741 data-target="#details-741" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">EvaluatableExpression</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">range</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a>, <span class="ident">expression</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#EvaluatableExpression">EvaluatableExpression</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-741">
<div class="comment"><p>Creates a new evaluatable expression object.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">range</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The range in the underlying document from which the evaluatable expression is extracted.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">expression</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>If specified overrides the extracted expression.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#EvaluatableExpression">EvaluatableExpression</a></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="EvaluatableExpression.expression"></a><span class="ts" id=745 data-target="#details-745" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">expression</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-745">
<div class="comment"><p>If specified the expression overrides the extracted expression.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="EvaluatableExpression.range"></a><span class="ts" id=744 data-target="#details-744" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">range</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-744">
<div class="comment"><p>The range is used to extract the evaluatable expression from the underlying document and to highlight it.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="EvaluatableExpressionProvider"></a><span class="code-item" id=746>EvaluatableExpressionProvider</span>



<div class="comment"><p>The evaluatable expression provider interface defines the contract between extensions and
the debug hover. In this contract the provider returns an evaluatable expression for a given position
in a document and the editor evaluates this expression in the active debug session and shows the result in a debug hover.</p>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="EvaluatableExpressionProvider.provideEvaluatableExpression"></a><span class="ts" id=748 data-target="#details-748" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">provideEvaluatableExpression</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a>, <span class="ident">position</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#EvaluatableExpression">EvaluatableExpression</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-748">
<div class="comment"><p>Provide an evaluatable expression for the given document and position.
The editor will evaluate this expression in the active debug session and will show the result in the debug hover.
The expression can be implicitly specified by the range in the underlying document or by explicitly returning an expression.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The document for which the debug hover is about to appear.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">position</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The line and character position in the document where the debug hover is about to appear.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#EvaluatableExpression">EvaluatableExpression</a>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>An EvaluatableExpression or a thenable that resolves to such. The lack of a result can be
signaled by returning <code>undefined</code> or <code>null</code>.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="Event"></a><span class="code-item" id=468>Event&lt;T&gt;</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Represents a typed event.</p>
<p>A function that represents an event to which you subscribe by calling it with
a listener function as argument.</p>
<p><strong>Example</strong></p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="ts" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">item</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">onDidChange</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">function</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">event</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">  console</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">log</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'Event happened: '</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> + </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">event</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">});</span></span>
<span class="line"></span></code></pre>
</div>



<a name="Event"></a><span class="ts" id=470 data-target="#details-470" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span>(</span><span class="ident">listener</span><span>: </span>(e: <span class="type-ref">T</span>) =&gt; <span class="type-intrinsic">any</span>, <span class="ident">thisArgs</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">any</span>, <span class="ident">disposables</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a>[]<span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-470">
<div class="comment"><p>A function that represents an event to which you subscribe by calling it with
a listener function as argument.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">listener</span><span>: </span>(e: <span class="type-ref">T</span>) =&gt; <span class="type-intrinsic">any</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The listener function will be called when the event happens.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">thisArgs</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">any</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The <code>this</code>-argument which will be used when calling the event listener.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">disposables</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a>[]</td><td><div class="comment"><p>An array to which a <a href="#Disposable">Disposable</a> will be added.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A disposable which unsubscribes the event listener.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="EventEmitter"></a><span class="code-item" id=477>EventEmitter&lt;T&gt;</span>



<div class="comment"><p>An event emitter can be used to create and manage an <a href="#Event">Event</a> for others
to subscribe to. One emitter always owns one event.</p>
<p>Use this class if you want to provide event from within your extension, for instance
inside a <a href="#TextDocumentContentProvider">TextDocumentContentProvider</a> or when providing
API to other extensions.</p>
</div>

#### Constructors



<a name="EventEmitter.EventEmitter"></a><span class="ts" id=480 data-target="#details-480" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">EventEmitter</span><span>&lt;</span>T<span>&gt;</span><span>(</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#EventEmitter&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">EventEmitter</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-480">
<div class="comment"></div>

<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#EventEmitter&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">EventEmitter</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="EventEmitter.event"></a><span class="ts" id=482 data-target="#details-482" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">event</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt;</span>

<div class="comment"><p>The event listeners can subscribe to.</p>

</div>

### <a name="Extension"></a><span class="code-item" id=2046>Extension&lt;T&gt;</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Represents an extension.</p>
<p>To get an instance of an <code>Extension</code> use <a href="#extensions.getExtension">getExtension</a>.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="Extension.exports"></a><span class="ts" id=2054 data-target="#details-2054" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">exports</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2054">
<div class="comment"><p>The public API exported by this extension (return value of <code>activate</code>).
It is an invalid action to access this field before this extension has been activated.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="Extension.extensionKind"></a><span class="ts" id=2053 data-target="#details-2053" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">extensionKind</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ExtensionKind">ExtensionKind</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2053">
<div class="comment"><p>The extension kind describes if an extension runs where the UI runs
or if an extension runs where the remote extension host runs. The extension kind
is defined in the <code>package.json</code>-file of extensions but can also be refined
via the <code>remote.extensionKind</code>-setting. When no remote extension host exists,
the value is <a href="#ExtensionKind.UI">ExtensionKind.UI</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="Extension.extensionPath"></a><span class="ts" id=2050 data-target="#details-2050" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">extensionPath</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2050">
<div class="comment"><p>The absolute file path of the directory containing this extension. Shorthand
notation for <a href="#Extension.extensionUri">Extension.extensionUri.fsPath</a> (independent of the uri scheme).</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="Extension.extensionUri"></a><span class="ts" id=2049 data-target="#details-2049" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">extensionUri</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2049">
<div class="comment"><p>The uri of the directory containing the extension.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="Extension.id"></a><span class="ts" id=2048 data-target="#details-2048" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">id</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2048">
<div class="comment"><p>The canonical extension identifier in the form of: <code>publisher.name</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="Extension.isActive"></a><span class="ts" id=2051 data-target="#details-2051" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">isActive</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2051">
<div class="comment"><p><code>true</code> if the extension has been activated.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="Extension.packageJSON"></a><span class="ts" id=2052 data-target="#details-2052" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">packageJSON</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">any</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2052">
<div class="comment"><p>The parsed contents of the extension&#39;s package.json.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="Extension.activate"></a><span class="ts" id=2056 data-target="#details-2056" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">activate</span><span>(</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2056">
<div class="comment"><p>Activates this extension and returns its public API.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A promise that will resolve when this extension has been activated.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="ExtensionContext"></a><span class="code-item" id=2061>ExtensionContext</span>



<div class="comment"><p>An extension context is a collection of utilities private to an
extension.</p>
<p>An instance of an <code>ExtensionContext</code> is provided as the first
parameter to the <code>activate</code>-call of an extension.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="ExtensionContext.environmentVariableCollection"></a><span class="ts" id=2075 data-target="#details-2075" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">environmentVariableCollection</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#GlobalEnvironmentVariableCollection">GlobalEnvironmentVariableCollection</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2075">
<div class="comment"><p>Gets the extension&#39;s global environment variable collection for this workspace, enabling changes to be
applied to terminal environment variables.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="ExtensionContext.extension"></a><span class="ts" id=2086 data-target="#details-2086" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">extension</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Extension&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Extension</a>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">any</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2086">
<div class="comment"><p>The current <code>Extension</code> instance.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="ExtensionContext.extensionMode"></a><span class="ts" id=2085 data-target="#details-2085" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">extensionMode</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ExtensionMode">ExtensionMode</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2085">
<div class="comment"><p>The mode the extension is running in. See <a href="#ExtensionMode">ExtensionMode</a>
for possible values and scenarios.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="ExtensionContext.extensionPath"></a><span class="ts" id=2074 data-target="#details-2074" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">extensionPath</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2074">
<div class="comment"><p>The absolute file path of the directory containing the extension. Shorthand
notation for <a href="#TextDocument.uri">ExtensionContext.extensionUri.fsPath</a> (independent of the uri scheme).</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="ExtensionContext.extensionUri"></a><span class="ts" id=2073 data-target="#details-2073" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">extensionUri</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2073">
<div class="comment"><p>The uri of the directory containing the extension.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="ExtensionContext.globalState"></a><span class="ts" id=2067 data-target="#details-2067" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">globalState</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Memento">Memento</a> &#38; {setKeysForSync}</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2067">
<div class="comment"><p>A memento object that stores state independent
of the current opened <a href="#workspace.workspaceFolders">workspace</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="ExtensionContext.globalStoragePath"></a><span class="ts" id=2082 data-target="#details-2082" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">globalStoragePath</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2082">
<div class="comment"><p>An absolute file path in which the extension can store global state.
The directory might not exist on disk and creation is
up to the extension. However, the parent directory is guaranteed to be existent.</p>
<p>Use <a href="#ExtensionContext.globalState">globalState</a> to store key value data.</p>
<ul>
<li><em>deprecated</em> - Use <a href="#ExtensionContext.globalStorageUri">globalStorageUri</a> instead.</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>



<a name="ExtensionContext.globalStorageUri"></a><span class="ts" id=2081 data-target="#details-2081" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">globalStorageUri</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2081">
<div class="comment"><p>The uri of a directory in which the extension can store global state.
The directory might not exist on disk and creation is
up to the extension. However, the parent directory is guaranteed to be existent.</p>
<p>Use <a href="#ExtensionContext.globalState">globalState</a> to store key value data.</p>
<p><em>See also</em>
<a href="#FileSystem">workspace.fs</a> for how to read and write files and folders from
 an uri.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="ExtensionContext.languageModelAccessInformation"></a><span class="ts" id=2087 data-target="#details-2087" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">languageModelAccessInformation</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#LanguageModelAccessInformation">LanguageModelAccessInformation</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2087">
<div class="comment"><p>An object that keeps information about how this extension can use language models.</p>
<p><em>See also</em>
<a href="#LanguageModelChat.sendRequest">LanguageModelChat.sendRequest</a></p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="ExtensionContext.logPath"></a><span class="ts" id=2084 data-target="#details-2084" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">logPath</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2084">
<div class="comment"><p>An absolute file path of a directory in which the extension can create log files.
The directory might not exist on disk and creation is up to the extension. However,
the parent directory is guaranteed to be existent.</p>
<ul>
<li><em>deprecated</em> - Use <a href="#ExtensionContext.logUri">logUri</a> instead.</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>



<a name="ExtensionContext.logUri"></a><span class="ts" id=2083 data-target="#details-2083" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">logUri</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2083">
<div class="comment"><p>The uri of a directory in which the extension can create log files.
The directory might not exist on disk and creation is up to the extension. However,
the parent directory is guaranteed to be existent.</p>
<p><em>See also</em>
<a href="#FileSystem">workspace.fs</a> for how to read and write files and folders from
 an uri.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="ExtensionContext.secrets"></a><span class="ts" id=2072 data-target="#details-2072" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">secrets</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#SecretStorage">SecretStorage</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2072">
<div class="comment"><p>A secret storage object that stores state independent
of the current opened <a href="#workspace.workspaceFolders">workspace</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="ExtensionContext.storagePath"></a><span class="ts" id=2080 data-target="#details-2080" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">storagePath</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2080">
<div class="comment"><p>An absolute file path of a workspace specific directory in which the extension
can store private state. The directory might not exist on disk and creation is
up to the extension. However, the parent directory is guaranteed to be existent.</p>
<p>Use <a href="#ExtensionContext.workspaceState">workspaceState</a> or
<a href="#ExtensionContext.globalState">globalState</a> to store key value data.</p>
<ul>
<li><em>deprecated</em> - Use <a href="#ExtensionContext.storageUri">storageUri</a> instead.</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>



<a name="ExtensionContext.storageUri"></a><span class="ts" id=2079 data-target="#details-2079" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">storageUri</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2079">
<div class="comment"><p>The uri of a workspace specific directory in which the extension
can store private state. The directory might not exist and creation is
up to the extension. However, the parent directory is guaranteed to be existent.
The value is <code>undefined</code> when no workspace nor folder has been opened.</p>
<p>Use <a href="#ExtensionContext.workspaceState">workspaceState</a> or
<a href="#ExtensionContext.globalState">globalState</a> to store key value data.</p>
<p><em>See also</em>
<a href="#FileSystem">workspace.fs</a> for how to read and write files and folders from
 a uri.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="ExtensionContext.subscriptions"></a><span class="ts" id=2062 data-target="#details-2062" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">subscriptions</span><span>: </span>Array&lt;{dispose}&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2062">
<div class="comment"><p>An array to which disposables can be added. When this
extension is deactivated the disposables will be disposed.</p>

</div>
</div>

</div>
</div>



<a name="ExtensionTerminalOptions.name"></a><span class="ts" id=3058 data-target="#details-3058" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">name</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3058">

</div>
</div>



<a name="ExtensionTerminalOptions.pty"></a><span class="ts" id=3059 data-target="#details-3059" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">pty</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Pseudoterminal">Pseudoterminal</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3059">
<div class="comment"><p>An implementation of <a href="#Pseudoterminal">Pseudoterminal</a> that allows an extension to
control a terminal.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="ExtensionTerminalOptions.shellIntegrationNonce"></a><span class="ts" id=3064 data-target="#details-3064" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">shellIntegrationNonce</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3064">
<div class="comment"><p>The nonce to use to verify shell integration sequences are coming from a trusted source.
An example impact of UX of this is if the command line is reported with a nonce, it will
not need to verify with the user that the command line is correct before rerunning it
via the <a href="https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/terminal/shell-integration#_command-decorations-and-the-overview-ruler">shell integration command decoration</a>.</p>
<p>This should be used if the terminal includes <a href="https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/terminal/shell-integration#_supported-escape-sequences">custom shell integration support</a>.
It should be set to a random GUID. Inside the <a href="#Pseudoterminal">Pseudoterminal</a> implementation, this value
can be passed through in the relevant sequences to make them trusted.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="FileDecorationProvider"></a><span class="code-item" id=2037>FileDecorationProvider</span>



<div class="comment"><p>The decoration provider interfaces defines the contract between extensions and
file decorations.</p>
</div>

#### Events



<a name="FileDecorationProvider.onDidChangeFileDecorations"></a><span class="ts" id=2038 data-target="#details-2038" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeFileDecorations</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a>[]&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2038">
<div class="comment"><p>An optional event to signal that decorations for one or many files have changed.</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that this event should be used to propagate information about children.</p>
<p><em>See also</em>
<a href="#EventEmitter">EventEmitter</a></p>
</div>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="FileDecorationProvider.provideFileDecoration"></a><span class="ts" id=2040 data-target="#details-2040" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">provideFileDecoration</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">uri</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#FileDecoration">FileDecoration</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2040">
<div class="comment"><p>Provide decorations for a given uri.</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that this function is only called when a file gets rendered in the UI.
This means a decoration from a descendent that propagates upwards must be signaled
to the editor via the <a href="#FileDecorationProvider.onDidChangeFileDecorations">onDidChangeFileDecorations</a>-event.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">uri</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The uri of the file to provide a decoration for.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#FileDecoration">FileDecoration</a>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A decoration or a thenable that resolves to such.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="FileDeleteEvent"></a><span class="code-item" id=3320>FileDeleteEvent</span>



<div class="comment"><p>An event that is fired after files are deleted.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="FileDeleteEvent.files"></a><span class="ts" id=3321 data-target="#details-3321" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">files</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3321">
<div class="comment"><p>The files that got deleted.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="FilePermission"></a><span class="code-item" id=2296>FilePermission</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Permissions of a file.</p>
</div>

#### Enumeration Members



<a name="FilePermission.Readonly"></a><span class="ts" id=2297 data-target="#details-2297" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Readonly</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">1</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2297">
<div class="comment"><p>The file is readonly.</p>
<p><em>Note:</em> All <code>FileStat</code> from a <code>FileSystemProvider</code> that is registered with
the option <code>isReadonly: true</code> will be implicitly handled as if <code>FilePermission.Readonly</code>
is set. As a consequence, it is not possible to have a readonly file system provider
registered where some <code>FileStat</code> are not readonly.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="FileRenameEvent"></a><span class="code-item" id=3333>FileRenameEvent</span>



<div class="comment"><p>An event that is fired after files are renamed.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="FileRenameEvent.files"></a><span class="ts" id=3334 data-target="#details-3334" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">files</span><span>: </span>ReadonlyArray&lt;{newUri: <a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a>, oldUri: <a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a>}&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3334">
<div class="comment"><p>The files that got renamed.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="FileStat"></a><span class="code-item" id=2298>FileStat</span>



<div class="comment"><p>The <code>FileStat</code>-type represents metadata about a file</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="FileStat.ctime"></a><span class="ts" id=2300 data-target="#details-2300" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">ctime</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2300">
<div class="comment"><p>The creation timestamp in milliseconds elapsed since January 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="FileStat.mtime"></a><span class="ts" id=2301 data-target="#details-2301" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">mtime</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2301">
<div class="comment"><p>The modification timestamp in milliseconds elapsed since January 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC.</p>
<p><em>Note:</em> If the file changed, it is important to provide an updated <code>mtime</code> that advanced
from the previous value. Otherwise there may be optimizations in place that will not show
the updated file contents in an editor for example.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="FileStat.permissions"></a><span class="ts" id=2303 data-target="#details-2303" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">permissions</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#FilePermission">FilePermission</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2303">
<div class="comment"><p>The permissions of the file, e.g. whether the file is readonly.</p>
<p><em>Note:</em> This value might be a bitmask, e.g. <code>FilePermission.Readonly | FilePermission.Other</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="FileStat.size"></a><span class="ts" id=2302 data-target="#details-2302" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">size</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2302">
<div class="comment"><p>The size in bytes.</p>
<p><em>Note:</em> If the file changed, it is important to provide an updated <code>size</code>. Otherwise there
may be optimizations in place that will not show the updated file contents in an editor for
example.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="FileStat.type"></a><span class="ts" id=2299 data-target="#details-2299" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">type</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#FileType">FileType</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2299">
<div class="comment"><p>The type of the file, e.g. is a regular file, a directory, or symbolic link
to a file.</p>
<p><em>Note:</em> This value might be a bitmask, e.g. <code>FileType.File | FileType.SymbolicLink</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="FileSystem"></a><span class="code-item" id=2383>FileSystem</span>



<div class="comment"><p>The file system interface exposes the editor&#39;s built-in and contributed
<a href="#FileSystemProvider">file system providers</a>. It allows extensions to work
with files from the local disk as well as files from remote places, like the
remote extension host or ftp-servers.</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that an instance of this interface is available as <a href="#workspace.fs">workspace.fs</a>.</p>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="FileSystem.copy"></a><span class="ts" id=2415 data-target="#details-2415" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">copy</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">source</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a>, <span class="ident">target</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a>, <span class="ident">options</span><span>?</span><span>: </span>{overwrite: <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>}<span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>

<div class="comment"><p>Copy files or folders.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">

<tr><td><span class="ident">source</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The existing file.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">target</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The destination location.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">options</span><span>?</span><span>: </span>{overwrite: <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>}</td><td><div class="comment"><p>Defines if existing files should be overwritten.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="FileSystem.createDirectory"></a><span class="ts" id=2391 data-target="#details-2391" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">createDirectory</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">uri</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>

<a name="FileSystem.delete"></a><span class="ts" id=2401 data-target="#details-2401" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">delete</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">uri</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a>, <span class="ident">options</span><span>?</span><span>: </span>{recursive: <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>, useTrash: <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>}<span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>

</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">options</span><span>?</span><span>: </span>{recursive: <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>, useTrash: <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>}</td><td><div class="comment"><p>Defines if trash can should be used and if deletion of folders is recursive</p>
</div></td></tr>

<a name="FileSystem.isWritableFileSystem"></a><span class="ts" id=2422 data-target="#details-2422" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">isWritableFileSystem</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">scheme</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2422">
<div class="comment"><p>Check if a given file system supports writing files.</p>
<p>Keep in mind that just because a file system supports writing, that does
not mean that writes will always succeed. There may be permissions issues
or other errors that prevent writing a file.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">scheme</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The scheme of the filesystem, for example <code>file</code> or <code>git</code>.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p><code>true</code> if the file system supports writing, <code>false</code> if it does not
support writing (i.e. it is readonly), and <code>undefined</code> if the editor does not
know about the filesystem.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="FileSystemError"></a><span class="code-item" id=2304>FileSystemError</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A type that filesystem providers should use to signal errors.</p>
<p>This class has factory methods for common error-cases, like <code>FileNotFound</code> when
a file or folder doesn&#39;t exist, use them like so: <code>throw vscode.FileSystemError.FileNotFound(someUri);</code></p>
</div>

<a name="FileSystemError.code"></a><span class="ts" id=2326 data-target="#details-2326" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">code</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>

<div class="comment"><p>A code that identifies this error.</p>
<p>Possible values are names of errors, like <a href="#FileSystemError.FileNotFound">FileNotFound</a>,
or <code>Unknown</code> for unspecified errors.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="FileSystemProvider"></a><span class="code-item" id=2334>FileSystemProvider</span>



<div class="comment"><p>The filesystem provider defines what the editor needs to read, write, discover,
and to manage files and folders. It allows extensions to serve files from remote places,
like ftp-servers, and to seamlessly integrate those into the editor.</p>
<ul>
<li><em>Note 1:</em> The filesystem provider API works with <a href="#Uri">uris</a> and assumes hierarchical
paths, e.g. <code>foo:/my/path</code> is a child of <code>foo:/my/</code> and a parent of <code>foo:/my/path/deeper</code>.</li>
<li><em>Note 2:</em> There is an activation event <code>onFileSystem:&lt;scheme&gt;</code> that fires when a file
or folder is being accessed.</li>
<li><em>Note 3:</em> The word &#39;file&#39; is often used to denote all <a href="#FileType">kinds</a> of files, e.g.
folders, symbolic links, and regular files.</li>
</ul>
</div>

#### Events



<a name="FileSystemProvider.onDidChangeFile"></a><span class="ts" id=2335 data-target="#details-2335" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeFile</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#FileChangeEvent">FileChangeEvent</a>[]&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2335">
<div class="comment"><p>An event to signal that a resource has been created, changed, or deleted. This
event should fire for resources that are being <a href="#FileSystemProvider.watch">watched</a>
by clients of this provider.</p>
<p><em>Note:</em> It is important that the metadata of the file that changed provides an
updated <code>mtime</code> that advanced from the previous value in the <a href="#FileStat">stat</a> and a
correct <code>size</code> value. Otherwise there may be optimizations in place that will not show
the change in an editor for example.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="FileSystemProvider.copy"></a><span class="ts" id=2377 data-target="#details-2377" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">copy</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">source</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a>, <span class="ident">destination</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a>, <span class="ident">options</span><span>: </span>{overwrite: <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>}<span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span> &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2377">
<div class="comment"><p>Copy files or folders. Implementing this function is optional but it will speedup
the copy operation.</p>
<ul>
<li><em>throws</em> - <a href="#FileSystemError.FileNotFound">FileNotFound</a> when <code>source</code> doesn&#39;t exist.</li>
</ul>
<ul>
<li><em>throws</em> - <a href="#FileSystemError.FileNotFound">FileNotFound</a> when parent of <code>destination</code> doesn&#39;t exist, e.g. no mkdirp-logic required.</li>
</ul>
<ul>
<li><em>throws</em> - <a href="#FileSystemError.FileExists">FileExists</a> when <code>destination</code> exists and when the <code>overwrite</code> option is not <code>true</code>.</li>
</ul>
<ul>
<li><em>throws</em> - <a href="#FileSystemError.NoPermissions">NoPermissions</a> when permissions aren&#39;t sufficient.</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">source</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The existing file.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">destination</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The destination location.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">options</span><span>: </span>{overwrite: <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>}</td><td><div class="comment"><p>Defines if existing files should be overwritten.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span> &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="FileSystemProvider.createDirectory"></a><span class="ts" id=2350 data-target="#details-2350" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">createDirectory</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">uri</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span> &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2350">
<div class="comment"><p>Create a new directory (Note, that new files are created via <code>write</code>-calls).</p>
<ul>
<li><em>throws</em> - <a href="#FileSystemError.FileNotFound">FileNotFound</a> when the parent of <code>uri</code> doesn&#39;t exist, e.g. no mkdirp-logic required.</li>
</ul>
<ul>
<li><em>throws</em> - <a href="#FileSystemError.FileExists">FileExists</a> when <code>uri</code> already exists.</li>
</ul>
<ul>
<li><em>throws</em> - <a href="#FileSystemError.NoPermissions">NoPermissions</a> when permissions aren&#39;t sufficient.</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">uri</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The uri of the new folder.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span> &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="FileSystemProvider.delete"></a><span class="ts" id=2364 data-target="#details-2364" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">delete</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">uri</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a>, <span class="ident">options</span><span>: </span>{recursive: <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>}<span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span> &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>

</ul>

</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">options</span><span>: </span>{recursive: <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>}</td><td><div class="comment"><p>Defines if deletion of folders is recursive.</p>

<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span> &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>

<a name="FileSystemProvider.rename"></a><span class="ts" id=2370 data-target="#details-2370" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">rename</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">oldUri</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a>, <span class="ident">newUri</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a>, <span class="ident">options</span><span>: </span>{overwrite: <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>}<span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span> &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>

<div class="comment"><p>Rename a file or folder.</p>
<ul>

</ul>
<ul>
<li><em>throws</em> - <a href="#FileSystemError.FileNotFound">FileNotFound</a> when parent of <code>newUri</code> doesn&#39;t exist, e.g. no mkdirp-logic required.</li>
</ul>
<ul>
<li><em>throws</em> - <a href="#FileSystemError.FileExists">FileExists</a> when <code>newUri</code> exists and when the <code>overwrite</code> option is not <code>true</code>.</li>
</ul>
<ul>
<li><em>throws</em> - <a href="#FileSystemError.NoPermissions">NoPermissions</a> when permissions aren&#39;t sufficient.</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">

</div></td></tr>

</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">options</span><span>: </span>{overwrite: <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>}</td><td><div class="comment"><p>Defines if existing files should be overwritten.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span> &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="FileSystemProvider.stat"></a><span class="ts" id=2344 data-target="#details-2344" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">stat</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">uri</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#FileStat">FileStat</a> &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#FileStat">FileStat</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2344">
<div class="comment"><p>Retrieve metadata about a file.</p>
<p>Note that the metadata for symbolic links should be the metadata of the file they refer to.
Still, the <a href="#FileType.SymbolicLink">SymbolicLink</a>-type must be used in addition to the actual type, e.g.
<code>FileType.SymbolicLink | FileType.Directory</code>.</p>
<ul>
<li><em>throws</em> - <a href="#FileSystemError.FileNotFound">FileNotFound</a> when <code>uri</code> doesn&#39;t exist.</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">uri</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The uri of the file to retrieve metadata about.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#FileStat">FileStat</a> &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#FileStat">FileStat</a>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>The file metadata about the file.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="FileSystemProvider.watch"></a><span class="ts" id=2337 data-target="#details-2337" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">watch</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">uri</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a>, <span class="ident">options</span><span>: </span>{excludes: readonly <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>[], recursive: <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>}<span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2337">
<div class="comment"><p>Subscribes to file change events in the file or folder denoted by <code>uri</code>. For folders,
the option <code>recursive</code> indicates whether subfolders, sub-subfolders, etc. should
be watched for file changes as well. With <code>recursive: false</code>, only changes to the
files that are direct children of the folder should trigger an event.</p>
<p>The <code>excludes</code> array is used to indicate paths that should be excluded from file
watching. It is typically derived from the <code>files.watcherExclude</code> setting that
is configurable by the user. Each entry can be be:</p>
<ul>
<li>the absolute path to exclude</li>
<li>a relative path to exclude (for example <code>build/output</code>)</li>
<li>a simple glob pattern (for example <code>**/build</code>, <code>output/**</code>)</li>
</ul>
<p><em>Note</em> that case-sensitivity of the <a href="#excludes">excludes</a> patterns for built-in file system providers
will depend on the underlying file system: on Windows and macOS the matching will be case-insensitive and
on Linux it will be case-sensitive.</p>
<p>It is the file system provider&#39;s job to call <a href="#FileSystemProvider.onDidChangeFile">onDidChangeFile</a>
for every change given these rules. No event should be emitted for files that match any of the provided
excludes.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">uri</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The uri of the file or folder to be watched.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">options</span><span>: </span>{excludes: readonly <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>[], recursive: <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>}</td><td><div class="comment"><p>Configures the watch.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#Disposable">Disposable</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A disposable that tells the provider to stop watching the <code>uri</code>.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="FileSystemProvider.writeFile"></a><span class="ts" id=2356 data-target="#details-2356" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">writeFile</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">uri</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a>, <span class="ident">content</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref-ts">Uint8Array</span>, <span class="ident">options</span><span>: </span>{create: <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>, overwrite: <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>}<span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span> &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2356">
<div class="comment"><p>Write data to a file, replacing its entire contents.</p>
<ul>
<li><em>throws</em> - <a href="#FileSystemError.FileNotFound">FileNotFound</a> when <code>uri</code> doesn&#39;t exist and <code>create</code> is not set.</li>
</ul>
<ul>
<li><em>throws</em> - <a href="#FileSystemError.FileNotFound">FileNotFound</a> when the parent of <code>uri</code> doesn&#39;t exist and <code>create</code> is set, e.g. no mkdirp-logic required.</li>
</ul>
<ul>
<li><em>throws</em> - <a href="#FileSystemError.FileExists">FileExists</a> when <code>uri</code> already exists, <code>create</code> is set but <code>overwrite</code> is not set.</li>
</ul>
<ul>
<li><em>throws</em> - <a href="#FileSystemError.NoPermissions">NoPermissions</a> when permissions aren&#39;t sufficient.</li>
</ul>
</div>

</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="FileSystemWatcher"></a><span class="code-item" id=488>FileSystemWatcher</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A file system watcher notifies about changes to files and folders
on disk or from other <a href="#FileSystemProvider">FileSystemProviders</a>.</p>
<p>To get an instance of a <code>FileSystemWatcher</code> use
<a href="#workspace.createFileSystemWatcher">createFileSystemWatcher</a>.</p>
</div>

### <a name="FileType"></a><span class="code-item" id=2291>FileType</span>

### <a name="FileWillCreateEvent"></a><span class="code-item" id=3302>FileWillCreateEvent</span>



<div class="comment"><p>An event that is fired when files are going to be created.</p>

call the <a href="#FileWillCreateEvent.waitUntil">waitUntil</a>-function with a
thenable that resolves to a <a href="#WorkspaceEdit">workspace edit</a>.</p>
</div>

### <a name="FoldingContext"></a><span class="code-item" id=1448>FoldingContext</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Folding context (for future use)</p>
</div>

### <a name="FoldingRange"></a><span class="code-item" id=1435>FoldingRange</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A line based folding range. To be valid, start and end line must be bigger than zero and smaller than the number of lines in the document.
Invalid ranges will be ignored.</p>
</div>

#### Constructors



<a name="FoldingRange.FoldingRange"></a><span class="ts" id=1437 data-target="#details-1437" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">FoldingRange</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">start</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span>, <span class="ident">end</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span>, <span class="ident">kind</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#FoldingRangeKind">FoldingRangeKind</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#FoldingRange">FoldingRange</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1437">
<div class="comment"><p>Creates a new folding range.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">start</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The start line of the folded range.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">end</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The end line of the folded range.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">kind</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#FoldingRangeKind">FoldingRangeKind</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The kind of the folding range.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#FoldingRange">FoldingRange</a></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="FoldingRange.end"></a><span class="ts" id=1442 data-target="#details-1442" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">end</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1442">
<div class="comment"><p>The zero-based end line of the range to fold. The folded area ends with the line&#39;s last character.
To be valid, the end must be zero or larger and smaller than the number of lines in the document.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="FoldingRange.kind"></a><span class="ts" id=1443 data-target="#details-1443" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">kind</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#FoldingRangeKind">FoldingRangeKind</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1443">
<div class="comment"><p>Describes the <a href="#FoldingRangeKind">Kind</a> of the folding range such as <a href="#FoldingRangeKind.Comment">Comment</a> or
<a href="#FoldingRangeKind.Region">Region</a>. The kind is used to categorize folding ranges and used by commands
like &#39;Fold all comments&#39;. See
<a href="#FoldingRangeKind">FoldingRangeKind</a> for an enumeration of all kinds.
If not set, the range is originated from a syntax element.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="FoldingRange.start"></a><span class="ts" id=1441 data-target="#details-1441" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">start</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1441">
<div class="comment"><p>The zero-based start line of the range to fold. The folded area starts after the line&#39;s last character.
To be valid, the end must be zero or larger and smaller than the number of lines in the document.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="FoldingRangeKind"></a><span class="code-item" id=1444>FoldingRangeKind</span>



<div class="comment"><p>An enumeration of specific folding range kinds. The kind is an optional field of a <a href="#FoldingRange">FoldingRange</a>
and is used to distinguish specific folding ranges such as ranges originated from comments. The kind is used by commands like
<code>Fold all comments</code> or <code>Fold all regions</code>.
If the kind is not set on the range, the range originated from a syntax element other than comments, imports or region markers.</p>
</div>

#### Enumeration Members



<a name="FoldingRangeKind.Comment"></a><span class="ts" id=1445 data-target="#details-1445" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Comment</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">1</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1445">
<div class="comment"><p>Kind for folding range representing a comment.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="FoldingRangeKind.Imports"></a><span class="ts" id=1446 data-target="#details-1446" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Imports</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">2</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1446">
<div class="comment"><p>Kind for folding range representing a import.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="FoldingRangeKind.Region"></a><span class="ts" id=1447 data-target="#details-1447" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Region</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">3</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1447">
<div class="comment"><p>Kind for folding range representing regions originating from folding markers like <code>#region</code> and <code>#endregion</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="FoldingRangeProvider"></a><span class="code-item" id=1449>FoldingRangeProvider</span>



<div class="comment"><p>The folding range provider interface defines the contract between extensions and
<a href="https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/codebasics#_folding">Folding</a> in the editor.</p>
</div>

#### Events



<a name="FoldingRangeProvider.onDidChangeFoldingRanges"></a><span class="ts" id=1450 data-target="#details-1450" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeFoldingRanges</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1450">
<div class="comment"><p>An optional event to signal that the folding ranges from this provider have changed.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="FoldingRangeProvider.provideFoldingRanges"></a><span class="ts" id=1452 data-target="#details-1452" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">provideFoldingRanges</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a>, <span class="ident">context</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#FoldingContext">FoldingContext</a>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#FoldingRange">FoldingRange</a>[]&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1452">
<div class="comment"><p>Returns a list of folding ranges or null and undefined if the provider
does not want to participate or was cancelled.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The document in which the command was invoked.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">context</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#FoldingContext">FoldingContext</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Additional context information (for future use)</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#FoldingRange">FoldingRange</a>[]&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="GlobalEnvironmentVariableCollection"></a><span class="code-item" id=3139>GlobalEnvironmentVariableCollection</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A collection of mutations that an extension can apply to a process environment. Applies to all scopes.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="GlobalEnvironmentVariableCollection.description"></a><span class="ts" id=3144 data-target="#details-3144" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">description</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#MarkdownString">MarkdownString</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3144">
<div class="comment"><p>A description for the environment variable collection, this will be used to describe the
changes in the UI.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="GlobalEnvironmentVariableCollection.persistent"></a><span class="ts" id=3143 data-target="#details-3143" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">persistent</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3143">
<div class="comment"><p>Whether the collection should be cached for the workspace and applied to the terminal
across window reloads. When true the collection will be active immediately such when the
window reloads. Additionally, this API will return the cached version if it exists. The
collection will be invalidated when the extension is uninstalled or when the collection
is cleared. Defaults to true.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="GlobalEnvironmentVariableCollection.append"></a><span class="ts" id=3151 data-target="#details-3151" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">append</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">variable</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">value</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">options</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#EnvironmentVariableMutatorOptions">EnvironmentVariableMutatorOptions</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3151">
<div class="comment"><p>Append a value to an environment variable.</p>
<p>Note that an extension can only make a single change to any one variable, so this will
overwrite any previous calls to replace, append or prepend.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">variable</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The variable to append to.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">value</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The value to append to the variable.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">options</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#EnvironmentVariableMutatorOptions">EnvironmentVariableMutatorOptions</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Options applied to the mutator, when no options are provided this will
default to <code>{ applyAtProcessCreation: true }</code>.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

</div></td></tr>

<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#EnvironmentVariableMutator">EnvironmentVariableMutator</a></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>

</div>
</div>



<a name="GlobalEnvironmentVariableCollection.getScoped"></a><span class="ts" id=3141 data-target="#details-3141" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">getScoped</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">scope</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#EnvironmentVariableScope">EnvironmentVariableScope</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#EnvironmentVariableCollection">EnvironmentVariableCollection</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3141">
<div class="comment"><p>Gets scope-specific environment variable collection for the extension. This enables alterations to
terminal environment variables solely within the designated scope, and is applied in addition to (and
after) the global collection.</p>
<p>Each object obtained through this method is isolated and does not impact objects for other scopes,
including the global collection.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">scope</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#EnvironmentVariableScope">EnvironmentVariableScope</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The scope to which the environment variable collection applies to.</p>
<p>If a scope parameter is omitted, collection applicable to all relevant scopes for that parameter is
returned. For instance, if the &#39;workspaceFolder&#39; parameter is not specified, the collection that applies
across all workspace folders will be returned.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#EnvironmentVariableCollection">EnvironmentVariableCollection</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Environment variable collection for the passed in scope.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="GlobalEnvironmentVariableCollection.prepend"></a><span class="ts" id=3156 data-target="#details-3156" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">prepend</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">variable</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">value</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">options</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#EnvironmentVariableMutatorOptions">EnvironmentVariableMutatorOptions</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3156">
<div class="comment"><p>Prepend a value to an environment variable.</p>
<p>Note that an extension can only make a single change to any one variable, so this will
overwrite any previous calls to replace, append or prepend.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">variable</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The variable to prepend.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">value</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The value to prepend to the variable.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">options</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#EnvironmentVariableMutatorOptions">EnvironmentVariableMutatorOptions</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Options applied to the mutator, when no options are provided this will
default to <code>{ applyAtProcessCreation: true }</code>.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="GlobalEnvironmentVariableCollection.replace"></a><span class="ts" id=3146 data-target="#details-3146" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">replace</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">variable</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">value</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">options</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#EnvironmentVariableMutatorOptions">EnvironmentVariableMutatorOptions</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3146">
<div class="comment"><p>Replace an environment variable with a value.</p>
<p>Note that an extension can only make a single change to any one variable, so this will
overwrite any previous calls to replace, append or prepend.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">variable</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The variable to replace.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">value</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The value to replace the variable with.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">options</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#EnvironmentVariableMutatorOptions">EnvironmentVariableMutatorOptions</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Options applied to the mutator, when no options are provided this will
default to <code>{ applyAtProcessCreation: true }</code>.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="GlobPattern"></a><span class="code-item" id=581>GlobPattern</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A file glob pattern to match file paths against. This can either be a glob pattern string
(like <code>**/*.{ts,js}</code> or <code>*.{ts,js}</code>) or a <a href="#RelativePattern">relative pattern</a>.</p>
<p>Glob patterns can have the following syntax:</p>
<ul>
<li><code>*</code> to match zero or more characters in a path segment</li>
<li><code>?</code> to match on one character in a path segment</li>
<li><code>**</code> to match any number of path segments, including none</li>
<li><code>{}</code> to group conditions (e.g. <code>**/*.{ts,js}</code> matches all TypeScript and JavaScript files)</li>
<li><code>[]</code> to declare a range of characters to match in a path segment (e.g., <code>example.[0-9]</code> to match on <code>example.0</code>, <code>example.1</code>, …)</li>
<li><code>[!...]</code> to negate a range of characters to match in a path segment (e.g., <code>example.[!0-9]</code> to match on <code>example.a</code>, <code>example.b</code>, but not <code>example.0</code>)</li>
</ul>
<p>Note: a backslash (``) is not valid within a glob pattern. If you have an existing file
path to match against, consider to use the <a href="#RelativePattern">relative pattern</a> support
that takes care of converting any backslash into slash. Otherwise, make sure to convert
any backslash to slash when creating the glob pattern.</p>
</div>



<a name="GlobPattern"></a><span class="ts" id=581 data-target="#details-581" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">GlobPattern</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#RelativePattern">RelativePattern</a></span>
