### <a name="IndentAction"></a><span class="code-item" id=1651>IndentAction</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Describes what to do with the indentation when pressing Enter.</p>
</div>

#### Enumeration Members



<a name="IndentAction.None"></a><span class="ts" id=1652 data-target="#details-1652" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">None</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">0</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1652">
<div class="comment"><p>Insert new line and copy the previous line&#39;s indentation.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="IndentAction.Indent"></a><span class="ts" id=1653 data-target="#details-1653" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Indent</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">1</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1653">
<div class="comment"><p>Insert new line and indent once (relative to the previous line&#39;s indentation).</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="IndentAction.IndentOutdent"></a><span class="ts" id=1654 data-target="#details-1654" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">IndentOutdent</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">2</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1654">
<div class="comment"><p>Insert two new lines:</p>
<ul>
<li>the first one indented which will hold the cursor</li>
<li>the second one at the same indentation level</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>



<a name="IndentAction.Outdent"></a><span class="ts" id=1655 data-target="#details-1655" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Outdent</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">3</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1655">
<div class="comment"><p>Insert new line and outdent once (relative to the previous line&#39;s indentation).</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="IndentationRule"></a><span class="code-item" id=1646>IndentationRule</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Describes indentation rules for a language.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="IndentationRule.decreaseIndentPattern"></a><span class="ts" id=1647 data-target="#details-1647" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">decreaseIndentPattern</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref-ts">RegExp</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1647">
<div class="comment"><p>If a line matches this pattern, then all the lines after it should be unindented once (until another rule matches).</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="IndentationRule.increaseIndentPattern"></a><span class="ts" id=1648 data-target="#details-1648" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">increaseIndentPattern</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref-ts">RegExp</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1648">
<div class="comment"><p>If a line matches this pattern, then all the lines after it should be indented once (until another rule matches).</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="IndentationRule.indentNextLinePattern"></a><span class="ts" id=1649 data-target="#details-1649" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">indentNextLinePattern</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref-ts">RegExp</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1649">
<div class="comment"><p>If a line matches this pattern, then <strong>only the next line</strong> after it should be indented once.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="IndentationRule.unIndentedLinePattern"></a><span class="ts" id=1650 data-target="#details-1650" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">unIndentedLinePattern</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref-ts">RegExp</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1650">
<div class="comment"><p>If a line matches this pattern, then its indentation should not be changed and it should not be evaluated against the other rules.</p>
</div>
</div>

<a name="InlayHint.paddingLeft"></a><span class="ts" id=1421 data-target="#details-1421" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">paddingLeft</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>

</div>
</div>



<a name="InlayHint.textEdits"></a><span class="ts" id=1420 data-target="#details-1420" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">textEdits</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextEdit">TextEdit</a>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1420">
<div class="comment"><p>Optional <a href="#TextEdit">text edits</a> that are performed when accepting this inlay hint. The default
gesture for accepting an inlay hint is the double click.</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that edits are expected to change the document so that the inlay hint (or its nearest variant) is
now part of the document and the inlay hint itself is now obsolete.</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that this property can be set late during
<a href="#InlayHintsProvider.resolveInlayHint">resolving</a> of inlay hints.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="InlayHint.tooltip"></a><span class="ts" id=1418 data-target="#details-1418" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">tooltip</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#MarkdownString">MarkdownString</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1418">
<div class="comment"><p>The tooltip text when you hover over this item.</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that this property can be set late during
<a href="#InlayHintsProvider.resolveInlayHint">resolving</a> of inlay hints.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="InlayHintKind"></a><span class="code-item" id=1399>InlayHintKind</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Inlay hint kinds.</p>
<p>The kind of an inline hint defines its appearance, e.g the corresponding foreground and background colors are being
used.</p>
</div>

#### Enumeration Members



<a name="InlayHintKind.Type"></a><span class="ts" id=1400 data-target="#details-1400" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Type</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">1</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1400">
<div class="comment"><p>An inlay hint that is for a type annotation.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="InlayHintKind.Parameter"></a><span class="ts" id=1401 data-target="#details-1401" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Parameter</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">2</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1401">
<div class="comment"><p>An inlay hint that is for a parameter.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="InlayHintLabelPart"></a><span class="code-item" id=1402>InlayHintLabelPart</span>



<div class="comment"><p>An inlay hint label part allows for interactive and composite labels of inlay hints.</p>
</div>

#### Constructors



<a name="InlayHintLabelPart.InlayHintLabelPart"></a><span class="ts" id=1404 data-target="#details-1404" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">InlayHintLabelPart</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">value</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#InlayHintLabelPart">InlayHintLabelPart</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1404">
<div class="comment"><p>Creates a new inlay hint label part.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">value</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The value of the part.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#InlayHintLabelPart">InlayHintLabelPart</a></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="InlayHintLabelPart.command"></a><span class="ts" id=1409 data-target="#details-1409" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">command</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Command">Command</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1409">
<div class="comment"><p>An optional command for this label part.</p>
<p>The editor renders parts with commands as clickable links. The command is added to the context menu
when a label part defines <a href="#InlayHintLabelPart.location">location</a> and <a href="#InlayHintLabelPart.command">command</a> .</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that this property can be set late during
<a href="#InlayHintsProvider.resolveInlayHint">resolving</a> of inlay hints.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="InlayHintLabelPart.location"></a><span class="ts" id=1408 data-target="#details-1408" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">location</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Location">Location</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1408">
<div class="comment"><p>An optional <a href="#Location">source code location</a> that represents this label
part.</p>
<p>The editor will use this location for the hover and for code navigation features: This
part will become a clickable link that resolves to the definition of the symbol at the
given location (not necessarily the location itself), it shows the hover that shows at
the given location, and it shows a context menu with further code navigation commands.</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that this property can be set late during
<a href="#InlayHintsProvider.resolveInlayHint">resolving</a> of inlay hints.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="InlayHintLabelPart.tooltip"></a><span class="ts" id=1407 data-target="#details-1407" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">tooltip</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#MarkdownString">MarkdownString</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1407">
<div class="comment"><p>The tooltip text when you hover over this label part.</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that this property can be set late during
<a href="#InlayHintsProvider.resolveInlayHint">resolving</a> of inlay hints.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="InlayHintLabelPart.value"></a><span class="ts" id=1406 data-target="#details-1406" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">value</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1406">
<div class="comment"><p>The value of this label part.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="InlayHintsProvider"></a><span class="code-item" id=1423>InlayHintsProvider&lt;T&gt;</span>



<div class="comment"><p>The inlay hints provider interface defines the contract between extensions and
the inlay hints feature.</p>
</div>

#### Events



<a name="InlayHintsProvider.onDidChangeInlayHints"></a><span class="ts" id=1425 data-target="#details-1425" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeInlayHints</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1425">
<div class="comment"><p>An optional event to signal that inlay hints from this provider have changed.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="InlayHintsProvider.provideInlayHints"></a><span class="ts" id=1427 data-target="#details-1427" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">provideInlayHints</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a>, <span class="ident">range</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>[]&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1427">
<div class="comment"><p>Provide inlay hints for the given range and document.</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that inlay hints that are not <a href="#Range.contains">contained</a> by the given range are ignored.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The document in which the command was invoked.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">range</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The range for which inlay hints should be computed.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>[]&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>An array of inlay hints or a thenable that resolves to such.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="InlayHintsProvider.resolveInlayHint"></a><span class="ts" id=1432 data-target="#details-1432" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">resolveInlayHint</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">hint</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1432">
<div class="comment"><p>Given an inlay hint fill in <a href="#InlayHint.tooltip">tooltip</a>, <a href="#InlayHint.textEdits">text edits</a>,
or complete label <a href="#InlayHintLabelPart">parts</a>.</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that the editor will resolve an inlay hint at most once.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">hint</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>An inlay hint.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>The resolved inlay hint or a thenable that resolves to such. It is OK to return the given <code>item</code>. When no result is returned, the given <code>item</code> will be used.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="InlineCompletionContext"></a><span class="code-item" id=1324>InlineCompletionContext</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Provides information about the context in which an inline completion was requested.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="InlineCompletionContext.selectedCompletionInfo"></a><span class="ts" id=1326 data-target="#details-1326" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">selectedCompletionInfo</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#SelectedCompletionInfo">SelectedCompletionInfo</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1326">
<div class="comment"><p>Provides information about the currently selected item in the autocomplete widget if it is visible.</p>
<p>If set, provided inline completions must extend the text of the selected item
and use the same range, otherwise they are not shown as preview.
As an example, if the document text is <code>console.</code> and the selected item is <code>.log</code> replacing the <code>.</code> in the document,
the inline completion must also replace <code>.</code> and start with <code>.log</code>, for example <code>.log()</code>.</p>
<p>Inline completion providers are requested again whenever the selected item changes.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="InlineCompletionContext.triggerKind"></a><span class="ts" id=1325 data-target="#details-1325" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">triggerKind</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#InlineCompletionTriggerKind">InlineCompletionTriggerKind</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1325">
<div class="comment"><p>Describes how the inline completion was triggered.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="InlineCompletionItem"></a><span class="code-item" id=1333>InlineCompletionItem</span>



<div class="comment"><p>An inline completion item represents a text snippet that is proposed inline to complete text that is being typed.</p>
<p><em>See also</em>
<a href="#InlineCompletionItemProvider.provideInlineCompletionItems">InlineCompletionItemProvider.provideInlineCompletionItems</a></p>
</div>

#### Constructors



<a name="InlineCompletionItem.InlineCompletionItem"></a><span class="ts" id=1335 data-target="#details-1335" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">InlineCompletionItem</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">insertText</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#SnippetString">SnippetString</a>, <span class="ident">range</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a>, <span class="ident">command</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Command">Command</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#InlineCompletionItem">InlineCompletionItem</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1335">
<div class="comment"><p>Creates a new inline completion item.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">insertText</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#SnippetString">SnippetString</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The text to replace the range with.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">range</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The range to replace. If not set, the word at the requested position will be used.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">command</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Command">Command</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>An optional <a href="#Command">Command</a> that is executed <em>after</em> inserting this completion.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#InlineCompletionItem">InlineCompletionItem</a></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="InlineCompletionItem.command"></a><span class="ts" id=1342 data-target="#details-1342" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">command</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Command">Command</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1342">
<div class="comment"><p>An optional <a href="#Command">Command</a> that is executed <em>after</em> inserting this completion.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="InlineCompletionItem.filterText"></a><span class="ts" id=1340 data-target="#details-1340" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">filterText</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1340">
<div class="comment"><p>A text that is used to decide if this inline completion should be shown. When <code>falsy</code>
the <a href="#InlineCompletionItem.insertText">InlineCompletionItem.insertText</a> is used.</p>
<p>An inline completion is shown if the text to replace is a prefix of the filter text.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="InlineCompletionItem.insertText"></a><span class="ts" id=1339 data-target="#details-1339" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">insertText</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#SnippetString">SnippetString</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1339">
<div class="comment"><p>The text to replace the range with. Must be set.
Is used both for the preview and the accept operation.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="InlineCompletionItem.range"></a><span class="ts" id=1341 data-target="#details-1341" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">range</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1341">
<div class="comment"><p>The range to replace.
Must begin and end on the same line.</p>
<p>Prefer replacements over insertions to provide a better experience when the user deletes typed text.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="InlineCompletionItemProvider"></a><span class="code-item" id=1312>InlineCompletionItemProvider</span>



<div class="comment"><p>The inline completion item provider interface defines the contract between extensions and
the inline completion feature.</p>
<p>Providers are asked for completions either explicitly by a user gesture or implicitly when typing.</p>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="InlineCompletionItemProvider.provideInlineCompletionItems"></a><span class="ts" id=1314 data-target="#details-1314" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">provideInlineCompletionItems</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a>, <span class="ident">position</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a>, <span class="ident">context</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#InlineCompletionContext">InlineCompletionContext</a>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#InlineCompletionList">InlineCompletionList</a> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#InlineCompletionItem">InlineCompletionItem</a>[]&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1314">
<div class="comment"><p>Provides inline completion items for the given position and document.
If inline completions are enabled, this method will be called whenever the user stopped typing.
It will also be called when the user explicitly triggers inline completions or explicitly asks for the next or previous inline completion.
In that case, all available inline completions should be returned.
<code>context.triggerKind</code> can be used to distinguish between these scenarios.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The document inline completions are requested for.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">position</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The position inline completions are requested for.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">context</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#InlineCompletionContext">InlineCompletionContext</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A context object with additional information.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#InlineCompletionList">InlineCompletionList</a> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#InlineCompletionItem">InlineCompletionItem</a>[]&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>An array of completion items or a thenable that resolves to an array of completion items.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="InlineCompletionList"></a><span class="code-item" id=1319>InlineCompletionList</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Represents a collection of <a href="#InlineCompletionItem">inline completion items</a> to be presented
in the editor.</p>
</div>

#### Constructors



<a name="InlineCompletionList.InlineCompletionList"></a><span class="ts" id=1321 data-target="#details-1321" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">InlineCompletionList</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">items</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#InlineCompletionItem">InlineCompletionItem</a>[]<span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#InlineCompletionList">InlineCompletionList</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1321">
<div class="comment"><p>Creates a new list of inline completion items.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">items</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#InlineCompletionItem">InlineCompletionItem</a>[]</td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#InlineCompletionList">InlineCompletionList</a></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="InlineCompletionList.items"></a><span class="ts" id=1323 data-target="#details-1323" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">items</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#InlineCompletionItem">InlineCompletionItem</a>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1323">
<div class="comment"><p>The inline completion items.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="InlineCompletionTriggerKind"></a><span class="code-item" id=1330>InlineCompletionTriggerKind</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Describes how an <a href="#InlineCompletionItemProvider">inline completion provider</a> was triggered.</p>
</div>

#### Enumeration Members



<a name="InlineCompletionTriggerKind.Invoke"></a><span class="ts" id=1331 data-target="#details-1331" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Invoke</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">0</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1331">
<div class="comment"><p>Completion was triggered explicitly by a user gesture.
Return multiple completion items to enable cycling through them.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="InlineCompletionTriggerKind.Automatic"></a><span class="ts" id=1332 data-target="#details-1332" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Automatic</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">1</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1332">
<div class="comment"><p>Completion was triggered automatically while editing.
It is sufficient to return a single completion item in this case.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="InlineValue"></a><span class="code-item" id=775>InlineValue</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Inline value information can be provided by different means:</p>
<ul>
<li>directly as a text value (class InlineValueText).</li>
<li>as a name to use for a variable lookup (class InlineValueVariableLookup)</li>
<li>as an evaluatable expression (class InlineValueEvaluatableExpression)
The InlineValue types combines all inline value types into one type.</li>
</ul>
</div>



<a name="InlineValue"></a><span class="ts" id=775 data-target="#details-775" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">InlineValue</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#InlineValueText">InlineValueText</a> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#InlineValueVariableLookup">InlineValueVariableLookup</a> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#InlineValueEvaluatableExpression">InlineValueEvaluatableExpression</a></span>

### <a name="InlineValueContext"></a><span class="code-item" id=776>InlineValueContext</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A value-object that contains contextual information when requesting inline values from a InlineValuesProvider.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="InlineValueContext.frameId"></a><span class="ts" id=777 data-target="#details-777" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">frameId</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-777">

</div>
</div>



<a name="InlineValueContext.stoppedLocation"></a><span class="ts" id=778 data-target="#details-778" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">stoppedLocation</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-778">

Typically the end position of the range denotes the line where the inline values are shown.</p>

### <a name="InlineValueEvaluatableExpression"></a><span class="code-item" id=768>InlineValueEvaluatableExpression</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Provide an inline value through an expression evaluation.
If only a range is specified, the expression will be extracted from the underlying document.
An optional expression can be used to override the extracted expression.</p>
</div>

#### Constructors



<a name="InlineValueEvaluatableExpression.InlineValueEvaluatableExpression"></a><span class="ts" id=770 data-target="#details-770" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">InlineValueEvaluatableExpression</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">range</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a>, <span class="ident">expression</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#InlineValueEvaluatableExpression">InlineValueEvaluatableExpression</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-770">
<div class="comment"><p>Creates a new InlineValueEvaluatableExpression object.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">range</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The range in the underlying document from which the evaluatable expression is extracted.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">expression</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>If specified overrides the extracted expression.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#InlineValueEvaluatableExpression">InlineValueEvaluatableExpression</a></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="InlineValueEvaluatableExpression.expression"></a><span class="ts" id=774 data-target="#details-774" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">expression</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-774">
<div class="comment"><p>If specified the expression overrides the extracted expression.</p>

<a name="InlineValueEvaluatableExpression.range"></a><span class="ts" id=773 data-target="#details-773" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">range</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-773">

The range is used to extract the evaluatable expression from the underlying document.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="InlineValuesProvider"></a><span class="code-item" id=779>InlineValuesProvider</span>



<div class="comment"><p>The inline values provider interface defines the contract between extensions and the editor&#39;s debugger inline values feature.
In this contract the provider returns inline value information for a given document range
and the editor shows this information in the editor at the end of lines.</p>
</div>

#### Events



<a name="InlineValuesProvider.onDidChangeInlineValues"></a><span class="ts" id=780 data-target="#details-780" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeInlineValues</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-780">
<div class="comment"><p>An optional event to signal that inline values have changed.</p>
<p><em>See also</em>
<a href="#EventEmitter">EventEmitter</a></p>
</div>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="InlineValuesProvider.provideInlineValues"></a><span class="ts" id=782 data-target="#details-782" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">provideInlineValues</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a>, <span class="ident">viewPort</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a>, <span class="ident">context</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#InlineValueContext">InlineValueContext</a>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#InlineValue">InlineValue</a>[]&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-782">
<div class="comment"><p>Provide &quot;inline value&quot; information for a given document and range.
The editor calls this method whenever debugging stops in the given document.
The returned inline values information is rendered in the editor at the end of lines.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The document for which the inline values information is needed.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">viewPort</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The visible document range for which inline values should be computed.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">context</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#InlineValueContext">InlineValueContext</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A bag containing contextual information like the current location.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#InlineValue">InlineValue</a>[]&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>An array of InlineValueDescriptors or a thenable that resolves to such. The lack of a result can be
signaled by returning <code>undefined</code> or <code>null</code>.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="InlineValueText"></a><span class="code-item" id=752>InlineValueText</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Provide inline value as text.</p>
</div>

#### Constructors



<a name="InlineValueText.InlineValueText"></a><span class="ts" id=754 data-target="#details-754" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">InlineValueText</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">range</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a>, <span class="ident">text</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#InlineValueText">InlineValueText</a></span>

<tr><td><span class="ident">text</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The value to be shown for the line.</p>

</div>



<a name="InlineValueText.text"></a><span class="ts" id=758 data-target="#details-758" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">text</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>

### <a name="InlineValueVariableLookup"></a><span class="code-item" id=759>InlineValueVariableLookup</span>

<a name="InlineValueVariableLookup.InlineValueVariableLookup"></a><span class="ts" id=761 data-target="#details-761" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">InlineValueVariableLookup</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">range</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a>, <span class="ident">variableName</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">caseSensitiveLookup</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#InlineValueVariableLookup">InlineValueVariableLookup</a></span>

<a name="InlineValueVariableLookup.caseSensitiveLookup"></a><span class="ts" id=767 data-target="#details-767" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">caseSensitiveLookup</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>

### <a name="InputBox"></a><span class="code-item" id=3235>InputBox</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A concrete <a href="#QuickInput">QuickInput</a> to let the user input a text value.</p>
<p>Note that in many cases the more convenient <a href="#window.showInputBox">window.showInputBox</a> is easier to use.
<a href="#window.createInputBox">window.createInputBox</a> should be used when <a href="#window.showInputBox">window.showInputBox</a> does not offer
the required flexibility.</p>
</div>

#### Events



<a name="InputBox.onDidAccept"></a><span class="ts" id=3241 data-target="#details-3241" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidAccept</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3241">
<div class="comment"><p>An event signaling when the user indicated acceptance of the input value.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="InputBox.onDidChangeValue"></a><span class="ts" id=3240 data-target="#details-3240" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeValue</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3240">
<div class="comment"><p>An event signaling when the value has changed.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="InputBox.onDidHide"></a><span class="ts" id=3256 data-target="#details-3256" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidHide</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3256">
<div class="comment"><p>An event signaling when this input UI is hidden.</p>
<p>There are several reasons why this UI might have to be hidden and the extension will be notified
through <a href="#QuickInput.onDidHide">onDidHide</a>. Examples include: an explicit call to
<a href="#QuickInput.hide">hide</a>, the user pressing Esc, some other input UI opening, etc.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="InputBox.onDidTriggerButton"></a><span class="ts" id=3243 data-target="#details-3243" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidTriggerButton</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#QuickInputButton">QuickInputButton</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3243">
<div class="comment"><p>An event signaling when a button was triggered.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="InputBox.busy"></a><span class="ts" id=3250 data-target="#details-3250" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">busy</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3250">
<div class="comment"><p>Determines if the UI should show a progress indicator. Defaults to <code>false</code>.</p>
<p>Change this to <code>true</code>, for example, while loading more data or validating user input.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="InputBox.buttons"></a><span class="ts" id=3242 data-target="#details-3242" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">buttons</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#QuickInputButton">QuickInputButton</a>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3242">
<div class="comment"><p>Buttons for actions in the UI.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="InputBox.enabled"></a><span class="ts" id=3249 data-target="#details-3249" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">enabled</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3249">
<div class="comment"><p>Determines if the UI should allow for user input. Defaults to <code>true</code>.</p>
<p>Change this to <code>false</code>, for example, while validating user input or loading data for the next
step in user input.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="InputBox.ignoreFocusOut"></a><span class="ts" id=3251 data-target="#details-3251" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">ignoreFocusOut</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3251">
<div class="comment"><p>Determines if the UI should stay open even when losing UI focus. Defaults to <code>false</code>.
This setting is ignored on iPad and is always <code>false</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="InputBox.password"></a><span class="ts" id=3239 data-target="#details-3239" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">password</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3239">
<div class="comment"><p>Determines if the input value should be hidden. Defaults to <code>false</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="InputBox.placeholder"></a><span class="ts" id=3238 data-target="#details-3238" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">placeholder</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3238">
<div class="comment"><p>Optional placeholder text shown when no value has been input.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="InputBox.prompt"></a><span class="ts" id=3244 data-target="#details-3244" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">prompt</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3244">
<div class="comment"><p>An optional prompt text providing some ask or explanation to the user.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="InputBox.step"></a><span class="ts" id=3247 data-target="#details-3247" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">step</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3247">
<div class="comment"><p>An optional current step count for multi-step input flows.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="InputBox.title"></a><span class="ts" id=3246 data-target="#details-3246" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">title</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3246">
<div class="comment"><p>An optional title for the input UI.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="InputBox.totalSteps"></a><span class="ts" id=3248 data-target="#details-3248" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">totalSteps</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3248">
<div class="comment"><p>An optional total step count for multi-step input flows.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="InputBox.validationMessage"></a><span class="ts" id=3245 data-target="#details-3245" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">validationMessage</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#InputBoxValidationMessage">InputBoxValidationMessage</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3245">
<div class="comment"><p>An optional validation message indicating a problem with the current input value.</p>
<p>By setting a string, the InputBox will use a default <a href="#InputBoxValidationSeverity">InputBoxValidationSeverity</a> of Error.
Returning <code>undefined</code> clears the validation message.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="InputBox.value"></a><span class="ts" id=3236 data-target="#details-3236" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">value</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3236">
<div class="comment"><p>The current input value.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="InputBox.valueSelection"></a><span class="ts" id=3237 data-target="#details-3237" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">valueSelection</span><span>: </span>readonly [<span class="type-intrinsic">number</span>, <span class="type-intrinsic">number</span>]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3237">
<div class="comment"><p>Selection range in the input value.</p>
<p>Defined as tuple of two numbers where the first is the inclusive start index and the second the
exclusive end index. When <code>undefined</code> the whole pre-filled value will be selected, when empty
(start equals end) only the cursor will be set, otherwise the defined range will be selected.</p>
<p>This property does not get updated when the user types or makes a selection, but it can be updated
by the extension.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="InputBox.dispose"></a><span class="ts" id=3258 data-target="#details-3258" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">dispose</span><span>(</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3258">
<div class="comment"><p>Dispose of this input UI and any associated resources.</p>
<p>If it is still visible, it is first hidden. After this call the input UI is no longer functional
and no additional methods or properties on it should be accessed. Instead a new input UI should
be created.</p>
</div>

</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="InputBox.hide"></a><span class="ts" id=3255 data-target="#details-3255" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">hide</span><span>(</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3255">
<div class="comment"><p>Hides this input UI.</p>
<p>This will also fire an <a href="#QuickInput.onDidHide">onDidHide</a> event.</p>
</div>

<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="InputBox.show"></a><span class="ts" id=3253 data-target="#details-3253" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">show</span><span>(</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span></span>

### <a name="InputBoxOptions"></a><span class="code-item" id=562>InputBoxOptions</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Options to configure the behavior of the input box UI.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="InputBoxOptions.ignoreFocusOut"></a><span class="ts" id=569 data-target="#details-569" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">ignoreFocusOut</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-569">
<div class="comment"><p>Set to <code>true</code> to keep the input box open when focus moves to another part of the editor or to another window.
This setting is ignored on iPad and is always false.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="InputBoxOptions.password"></a><span class="ts" id=568 data-target="#details-568" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">password</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-568">
<div class="comment"><p>Controls if a password input is shown. Password input hides the typed text.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="InputBoxOptions.placeHolder"></a><span class="ts" id=567 data-target="#details-567" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">placeHolder</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-567">
<div class="comment"><p>An optional string to show as placeholder in the input box to guide the user what to type.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="InputBoxOptions.prompt"></a><span class="ts" id=566 data-target="#details-566" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">prompt</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-566">
<div class="comment"><p>The text to display underneath the input box.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="InputBoxOptions.title"></a><span class="ts" id=563 data-target="#details-563" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">title</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-563">
<div class="comment"><p>An optional string that represents the title of the input box.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="InputBoxOptions.value"></a><span class="ts" id=564 data-target="#details-564" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">value</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-564">
<div class="comment"><p>The value to pre-fill in the input box.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="InputBoxOptions.valueSelection"></a><span class="ts" id=565 data-target="#details-565" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">valueSelection</span><span>?</span><span>: </span>[<span class="type-intrinsic">number</span>, <span class="type-intrinsic">number</span>]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-565">
<div class="comment"><p>Selection of the pre-filled <a href="#InputBoxOptions.value">value</a>. Defined as tuple of two number where the
first is the inclusive start index and the second the exclusive end index. When <code>undefined</code> the whole
pre-filled value will be selected, when empty (start equals end) only the cursor will be set,
otherwise the defined range will be selected.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="InputBoxOptions.validateInput"></a><span class="ts" id=571 data-target="#details-571" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">validateInput</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">value</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#InputBoxValidationMessage">InputBoxValidationMessage</a> &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#InputBoxValidationMessage">InputBoxValidationMessage</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-571">
<div class="comment"><p>An optional function that will be called to validate input and to give a hint
to the user.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">value</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The current value of the input box.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#InputBoxValidationMessage">InputBoxValidationMessage</a> &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#InputBoxValidationMessage">InputBoxValidationMessage</a>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>Either a human-readable string which is presented as an error message or an <a href="#InputBoxValidationMessage">InputBoxValidationMessage</a>
 which can provide a specific message severity. Return <code>undefined</code>, <code>null</code>, or the empty string when &#39;value&#39; is valid.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="InputBoxValidationMessage"></a><span class="code-item" id=559>InputBoxValidationMessage</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Represents a validation message for an <a href="#InputBox">InputBox</a>.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="InputBoxValidationMessage.message"></a><span class="ts" id=560 data-target="#details-560" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">message</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-560">
<div class="comment"><p>The validation message to display to the user.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="InputBoxValidationMessage.severity"></a><span class="ts" id=561 data-target="#details-561" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">severity</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#InputBoxValidationSeverity">InputBoxValidationSeverity</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-561">
<div class="comment"><p>The severity level of the validation message.</p>
<p><strong>Note:</strong> When using <a href="#InputBoxValidationSeverity.Error">InputBoxValidationSeverity.Error</a>, the user will not be able to accept
the input (e.g., by pressing Enter). <a href="#InputBoxValidationSeverity.Info">Info</a> and
<a href="#InputBoxValidationSeverity.Warning">Warning</a> severities will still allow the input to be accepted.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="InputBoxValidationSeverity"></a><span class="code-item" id=555>InputBoxValidationSeverity</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Severity levels for input box validation messages.</p>
</div>

#### Enumeration Members



<a name="InputBoxValidationSeverity.Info"></a><span class="ts" id=556 data-target="#details-556" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Info</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">1</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-556">
<div class="comment"><p>Indicates an informational message that does not prevent input acceptance.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="InputBoxValidationSeverity.Warning"></a><span class="ts" id=557 data-target="#details-557" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Warning</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">2</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-557">
<div class="comment"><p>Indicates a warning message that does not prevent input acceptance.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="InputBoxValidationSeverity.Error"></a><span class="ts" id=558 data-target="#details-558" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Error</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">3</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-558">
<div class="comment"><p>Indicates an error message that prevents the user from accepting the input.</p>
</div>
</div>

<a name="LanguageConfiguration.wordPattern"></a><span class="ts" id=1677 data-target="#details-1677" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">wordPattern</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref-ts">RegExp</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1677">
<div class="comment"><p>The language&#39;s word definition.
If the language supports Unicode identifiers (e.g. JavaScript), it is preferable
to provide a word definition that uses exclusion of known separators.
e.g.: A regex that matches anything except known separators (and dot is allowed to occur in a floating point number):</p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="text" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span>/(-?\d*\.\d\w*)|([^\`\~\!\\#\%\^\&#x26;\*\(\)\-\=\+\[\{\]\}\\\|\;\:\'\"\,\.\&#x3C;\>/\?\s]+)/g</span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="LanguageModelAccessInformation"></a><span class="code-item" id=5099>LanguageModelAccessInformation</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Represents extension specific information about the access to language models.</p>
</div>

#### Events



<a name="LanguageModelAccessInformation.onDidChange"></a><span class="ts" id=5100 data-target="#details-5100" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChange</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-5100">
<div class="comment"><p>An event that fires when access information changes.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="LanguageModelAccessInformation.canSendRequest"></a><span class="ts" id=5102 data-target="#details-5102" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">canSendRequest</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">chat</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#LanguageModelChat">LanguageModelChat</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-5102">
<div class="comment"><p>Checks if a request can be made to a language model.</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that calling this function will not trigger a consent UI but just checks for a persisted state.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">chat</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#LanguageModelChat">LanguageModelChat</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A language model chat object.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p><code>true</code> if a request can be made, <code>false</code> if not, <code>undefined</code> if the language
model does not exist or consent hasn&#39;t been asked for.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="LanguageModelChat"></a><span class="code-item" id=4949>LanguageModelChat</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Represents a language model for making chat requests.</p>
<p><em>See also</em>
<a href="#lm.selectChatModels">lm.selectChatModels</a></p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="LanguageModelChat.family"></a><span class="ts" id=4953 data-target="#details-4953" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">family</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4953">
<div class="comment"><p>Opaque family-name of the language model. Values might be <code>gpt-3.5-turbo</code>, <code>gpt4</code>, <code>phi2</code>, or <code>llama</code>
but they are defined by extensions contributing languages and subject to change.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="LanguageModelChat.id"></a><span class="ts" id=4951 data-target="#details-4951" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">id</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4951">
<div class="comment"><p>Opaque identifier of the language model.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="LanguageModelChat.maxInputTokens"></a><span class="ts" id=4955 data-target="#details-4955" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">maxInputTokens</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4955">
<div class="comment"><p>The maximum number of tokens that can be sent to the model in a single request.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="LanguageModelChat.name"></a><span class="ts" id=4950 data-target="#details-4950" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">name</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4950">
<div class="comment"><p>Human-readable name of the language model.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="LanguageModelChat.vendor"></a><span class="ts" id=4952 data-target="#details-4952" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">vendor</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4952">
<div class="comment"><p>A well-known identifier of the vendor of the language model. An example is <code>copilot</code>, but
values are defined by extensions contributing chat models and need to be looked up with them.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="LanguageModelChat.version"></a><span class="ts" id=4954 data-target="#details-4954" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">version</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4954">
<div class="comment"><p>Opaque version string of the model. This is defined by the extension contributing the language model
and subject to change.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="LanguageModelChat.countTokens"></a><span class="ts" id=4962 data-target="#details-4962" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">countTokens</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">text</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#LanguageModelChatMessage">LanguageModelChatMessage</a>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">number</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4962">
<div class="comment"><p>Count the number of tokens in a message using the model specific tokenizer-logic.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">text</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#LanguageModelChatMessage">LanguageModelChatMessage</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A string or a message instance.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Optional cancellation token.  See <a href="#CancellationTokenSource">CancellationTokenSource</a> for how to create one.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">number</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A thenable that resolves to the number of tokens.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="LanguageModelChat.sendRequest"></a><span class="ts" id=4957 data-target="#details-4957" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">sendRequest</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">messages</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#LanguageModelChatMessage">LanguageModelChatMessage</a>[], <span class="ident">options</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#LanguageModelChatRequestOptions">LanguageModelChatRequestOptions</a>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#LanguageModelChatResponse">LanguageModelChatResponse</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4957">
<div class="comment"><p>Make a chat request using a language model.</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that language model use may be subject to access restrictions and user consent. Calling this function
for the first time (for an extension) will show a consent dialog to the user and because of that this function
must <em>only be called in response to a user action!</em> Extensions can use <a href="#LanguageModelAccessInformation.canSendRequest">LanguageModelAccessInformation.canSendRequest</a>
to check if they have the necessary permissions to make a request.</p>
<p>This function will return a rejected promise if making a request to the language model is not
possible. Reasons for this can be:</p>
<ul>
<li>user consent not given, see <a href="#LanguageModelError.NoPermissions"><code>NoPermissions</code></a></li>
<li>model does not exist anymore, see <a href="#LanguageModelError.NotFound"><code>NotFound</code></a></li>
<li>quota limits exceeded, see <a href="#LanguageModelError.Blocked"><code>Blocked</code></a></li>
<li>other issues in which case extension must check [LanguageModelError.cause <code>LanguageModelError.cause</code>](#LanguageModelError.cause <code>LanguageModelError.cause</code>)</li>
</ul>
<p>An extension can make use of language model tool calling by passing a set of tools to
<a href="#LanguageModelChatRequestOptions.tools">LanguageModelChatRequestOptions.tools</a>. The language model will return a <a href="#LanguageModelToolCallPart">LanguageModelToolCallPart</a> and
the extension can invoke the tool and make another request with the result.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">messages</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#LanguageModelChatMessage">LanguageModelChatMessage</a>[]</td><td><div class="comment"><p>An array of message instances.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">options</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#LanguageModelChatRequestOptions">LanguageModelChatRequestOptions</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Options that control the request.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token which controls the request. See <a href="#CancellationTokenSource">CancellationTokenSource</a> for how to create one.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#LanguageModelChatResponse">LanguageModelChatResponse</a>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A thenable that resolves to a <a href="#LanguageModelChatResponse">LanguageModelChatResponse</a>. The promise will reject when the request couldn&#39;t be made.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="LanguageModelChatCapabilities"></a><span class="code-item" id=5045>LanguageModelChatCapabilities</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Various features that the <a href="#LanguageModelChatInformation">LanguageModelChatInformation</a> supports such as tool calling or image input.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="LanguageModelChatCapabilities.imageInput"></a><span class="ts" id=5046 data-target="#details-5046" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">imageInput</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-5046">
<div class="comment"><p>Whether image input is supported by the model.
Common supported images are jpg and png, but each model will vary in supported mimetypes.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="LanguageModelChatCapabilities.toolCalling"></a><span class="ts" id=5047 data-target="#details-5047" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">toolCalling</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span> &#124; <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-5047">
<div class="comment"><p>Whether tool calling is supported by the model.
If a number is provided, that is the maximum number of tools that can be provided in a request to the model.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="LanguageModelChatInformation"></a><span class="code-item" id=5035>LanguageModelChatInformation</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Represents a language model provided by a <a href="#LanguageModelChatProvider">LanguageModelChatProvider</a>.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="LanguageModelChatInformation.capabilities"></a><span class="ts" id=5044 data-target="#details-5044" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">capabilities</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#LanguageModelChatCapabilities">LanguageModelChatCapabilities</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-5044">
<div class="comment"><p>Various features that the model supports such as tool calling or image input.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="LanguageModelChatInformation.detail"></a><span class="ts" id=5040 data-target="#details-5040" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">detail</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-5040">
<div class="comment"><p>An optional, human-readable string which will be rendered alongside the model.
Useful for distinguishing models of the same name in the UI.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="LanguageModelChatInformation.family"></a><span class="ts" id=5038 data-target="#details-5038" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">family</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-5038">
<div class="comment"><p>Opaque family-name of the language model. Values might be <code>gpt-3.5-turbo</code>, <code>gpt4</code>, <code>phi2</code>, or <code>llama</code></p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="LanguageModelChatInformation.id"></a><span class="ts" id=5036 data-target="#details-5036" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">id</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-5036">
<div class="comment"><p>Unique identifier for the language model. Must be unique per provider, but not required to be globally unique.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="LanguageModelChatInformation.maxInputTokens"></a><span class="ts" id=5042 data-target="#details-5042" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">maxInputTokens</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-5042">
<div class="comment"><p>The maximum number of tokens the model can accept as input.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="LanguageModelChatInformation.maxOutputTokens"></a><span class="ts" id=5043 data-target="#details-5043" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">maxOutputTokens</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-5043">
<div class="comment"><p>The maximum number of tokens the model is capable of producing.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="LanguageModelChatInformation.name"></a><span class="ts" id=5037 data-target="#details-5037" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">name</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-5037">
<div class="comment"><p>Human-readable name of the language model.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="LanguageModelChatInformation.tooltip"></a><span class="ts" id=5039 data-target="#details-5039" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">tooltip</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-5039">
<div class="comment"><p>The tooltip to render when hovering the model. Used to provide more information about the model.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="LanguageModelChatInformation.version"></a><span class="ts" id=5041 data-target="#details-5041" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">version</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-5041">
<div class="comment"><p>Opaque version string of the model.
This is used as a lookup value in <a href="#LanguageModelChatSelector.version">LanguageModelChatSelector.version</a>
An example is how GPT 4o has multiple versions like 2024-11-20 and 2024-08-06</p>
</div>
</div>

<a name="LanguageModelChatMessageRole.User"></a><span class="ts" id=4927 data-target="#details-4927" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">User</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">1</span></span>

</div>



<a name="LanguageModelChatMessageRole.Assistant"></a><span class="ts" id=4928 data-target="#details-4928" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Assistant</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">2</span></span>
