### <a name="LanguageModelChatProvider"></a><span class="code-item" id=5054>LanguageModelChatProvider&lt;T&gt;</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A LanguageModelChatProvider implements access to language models, which users can then use through the chat view, or through extension API by acquiring a LanguageModelChat.
An example of this would be an OpenAI provider that provides models like gpt-5, o3, etc.</p>
</div>

#### Events



<a name="LanguageModelChatProvider.onDidChangeLanguageModelChatInformation"></a><span class="ts" id=5056 data-target="#details-5056" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeLanguageModelChatInformation</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-5056">
<div class="comment"><p>An optional event fired when the available set of language models changes.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="LanguageModelChatProvider.provideLanguageModelChatInformation"></a><span class="ts" id=5058 data-target="#details-5058" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">provideLanguageModelChatInformation</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">options</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#PrepareLanguageModelChatModelOptions">PrepareLanguageModelChatModelOptions</a>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>[]&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-5058">
<div class="comment"><p>Get the list of available language models provided by this provider</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">options</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#PrepareLanguageModelChatModelOptions">PrepareLanguageModelChatModelOptions</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Options which specify the calling context of this function</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>[]&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>The list of available language models</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="LanguageModelChatProvider.provideLanguageModelChatResponse"></a><span class="ts" id=5062 data-target="#details-5062" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">provideLanguageModelChatResponse</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">model</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span>, <span class="ident">messages</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#LanguageModelChatRequestMessage">LanguageModelChatRequestMessage</a>[], <span class="ident">options</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProvideLanguageModelChatResponseOptions">ProvideLanguageModelChatResponseOptions</a>, <span class="ident">progress</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Progress&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Progress</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#LanguageModelResponsePart">LanguageModelResponsePart</a>&gt;, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-5062">
<div class="comment"><p>Returns the response for a chat request, passing the results to the progress callback.
The <a href="#LanguageModelChatProvider">LanguageModelChatProvider</a> must emit the response parts to the progress callback as they are received from the language model.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">model</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The language model to use</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">messages</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#LanguageModelChatRequestMessage">LanguageModelChatRequestMessage</a>[]</td><td><div class="comment"><p>The messages to include in the request</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">options</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProvideLanguageModelChatResponseOptions">ProvideLanguageModelChatResponseOptions</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Options for the request</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">progress</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Progress&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Progress</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#LanguageModelResponsePart">LanguageModelResponsePart</a>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>The progress to emit the streamed response chunks to</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A promise that resolves when the response is complete. Results are actually passed to the progress callback.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="LanguageModelChatProvider.provideTokenCount"></a><span class="ts" id=5069 data-target="#details-5069" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">provideTokenCount</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">model</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span>, <span class="ident">text</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#LanguageModelChatRequestMessage">LanguageModelChatRequestMessage</a>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">number</span>&gt;</span>

<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>

<tr><td><span class="ident">text</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#LanguageModelChatRequestMessage">LanguageModelChatRequestMessage</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The text to count tokens for</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token</p>

### <a name="LanguageModelChatRequestOptions"></a><span class="code-item" id=4984>LanguageModelChatRequestOptions</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Options for making a chat request using a language model.</p>
<p><em>See also</em>
<a href="#LanguageModelChat.sendRequest">LanguageModelChat.sendRequest</a></p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="LanguageModelChatRequestOptions.justification"></a><span class="ts" id=4985 data-target="#details-4985" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">justification</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4985">
<div class="comment"><p>A human-readable message that explains why access to a language model is needed and what feature is enabled by it.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="LanguageModelChatRequestOptions.modelOptions"></a><span class="ts" id=4986 data-target="#details-4986" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">modelOptions</span><span>?</span><span>: </span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4986">
<div class="comment"><p>A set of options that control the behavior of the language model. These options are specific to the language model
and need to be looked up in the respective documentation.</p>

</div>



<a name="LanguageModelChatRequestOptions.toolMode"></a><span class="ts" id=4991 data-target="#details-4991" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">toolMode</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#LanguageModelChatToolMode">LanguageModelChatToolMode</a></span>

</div>
</div>



<a name="LanguageModelChatRequestOptions.tools"></a><span class="ts" id=4990 data-target="#details-4990" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">tools</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#LanguageModelChatTool">LanguageModelChatTool</a>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4990">
<div class="comment"><p>An optional list of tools that are available to the language model. These could be registered tools available via
<a href="#lm.tools">lm.tools</a>, or private tools that are just implemented within the calling extension.</p>
<p>If the LLM requests to call one of these tools, it will return a <a href="#LanguageModelToolCallPart">LanguageModelToolCallPart</a> in
<a href="#LanguageModelChatResponse.stream">LanguageModelChatResponse.stream</a>. It&#39;s the caller&#39;s responsibility to invoke the tool. If it&#39;s a tool
registered in <a href="#lm.tools">lm.tools</a>, that means calling <a href="#lm.invokeTool">lm.invokeTool</a>.</p>
<p>Then, the tool result can be provided to the LLM by creating an Assistant-type <a href="#LanguageModelChatMessage">LanguageModelChatMessage</a> with a
<a href="#LanguageModelToolCallPart">LanguageModelToolCallPart</a>, followed by a User-type message with a <a href="#LanguageModelToolResultPart">LanguageModelToolResultPart</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="LanguageModelChatResponse"></a><span class="code-item" id=4946>LanguageModelChatResponse</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Represents a language model response.</p>
<p><em>See also</em>
<a href="#ChatRequest">ChatRequest</a></p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="LanguageModelChatResponse.stream"></a><span class="ts" id=4947 data-target="#details-4947" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">stream</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref-ts">AsyncIterable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">unknown</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4947">
<div class="comment"><p>An async iterable that is a stream of text and tool-call parts forming the overall response. A
<a href="#LanguageModelTextPart">LanguageModelTextPart</a> is part of the assistant&#39;s response to be shown to the user. A
<a href="#LanguageModelToolCallPart">LanguageModelToolCallPart</a> is a request from the language model to call a tool. The latter will
only be returned if tools were passed in the request via <a href="#LanguageModelChatRequestOptions.tools">LanguageModelChatRequestOptions.tools</a>. The
<code>unknown</code>-type is used as a placeholder for future parts, like image data parts.</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that this stream will error when during data receiving an error occurs. Consumers of the stream should handle
the errors accordingly.</p>
<p>To cancel the stream, the consumer can <a href="#CancellationTokenSource.cancel">cancel</a> the token that was used to make
the request or break from the for-loop.</p>
<p><strong>Example</strong></p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="ts" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#C586C0;--shiki-light:#AF00DB">try</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#6A9955;--shiki-light:#008000">  // consume stream</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#C586C0;--shiki-light:#AF00DB">  for</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#C586C0;--shiki-light:#AF00DB"> await</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> (</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">const</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4FC1FF;--shiki-light:#0070C1"> chunk</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF"> of</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080"> response</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">stream</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#C586C0;--shiki-light:#AF00DB">    if</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> (</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">chunk</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF"> instanceof</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0;--shiki-light:#267F99"> LanguageModelTextPart</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">      console</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">log</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'TEXT'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">, </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">chunk</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">    } </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#C586C0;--shiki-light:#AF00DB">else</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#C586C0;--shiki-light:#AF00DB"> if</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> (</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">chunk</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF"> instanceof</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0;--shiki-light:#267F99"> LanguageModelToolCallPart</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">      console</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">log</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'TOOL CALL'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">, </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">chunk</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">} </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#C586C0;--shiki-light:#AF00DB">catch</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> (</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">e</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#6A9955;--shiki-light:#008000">  // stream ended with an error</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">  console</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">error</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">e</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="LanguageModelDataPart"></a><span class="code-item" id=5142>LanguageModelDataPart</span>

</div>

### <a name="LanguageModelError"></a><span class="code-item" id=4970>LanguageModelError</span>



<div class="comment"><p>An error type for language model specific errors.</p>
<p>Consumers of language models should check the code property to determine specific
failure causes, like <code>if(someError.code === vscode.LanguageModelError.NotFound.name) {...}</code>
for the case of referring to an unknown language model. For unspecified errors the <code>cause</code>-property
will contain the actual error.</p>
</div>

### <a name="LanguageModelTool"></a><span class="code-item" id=5181>LanguageModelTool&lt;T&gt;</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A tool that can be invoked by a call to a <a href="#LanguageModelChat">LanguageModelChat</a>.</p>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="LanguageModelTool.invoke"></a><span class="ts" id=5184 data-target="#details-5184" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">invoke</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">options</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#LanguageModelToolInvocationOptions&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">LanguageModelToolInvocationOptions</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt;, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#LanguageModelToolResult">LanguageModelToolResult</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-5184">
<div class="comment"><p>Invoke the tool with the given input and return a result.</p>
<p>The provided <a href="#LanguageModelToolInvocationOptions.input">LanguageModelToolInvocationOptions.input</a> has been validated against the declared schema.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">options</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#LanguageModelToolInvocationOptions&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">LanguageModelToolInvocationOptions</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#LanguageModelToolResult">LanguageModelToolResult</a>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="LanguageModelTool.prepareInvocation"></a><span class="ts" id=5188 data-target="#details-5188" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">prepareInvocation</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">options</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#LanguageModelToolInvocationPrepareOptions&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">LanguageModelToolInvocationPrepareOptions</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt;, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#PreparedToolInvocation">PreparedToolInvocation</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-5188">
<div class="comment"><p>Called once before a tool is invoked. It&#39;s recommended to implement this to customize the progress message that appears
while the tool is running, and to provide a more useful message with context from the invocation input. Can also
signal that a tool needs user confirmation before running, if appropriate.</p>
<ul>
<li><em>Note 1:</em> Must be free of side-effects.</li>
<li><em>Note 2:</em> A call to <code>prepareInvocation</code> is not necessarily followed by a call to <code>invoke</code>.</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">options</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#LanguageModelToolInvocationPrepareOptions&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">LanguageModelToolInvocationPrepareOptions</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#PreparedToolInvocation">PreparedToolInvocation</a>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="LanguageModelToolCallPart"></a><span class="code-item" id=5111>LanguageModelToolCallPart</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A language model response part indicating a tool call, returned from a <a href="#LanguageModelChatResponse">LanguageModelChatResponse</a>, and also can be
included as a content part on a <a href="#LanguageModelChatMessage">LanguageModelChatMessage</a>, to represent a previous tool call in a chat request.</p>
</div>

</table>
</div>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="LanguageModelToolCallPart.callId"></a><span class="ts" id=5117 data-target="#details-5117" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">callId</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>

</div>

### <a name="LanguageModelToolInvocationOptions"></a><span class="code-item" id=5162>LanguageModelToolInvocationOptions&lt;T&gt;</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Options provided for tool invocation.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="LanguageModelToolInvocationOptions.input"></a><span class="ts" id=5165 data-target="#details-5165" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">input</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-5165">
<div class="comment"><p>The input with which to invoke the tool. The input must match the schema defined in
<a href="#LanguageModelToolInformation.inputSchema">LanguageModelToolInformation.inputSchema</a></p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="LanguageModelToolInvocationOptions.tokenizationOptions"></a><span class="ts" id=5166 data-target="#details-5166" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">tokenizationOptions</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#LanguageModelToolTokenizationOptions">LanguageModelToolTokenizationOptions</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-5166">
<div class="comment"><p>Options to hint at how many tokens the tool should return in its response, and enable the tool to count tokens
accurately.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="LanguageModelToolInvocationOptions.toolInvocationToken"></a><span class="ts" id=5164 data-target="#details-5164" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">toolInvocationToken</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">undefined</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-5164">
<div class="comment"><p>An opaque object that ties a tool invocation to a chat request from a <a href="#ChatParticipant">chat participant</a>.</p>
<p>The <em>only</em> way to get a valid tool invocation token is using the provided <a href="#ChatRequest.toolInvocationToken">toolInvocationToken</a>
from a chat request. In that case, a progress bar will be automatically shown for the tool invocation in the chat response view, and if
the tool requires user confirmation, it will show up inline in the chat view.</p>
<p>If the tool is being invoked outside of a chat request, <code>undefined</code> should be passed instead, and no special UI except for
confirmations will be shown.</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that a tool that invokes another tool during its invocation, can pass along the <code>toolInvocationToken</code> that it received.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="LanguageModelToolInvocationPrepareOptions"></a><span class="code-item" id=5178>LanguageModelToolInvocationPrepareOptions&lt;T&gt;</span>

### <a name="LanguageStatusItem"></a><span class="code-item" id=1815>LanguageStatusItem</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A language status item is the preferred way to present language status reports for the active text editors,
such as selected linter or notifying about a configuration problem.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="LanguageStatusItem.accessibilityInformation"></a><span class="ts" id=1824 data-target="#details-1824" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">accessibilityInformation</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#AccessibilityInformation">AccessibilityInformation</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1824">
<div class="comment"><p>Accessibility information used when a screen reader interacts with this item</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="LanguageStatusItem.busy"></a><span class="ts" id=1822 data-target="#details-1822" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">busy</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1822">
<div class="comment"><p>Controls whether the item is shown as &quot;busy&quot;. Defaults to <code>false</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="LanguageStatusItem.command"></a><span class="ts" id=1823 data-target="#details-1823" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">command</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Command">Command</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1823">
<div class="comment"><p>A <a href="#Command">command</a> for this item.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="LanguageStatusItem.detail"></a><span class="ts" id=1821 data-target="#details-1821" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">detail</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1821">
<div class="comment"><p>Optional, human-readable details for this item.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="LanguageStatusItem.id"></a><span class="ts" id=1816 data-target="#details-1816" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">id</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1816">
<div class="comment"><p>The identifier of this item.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="LanguageStatusItem.name"></a><span class="ts" id=1817 data-target="#details-1817" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">name</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1817">
<div class="comment"><p>The short name of this item, like &#39;Java Language Status&#39;, etc.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="LanguageStatusItem.selector"></a><span class="ts" id=1818 data-target="#details-1818" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">selector</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DocumentSelector">DocumentSelector</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1818">
<div class="comment"><p>A <a href="#DocumentSelector">selector</a> that defines for what editors
this item shows.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="LanguageStatusItem.severity"></a><span class="ts" id=1819 data-target="#details-1819" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">severity</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#LanguageStatusSeverity">LanguageStatusSeverity</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1819">
<div class="comment"><p>The severity of this item.</p>
<p>Defaults to <a href="#LanguageStatusSeverity.Information">information</a>. You can use this property to
signal to users that there is a problem that needs attention, like a missing executable or an
invalid configuration.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="LanguageStatusItem.text"></a><span class="ts" id=1820 data-target="#details-1820" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">text</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1820">
<div class="comment"><p>The text to show for the entry. You can embed icons in the text by leveraging the syntax:</p>
<p><code>My text $(icon-name) contains icons like $(icon-name) this one.</code></p>
<p>Where the icon-name is taken from the ThemeIcon <a href="https://code.visualstudio.com/api/references/icons-in-labels#icon-listing">icon set</a>, e.g.
<code>light-bulb</code>, <code>thumbsup</code>, <code>zap</code> etc.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="LinkedEditingRangeProvider"></a><span class="code-item" id=1550>LinkedEditingRangeProvider</span>



<div class="comment"><p>The linked editing range provider interface defines the contract between extensions and
the linked editing feature.</p>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="LinkedEditingRangeProvider.provideLinkedEditingRanges"></a><span class="ts" id=1552 data-target="#details-1552" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">provideLinkedEditingRanges</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a>, <span class="ident">position</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#LinkedEditingRanges">LinkedEditingRanges</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1552">
<div class="comment"><p>For a given position in a document, returns the range of the symbol at the position and all ranges
that have the same content. A change to one of the ranges can be applied to all other ranges if the new content
is valid. An optional word pattern can be returned with the result to describe valid contents.
If no result-specific word pattern is provided, the word pattern from the language configuration is used.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The document in which the provider was invoked.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">position</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The position at which the provider was invoked.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#LinkedEditingRanges">LinkedEditingRanges</a>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A list of ranges that can be edited together</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="LinkedEditingRanges"></a><span class="code-item" id=1543>LinkedEditingRanges</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Represents a list of ranges that can be edited together along with a word pattern to describe valid range contents.</p>
</div>

#### Constructors



<a name="LinkedEditingRanges.LinkedEditingRanges"></a><span class="ts" id=1545 data-target="#details-1545" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">LinkedEditingRanges</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">ranges</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a>[], <span class="ident">wordPattern</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref-ts">RegExp</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#LinkedEditingRanges">LinkedEditingRanges</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1545">
<div class="comment"><p>Create a new linked editing ranges object.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">ranges</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a>[]</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A list of ranges that can be edited together</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">wordPattern</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref-ts">RegExp</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>An optional word pattern that describes valid contents for the given ranges</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#LinkedEditingRanges">LinkedEditingRanges</a></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="LinkedEditingRanges.ranges"></a><span class="ts" id=1548 data-target="#details-1548" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">ranges</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1548">
<div class="comment"><p>A list of ranges that can be edited together. The ranges must have
identical length and text content. The ranges cannot overlap.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="LinkedEditingRanges.wordPattern"></a><span class="ts" id=1549 data-target="#details-1549" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">wordPattern</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref-ts">RegExp</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1549">
<div class="comment"><p>An optional word pattern that describes valid contents for the given ranges.
If no pattern is provided, the language configuration&#39;s word pattern will be used.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="MarkdownString"></a><span class="code-item" id=700>MarkdownString</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Human-readable text that supports formatting via the <a href="https://commonmark.org">markdown syntax</a>.</p>
<p>Rendering of <a href="#ThemeIcon">theme icons</a> via the <code>$(&lt;name&gt;)</code>-syntax is supported
when the <a href="#MarkdownString.supportThemeIcons">supportThemeIcons</a> is set to <code>true</code>.</p>
<p>Rendering of embedded html is supported when <a href="#MarkdownString.supportHtml">supportHtml</a> is set to <code>true</code>.</p>
</div>

#### Constructors



<a name="MarkdownString.MarkdownString"></a><span class="ts" id=702 data-target="#details-702" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">MarkdownString</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">value</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">supportThemeIcons</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#MarkdownString">MarkdownString</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-702">
<div class="comment"><p>Creates a new markdown string with the given value.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">value</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Optional, initial value.</p>
</div></td></tr>

</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#MarkdownString">MarkdownString</a></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="MarkdownString.baseUri"></a><span class="ts" id=711 data-target="#details-711" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">baseUri</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-711">
<div class="comment"><p>Uri that relative paths are resolved relative to.</p>
<p>If the <code>baseUri</code> ends with <code>/</code>, it is considered a directory and relative paths in the markdown are resolved relative to that directory:</p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="ts" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">const</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4FC1FF;--shiki-light:#0070C1"> md</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> = </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">new</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080"> vscode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">MarkdownString</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">`[link](./file.js)`</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">md</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">baseUri</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> = </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">vscode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">Uri</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">file</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'/path/to/dir/'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#6A9955;--shiki-light:#008000">// Here 'link' in the rendered markdown resolves to '/path/to/dir/file.js'</span></span>
<span class="line"></span></code></pre>
<p>If the <code>baseUri</code> is a file, relative paths in the markdown are resolved relative to the parent dir of that file:</p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="ts" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">const</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4FC1FF;--shiki-light:#0070C1"> md</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> = </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">new</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080"> vscode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">MarkdownString</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">`[link](./file.js)`</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">md</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">baseUri</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> = </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">vscode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">Uri</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">file</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'/path/to/otherFile.js'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#6A9955;--shiki-light:#008000">// Here 'link' in the rendered markdown resolves to '/path/to/file.js'</span></span>
<span class="line"></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>



<a name="MarkdownString.isTrusted"></a><span class="ts" id=706 data-target="#details-706" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">isTrusted</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span> &#124; {enabledCommands: readonly <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>[]}</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-706">
<div class="comment"><p>Indicates that this markdown string is from a trusted source. Only <em>trusted</em>
markdown supports links that execute commands, e.g. <code>[Run it](command:myCommandId)</code>.</p>
<p>Defaults to <code>false</code> (commands are disabled).</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="MarkdownString.supportHtml"></a><span class="ts" id=710 data-target="#details-710" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">supportHtml</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-710">
<div class="comment"><p>Indicates that this markdown string can contain raw html tags. Defaults to <code>false</code>.</p>
<p>When <code>supportHtml</code> is false, the markdown renderer will strip out any raw html tags
that appear in the markdown text. This means you can only use markdown syntax for rendering.</p>
<p>When <code>supportHtml</code> is true, the markdown render will also allow a safe subset of html tags
and attributes to be rendered. See <a href="https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/blob/6d2920473c6f13759c978dd89104c4270a83422d/src/vs/base/browser/markdownRenderer.ts#L296">https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/blob/6d2920473c6f13759c978dd89104c4270a83422d/src/vs/base/browser/markdownRenderer.ts#L296</a>
for a list of all supported tags and attributes.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="MarkedString"></a><span class="code-item" id=722>MarkedString</span>



<div class="comment"><p>MarkedString can be used to render human-readable text. It is either a markdown string
or a code-block that provides a language and a code snippet. Note that
markdown strings will be sanitized - that means html will be escaped.</p>
<ul>
<li><em>deprecated</em> - This type is deprecated, please use <a href="#MarkdownString">MarkdownString</a> instead.</li>
</ul>
</div>

### <a name="McpServerDefinition"></a><span class="code-item" id=5017>McpServerDefinition</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Definitions that describe different types of Model Context Protocol servers,
which can be returned from the <a href="#McpServerDefinitionProvider">McpServerDefinitionProvider</a>.</p>
</div>



<a name="McpServerDefinition"></a><span class="ts" id=5017 data-target="#details-5017" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">McpServerDefinition</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#McpStdioServerDefinition">McpStdioServerDefinition</a> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#McpHttpServerDefinition">McpHttpServerDefinition</a></span>

### <a name="McpServerDefinitionProvider"></a><span class="code-item" id=5018>McpServerDefinitionProvider&lt;T&gt;</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A type that can provide Model Context Protocol server definitions. This
should be registered using <a href="#lm.registerMcpServerDefinitionProvider">lm.registerMcpServerDefinitionProvider</a>
during extension activation.</p>
</div>

#### Events



<a name="McpServerDefinitionProvider.onDidChangeMcpServerDefinitions"></a><span class="ts" id=5020 data-target="#details-5020" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeMcpServerDefinitions</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-5020">
<div class="comment"><p>Optional event fired to signal that the set of available servers has changed.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="McpServerDefinitionProvider.provideMcpServerDefinitions"></a><span class="ts" id=5022 data-target="#details-5022" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">provideMcpServerDefinitions</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>[]&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-5022">
<div class="comment"><p>Provides available MCP servers. The editor will call this method eagerly
to ensure the availability of servers for the language model, and so
extensions should not take actions which would require user
interaction, such as authentication.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>[]&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>An array of MCP available MCP servers</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="McpServerDefinitionProvider.resolveMcpServerDefinition"></a><span class="ts" id=5025 data-target="#details-5025" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">resolveMcpServerDefinition</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">server</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-5025">
<div class="comment"><p>This function will be called when the editor needs to start a MCP server.
At this point, the extension may take any actions which may require user
interaction, such as authentication. Any non-<code>readonly</code> property of the
server may be modified, and the extension should return the resolved server.</p>
<p>The extension may return undefined to indicate that the server
should not be started, or throw an error. If there is a pending tool
call, the editor will cancel it and return an error message to the
language model.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">server</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The MCP server to resolve</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>The resolved server or thenable that resolves to such. This may
be the given <code>server</code> definition with non-readonly properties filled in.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="McpStdioServerDefinition"></a><span class="code-item" id=4992>McpStdioServerDefinition</span>



<div class="comment"><p>McpStdioServerDefinition represents an MCP server available by running
a local process and operating on its stdin and stdout streams. The process
will be spawned as a child process of the extension host and by default
will not run in a shell environment.</p>
</div>

</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">version</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Optional version identification for the server.</p>

<div class="details collapse" id="details-2100">
<div class="comment"><p>Store a value. The value must be JSON-stringifyable.</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that using <code>undefined</code> as value removes the key from the underlying
storage.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">key</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A string.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">value</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">any</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A value. MUST not contain cyclic references.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="MessageItem"></a><span class="code-item" id=549>MessageItem</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Represents an action that is shown with an information, warning, or
error message.</p>
<p><em>See also</em></p>
<ul>
<li><a href="#window.showInformationMessage">showInformationMessage</a></li>
<li><a href="#window.showWarningMessage">showWarningMessage</a></li>
<li><a href="#window.showErrorMessage">showErrorMessage</a></li>
</ul>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="MessageItem.isCloseAffordance"></a><span class="ts" id=551 data-target="#details-551" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">isCloseAffordance</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-551">
<div class="comment"><p>A hint for modal dialogs that the item should be triggered
when the user cancels the dialog (e.g. by pressing the ESC
key).</p>
<p>Note: this option is ignored for non-modal messages.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="MessageItem.title"></a><span class="ts" id=550 data-target="#details-550" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">title</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-550">
<div class="comment"><p>A short title like &#39;Retry&#39;, &#39;Open Log&#39; etc.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="MessageOptions"></a><span class="code-item" id=552>MessageOptions</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Options to configure the behavior of the message.</p>
<p><em>See also</em></p>
<ul>
<li><a href="#window.showInformationMessage">showInformationMessage</a></li>
<li><a href="#window.showWarningMessage">showWarningMessage</a></li>
<li><a href="#window.showErrorMessage">showErrorMessage</a></li>
</ul>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="MessageOptions.detail"></a><span class="ts" id=554 data-target="#details-554" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">detail</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-554">
<div class="comment"><p>Human-readable detail message that is rendered less prominent. <em>Note</em> that detail
is only shown for <a href="#MessageOptions.modal">modal</a> messages.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="MessageOptions.modal"></a><span class="ts" id=553 data-target="#details-553" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">modal</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-553">
<div class="comment"><p>Indicates that this message should be modal.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="NotebookCell"></a><span class="code-item" id=3691>NotebookCell</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Represents a cell of a <a href="#NotebookDocument">notebook</a>, either a <a href="#NotebookCellKind.Code">code</a>-cell
or <a href="#NotebookCellKind.Markup">markup</a>-cell.</p>
<p>NotebookCell instances are immutable and are kept in sync for as long as they are part of their notebook.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="NotebookCell.document"></a><span class="ts" id=3695 data-target="#details-3695" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3695">
<div class="comment"><p>The <a href="#TextDocument">text</a> of this cell, represented as text document.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookCell.executionSummary"></a><span class="ts" id=3701 data-target="#details-3701" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">executionSummary</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookCellExecutionSummary">NotebookCellExecutionSummary</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3701">
<div class="comment"><p>The most recent <a href="#NotebookCellExecutionSummary">execution summary</a> for this cell.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookCell.index"></a><span class="ts" id=3692 data-target="#details-3692" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">index</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3692">
<div class="comment"><p>The index of this cell in its <a href="#NotebookDocument.cellAt">containing notebook</a>. The
index is updated when a cell is moved within its notebook. The index is <code>-1</code>
when the cell has been removed from its notebook.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookCell.kind"></a><span class="ts" id=3694 data-target="#details-3694" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">kind</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookCellKind">NotebookCellKind</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3694">
<div class="comment"><p>The kind of this cell.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookCell.metadata"></a><span class="ts" id=3696 data-target="#details-3696" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">metadata</span><span>: </span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3696">
<div class="comment"><p>The metadata of this cell. Can be anything but must be JSON-stringifyable.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookCell.notebook"></a><span class="ts" id=3693 data-target="#details-3693" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">notebook</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookDocument">NotebookDocument</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3693">
<div class="comment"><p>The <a href="#NotebookDocument">notebook</a> that contains this cell.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookCell.outputs"></a><span class="ts" id=3700 data-target="#details-3700" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">outputs</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookCellOutput">NotebookCellOutput</a>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3700">
<div class="comment"><p>The outputs of this cell.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="NotebookCellData"></a><span class="code-item" id=3810>NotebookCellData</span>



<div class="comment"><p>NotebookCellData is the raw representation of notebook cells. Its is part of <a href="#NotebookData">NotebookData</a>.</p>
</div>

#### Constructors



<a name="NotebookCellData.NotebookCellData"></a><span class="ts" id=3812 data-target="#details-3812" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">NotebookCellData</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">kind</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookCellKind">NotebookCellKind</a>, <span class="ident">value</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">languageId</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookCellData">NotebookCellData</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3812">
<div class="comment"><p>Create new cell data. Minimal cell data specifies its kind, its source value, and the
language identifier of its source.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">kind</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookCellKind">NotebookCellKind</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The kind.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">value</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The source value.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">languageId</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The language identifier of the source value.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookCellData">NotebookCellData</a></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="NotebookCellData.executionSummary"></a><span class="ts" id=3824 data-target="#details-3824" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">executionSummary</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookCellExecutionSummary">NotebookCellExecutionSummary</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3824">
<div class="comment"><p>The execution summary of this cell data.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookCellData.kind"></a><span class="ts" id=3816 data-target="#details-3816" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">kind</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookCellKind">NotebookCellKind</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3816">
<div class="comment"><p>The <a href="#NotebookCellKind">kind</a> of this cell data.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookCellData.languageId"></a><span class="ts" id=3818 data-target="#details-3818" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">languageId</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3818">
<div class="comment"><p>The language identifier of the source value of this cell data. Any value from
<a href="#languages.getLanguages">getLanguages</a> is possible.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookCellData.metadata"></a><span class="ts" id=3820 data-target="#details-3820" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">metadata</span><span>?</span><span>: </span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3820">
<div class="comment"><p>Arbitrary metadata of this cell data. Can be anything but must be JSON-stringifyable.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookCellData.outputs"></a><span class="ts" id=3819 data-target="#details-3819" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">outputs</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookCellOutput">NotebookCellOutput</a>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3819">
<div class="comment"><p>The outputs of this cell data.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookCellData.value"></a><span class="ts" id=3817 data-target="#details-3817" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">value</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3817">
<div class="comment"><p>The source value of this cell data - either source code or formatted text.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="NotebookCellExecution"></a><span class="code-item" id=3887>NotebookCellExecution</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A NotebookCellExecution is how <a href="#NotebookController">notebook controller</a> modify a notebook cell as
it is executing.</p>
<p>When a cell execution object is created, the cell enters the [NotebookCellExecutionState.Pending Pending](#NotebookCellExecutionState.Pending Pending) state.
When <a href="#NotebookCellExecution.start">start(...)</a> is called on the execution task, it enters the [NotebookCellExecutionState.Executing Executing](#NotebookCellExecutionState.Executing Executing) state. When
<a href="#NotebookCellExecution.end">end(...)</a> is called, it enters the [NotebookCellExecutionState.Idle Idle](#NotebookCellExecutionState.Idle Idle) state.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="NotebookCellExecution.cell"></a><span class="ts" id=3888 data-target="#details-3888" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">cell</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookCell">NotebookCell</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3888">
<div class="comment"><p>The <a href="#NotebookCell">cell</a> for which this execution has been created.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookCellExecution.executionOrder"></a><span class="ts" id=3890 data-target="#details-3890" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">executionOrder</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3890">
<div class="comment"><p>Set and unset the order of this cell execution.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookCellExecution.token"></a><span class="ts" id=3889 data-target="#details-3889" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3889">
<div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token which will be triggered when the cell execution is canceled
from the UI.</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that the cancellation token will not be triggered when the <a href="#NotebookController">controller</a>
that created this execution uses an <a href="#NotebookController.interruptHandler">interrupt-handler</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="NotebookCellExecution.appendOutput"></a><span class="ts" id=3906 data-target="#details-3906" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">appendOutput</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">out</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookCellOutput">NotebookCellOutput</a> &#124; readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookCellOutput">NotebookCellOutput</a>[], <span class="ident">cell</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookCell">NotebookCell</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3906">
<div class="comment"><p>Append to the output of the cell that is executing or to another cell that is affected by this execution.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">out</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookCellOutput">NotebookCellOutput</a> &#124; readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookCellOutput">NotebookCellOutput</a>[]</td><td><div class="comment"><p>Output that is appended to the current output.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">cell</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookCell">NotebookCell</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Cell for which output is cleared. Defaults to the <a href="#NotebookCellExecution.cell">cell</a> of
this execution.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A thenable that resolves when the operation finished.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookCellExecution.appendOutputItems"></a><span class="ts" id=3914 data-target="#details-3914" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">appendOutputItems</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">items</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookCellOutputItem">NotebookCellOutputItem</a> &#124; readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookCellOutputItem">NotebookCellOutputItem</a>[], <span class="ident">output</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookCellOutput">NotebookCellOutput</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3914">
<div class="comment"><p>Append output items to existing cell output.</p>

<div class="signature callable-signature">

<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">items</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookCellOutputItem">NotebookCellOutputItem</a> &#124; readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookCellOutputItem">NotebookCellOutputItem</a>[]</td><td><div class="comment"><p>Output items that are append to existing output.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">output</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookCellOutput">NotebookCellOutput</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Output object that already exists.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A thenable that resolves when the operation finished.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

<div class="details collapse" id="details-3899">

<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A thenable that resolves when the operation finished.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookCellExecution.end"></a><span class="ts" id=3895 data-target="#details-3895" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">end</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">success</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>, <span class="ident">endTime</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span></span>

<a name="NotebookCellExecution.start"></a><span class="ts" id=3892 data-target="#details-3892" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">start</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">startTime</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span></span>

<p>The command must be <a href="#commands.getCommands">known</a>.</p>
<p>Note that if this is a <a href="#Command">Command</a> object, only the <a href="#Command.command">command</a> and <a href="#Command.arguments">arguments</a>
are used by the editor.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="NotebookCellStatusBarItemProvider"></a><span class="code-item" id=3931>NotebookCellStatusBarItemProvider</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A provider that can contribute items to the status bar that appears below a cell&#39;s editor.</p>
</div>

#### Events



<a name="NotebookCellStatusBarItemProvider.onDidChangeCellStatusBarItems"></a><span class="ts" id=3932 data-target="#details-3932" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeCellStatusBarItems</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3932">
<div class="comment"><p>An optional event to signal that statusbar items have changed. The provide method will be called again.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="NotebookCellStatusBarItemProvider.provideCellStatusBarItems"></a><span class="ts" id=3934 data-target="#details-3934" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">provideCellStatusBarItems</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">cell</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookCell">NotebookCell</a>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookCellStatusBarItem">NotebookCellStatusBarItem</a> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookCellStatusBarItem">NotebookCellStatusBarItem</a>[]&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3934">
<div class="comment"><p>The provider will be called when the cell scrolls into view, when its content, outputs, language, or metadata change, and when it changes execution state.</p>
</div>
