<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">cell</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookCell">NotebookCell</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The cell for which to return items.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A token triggered if this request should be cancelled.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookCellStatusBarItem">NotebookCellStatusBarItem</a> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookCellStatusBarItem">NotebookCellStatusBarItem</a>[]&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>One or more <a href="#NotebookCellStatusBarItem">cell statusbar items</a></p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="NotebookController"></a><span class="code-item" id=3856>NotebookController</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A notebook controller represents an entity that can execute notebook cells. This is often referred to as a kernel.</p>
<p>There can be multiple controllers and the editor will let users choose which controller to use for a certain notebook. The
<a href="#NotebookController.notebookType">notebookType</a>-property defines for what kind of notebooks a controller is for and
the <a href="#NotebookController.updateNotebookAffinity">updateNotebookAffinity</a>-function allows controllers to set a preference
for specific notebook documents. When a controller has been selected its
<a href="#NotebookController.onDidChangeSelectedNotebooks">onDidChangeSelectedNotebooks</a>-event fires.</p>
<p>When a cell is being run the editor will invoke the <a href="#NotebookController.executeHandler">executeHandler</a> and a controller
is expected to create and finalize a <a href="#NotebookCellExecution">notebook cell execution</a>. However, controllers are also free
to create executions by themselves.</p>
</div>

#### Events



<a name="NotebookController.onDidChangeSelectedNotebooks"></a><span class="ts" id=3877 data-target="#details-3877" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeSelectedNotebooks</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;{notebook: <a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookDocument">NotebookDocument</a>, selected: <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>}&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3877">
<div class="comment"><p>An event that fires whenever a controller has been selected or un-selected for a notebook document.</p>
<p>There can be multiple controllers for a notebook and in that case a controllers needs to be <em>selected</em>. This is a user gesture
and happens either explicitly or implicitly when interacting with a notebook for which a controller was <em>suggested</em>. When possible,
the editor <em>suggests</em> a controller that is most likely to be <em>selected</em>.</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that controller selection is persisted (by the controllers <a href="#NotebookController.id">id</a>) and restored as soon as a
controller is re-created or as a notebook is <a href="#workspace.onDidOpenNotebookDocument">opened</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="NotebookController.description"></a><span class="ts" id=3861 data-target="#details-3861" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">description</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3861">
<div class="comment"><p>The human-readable description which is rendered less prominent.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookController.detail"></a><span class="ts" id=3862 data-target="#details-3862" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">detail</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3862">
<div class="comment"><p>The human-readable detail which is rendered less prominent.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookController.executeHandler"></a><span class="ts" id=3867 data-target="#details-3867" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">executeHandler</span><span>: </span>(cells: <a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookCell">NotebookCell</a>[], notebook: <a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookDocument">NotebookDocument</a>, controller: <a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookController">NotebookController</a>) =&gt; <span class="type-intrinsic">void</span> &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3867">
<div class="comment"><p>The execute handler is invoked when the run gestures in the UI are selected, e.g Run Cell, Run All,
Run Selection etc. The execute handler is responsible for creating and managing <a href="#NotebookCellExecution">execution</a>-objects.</p>
</div>
<div class="comment"></div>
<div class="signature variable-declaration-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">cells</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookCell">NotebookCell</a>[]</td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">notebook</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookDocument">NotebookDocument</a></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">controller</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookController">NotebookController</a></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span> &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookController.id"></a><span class="ts" id=3857 data-target="#details-3857" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">id</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3857">
<div class="comment"><p>The identifier of this notebook controller.</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that controllers are remembered by their identifier and that extensions should use
stable identifiers across sessions.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookController.interruptHandler"></a><span class="ts" id=3873 data-target="#details-3873" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">interruptHandler</span><span>?</span><span>: </span>(notebook: <a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookDocument">NotebookDocument</a>) =&gt; <span class="type-intrinsic">void</span> &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3873">
<div class="comment"><p>Optional interrupt handler.</p>
<p>By default cell execution is canceled via <a href="#NotebookCellExecution.token">tokens</a>. Cancellation
tokens require that a controller can keep track of its execution so that it can cancel a specific execution at a later
point. Not all scenarios allow for that, eg. REPL-style controllers often work by interrupting whatever is currently
running. For those cases the interrupt handler exists - it can be thought of as the equivalent of <code>SIGINT</code>
or <code>Control+C</code> in terminals.</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that supporting <a href="#NotebookCellExecution.token">cancellation tokens</a> is preferred and that interrupt handlers should
only be used when tokens cannot be supported.</p>
</div>
<div class="comment"></div>
<div class="signature variable-declaration-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">notebook</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookDocument">NotebookDocument</a></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span> &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookController.label"></a><span class="ts" id=3860 data-target="#details-3860" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">label</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>

<a name="NotebookController.notebookType"></a><span class="ts" id=3858 data-target="#details-3858" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">notebookType</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3858">

</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookController.supportedLanguages"></a><span class="ts" id=3859 data-target="#details-3859" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">supportedLanguages</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3859">
<div class="comment"><p>An array of language identifiers that are supported by this
controller. Any language identifier from <a href="#languages.getLanguages">getLanguages</a>
is possible. When falsy all languages are supported.</p>
<p>Samples:</p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="js" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#6A9955;--shiki-light:#008000">// support JavaScript and TypeScript</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">myController</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">supportedLanguages</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> = [</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'javascript'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">, </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'typescript'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">];</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#6A9955;--shiki-light:#008000">// support all languages</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">myController</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">supportedLanguages</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> = </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">undefined</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">; </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#6A9955;--shiki-light:#008000">// falsy</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">myController</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">supportedLanguages</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> = []; </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#6A9955;--shiki-light:#008000">// falsy</span></span>
<span class="line"></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookController.supportsExecutionOrder"></a><span class="ts" id=3863 data-target="#details-3863" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">supportsExecutionOrder</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3863">
<div class="comment"><p>Whether this controller supports execution order so that the
editor can render placeholders for them.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="NotebookController.createNotebookCellExecution"></a><span class="ts" id=3865 data-target="#details-3865" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">createNotebookCellExecution</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">cell</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookCell">NotebookCell</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookCellExecution">NotebookCellExecution</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3865">
<div class="comment"><p>Create a cell execution task.</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that there can only be one execution per cell at a time and that an error is thrown if
a cell execution is created while another is still active.</p>
<p>This should be used in response to the <a href="#NotebookController.executeHandler">execution handler</a>
being called or when cell execution has been started else, e.g when a cell was already
executing or when cell execution was triggered from another source.</p>
</div>

<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookCellExecution">NotebookCellExecution</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A notebook cell execution.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="NotebookDocument"></a><span class="code-item" id=3702>NotebookDocument</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Represents a notebook which itself is a sequence of <a href="#NotebookCell">code or markup cells</a>. Notebook documents are
created from <a href="#NotebookData">notebook data</a>.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="NotebookDocument.cellCount"></a><span class="ts" id=3713 data-target="#details-3713" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">cellCount</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></span>

<a name="NotebookDocument.isClosed"></a><span class="ts" id=3708 data-target="#details-3708" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">isClosed</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>

and won&#39;t be re-used when the same resource is opened again.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookDocument.isDirty"></a><span class="ts" id=3706 data-target="#details-3706" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">isDirty</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>

</div>



<a name="NotebookDocument.isUntitled"></a><span class="ts" id=3707 data-target="#details-3707" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">isUntitled</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3707">
<div class="comment"><p>Is this notebook representing an untitled file which has not been saved yet.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookDocument.metadata"></a><span class="ts" id=3709 data-target="#details-3709" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">metadata</span><span>: </span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3709">
<div class="comment"><p>Arbitrary metadata for this notebook. Can be anything but must be JSON-stringifyable.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookDocument.notebookType"></a><span class="ts" id=3704 data-target="#details-3704" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">notebookType</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3704">
<div class="comment"><p>The type of notebook.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookDocument.uri"></a><span class="ts" id=3703 data-target="#details-3703" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">uri</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3703">
<div class="comment"><p>The associated uri for this notebook.</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that most notebooks use the <code>file</code>-scheme, which means they are files on disk. However, <strong>not</strong> all notebooks are
saved on disk and therefore the <code>scheme</code> must be checked before trying to access the underlying file or siblings on disk.</p>
<p><em>See also</em>
<a href="#FileSystemProvider">FileSystemProvider</a></p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookDocument.version"></a><span class="ts" id=3705 data-target="#details-3705" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">version</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3705">
<div class="comment"><p>The version number of this notebook (it will strictly increase after each
change, including undo/redo).</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="NotebookDocument.cellAt"></a><span class="ts" id=3715 data-target="#details-3715" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">cellAt</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">index</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookCell">NotebookCell</a></span>

</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">

<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">index</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The index of the cell to retrieve.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookCell">NotebookCell</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A <a href="#NotebookCell">cell</a>.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookDocument.getCells"></a><span class="ts" id=3718 data-target="#details-3718" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">getCells</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">range</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookRange">NotebookRange</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookCell">NotebookCell</a>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3718">
<div class="comment"><p>Get the cells of this notebook. A subset can be retrieved by providing
a range. The range will be adjusted to the notebook.</p>

<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">range</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookRange">NotebookRange</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A notebook range.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookCell">NotebookCell</a>[]</td><td><div class="comment"><p>The cells contained by the range or all cells.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookDocument.save"></a><span class="ts" id=3721 data-target="#details-3721" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">save</span><span>(</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3721">

<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A promise that will resolve to true when the document
has been saved. Will return false if the file was not dirty or when save failed.</p>
</div></td></tr>

### <a name="NotebookDocumentCellChange"></a><span class="code-item" id=3722>NotebookDocumentCellChange</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Describes a change to a notebook cell.</p>
<p><em>See also</em>
<a href="#NotebookDocumentChangeEvent">NotebookDocumentChangeEvent</a></p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="NotebookDocumentCellChange.cell"></a><span class="ts" id=3723 data-target="#details-3723" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">cell</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookCell">NotebookCell</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3723">
<div class="comment"><p>The affected cell.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookDocumentCellChange.document"></a><span class="ts" id=3724 data-target="#details-3724" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3724">
<div class="comment"><p>The document of the cell or <code>undefined</code> when it did not change.</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that you should use the <a href="#workspace.onDidChangeTextDocument">onDidChangeTextDocument</a>-event
for detailed change information, like what edits have been performed.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookDocumentCellChange.executionSummary"></a><span class="ts" id=3730 data-target="#details-3730" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">executionSummary</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookCellExecutionSummary">NotebookCellExecutionSummary</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3730">
<div class="comment"><p>The new execution summary of the cell or <code>undefined</code> when it did not change.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookDocumentCellChange.metadata"></a><span class="ts" id=3725 data-target="#details-3725" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">metadata</span><span>: </span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3725">
<div class="comment"><p>The new metadata of the cell or <code>undefined</code> when it did not change.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookDocumentCellChange.outputs"></a><span class="ts" id=3729 data-target="#details-3729" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">outputs</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookCellOutput">NotebookCellOutput</a>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3729">
<div class="comment"><p>The new outputs of the cell or <code>undefined</code> when they did not change.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="NotebookDocumentChangeEvent"></a><span class="code-item" id=3735>NotebookDocumentChangeEvent</span>



<div class="comment"><p>An event describing a transactional <a href="#NotebookDocument">notebook</a> change.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="NotebookDocumentChangeEvent.cellChanges"></a><span class="ts" id=3742 data-target="#details-3742" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">cellChanges</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookDocumentCellChange">NotebookDocumentCellChange</a>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3742">
<div class="comment"><p>An array of <a href="#NotebookDocumentCellChange">cell changes</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookDocumentChangeEvent.contentChanges"></a><span class="ts" id=3741 data-target="#details-3741" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">contentChanges</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookDocumentContentChange">NotebookDocumentContentChange</a>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3741">
<div class="comment"><p>An array of content changes describing added or removed <a href="#NotebookCell">cells</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookDocumentChangeEvent.metadata"></a><span class="ts" id=3737 data-target="#details-3737" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">metadata</span><span>: </span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3737">
<div class="comment"><p>The new metadata of the notebook or <code>undefined</code> when it did not change.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookDocumentChangeEvent.notebook"></a><span class="ts" id=3736 data-target="#details-3736" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">notebook</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookDocument">NotebookDocument</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3736">
<div class="comment"><p>The affected notebook.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="NotebookDocumentContentChange"></a><span class="code-item" id=3731>NotebookDocumentContentChange</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Describes a structural change to a notebook document, e.g newly added and removed cells.</p>
<p><em>See also</em>
<a href="#NotebookDocumentChangeEvent">NotebookDocumentChangeEvent</a></p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="NotebookDocumentContentChange.addedCells"></a><span class="ts" id=3733 data-target="#details-3733" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">addedCells</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookCell">NotebookCell</a>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3733">
<div class="comment"><p>Cells that have been added to the document.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookDocumentContentChange.range"></a><span class="ts" id=3732 data-target="#details-3732" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">range</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookRange">NotebookRange</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3732">
<div class="comment"><p>The range at which cells have been either added or removed.</p>
<p>Note that no cells have been <a href="#NotebookDocumentContentChange.removedCells">removed</a>
when this range is <a href="#NotebookRange.isEmpty">empty</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookDocumentContentChange.removedCells"></a><span class="ts" id=3734 data-target="#details-3734" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">removedCells</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookCell">NotebookCell</a>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3734">
<div class="comment"><p>Cells that have been removed from the document.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="NotebookDocumentContentOptions"></a><span class="code-item" id=3843>NotebookDocumentContentOptions</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Notebook content options define what parts of a notebook are persisted. Note</p>
<p>For instance, a notebook serializer can opt-out of saving outputs and in that case the editor doesn&#39;t mark a
notebooks as <a href="#NotebookDocument.isDirty">dirty</a> when its output has changed.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="NotebookDocumentContentOptions.transientCellMetadata"></a><span class="ts" id=3845 data-target="#details-3845" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">transientCellMetadata</span><span>?</span><span>: </span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3845">
<div class="comment"><p>Controls if a cell metadata property change event will trigger notebook document content
change events and if it will be used in the diff editor, defaults to false. If the
content provider doesn&#39;t persist a metadata property in the file document, it should be
set to true.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookDocumentContentOptions.transientDocumentMetadata"></a><span class="ts" id=3849 data-target="#details-3849" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">transientDocumentMetadata</span><span>?</span><span>: </span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3849">
<div class="comment"><p>Controls if a document metadata property change event will trigger notebook document
content change event and if it will be used in the diff editor, defaults to false. If the
content provider doesn&#39;t persist a metadata property in the file document, it should be
set to true.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookDocumentContentOptions.transientOutputs"></a><span class="ts" id=3844 data-target="#details-3844" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">transientOutputs</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3844">
<div class="comment"><p>Controls if output change events will trigger notebook document content change events and
if it will be used in the diff editor, defaults to false. If the content provider doesn&#39;t
persist the outputs in the file document, this should be set to true.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="NotebookDocumentShowOptions"></a><span class="code-item" id=233>NotebookDocumentShowOptions</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Represents options to configure the behavior of showing a <a href="#NotebookDocument">notebook document</a> in an <a href="#NotebookEditor">notebook editor</a>.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="NotebookDocumentShowOptions.preserveFocus"></a><span class="ts" id=235 data-target="#details-235" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">preserveFocus</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-235">
<div class="comment"><p>An optional flag that when <code>true</code> will stop the <a href="#NotebookEditor">notebook editor</a> from taking focus.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookDocumentShowOptions.preview"></a><span class="ts" id=236 data-target="#details-236" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">preview</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-236">
<div class="comment"><p>An optional flag that controls if an <a href="#NotebookEditor">notebook editor</a>-tab shows as preview. Preview tabs will
be replaced and reused until set to stay - either explicitly or through editing. The default behaviour depends
on the <code>workbench.editor.enablePreview</code>-setting.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookDocumentShowOptions.selections"></a><span class="ts" id=237 data-target="#details-237" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">selections</span><span>?</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookRange">NotebookRange</a>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-237">
<div class="comment"><p>An optional selection to apply for the document in the <a href="#NotebookEditor">notebook editor</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookDocumentShowOptions.viewColumn"></a><span class="ts" id=234 data-target="#details-234" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">viewColumn</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ViewColumn">ViewColumn</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-234">
<div class="comment"><p>An optional view column in which the <a href="#NotebookEditor">notebook editor</a> should be shown.
The default is the <a href="#ViewColumn.Active">active</a>. Columns that do not exist
will be created as needed up to the maximum of <a href="#ViewColumn.Nine">ViewColumn.Nine</a>.
Use <a href="#ViewColumn.Beside">ViewColumn.Beside</a> to open the editor to the side of the currently
active one.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="NotebookDocumentWillSaveEvent"></a><span class="code-item" id=3743>NotebookDocumentWillSaveEvent</span>



<div class="comment"><p>An event that is fired when a <a href="#NotebookDocument">notebook document</a> will be saved.</p>
<p>To make modifications to the document before it is being saved, call the
<a href="#NotebookDocumentWillSaveEvent.waitUntil">waitUntil</a>-function with a thenable
that resolves to a <a href="#WorkspaceEdit">workspace edit</a>.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="NotebookDocumentWillSaveEvent.notebook"></a><span class="ts" id=3745 data-target="#details-3745" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">notebook</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookDocument">NotebookDocument</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3745">
<div class="comment"><p>The <a href="#NotebookDocument">notebook document</a> that will be saved.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookDocumentWillSaveEvent.reason"></a><span class="ts" id=3746 data-target="#details-3746" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">reason</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocumentSaveReason">TextDocumentSaveReason</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3746">
<div class="comment"><p>The reason why save was triggered.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookDocumentWillSaveEvent.token"></a><span class="ts" id=3744 data-target="#details-3744" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3744">
<div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="NotebookDocumentWillSaveEvent.waitUntil"></a><span class="ts" id=3748 data-target="#details-3748" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">waitUntil</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">thenable</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#WorkspaceEdit">WorkspaceEdit</a>&gt;<span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3748">
<div class="comment"><p>Allows to pause the event loop and to apply <a href="#WorkspaceEdit">workspace edit</a>.
Edits of subsequent calls to this function will be applied in order. The
edits will be <em>ignored</em> if concurrent modifications of the notebook document happened.</p>
<p><em>Note:</em> This function can only be called during event dispatch and not
in an asynchronous manner:</p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="ts" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">workspace</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">onWillSaveNotebookDocument</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">event</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF"> =></span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#6A9955;--shiki-light:#008000">  // async, will *throw* an error</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">  setTimeout</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(() </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">=></span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080"> event</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">waitUntil</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">promise</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">));</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#6A9955;--shiki-light:#008000">  // sync, OK</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">  event</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">waitUntil</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">promise</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">});</span></span>
<span class="line"></span></code></pre>
</div>

</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>

### <a name="NotebookEdit"></a><span class="code-item" id=930>NotebookEdit</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A notebook edit represents edits that should be applied to the contents of a notebook.</p>
</div>

### <a name="NotebookEditor"></a><span class="code-item" id=3669>NotebookEditor</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Represents a notebook editor that is attached to a <a href="#NotebookDocument">notebook</a>.
Additional properties of the NotebookEditor are available in the proposed
API, which will be finalized later.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="NotebookEditor.notebook"></a><span class="ts" id=3670 data-target="#details-3670" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">notebook</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookDocument">NotebookDocument</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3670">
<div class="comment"><p>The <a href="#NotebookDocument">notebook document</a> associated with this notebook editor.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookEditor.selection"></a><span class="ts" id=3671 data-target="#details-3671" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">selection</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookRange">NotebookRange</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3671">
<div class="comment"><p>The primary selection in this notebook editor.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookEditor.selections"></a><span class="ts" id=3672 data-target="#details-3672" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">selections</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookRange">NotebookRange</a>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3672">
<div class="comment"><p>All selections in this notebook editor.</p>
<p>The primary selection (or focused range) is <code>selections[0]</code>. When the document has no cells, the primary selection is empty <code>{ start: 0, end: 0 }</code>;</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookEditor.viewColumn"></a><span class="ts" id=3674 data-target="#details-3674" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">viewColumn</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ViewColumn">ViewColumn</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3674">
<div class="comment"><p>The column in which this editor shows.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookEditor.visibleRanges"></a><span class="ts" id=3673 data-target="#details-3673" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">visibleRanges</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookRange">NotebookRange</a>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3673">
<div class="comment"><p>The current visible ranges in the editor (vertically).</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="NotebookEditorRevealType"></a><span class="code-item" id=3664>NotebookEditorRevealType</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Represents a notebook editor that is attached to a <a href="#NotebookDocument">notebook</a>.</p>
</div>

#### Enumeration Members



<a name="NotebookEditorRevealType.Default"></a><span class="ts" id=3665 data-target="#details-3665" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Default</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">0</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3665">
<div class="comment"><p>The range will be revealed with as little scrolling as possible.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookEditorRevealType.InCenter"></a><span class="ts" id=3666 data-target="#details-3666" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">InCenter</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">1</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3666">
<div class="comment"><p>The range will always be revealed in the center of the viewport.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookEditorRevealType.InCenterIfOutsideViewport"></a><span class="ts" id=3667 data-target="#details-3667" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">InCenterIfOutsideViewport</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">2</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3667">
<div class="comment"><p>If the range is outside the viewport, it will be revealed in the center of the viewport.
Otherwise, it will be revealed with as little scrolling as possible.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookEditorRevealType.AtTop"></a><span class="ts" id=3668 data-target="#details-3668" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">AtTop</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">3</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3668">
<div class="comment"><p>The range will always be revealed at the top of the viewport.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="NotebookRange"></a><span class="code-item" id=3759>NotebookRange</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A notebook range represents an ordered pair of two cell indices.
It is guaranteed that start is less than or equal to end.</p>
</div>

#### Constructors



<a name="NotebookRange.NotebookRange"></a><span class="ts" id=3761 data-target="#details-3761" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">NotebookRange</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">start</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span>, <span class="ident">end</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookRange">NotebookRange</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3761">
<div class="comment"><p>Create a new notebook range. If <code>start</code> is not
before or equal to <code>end</code>, the values will be swapped.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">start</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>start index</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">end</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>end index.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookRange">NotebookRange</a></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="NotebookRange.end"></a><span class="ts" id=3765 data-target="#details-3765" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">end</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3765">
<div class="comment"><p>The exclusive end index of this range (zero-based).</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookRange.isEmpty"></a><span class="ts" id=3766 data-target="#details-3766" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">isEmpty</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3766">
<div class="comment"><p><code>true</code> if <code>start</code> and <code>end</code> are equal.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookRange.start"></a><span class="ts" id=3764 data-target="#details-3764" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">start</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3764">
<div class="comment"><p>The zero-based start index of this range.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="NotebookRendererMessaging"></a><span class="code-item" id=3679>NotebookRendererMessaging</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Renderer messaging is used to communicate with a single renderer. It&#39;s returned from <a href="#notebooks.createRendererMessaging">notebooks.createRendererMessaging</a>.</p>
</div>

#### Events



<a name="NotebookRendererMessaging.onDidReceiveMessage"></a><span class="ts" id=3680 data-target="#details-3680" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidReceiveMessage</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;{editor: <a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookEditor">NotebookEditor</a>, message: <span class="type-intrinsic">any</span>}&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3680">
<div class="comment"><p>An event that fires when a message is received from a renderer.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="NotebookRendererMessaging.postMessage"></a><span class="ts" id=3685 data-target="#details-3685" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">postMessage</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">message</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">any</span>, <span class="ident">editor</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookEditor">NotebookEditor</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3685">
<div class="comment"><p>Send a message to one or all renderer.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">message</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">any</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Message to send</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">editor</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookEditor">NotebookEditor</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Editor to target with the message. If not provided, the
message is sent to all renderers.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>a boolean indicating whether the message was successfully
delivered to any renderer.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="NotebookSerializer"></a><span class="code-item" id=3834>NotebookSerializer</span>



<div class="comment"><p>The notebook serializer enables the editor to open notebook files.</p>
<p>At its core the editor only knows a <a href="#NotebookData">notebook data structure</a> but not
how that data structure is written to a file, nor how it is read from a file. The
notebook serializer bridges this gap by deserializing bytes into notebook data and
vice versa.</p>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="NotebookSerializer.deserializeNotebook"></a><span class="ts" id=3836 data-target="#details-3836" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">deserializeNotebook</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">content</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref-ts">Uint8Array</span>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookData">NotebookData</a> &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookData">NotebookData</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3836">
<div class="comment"><p>Deserialize contents of a notebook file into the notebook data structure.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">content</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref-ts">Uint8Array</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Contents of a notebook file.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookData">NotebookData</a> &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookData">NotebookData</a>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>Notebook data or a thenable that resolves to such.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="NotebookSerializer.serializeNotebook"></a><span class="ts" id=3840 data-target="#details-3840" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">serializeNotebook</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">data</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookData">NotebookData</a>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref-ts">Uint8Array</span>&lt;<span class="type-ref-ts">ArrayBufferLike</span>&gt; &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-ref-ts">Uint8Array</span>&lt;<span class="type-ref-ts">ArrayBufferLike</span>&gt;&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3840">
<div class="comment"><p>Serialize notebook data into file contents.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">data</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#NotebookData">NotebookData</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A notebook data structure.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref-ts">Uint8Array</span>&lt;<span class="type-ref-ts">ArrayBufferLike</span>&gt; &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-ref-ts">Uint8Array</span>&lt;<span class="type-ref-ts">ArrayBufferLike</span>&gt;&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>An array of bytes or a thenable that resolves to such.</p>

### <a name="OnTypeFormattingEditProvider"></a><span class="code-item" id=1178>OnTypeFormattingEditProvider</span>



<div class="comment"><p>The document formatting provider interface defines the contract between extensions and
the formatting-feature.</p>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="OnTypeFormattingEditProvider.provideOnTypeFormattingEdits"></a><span class="ts" id=1180 data-target="#details-1180" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">provideOnTypeFormattingEdits</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a>, <span class="ident">position</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a>, <span class="ident">ch</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">options</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#FormattingOptions">FormattingOptions</a>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#TextEdit">TextEdit</a>[]&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1180">
<div class="comment"><p>Provide formatting edits after a character has been typed.</p>
<p>The given position and character should hint to the provider
what range the position to expand to, like find the matching <code>{</code>
when <code>}</code> has been entered.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The document in which the command was invoked.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">position</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The position at which the command was invoked.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">ch</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The character that has been typed.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">options</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#FormattingOptions">FormattingOptions</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Options controlling formatting.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#TextEdit">TextEdit</a>[]&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A set of text edits or a thenable that resolves to such. The lack of a result can be
signaled by returning <code>undefined</code>, <code>null</code>, or an empty array.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="OpenDialogOptions"></a><span class="code-item" id=530>OpenDialogOptions</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Options to configure the behavior of a file open dialog.</p>
<ul>
<li>Note 1: On Windows and Linux, a file dialog cannot be both a file selector and a folder selector, so if you
set both <code>canSelectFiles</code> and <code>canSelectFolders</code> to <code>true</code> on these platforms, a folder selector will be shown.</li>
<li>Note 2: Explicitly setting <code>canSelectFiles</code> and <code>canSelectFolders</code> to <code>false</code> is futile
and the editor then silently adjusts the options to select files.</li>
</ul>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="OpenDialogOptions.canSelectFiles"></a><span class="ts" id=533 data-target="#details-533" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">canSelectFiles</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-533">
<div class="comment"><p>Allow to select files, defaults to <code>true</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="OpenDialogOptions.canSelectFolders"></a><span class="ts" id=534 data-target="#details-534" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">canSelectFolders</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-534">
<div class="comment"><p>Allow to select folders, defaults to <code>false</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="OpenDialogOptions.canSelectMany"></a><span class="ts" id=535 data-target="#details-535" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">canSelectMany</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-535">
<div class="comment"><p>Allow to select many files or folders.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="OpenDialogOptions.defaultUri"></a><span class="ts" id=531 data-target="#details-531" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">defaultUri</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-531">
<div class="comment"><p>The resource the dialog shows when opened.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="OpenDialogOptions.filters"></a><span class="ts" id=536 data-target="#details-536" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">filters</span><span>?</span><span>: </span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-536">
<div class="comment"><p>A set of file filters that are used by the dialog. Each entry is a human-readable label,
like &quot;TypeScript&quot;, and an array of extensions, for example:</p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="ts" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">{</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">    'Images'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">: [</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'png'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">, </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'jpg'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">],</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">    'TypeScript'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">: [</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'ts'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">, </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'tsx'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">]</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">}</span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>



<a name="OpenDialogOptions.openLabel"></a><span class="ts" id=532 data-target="#details-532" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">openLabel</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-532">
<div class="comment"><p>A human-readable string for the open button.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="OpenDialogOptions.title"></a><span class="ts" id=540 data-target="#details-540" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">title</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-540">
<div class="comment"><p>Dialog title.</p>
<p>This parameter might be ignored, as not all operating systems display a title on open dialogs
(for example, macOS).</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="Position"></a><span class="code-item" id=52>Position</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Represents a line and character position, such as
the position of the cursor.</p>
<p>Position objects are <strong>immutable</strong>. Use the <a href="#Position.with">with</a> or
<a href="#Position.translate">translate</a> methods to derive new positions
from an existing position.</p>
</div>

</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">character</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A zero-based character value.</p>

<a name="Position.translate"></a><span class="ts" id=78 data-target="#details-78" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">translate</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">lineDelta</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span>, <span class="ident">characterDelta</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a></span>

<tr><td><span class="ident">lineDelta</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Delta value for the line value, default is <code>0</code>.</p>

<tr><td><span class="ident">characterDelta</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Delta value for the character value, default is <code>0</code>.</p>

<a name="ProcessExecution.process"></a><span class="ts" id=2172 data-target="#details-2172" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">process</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2172">
<div class="comment"><p>The process to be executed.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="ProcessExecutionOptions"></a><span class="code-item" id=2157>ProcessExecutionOptions</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Options for a process execution</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="ProcessExecutionOptions.cwd"></a><span class="ts" id=2158 data-target="#details-2158" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">cwd</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2158">
<div class="comment"><p>The current working directory of the executed program or shell.
If omitted the tools current workspace root is used.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="ProcessExecutionOptions.env"></a><span class="ts" id=2159 data-target="#details-2159" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">env</span><span>?</span><span>: </span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2159">
<div class="comment"><p>The additional environment of the executed program or shell. If omitted
the parent process&#39; environment is used. If provided it is merged with
the parent process&#39; environment.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="Progress"></a><span class="code-item" id=1930>Progress&lt;T&gt;</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Defines a generalized way of reporting progress updates.</p>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="Progress.report"></a><span class="ts" id=1933 data-target="#details-1933" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">report</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">value</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1933">
<div class="comment"><p>Report a progress update.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">value</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A progress item, like a message and/or an
report on how much work finished</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="ProgressLocation"></a><span class="code-item" id=3179>ProgressLocation</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A location in the editor at which progress information can be shown. It depends on the
location how progress is visually represented.</p>
</div>

#### Enumeration Members



<a name="ProgressLocation.SourceControl"></a><span class="ts" id=3180 data-target="#details-3180" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">SourceControl</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">1</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3180">
<div class="comment"><p>Show progress for the source control viewlet, as overlay for the icon and as progress bar
inside the viewlet (when visible). Neither supports cancellation nor discrete progress nor
a label to describe the operation.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="ProgressLocation.Window"></a><span class="ts" id=3181 data-target="#details-3181" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Window</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">10</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3181">
<div class="comment"><p>Show progress in the status bar of the editor. Neither supports cancellation nor discrete progress.
Supports rendering of <a href="#ThemeIcon">theme icons</a> via the <code>$(&lt;name&gt;)</code>-syntax in the progress label.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="ProgressLocation.Notification"></a><span class="ts" id=3182 data-target="#details-3182" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Notification</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">15</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3182">
<div class="comment"><p>Show progress as notification with an optional cancel button. Supports to show infinite and discrete
progress but does not support rendering of icons.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="ProgressOptions"></a><span class="code-item" id=3183>ProgressOptions</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Value-object describing where and how progress should show.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="ProgressOptions.cancellable"></a><span class="ts" id=3188 data-target="#details-3188" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">cancellable</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3188">
<div class="comment"><p>Controls if a cancel button should show to allow the user to
cancel the long running operation.  Note that currently only
<code>ProgressLocation.Notification</code> is supporting to show a cancel
button.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="ProgressOptions.location"></a><span class="ts" id=3184 data-target="#details-3184" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">location</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProgressLocation">ProgressLocation</a> &#124; {viewId: <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>}</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3184">
<div class="comment"><p>The location at which progress should show.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="ProgressOptions.title"></a><span class="ts" id=3187 data-target="#details-3187" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">title</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3187">
<div class="comment"><p>A human-readable string which will be used to describe the
operation.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="ProvideLanguageModelChatResponseOptions"></a><span class="code-item" id=5028>ProvideLanguageModelChatResponseOptions</span>



<div class="comment"><p>The provider version of <a href="#LanguageModelChatRequestOptions">LanguageModelChatRequestOptions</a></p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="ProvideLanguageModelChatResponseOptions.modelOptions"></a><span class="ts" id=5029 data-target="#details-5029" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">modelOptions</span><span>?</span><span>: </span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-5029">
<div class="comment"><p>A set of options that control the behavior of the language model. These options are specific to the language model.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="ProvideLanguageModelChatResponseOptions.toolMode"></a><span class="ts" id=5034 data-target="#details-5034" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">toolMode</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#LanguageModelChatToolMode">LanguageModelChatToolMode</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-5034">
<div class="comment"><p>The tool-selecting mode to use. The provider must implement respecting this.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="ProvideLanguageModelChatResponseOptions.tools"></a><span class="ts" id=5033 data-target="#details-5033" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">tools</span><span>?</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#LanguageModelChatTool">LanguageModelChatTool</a>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-5033">
<div class="comment"><p>An optional list of tools that are available to the language model. These could be registered tools available via
<a href="#lm.tools">lm.tools</a>, or private tools that are just implemented within the calling extension.</p>
<p>If the LLM requests to call one of these tools, it will return a <a href="#LanguageModelToolCallPart">LanguageModelToolCallPart</a> in
<a href="#LanguageModelChatResponse.stream">LanguageModelChatResponse.stream</a>. It&#39;s the caller&#39;s responsibility to invoke the tool. If it&#39;s a tool
registered in <a href="#lm.tools">lm.tools</a>, that means calling <a href="#lm.invokeTool">lm.invokeTool</a>.</p>
<p>Then, the tool result can be provided to the LLM by creating an Assistant-type <a href="#LanguageModelChatMessage">LanguageModelChatMessage</a> with a
<a href="#LanguageModelToolCallPart">LanguageModelToolCallPart</a>, followed by a User-type message with a <a href="#LanguageModelToolResultPart">LanguageModelToolResultPart</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="ProviderResult"></a><span class="code-item" id=588>ProviderResult&lt;T&gt;</span>

to that type <code>T</code>. In addition, <code>null</code> and <code>undefined</code> can be returned - either directly or from a
thenable.</p>

### <a name="Pseudoterminal"></a><span class="code-item" id=3065>Pseudoterminal</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Defines the interface of a terminal pty, enabling extensions to control a terminal.</p>
</div>

#### Events



<a name="Pseudoterminal.onDidChangeName"></a><span class="ts" id=3069 data-target="#details-3069" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeName</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>&gt;</span>

<div class="comment"><p>An event that when fired allows changing the name of the terminal.</p>
<p>Events fired before <a href="#Pseudoterminal.open">Pseudoterminal.open</a> is called will be be ignored.</p>

<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">const</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4FC1FF;--shiki-light:#0070C1"> changeNameEmitter</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> = </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">new</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080"> vscode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">EventEmitter</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">&#x3C;</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0;--shiki-light:#267F99">string</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">>();</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">const</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4FC1FF;--shiki-light:#0070C1"> pty</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">: </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0;--shiki-light:#267F99">vscode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0;--shiki-light:#267F99">Pseudoterminal</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> = {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">  onDidWrite:</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080"> writeEmitter</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">event</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">,</span></span>

<a name="Pseudoterminal.onDidClose"></a><span class="ts" id=3068 data-target="#details-3068" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidClose</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">number</span> &#124; <span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3068">
<div class="comment"><p>An event that when fired will signal that the pty is closed and dispose of the terminal.</p>
<p>Events fired before <a href="#Pseudoterminal.open">Pseudoterminal.open</a> is called will be be ignored.</p>
<p>A number can be used to provide an exit code for the terminal. Exit codes must be
positive and a non-zero exit codes signals failure which shows a notification for a
regular terminal and allows dependent tasks to proceed when used with the
<code>CustomExecution</code> API.</p>
<p><strong>Example:</strong> Exit the terminal when &quot;y&quot; is pressed, otherwise show a notification.</p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="typescript" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">const</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4FC1FF;--shiki-light:#0070C1"> writeEmitter</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> = </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">new</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080"> vscode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">EventEmitter</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">&#x3C;</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0;--shiki-light:#267F99">string</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">>();</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">const</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4FC1FF;--shiki-light:#0070C1"> closeEmitter</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> = </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">new</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080"> vscode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">EventEmitter</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">&#x3C;</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0;--shiki-light:#267F99">void</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">>();</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">  open</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">:</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> () </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">=></span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080"> writeEmitter</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">fire</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'Press y to exit successfully'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">),</span></span>
