<a name="Pseudoterminal.onDidOverrideDimensions"></a><span class="ts" id=3067 data-target="#details-3067" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidOverrideDimensions</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#TerminalDimensions">TerminalDimensions</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3067">
<div class="comment"><p>An event that when fired allows overriding the <a href="#Pseudoterminal.setDimensions">dimensions</a> of the
terminal. Note that when set, the overridden dimensions will only take effect when they
are lower than the actual dimensions of the terminal (ie. there will never be a scroll
bar). Set to <code>undefined</code> for the terminal to go back to the regular dimensions (fit to
the size of the panel).</p>
<p>Events fired before <a href="#Pseudoterminal.open">Pseudoterminal.open</a> is called will be be ignored.</p>
<p><strong>Example:</strong> Override the dimensions of a terminal to 20 columns and 10 rows</p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="typescript" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">const</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4FC1FF;--shiki-light:#0070C1"> dimensionsEmitter</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> = </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">new</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080"> vscode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">EventEmitter</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">&#x3C;</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0;--shiki-light:#267F99">vscode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0;--shiki-light:#267F99">TerminalDimensions</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">>();</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">const</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4FC1FF;--shiki-light:#0070C1"> pty</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">: </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0;--shiki-light:#267F99">vscode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0;--shiki-light:#267F99">Pseudoterminal</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> = {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">  onDidWrite:</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080"> writeEmitter</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">event</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">  onDidOverrideDimensions:</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080"> dimensionsEmitter</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">event</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">  open</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">:</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> () </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">=></span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> {</span></span>

<a name="Pseudoterminal.onDidWrite"></a><span class="ts" id=3066 data-target="#details-3066" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidWrite</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3066">
<div class="comment"><p>An event that when fired will write data to the terminal. Unlike
<a href="#Terminal.sendText">Terminal.sendText</a> which sends text to the underlying child
pseudo-device (the child), this will write the text to parent pseudo-device (the
<em>terminal</em> itself).</p>
<p>Note writing <code>\n</code> will just move the cursor down 1 row, you need to write <code>\r</code> as well
to move the cursor to the left-most cell.</p>
<p>Events fired before <a href="#Pseudoterminal.open">Pseudoterminal.open</a> is called will be be ignored.</p>
<p><strong>Example:</strong> Write red text to the terminal</p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="typescript" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">const</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4FC1FF;--shiki-light:#0070C1"> writeEmitter</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> = </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">new</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080"> vscode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">EventEmitter</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">&#x3C;</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0;--shiki-light:#267F99">string</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">>();</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">const</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4FC1FF;--shiki-light:#0070C1"> pty</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">: </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0;--shiki-light:#267F99">vscode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0;--shiki-light:#267F99">Pseudoterminal</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> = {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">  onDidWrite:</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080"> writeEmitter</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">event</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">  open</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">:</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> () </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">=></span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080"> writeEmitter</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">fire</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D7BA7D;--shiki-light:#EE0000">\x1b</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">[31mHello world</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D7BA7D;--shiki-light:#EE0000">\x1b</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">[0m'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">),</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">  close</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">:</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> () </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">=></span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> {}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">};</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">vscode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">window</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">createTerminal</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">({ </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">name:</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515"> 'My terminal'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">, </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">pty</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> });</span></span>
<span class="line"></span></code></pre>
<p><strong>Example:</strong> Move the cursor to the 10th row and 20th column and write an asterisk</p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="typescript" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">writeEmitter</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">fire</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D7BA7D;--shiki-light:#EE0000">\x1b</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">[10;20H*'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span></code></pre>

<a name="Pseudoterminal.setDimensions"></a><span class="ts" id=3079 data-target="#details-3079" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">setDimensions</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">dimensions</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TerminalDimensions">TerminalDimensions</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3079">
<div class="comment"><p>Implement to handle when the number of rows and columns that fit into the terminal panel
changes, for example when font size changes or when the panel is resized. The initial
state of a terminal&#39;s dimensions should be treated as <code>undefined</code> until this is triggered
as the size of a terminal isn&#39;t known until it shows up in the user interface.</p>
<p>When dimensions are overridden by
<a href="#Pseudoterminal.onDidOverrideDimensions">onDidOverrideDimensions</a>, <code>setDimensions</code> will
continue to be called with the regular panel dimensions, allowing the extension continue
to react dimension changes.</p>
</div>

</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="QuickDiffProvider"></a><span class="code-item" id=3961>QuickDiffProvider</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A quick diff provider provides a <a href="#Uri">uri</a> to the original state of a
modified resource. The editor will use this information to render ad&#39;hoc diffs
within the text.</p>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="QuickDiffProvider.provideOriginalResource"></a><span class="ts" id=3963 data-target="#details-3963" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">provideOriginalResource</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">uri</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3963">
<div class="comment"><p>Provide a <a href="#Uri">Uri</a> to the original resource of any given resource uri.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">uri</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The uri of the resource open in a text editor.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A thenable that resolves to uri of the matching original resource.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="QuickInput"></a><span class="code-item" id=3189>QuickInput</span>



<div class="comment"><p>The base interface for all quick input types.</p>
<p>Quick input provides a unified way for extensions to interact with users through simple UI elements.
A quick input UI is initially not visible. After configuring it through its properties the extension
can make it visible by calling <a href="#QuickInput.show">show</a>.</p>
<p>There are several reasons why this UI might have to be hidden and the extension will be notified
through <a href="#QuickInput.onDidHide">onDidHide</a>. Examples include: an explicit call to
<a href="#QuickInput.hide">hide</a>, the user pressing Esc, some other input UI opening, etc.</p>
<p>A user pressing Enter or some other gesture implying acceptance of the current state does not
automatically hide this UI component. It is up to the extension to decide whether to accept the
user&#39;s input and if the UI should indeed be hidden through a call to <a href="#QuickInput.hide">hide</a>.</p>
<p>When the extension no longer needs this input UI, it should <a href="#QuickInput.dispose">dispose</a> it
to allow for freeing up any resources associated with it.</p>
<p>See <a href="#QuickPick">QuickPick</a> and <a href="#InputBox">InputBox</a> for concrete UIs.</p>
</div>

#### Events



<a name="QuickInput.onDidHide"></a><span class="ts" id=3200 data-target="#details-3200" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidHide</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3200">
<div class="comment"><p>An event signaling when this input UI is hidden.</p>
<p>There are several reasons why this UI might have to be hidden and the extension will be notified
through <a href="#QuickInput.onDidHide">onDidHide</a>. Examples include: an explicit call to
<a href="#QuickInput.hide">hide</a>, the user pressing Esc, some other input UI opening, etc.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="QuickInput.busy"></a><span class="ts" id=3194 data-target="#details-3194" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">busy</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3194">
<div class="comment"><p>Determines if the UI should show a progress indicator. Defaults to <code>false</code>.</p>
<p>Change this to <code>true</code>, for example, while loading more data or validating user input.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="QuickInput.enabled"></a><span class="ts" id=3193 data-target="#details-3193" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">enabled</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3193">
<div class="comment"><p>Determines if the UI should allow for user input. Defaults to <code>true</code>.</p>
<p>Change this to <code>false</code>, for example, while validating user input or loading data for the next
step in user input.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="QuickInput.ignoreFocusOut"></a><span class="ts" id=3195 data-target="#details-3195" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">ignoreFocusOut</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3195">
<div class="comment"><p>Determines if the UI should stay open even when losing UI focus. Defaults to <code>false</code>.
This setting is ignored on iPad and is always <code>false</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="QuickInput.step"></a><span class="ts" id=3191 data-target="#details-3191" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">step</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3191">
<div class="comment"><p>An optional current step count for multi-step input flows.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="QuickInput.title"></a><span class="ts" id=3190 data-target="#details-3190" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">title</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3190">
<div class="comment"><p>An optional title for the input UI.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="QuickInput.totalSteps"></a><span class="ts" id=3192 data-target="#details-3192" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">totalSteps</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3192">
<div class="comment"><p>An optional total step count for multi-step input flows.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="QuickInput.dispose"></a><span class="ts" id=3202 data-target="#details-3202" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">dispose</span><span>(</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3202">
<div class="comment"><p>Dispose of this input UI and any associated resources.</p>
<p>If it is still visible, it is first hidden. After this call the input UI is no longer functional
and no additional methods or properties on it should be accessed. Instead a new input UI should
be created.</p>
</div>

<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

<div class="details collapse" id="details-3199">
<div class="comment"><p>Hides this input UI.</p>
<p>This will also fire an <a href="#QuickInput.onDidHide">onDidHide</a> event.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">

</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="QuickInput.show"></a><span class="ts" id=3197 data-target="#details-3197" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">show</span><span>(</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span></span>

### <a name="QuickInputButton"></a><span class="code-item" id=3263>QuickInputButton</span>

#### Properties



<a name="QuickInputButton.iconPath"></a><span class="ts" id=3264 data-target="#details-3264" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">iconPath</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#IconPath">IconPath</a></span>

<a name="QuickInputButton.tooltip"></a><span class="ts" id=3265 data-target="#details-3265" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">tooltip</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>

### <a name="QuickInputButtons"></a><span class="code-item" id=3270>QuickInputButtons</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Predefined buttons for <a href="#QuickPick">QuickPick</a> and <a href="#InputBox">InputBox</a>.</p>
</div>

#### Static



<a name="QuickInputButtons.Back"></a><span class="ts" id=3271 data-target="#details-3271" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Back</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#QuickInputButton">QuickInputButton</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3271">
<div class="comment"><p>A predefined back button for <a href="#QuickPick">QuickPick</a> and <a href="#InputBox">InputBox</a>.</p>
<p>This button should be used for consistency when a navigation back button is needed. It comes
with a predefined icon, tooltip, and location.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="QuickPick"></a><span class="code-item" id=3203>QuickPick&lt;T&gt;</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A concrete <a href="#QuickInput">QuickInput</a> to let the user pick an item from a list of items of type <code>T</code>.</p>
<p>The items can be filtered through a filter text field and there is an option
<a href="#QuickPick.canSelectMany">canSelectMany</a> to allow for selecting multiple items.</p>
<p>Note that in many cases the more convenient <a href="#window.showQuickPick">window.showQuickPick</a> is easier to use.
<a href="#window.createQuickPick">window.createQuickPick</a> should be used when <a href="#window.showQuickPick">window.showQuickPick</a> does not offer
the required flexibility.</p>
</div>

#### Events



<a name="QuickPick.onDidAccept"></a><span class="ts" id=3209 data-target="#details-3209" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidAccept</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3209">
<div class="comment"><p>An event signaling when the user indicated acceptance of the selected item(s).</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="QuickPick.onDidChangeActive"></a><span class="ts" id=3219 data-target="#details-3219" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeActive</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;readonly <span class="type-ref">T</span>[]&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3219">
<div class="comment"><p>An event signaling when the active items have changed.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="QuickPick.onDidChangeSelection"></a><span class="ts" id=3221 data-target="#details-3221" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeSelection</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;readonly <span class="type-ref">T</span>[]&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3221">
<div class="comment"><p>An event signaling when the selected items have changed.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="QuickPick.onDidChangeValue"></a><span class="ts" id=3208 data-target="#details-3208" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeValue</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3208">
<div class="comment"><p>An event signaling when the value of the filter text has changed.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="QuickPick.onDidHide"></a><span class="ts" id=3232 data-target="#details-3232" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidHide</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3232">
<div class="comment"><p>An event signaling when this input UI is hidden.</p>
<p>There are several reasons why this UI might have to be hidden and the extension will be notified
through <a href="#QuickInput.onDidHide">onDidHide</a>. Examples include: an explicit call to
<a href="#QuickInput.hide">hide</a>, the user pressing Esc, some other input UI opening, etc.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="QuickPick.onDidTriggerButton"></a><span class="ts" id=3211 data-target="#details-3211" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidTriggerButton</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#QuickInputButton">QuickInputButton</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3211">
<div class="comment"><p>An event signaling when a button was triggered.</p>
<p>This event fires for buttons stored in the <a href="#QuickPick.buttons">buttons</a> array. This event does
not fire for buttons on a <a href="#QuickPickItem">QuickPickItem</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="QuickPick.onDidTriggerItemButton"></a><span class="ts" id=3212 data-target="#details-3212" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidTriggerItemButton</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#QuickPickItemButtonEvent&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">QuickPickItemButtonEvent</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt;&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3212">
<div class="comment"><p>An event signaling when a button in a particular <a href="#QuickPickItem">QuickPickItem</a> was triggered.</p>
<p>This event does not fire for buttons in the title bar which are part of <a href="#QuickPick.buttons">buttons</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="QuickPick.activeItems"></a><span class="ts" id=3218 data-target="#details-3218" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">activeItems</span><span>: </span>readonly <span class="type-ref">T</span>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3218">
<div class="comment"><p>Active items. This can be read and updated by the extension.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="QuickPick.busy"></a><span class="ts" id=3226 data-target="#details-3226" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">busy</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3226">
<div class="comment"><p>Determines if the UI should show a progress indicator. Defaults to <code>false</code>.</p>
<p>Change this to <code>true</code>, for example, while loading more data or validating user input.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="QuickPick.buttons"></a><span class="ts" id=3210 data-target="#details-3210" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">buttons</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#QuickInputButton">QuickInputButton</a>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3210">
<div class="comment"><p>Buttons for actions in the UI.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="QuickPick.canSelectMany"></a><span class="ts" id=3214 data-target="#details-3214" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">canSelectMany</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3214">
<div class="comment"><p>Determines if multiple items can be selected at the same time. Defaults to <code>false</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="QuickPick.enabled"></a><span class="ts" id=3225 data-target="#details-3225" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">enabled</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3225">
<div class="comment"><p>Determines if the UI should allow for user input. Defaults to <code>true</code>.</p>
<p>Change this to <code>false</code>, for example, while validating user input or loading data for the next
step in user input.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="QuickPick.ignoreFocusOut"></a><span class="ts" id=3227 data-target="#details-3227" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">ignoreFocusOut</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3227">
<div class="comment"><p>Determines if the UI should stay open even when losing UI focus. Defaults to <code>false</code>.
This setting is ignored on iPad and is always <code>false</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="QuickPick.items"></a><span class="ts" id=3213 data-target="#details-3213" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">items</span><span>: </span>readonly <span class="type-ref">T</span>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3213">
<div class="comment"><p>Items to pick from. This can be read and updated by the extension.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="QuickPick.keepScrollPosition"></a><span class="ts" id=3217 data-target="#details-3217" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">keepScrollPosition</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3217">
<div class="comment"><p>Determines if the scroll position is maintained when the quick pick items are updated. Defaults to <code>false</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="QuickPick.matchOnDescription"></a><span class="ts" id=3215 data-target="#details-3215" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">matchOnDescription</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3215">
<div class="comment"><p>Determines if the filter text should also be matched against the <a href="#QuickPickItem.description">description</a> of the items. Defaults to <code>false</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="QuickPick.matchOnDetail"></a><span class="ts" id=3216 data-target="#details-3216" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">matchOnDetail</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3216">
<div class="comment"><p>Determines if the filter text should also be matched against the <a href="#QuickPickItem.detail">detail</a> of the items. Defaults to <code>false</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="QuickPick.placeholder"></a><span class="ts" id=3206 data-target="#details-3206" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">placeholder</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3206">
<div class="comment"><p>Optional placeholder text displayed in the filter text box when no value has been entered.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="QuickPick.prompt"></a><span class="ts" id=3207 data-target="#details-3207" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">prompt</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3207">
<div class="comment"><p>Optional text that provides instructions or context to the user.</p>
<p>The prompt is displayed below the input box and above the list of items.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="QuickPick.selectedItems"></a><span class="ts" id=3220 data-target="#details-3220" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">selectedItems</span><span>: </span>readonly <span class="type-ref">T</span>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3220">
<div class="comment"><p>Selected items. This can be read and updated by the extension.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="QuickPick.step"></a><span class="ts" id=3223 data-target="#details-3223" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">step</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3223">
<div class="comment"><p>An optional current step count for multi-step input flows.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="QuickPick.title"></a><span class="ts" id=3222 data-target="#details-3222" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">title</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3222">
<div class="comment"><p>An optional title for the input UI.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="QuickPick.totalSteps"></a><span class="ts" id=3224 data-target="#details-3224" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">totalSteps</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3224">
<div class="comment"><p>An optional total step count for multi-step input flows.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="QuickPick.value"></a><span class="ts" id=3205 data-target="#details-3205" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">value</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3205">
<div class="comment"><p>The current value of the filter text.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="QuickPick.dispose"></a><span class="ts" id=3234 data-target="#details-3234" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">dispose</span><span>(</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3234">
<div class="comment"><p>Dispose of this input UI and any associated resources.</p>
<p>If it is still visible, it is first hidden. After this call the input UI is no longer functional
and no additional methods or properties on it should be accessed. Instead a new input UI should
be created.</p>
</div>

<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="QuickPick.hide"></a><span class="ts" id=3231 data-target="#details-3231" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">hide</span><span>(</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span></span>

<div class="comment"><p>Hides this input UI.</p>
<p>This will also fire an <a href="#QuickInput.onDidHide">onDidHide</a> event.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">

<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="QuickPick.show"></a><span class="ts" id=3229 data-target="#details-3229" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">show</span><span>(</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3229">
<div class="comment"><p>Makes the input UI visible in its current configuration.</p>
<p>Any other input UI will first fire an <a href="#QuickInput.onDidHide">onDidHide</a> event.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">

<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>

</table>
</div>

### <a name="QuickPickItem"></a><span class="code-item" id=506>QuickPickItem</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Represents an item that can be selected from a list of items.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="QuickPickItem.alwaysShow"></a><span class="ts" id=514 data-target="#details-514" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">alwaysShow</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-514">
<div class="comment"><p>Determines if this item is always shown, even when filtered out by the user&#39;s input.</p>
<p><strong>Note:</strong> This property is ignored when <a href="#QuickPickItem.kind">kind</a> is set to
<a href="#QuickPickItemKind.Separator">QuickPickItemKind.Separator</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="QuickPickItem.buttons"></a><span class="ts" id=515 data-target="#details-515" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">buttons</span><span>?</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#QuickInputButton">QuickInputButton</a>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-515">
<div class="comment"><p>Optional buttons that will be rendered on this particular item.</p>
<p>These buttons will trigger an <a href="#QuickPickItemButtonEvent">QuickPickItemButtonEvent</a> when pressed. Buttons are only rendered
when using a quick pick created by the <a href="#window.createQuickPick">createQuickPick</a> API. Buttons are
not rendered when using the <a href="#window.showQuickPick">showQuickPick</a> API.</p>
<p><strong>Note:</strong> This property is ignored when <a href="#QuickPickItem.kind">kind</a> is set to
<a href="#QuickPickItemKind.Separator">QuickPickItemKind.Separator</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="QuickPickItem.description"></a><span class="ts" id=510 data-target="#details-510" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">description</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-510">
<div class="comment"><p>A human-readable string which is rendered less prominently in the same line.</p>
<p>Supports rendering of <a href="#ThemeIcon">theme icons</a> via the <code>$(&lt;name&gt;)</code>-syntax.</p>
<p><strong>Note:</strong> This property is ignored when <a href="#QuickPickItem.kind">kind</a> is set to
<a href="#QuickPickItemKind.Separator">QuickPickItemKind.Separator</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="QuickPickItem.detail"></a><span class="ts" id=511 data-target="#details-511" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">detail</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-511">
<div class="comment"><p>A human-readable string which is rendered less prominently in a separate line.</p>
<p>Supports rendering of <a href="#ThemeIcon">theme icons</a> via the <code>$(&lt;name&gt;)</code>-syntax.</p>
<p><strong>Note:</strong> This property is ignored when <a href="#QuickPickItem.kind">kind</a> is set to
<a href="#QuickPickItemKind.Separator">QuickPickItemKind.Separator</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="QuickPickItem.iconPath"></a><span class="ts" id=509 data-target="#details-509" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">iconPath</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#IconPath">IconPath</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-509">
<div class="comment"><p>The icon for the item.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="QuickPickItem.kind"></a><span class="ts" id=508 data-target="#details-508" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">kind</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#QuickPickItemKind">QuickPickItemKind</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-508">
<div class="comment"><p>The kind of this item that determines how it is rendered in the quick pick.</p>
<p>When not specified, the default is <a href="#QuickPickItemKind.Default">QuickPickItemKind.Default</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="QuickPickItem.label"></a><span class="ts" id=507 data-target="#details-507" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">label</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-507">
<div class="comment"><p>A human-readable string which is rendered prominently.</p>
<p>Supports rendering of <a href="#ThemeIcon">theme icons</a> via the <code>$(&lt;name&gt;)</code>-syntax.</p>
<p><strong>Note:</strong> When <a href="#QuickPickItem.kind">kind</a> is set to <a href="#QuickPickItemKind.Default">QuickPickItemKind.Default</a> (so a regular
item instead of a separator), it supports rendering of <a href="#ThemeIcon">theme icons</a> via the
<code>$(&lt;name&gt;)</code>-syntax.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="QuickPickItem.picked"></a><span class="ts" id=513 data-target="#details-513" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">picked</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-513">
<div class="comment"><p>Optional flag indicating if this item is initially selected.</p>
<p>This is only honored when using the <a href="#window.showQuickPick">showQuickPick</a> API. To do the same
thing with the <a href="#window.createQuickPick">createQuickPick</a> API, simply set the
<a href="#QuickPick.selectedItems">selectedItems</a> to the items you want selected initially.</p>
<p><strong>Note:</strong> This is only honored when the picker allows multiple selections.</p>
<p><em>See also</em>
<a href="#QuickPickOptions.canPickMany">QuickPickOptions.canPickMany</a></p>
<p><strong>Note:</strong> This property is ignored when <a href="#QuickPickItem.kind">kind</a> is set to
<a href="#QuickPickItemKind.Separator">QuickPickItemKind.Separator</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="QuickPickItem.resourceUri"></a><span class="ts" id=512 data-target="#details-512" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">resourceUri</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-512">
<div class="comment"><p>A <a href="#Uri">Uri</a> representing the resource associated with this item.</p>
<p>When set, this property is used to automatically derive several item properties if they are not explicitly provided:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Label</strong>: Derived from the resource&#39;s file name when <a href="#QuickPickItem.label">label</a> is not provided or is empty.</li>
<li><strong>Description</strong>: Derived from the resource&#39;s path when <a href="#QuickPickItem.description">description</a> is not provided or is empty.</li>
<li><strong>Icon</strong>: Derived from the current file icon theme when <a href="#QuickPickItem.iconPath">iconPath</a> is set to
<a href="#ThemeIcon.File">ThemeIcon.File</a> or <a href="#ThemeIcon.Folder">ThemeIcon.Folder</a>.</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="QuickPickItemButtonEvent"></a><span class="code-item" id=3274>QuickPickItemButtonEvent&lt;T&gt;</span>



<div class="comment"><p>An event describing a button that was pressed on a <a href="#QuickPickItem">QuickPickItem</a>.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="QuickPickItemButtonEvent.button"></a><span class="ts" id=3276 data-target="#details-3276" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">button</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#QuickInputButton">QuickInputButton</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3276">
<div class="comment"><p>The button that was pressed.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="QuickPickItemButtonEvent.item"></a><span class="ts" id=3277 data-target="#details-3277" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">item</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3277">
<div class="comment"><p>The item that the button belongs to.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="QuickPickItemKind"></a><span class="code-item" id=503>QuickPickItemKind</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Defines the kind of <a href="#QuickPickItem">quick pick item</a>.</p>
</div>

#### Enumeration Members



<a name="QuickPickItemKind.Separator"></a><span class="ts" id=504 data-target="#details-504" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Separator</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">-1</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-504">
<div class="comment"><p>A separator item that provides a visual grouping.</p>
<p>When a <a href="#QuickPickItem">QuickPickItem</a> has a kind of <a href="#QuickPickItemKind.Separator">Separator</a>, the item is just a visual separator
and does not represent a selectable item. The only property that applies is
<a href="#QuickPickItem.label">label</a>. All other properties on <a href="#QuickPickItem">QuickPickItem</a> will be ignored
and have no effect.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="QuickPickItemKind.Default"></a><span class="ts" id=505 data-target="#details-505" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Default</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">0</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-505">
<div class="comment"><p>The default kind for an item that can be selected in the quick pick.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="QuickPickOptions"></a><span class="code-item" id=516>QuickPickOptions</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Options to configure the behavior of the quick pick UI.</p>
</div>

#### Events



<a name="QuickPickOptions.onDidSelectItem"></a><span class="ts" id=525 data-target="#details-525" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidSelectItem</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">item</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#QuickPickItem">QuickPickItem</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">any</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-525">
<div class="comment"><p>An optional function that is invoked whenever an item is selected.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">item</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#QuickPickItem">QuickPickItem</a></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-intrinsic">any</span></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="QuickPickOptions.canPickMany"></a><span class="ts" id=523 data-target="#details-523" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">canPickMany</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-523">
<div class="comment"><p>Determines if the picker allows multiple selections. When <code>true</code>, the result is an array of picks.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="QuickPickOptions.ignoreFocusOut"></a><span class="ts" id=522 data-target="#details-522" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">ignoreFocusOut</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-522">
<div class="comment"><p>Set to <code>true</code> to keep the picker open when focus moves to another part of the editor or to another window.
This setting is ignored on iPad and is always <code>false</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="QuickPickOptions.matchOnDescription"></a><span class="ts" id=518 data-target="#details-518" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">matchOnDescription</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-518">
<div class="comment"><p>Determines if the <a href="#QuickPickItem.description">description</a> should be included when filtering items. Defaults to <code>false</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="QuickPickOptions.matchOnDetail"></a><span class="ts" id=519 data-target="#details-519" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">matchOnDetail</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-519">
<div class="comment"><p>Determines if the <a href="#QuickPickItem.detail">detail</a> should be included when filtering items. Defaults to <code>false</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="QuickPickOptions.placeHolder"></a><span class="ts" id=520 data-target="#details-520" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">placeHolder</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-520">
<div class="comment"><p>An optional string to show as placeholder in the input box to guide the user.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="QuickPickOptions.prompt"></a><span class="ts" id=521 data-target="#details-521" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">prompt</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-521">
<div class="comment"><p>Optional text that provides instructions or context to the user.</p>
<p>The prompt is displayed below the input box and above the list of items.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="QuickPickOptions.title"></a><span class="ts" id=517 data-target="#details-517" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">title</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-517">
<div class="comment"><p>An optional title for the quick pick.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="Range"></a><span class="code-item" id=95>Range</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A range represents an ordered pair of two positions.
It is guaranteed that <a href="#Range.start">start</a>.isBeforeOrEqual(<a href="#Range.end">end</a>)</p>
<p>Range objects are <strong>immutable</strong>. Use the <a href="#Range.with">with</a>,
<a href="#Range.intersection">intersection</a>, or <a href="#Range.union">union</a> methods
to derive new ranges from an existing range.</p>
</div>

#### Constructors



<a name="Range.Range"></a><span class="ts" id=97 data-target="#details-97" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Range</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">start</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a>, <span class="ident">end</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-97">
<div class="comment"><p>Create a new range from two positions. If <code>start</code> is not
before or equal to <code>end</code>, the values will be swapped.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">start</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A position.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">end</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A position.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="Range.Range"></a><span class="ts" id=100 data-target="#details-100" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Range</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">startLine</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span>, <span class="ident">startCharacter</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span>, <span class="ident">endLine</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span>, <span class="ident">endCharacter</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-100">
<div class="comment"><p>Create a new range from number coordinates. It is a shorter equivalent of
using <code>new Range(new Position(startLine, startCharacter), new Position(endLine, endCharacter))</code></p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">startLine</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A zero-based line value.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">startCharacter</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A zero-based character value.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">endLine</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A zero-based line value.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">endCharacter</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A zero-based character value.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="Range.end"></a><span class="ts" id=106 data-target="#details-106" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">end</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-106">
<div class="comment"><p>The end position. It is after or equal to <a href="#Range.start">start</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="Range.isEmpty"></a><span class="ts" id=107 data-target="#details-107" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">isEmpty</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-107">
<div class="comment"><p><code>true</code> if <code>start</code> and <code>end</code> are equal.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="Range.isSingleLine"></a><span class="ts" id=108 data-target="#details-108" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">isSingleLine</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-108">
<div class="comment"><p><code>true</code> if <code>start.line</code> and <code>end.line</code> are equal.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="Range.start"></a><span class="ts" id=105 data-target="#details-105" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">start</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-105">
<div class="comment"><p>The start position. It is before or equal to <a href="#Range.end">end</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="Range.contains"></a><span class="ts" id=110 data-target="#details-110" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">contains</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">positionOrRange</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-110">
<div class="comment"><p>Check if a position or a range is contained in this range.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">positionOrRange</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A position or a range.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p><code>true</code> if the position or range is inside or equal
to this range.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="Range.intersection"></a><span class="ts" id=116 data-target="#details-116" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">intersection</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">range</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-116">
<div class="comment"><p>Intersect <code>range</code> with this range and returns a new range or <code>undefined</code>
if the ranges have no overlap.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">range</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A range.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A range of the greater start and smaller end positions. Will
return undefined when there is no overlap.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="Range.isEqual"></a><span class="ts" id=113 data-target="#details-113" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">isEqual</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">other</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>

<div class="comment"><p>Check if <code>other</code> equals this range.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">other</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A range.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p><code>true</code> when start and end are <a href="#Position.isEqual">equal</a> to
start and end of this range.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="Range.union"></a><span class="ts" id=119 data-target="#details-119" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">union</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">other</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-119">
<div class="comment"><p>Compute the union of <code>other</code> with this range.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">other</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A range.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A range of smaller start position and the greater end position.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="Range.with"></a><span class="ts" id=122 data-target="#details-122" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">with</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">start</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a>, <span class="ident">end</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-122">
<div class="comment"><p>Derived a new range from this range.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">start</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A position that should be used as start. The default value is the <a href="#Range.start">current start</a>.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">end</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A position that should be used as end. The default value is the <a href="#Range.end">current end</a>.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A range derived from this range with the given start and end position.
If start and end are not different <code>this</code> range will be returned.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="Range.with"></a><span class="ts" id=125 data-target="#details-125" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">with</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">change</span><span>: </span>{end: <a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a>, start: <a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a>}<span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-125">
<div class="comment"><p>Derived a new range from this range.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">change</span><span>: </span>{end: <a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a>, start: <a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a>}</td><td><div class="comment"><p>An object that describes a change to this range.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A range that reflects the given change. Will return <code>this</code> range if the change

</table>

#### Methods

<tr><td><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The document in which the command was invoked.</p>

<tr><td><span class="ident">position</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The position at which the command was invoked.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">context</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ReferenceContext">ReferenceContext</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Additional information about the references request.</p>
</div></td></tr>

<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>

### <a name="RelativePattern"></a><span class="code-item" id=573>RelativePattern</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A relative pattern is a helper to construct glob patterns that are matched
relatively to a base file path. The base path can either be an absolute file
path as string or uri or a <a href="#WorkspaceFolder">workspace folder</a>, which is the
preferred way of creating the relative pattern.</p>
</div>

#### Constructors



<a name="RelativePattern.RelativePattern"></a><span class="ts" id=575 data-target="#details-575" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">RelativePattern</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">base</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#WorkspaceFolder">WorkspaceFolder</a>, <span class="ident">pattern</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#RelativePattern">RelativePattern</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-575">
<div class="comment"><p>Creates a new relative pattern object with a base file path and pattern to match. This pattern
will be matched on file paths relative to the base.</p>
<p>Example:</p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="ts" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">const</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4FC1FF;--shiki-light:#0070C1"> folder</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> = </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">vscode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">workspace</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">workspaceFolders</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">?.[</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#B5CEA8;--shiki-light:#098658">0</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">];</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#C586C0;--shiki-light:#AF00DB">if</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> (</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">folder</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#6A9955;--shiki-light:#008000">  // Match any TypeScript file in the root of this workspace folder</span></span>

<div class="comment"><p>A base file path to which this pattern will be matched against relatively.</p>

<p><em>Note:</em> updating this value will update <a href="#RelativePattern.baseUri">RelativePattern.baseUri</a> to

</ul>
</div>
</div>



<a name="RelativePattern.baseUri"></a><span class="ts" id=578 data-target="#details-578" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">baseUri</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-578">
<div class="comment"><p>A base file path to which this pattern will be matched against relatively. The
file path must be absolute, should not have any trailing path separators and
not include any relative segments (<code>.</code> or <code>..</code>).</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="RelativePattern.pattern"></a><span class="ts" id=580 data-target="#details-580" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">pattern</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-580">
<div class="comment"><p>A file glob pattern like <code>*.{ts,js}</code> that will be matched on file paths
relative to the base path.</p>
<p>Example: Given a base of <code>/home/work/folder</code> and a file path of <code>/home/work/folder/index.js</code>,
the file glob pattern will match on <code>index.js</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="RenameProvider"></a><span class="code-item" id=1073>RenameProvider</span>



<div class="comment"><p>The rename provider interface defines the contract between extensions and
the <a href="https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/editingevolved#_rename-symbol">rename</a>-feature.</p>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="RenameProvider.prepareRename"></a><span class="ts" id=1081 data-target="#details-1081" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">prepareRename</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a>, <span class="ident">position</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a> &#124; {placeholder: <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, range: <a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a>}&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1081">
<div class="comment"><p>Optional function for resolving and validating a position <em>before</em> running rename. The result can
be a range or a range and a placeholder text. The placeholder text should be the identifier of the symbol
which is being renamed - when omitted the text in the returned range is used.</p>
<p><em>Note:</em> This function should throw an error or return a rejected thenable when the provided location
doesn&#39;t allow for a rename.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The document in which rename will be invoked.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">position</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The position at which rename will be invoked.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a> &#124; {placeholder: <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, range: <a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a>}&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>The range or range and placeholder text of the identifier that is to be renamed. The lack of a result can signaled by returning <code>undefined</code> or <code>null</code>.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="RenameProvider.provideRenameEdits"></a><span class="ts" id=1075 data-target="#details-1075" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">provideRenameEdits</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a>, <span class="ident">position</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a>, <span class="ident">newName</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#WorkspaceEdit">WorkspaceEdit</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1075">
<div class="comment"><p>Provide an edit that describes changes that have to be made to one
or many resources to rename a symbol to a different name.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The document in which the command was invoked.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">position</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The position at which the command was invoked.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">newName</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The new name of the symbol. If the given name is not valid, the provider must return a rejected promise.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#WorkspaceEdit">WorkspaceEdit</a>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A workspace edit or a thenable that resolves to such. The lack of a result can be
signaled by returning <code>undefined</code> or <code>null</code>.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="SecretStorage"></a><span class="code-item" id=2105>SecretStorage</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Represents a storage utility for secrets (or any information that is sensitive)
that will be stored encrypted. The implementation of the secret storage will
be different on each platform and the secrets will not be synced across
machines.</p>

<a name="Selection.isEmpty"></a><span class="ts" id=145 data-target="#details-145" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">isEmpty</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>

<a name="Selection.isReversed"></a><span class="ts" id=142 data-target="#details-142" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">isReversed</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>

<a name="Selection.isSingleLine"></a><span class="ts" id=146 data-target="#details-146" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">isSingleLine</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>

<a name="Selection.intersection"></a><span class="ts" id=154 data-target="#details-154" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">intersection</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">range</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a></span>

<a name="Selection.with"></a><span class="ts" id=160 data-target="#details-160" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">with</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">start</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a>, <span class="ident">end</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a></span>

</div></td></tr>

<a name="Selection.with"></a><span class="ts" id=163 data-target="#details-163" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">with</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">change</span><span>: </span>{end: <a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a>, start: <a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a>}<span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a></span>

</div></td></tr>

</table>
</div>

### <a name="SelectionRange"></a><span class="code-item" id=1456>SelectionRange</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A selection range represents a part of a selection hierarchy. A selection range
may have a parent selection range that contains it.</p>
</div>

</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">parent</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#SelectionRange">SelectionRange</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The parent of the selection range.</p>
</div></td></tr>

</div>
</div>
