### <a name="SelectionRangeProvider"></a><span class="code-item" id=1463>SelectionRangeProvider</span>



<div class="comment"><p>The selection range provider interface defines the contract between extensions and the &quot;Expand and Shrink Selection&quot; feature.</p>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="SelectionRangeProvider.provideSelectionRanges"></a><span class="ts" id=1465 data-target="#details-1465" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">provideSelectionRanges</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a>, <span class="ident">positions</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a>[], <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#SelectionRange">SelectionRange</a>[]&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1465">
<div class="comment"><p>Provide selection ranges for the given positions.</p>
<p>Selection ranges should be computed individually and independent for each position. The editor will merge
and deduplicate ranges but providers must return hierarchies of selection ranges so that a range
is <a href="#Range.contains">contained</a> by its parent.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The document in which the command was invoked.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">positions</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a>[]</td><td><div class="comment"><p>The positions at which the command was invoked.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#SelectionRange">SelectionRange</a>[]&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>Selection ranges or a thenable that resolves to such. The lack of a result can be
signaled by returning <code>undefined</code> or <code>null</code>.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="SemanticTokens"></a><span class="code-item" id=1113>SemanticTokens</span>

<a name="ShellExecution.ShellExecution"></a><span class="ts" id=2203 data-target="#details-2203" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">ShellExecution</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">command</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#ShellQuotedString">ShellQuotedString</a>, <span class="ident">args</span><span>: </span>Array&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#ShellQuotedString">ShellQuotedString</a>&gt;, <span class="ident">options</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ShellExecutionOptions">ShellExecutionOptions</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ShellExecution">ShellExecution</a></span>

</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">options</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ShellExecutionOptions">ShellExecutionOptions</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Optional options for the started the shell.</p>
</div></td></tr>

</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="ShellExecutionOptions"></a><span class="code-item" id=2182>ShellExecutionOptions</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Options for a shell execution</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="ShellExecutionOptions.cwd"></a><span class="ts" id=2186 data-target="#details-2186" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">cwd</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2186">
<div class="comment"><p>The current working directory of the executed shell.
If omitted the tools current workspace root is used.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="ShellExecutionOptions.env"></a><span class="ts" id=2187 data-target="#details-2187" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">env</span><span>?</span><span>: </span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2187">
<div class="comment"><p>The additional environment of the executed shell. If omitted
the parent process&#39; environment is used. If provided it is merged with
the parent process&#39; environment.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="ShellExecutionOptions.executable"></a><span class="ts" id=2183 data-target="#details-2183" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">executable</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2183">
<div class="comment"><p>The shell executable.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="ShellExecutionOptions.shellArgs"></a><span class="ts" id=2184 data-target="#details-2184" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">shellArgs</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2184">
<div class="comment"><p>The arguments to be passed to the shell executable used to run the task. Most shells
require special arguments to execute a command. For  example <code>bash</code> requires the <code>-c</code>
argument to execute a command, <code>PowerShell</code> requires <code>-Command</code> and <code>cmd</code> requires both
<code>/d</code> and <code>/c</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="ShellExecutionOptions.shellQuoting"></a><span class="ts" id=2185 data-target="#details-2185" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">shellQuoting</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ShellQuotingOptions">ShellQuotingOptions</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2185">
<div class="comment"><p>The shell quotes supported by this shell.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="ShellQuotedString"></a><span class="code-item" id=2195>ShellQuotedString</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A string that will be quoted depending on the used shell.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="ShellQuotedString.quoting"></a><span class="ts" id=2197 data-target="#details-2197" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">quoting</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ShellQuoting">ShellQuoting</a></span>

### <a name="ShellQuoting"></a><span class="code-item" id=2191>ShellQuoting</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Defines how an argument should be quoted if it contains
spaces or unsupported characters.</p>
</div>

#### Enumeration Members



<a name="ShellQuoting.Escape"></a><span class="ts" id=2192 data-target="#details-2192" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Escape</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">1</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2192">
<div class="comment"><p>Character escaping should be used. This for example
uses \ on bash and ` on PowerShell.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="ShellQuoting.Strong"></a><span class="ts" id=2193 data-target="#details-2193" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Strong</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">2</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2193">
<div class="comment"><p>Strong string quoting should be used. This for example
uses &quot; for Windows cmd and &#39; for bash and PowerShell.
Strong quoting treats arguments as literal strings.
Under PowerShell echo &#39;The value is $(2 * 3)&#39; will
print <code>The value is $(2 * 3)</code></p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="ShellQuoting.Weak"></a><span class="ts" id=2194 data-target="#details-2194" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Weak</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">3</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2194">
<div class="comment"><p>Weak string quoting should be used. This for example
uses &quot; for Windows cmd, bash and PowerShell. Weak quoting
still performs some kind of evaluation inside the quoted
string.  Under PowerShell echo &quot;The value is $(2 * 3)&quot;
will print <code>The value is 6</code></p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="ShellQuotingOptions"></a><span class="code-item" id=2175>ShellQuotingOptions</span>



<div class="comment"><p>The shell quoting options.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="ShellQuotingOptions.escape"></a><span class="ts" id=2176 data-target="#details-2176" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">escape</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; {charsToEscape: <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, escapeChar: <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>}</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2176">
<div class="comment"><p>The character used to do character escaping. If a string is provided only spaces
are escaped. If a <code>{ escapeChar, charsToEscape }</code> literal is provide all characters
in <code>charsToEscape</code> are escaped using the <code>escapeChar</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="ShellQuotingOptions.strong"></a><span class="ts" id=2180 data-target="#details-2180" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">strong</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2180">
<div class="comment"><p>The character used for strong quoting. The string&#39;s length must be 1.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="ShellQuotingOptions.weak"></a><span class="ts" id=2181 data-target="#details-2181" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">weak</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2181">
<div class="comment"><p>The character used for weak quoting. The string&#39;s length must be 1.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="SignatureHelpContext"></a><span class="code-item" id=1212>SignatureHelpContext</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Additional information about the context in which a
<a href="#SignatureHelpProvider.provideSignatureHelp">SignatureHelpProvider</a> was triggered.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="SignatureHelpContext.activeSignatureHelp"></a><span class="ts" id=1216 data-target="#details-1216" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">activeSignatureHelp</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#SignatureHelp">SignatureHelp</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1216">
<div class="comment"><p>The currently active <a href="#SignatureHelp">SignatureHelp</a>.</p>
<p>The <code>activeSignatureHelp</code> has its <a href="#SignatureHelp.activeSignature">activeSignature</a> field updated based on
the user arrowing through available signatures.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="SignatureHelpContext.isRetrigger"></a><span class="ts" id=1215 data-target="#details-1215" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">isRetrigger</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1215">
<div class="comment"><p><code>true</code> if signature help was already showing when it was triggered.</p>
<p>Retriggers occur when the signature help is already active and can be caused by actions such as
typing a trigger character, a cursor move, or document content changes.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="SignatureHelpContext.triggerCharacter"></a><span class="ts" id=1214 data-target="#details-1214" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">triggerCharacter</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1214">
<div class="comment"><p>Character that caused signature help to be triggered.</p>
<p>This is <code>undefined</code> when signature help is not triggered by typing, such as when manually invoking
signature help or when moving the cursor.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="SignatureHelpContext.triggerKind"></a><span class="ts" id=1213 data-target="#details-1213" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">triggerKind</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#SignatureHelpTriggerKind">SignatureHelpTriggerKind</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1213">
<div class="comment"><p>Action that caused signature help to be triggered.</p>
</div>
</div>

<div class="comment"><p>The signature help provider interface defines the contract between extensions and
the <a href="https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/intellisense">parameter hints</a>-feature.</p>

<div class="comment"><p>Provide help for the signature at the given position and document.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The document in which the command was invoked.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">position</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The position at which the command was invoked.</p>
</div></td></tr>

</div></td></tr>

</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#SignatureHelp">SignatureHelp</a>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>Signature help or a thenable that resolves to such. The lack of a result can be
signaled by returning <code>undefined</code> or <code>null</code>.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="SignatureInformation"></a><span class="code-item" id=1193>SignatureInformation</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Represents the signature of something callable. A signature
can have a label, like a function-name, a doc-comment, and
a set of parameters.</p>

### <a name="SnippetString"></a><span class="code-item" id=1044>SnippetString</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A snippet string is a template which allows to insert text
and to control the editor cursor when insertion happens.</p>
<p>A snippet can define tab stops and placeholders with <code>$1</code>, <code>$2</code>
and <code>${3:foo}</code>. <code>$0</code> defines the final tab stop, it defaults to
the end of the snippet. Variables are defined with <code>$name</code> and
<code>${name:default value}</code>. Also see
<a href="https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/userdefinedsnippets#_create-your-own-snippets">the full snippet syntax</a>.</p>
</div>

#### Constructors

<div class="comment"><p>Create a new snippet string.</p>
</div>

### <a name="SnippetTextEdit"></a><span class="code-item" id=914>SnippetTextEdit</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A snippet edit represents an interactive edit that is performed by
the editor.</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that a snippet edit can always be performed as a normal <a href="#TextEdit">text edit</a>.
This will happen when no matching editor is open or when a <a href="#WorkspaceEdit">workspace edit</a>
contains snippet edits for multiple files. In that case only those that match the active editor
will be performed as snippet edits and the others as normal text edits.</p>
</div>

</div>

</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">snippet</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#SnippetString">SnippetString</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A snippet string.</p>
</div></td></tr>

</div></td></tr>

</div>

### <a name="SourceControl"></a><span class="code-item" id=3988>SourceControl</span>



<div class="comment"><p>An source control is able to provide <a href="#SourceControlResourceState">resource states</a>
to the editor and interact with the editor in several source control related ways.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="SourceControl.acceptInputCommand"></a><span class="ts" id=3996 data-target="#details-3996" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">acceptInputCommand</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Command">Command</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3996">
<div class="comment"><p>Optional accept input command.</p>
<p>This command will be invoked when the user accepts the value
in the Source Control input.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="SourceControl.commitTemplate"></a><span class="ts" id=3995 data-target="#details-3995" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">commitTemplate</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3995">
<div class="comment"><p>Optional commit template string.</p>
<p>The Source Control viewlet will populate the Source Control
input with this value when appropriate.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="SourceControl.count"></a><span class="ts" id=3993 data-target="#details-3993" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">count</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3993">
<div class="comment"><p>The UI-visible count of <a href="#SourceControlResourceState">resource states</a> of
this source control.</p>
<p>If undefined, this source control will</p>
<ul>
<li>display its UI-visible count as zero, and</li>
<li>contribute the count of its <a href="#SourceControlResourceState">resource states</a> to the UI-visible aggregated count for all source controls</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>

<div class="details collapse" id="details-3992">

</div>

<div class="details collapse" id="details-3990">
<div class="comment"><p>The human-readable label of this source control.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="SourceControlResourceGroup"></a><span class="code-item" id=3980>SourceControlResourceGroup</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A source control resource group is a collection of
<a href="#SourceControlResourceState">source control resource states</a>.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="SourceControlResourceGroup.contextValue"></a><span class="ts" id=3984 data-target="#details-3984" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">contextValue</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3984">
<div class="comment"><p>Context value of the resource group. This can be used to contribute resource group specific actions.
For example, if a resource group is given a context value of <code>exportable</code>, when contributing actions to <code>scm/resourceGroup/context</code>
using <code>menus</code> extension point, you can specify context value for key <code>scmResourceGroupState</code> in <code>when</code> expressions, like <code>scmResourceGroupState == exportable</code>.</p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="json" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">"contributes"</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">: {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#0451A5">  "menus"</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">: {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#0451A5">    "scm/resourceGroup/context"</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">: [</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">      {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#0451A5">        "command"</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">: </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">"extension.export"</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#0451A5">        "when"</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">: </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">"scmResourceGroupState == exportable"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">      }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">    ]</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">}</span></span></code></pre>
<p>This will show action <code>extension.export</code> only for resource groups with <code>contextValue</code> equal to <code>exportable</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="SourceControlResourceState"></a><span class="code-item" id=3975>SourceControlResourceState</span>



<div class="comment"><p>An source control resource state represents the state of an underlying workspace
resource within a certain <a href="#SourceControlResourceGroup">source control group</a>.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="SourceControlResourceState.command"></a><span class="ts" id=3977 data-target="#details-3977" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">command</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Command">Command</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3977">
<div class="comment"><p>The <a href="#Command">Command</a> which should be run when the resource
state is open in the Source Control viewlet.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="SourceControlResourceState.contextValue"></a><span class="ts" id=3979 data-target="#details-3979" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">contextValue</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3979">
<div class="comment"><p>Context value of the resource state. This can be used to contribute resource specific actions.
For example, if a resource is given a context value as <code>diffable</code>. When contributing actions to <code>scm/resourceState/context</code>
using <code>menus</code> extension point, you can specify context value for key <code>scmResourceState</code> in <code>when</code> expressions, like <code>scmResourceState == diffable</code>.</p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="json" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">"contributes"</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">: {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#0451A5">  "menus"</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">: {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#0451A5">    "scm/resourceState/context"</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">: [</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">      {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#0451A5">        "command"</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">: </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">"extension.diff"</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#0451A5">        "when"</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">: </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">"scmResourceState == diffable"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">      }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">    ]</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">}</span></span></code></pre>
<p>This will show action <code>extension.diff</code> only for resources with <code>contextValue</code> is <code>diffable</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="StatusBarItem"></a><span class="code-item" id=1913>StatusBarItem</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A status bar item is a status bar contribution that can
show text and icons and run a command on click.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="StatusBarItem.accessibilityInformation"></a><span class="ts" id=1923 data-target="#details-1923" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">accessibilityInformation</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#AccessibilityInformation">AccessibilityInformation</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1923">
<div class="comment"><p>Accessibility information used when a screen reader interacts with this StatusBar item</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="StatusBarItem.alignment"></a><span class="ts" id=1915 data-target="#details-1915" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">alignment</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#StatusBarAlignment">StatusBarAlignment</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1915">
<div class="comment"><p>The alignment of this item.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="StatusBarItem.backgroundColor"></a><span class="ts" id=1921 data-target="#details-1921" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">backgroundColor</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ThemeColor">ThemeColor</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1921">
<div class="comment"><p>The background color for this entry.</p>
<p><em>Note</em>: only the following colors are supported:</p>
<ul>
<li><code>new ThemeColor(&#39;statusBarItem.errorBackground&#39;)</code></li>
<li><code>new ThemeColor(&#39;statusBarItem.warningBackground&#39;)</code></li>
</ul>
<p>More background colors may be supported in the future.</p>
<p><em>Note</em>: when a background color is set, the statusbar may override
the <code>color</code> choice to ensure the entry is readable in all themes.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="StatusBarItem.color"></a><span class="ts" id=1920 data-target="#details-1920" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">color</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#ThemeColor">ThemeColor</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1920">
<div class="comment"><p>The foreground color for this entry.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="StatusBarItem.command"></a><span class="ts" id=1922 data-target="#details-1922" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">command</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#Command">Command</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1922">
<div class="comment"><p><a href="#Command">Command</a> or identifier of a command to run on click.</p>
<p>The command must be <a href="#commands.getCommands">known</a>.</p>
<p>Note that if this is a <a href="#Command">Command</a> object, only the <a href="#Command.command">command</a> and <a href="#Command.arguments">arguments</a>
are used by the editor.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="StatusBarItem.id"></a><span class="ts" id=1914 data-target="#details-1914" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">id</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1914">
<div class="comment"><p>The identifier of this item.</p>
<p><em>Note</em>: if no identifier was provided by the <a href="#window.createStatusBarItem">window.createStatusBarItem</a>
method, the identifier will match the <a href="#Extension.id">extension identifier</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="StatusBarItem.name"></a><span class="ts" id=1917 data-target="#details-1917" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">name</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1917">
<div class="comment"><p>The name of the entry, like &#39;Python Language Indicator&#39;, &#39;Git Status&#39; etc.
Try to keep the length of the name short, yet descriptive enough that
users can understand what the status bar item is about.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="StatusBarItem.priority"></a><span class="ts" id=1916 data-target="#details-1916" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">priority</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1916">
<div class="comment"><p>The priority of this item. Higher value means the item should
be shown more to the left.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="StatusBarItem.text"></a><span class="ts" id=1918 data-target="#details-1918" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">text</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1918">
<div class="comment"><p>The text to show for the entry. You can embed icons in the text by leveraging the syntax:</p>
<p><code>My text $(icon-name) contains icons like $(icon-name) this one.</code></p>
<p>Where the icon-name is taken from the ThemeIcon <a href="https://code.visualstudio.com/api/references/icons-in-labels#icon-listing">icon set</a>, e.g.
<code>light-bulb</code>, <code>thumbsup</code>, <code>zap</code> etc.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="StatusBarItem.tooltip"></a><span class="ts" id=1919 data-target="#details-1919" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">tooltip</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#MarkdownString">MarkdownString</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1919">
<div class="comment"><p>The tooltip text when you hover over this entry.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Methods

### <a name="Tab"></a><span class="code-item" id=4706>Tab</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Represents a tab within a <a href="#TabGroup">group of tabs</a>.
Tabs are merely the graphical representation within the editor area.
A backing editor is not a guarantee.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="Tab.group"></a><span class="ts" id=4708 data-target="#details-4708" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">group</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TabGroup">TabGroup</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4708">
<div class="comment"><p>The group which the tab belongs to.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="Tab.input"></a><span class="ts" id=4709 data-target="#details-4709" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">input</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">unknown</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4709">
<div class="comment"><p>Defines the structure of the tab i.e. text, notebook, custom, etc.
Resource and other useful properties are defined on the tab kind.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="Tab.isActive"></a><span class="ts" id=4710 data-target="#details-4710" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">isActive</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4710">
<div class="comment"><p>Whether or not the tab is currently active.
This is dictated by being the selected tab in the group.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="Tab.isDirty"></a><span class="ts" id=4711 data-target="#details-4711" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">isDirty</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4711">
<div class="comment"><p>Whether or not the dirty indicator is present on the tab.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="Tab.isPinned"></a><span class="ts" id=4712 data-target="#details-4712" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">isPinned</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4712">
<div class="comment"><p>Whether or not the tab is pinned (pin icon is present).</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="Tab.isPreview"></a><span class="ts" id=4713 data-target="#details-4713" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">isPreview</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4713">
<div class="comment"><p>Whether or not the tab is in preview mode.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="TabGroup"></a><span class="code-item" id=4722>TabGroup</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Represents a group of tabs. A tab group itself consists of multiple tabs.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="TabGroup.activeTab"></a><span class="ts" id=4725 data-target="#details-4725" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">activeTab</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Tab">Tab</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4725">
<div class="comment"><p>The active <a href="#Tab">tab</a> in the group. This is the tab whose contents are currently
being rendered.</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that there can be one active tab per group but there can only be one <a href="#TabGroups.activeTabGroup">active group</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TabGroup.isActive"></a><span class="ts" id=4723 data-target="#details-4723" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">isActive</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4723">
<div class="comment"><p>Whether or not the group is currently active.</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that only one tab group is active at a time, but that multiple tab
groups can have an <a href="#TabGroup.activeTab">active tab</a>.</p>
<p><em>See also</em>
<a href="#Tab.isActive">Tab.isActive</a></p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TabGroup.tabs"></a><span class="ts" id=4726 data-target="#details-4726" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">tabs</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#Tab">Tab</a>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4726">
<div class="comment"><p>The list of tabs contained within the group.
This can be empty if the group has no tabs open.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TabGroup.viewColumn"></a><span class="ts" id=4724 data-target="#details-4724" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">viewColumn</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ViewColumn">ViewColumn</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4724">
<div class="comment"><p>The view column of the group.</p>
</div>
</div>

<a name="TabGroups.onDidChangeTabGroups"></a><span class="ts" id=4730 data-target="#details-4730" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeTabGroups</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#TabGroupChangeEvent">TabGroupChangeEvent</a>&gt;</span>

<a name="TabGroups.close"></a><span class="ts" id=4733 data-target="#details-4733" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">close</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">tab</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Tab">Tab</a> &#124; readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#Tab">Tab</a>[], <span class="ident">preserveFocus</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4733">
<div class="comment"><p>Closes the tab. This makes the tab object invalid and the tab
should no longer be used for further actions.
Note: In the case of a dirty tab, a confirmation dialog will be shown which may be cancelled. If cancelled the tab is still valid</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">tab</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Tab">Tab</a> &#124; readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#Tab">Tab</a>[]</td><td><div class="comment"><p>The tab to close.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">preserveFocus</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>When <code>true</code> focus will remain in its current position. If <code>false</code> it will jump to the next tab.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A promise that resolves to <code>true</code> when all tabs have been closed.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

<tr><td><span class="ident">source</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The task&#39;s source (e.g. &#39;gulp&#39;, &#39;npm&#39;, ...). Is presented in the user interface.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">execution</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProcessExecution">ProcessExecution</a> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#ShellExecution">ShellExecution</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The process or shell execution.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">problemMatchers</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>[]</td><td><div class="comment"><p>the names of problem matchers to use, like &#39;$tsc&#39;
 or &#39;$eslint&#39;. Problem matchers can be contributed by an extension using
 the <code>problemMatchers</code> extension point.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#Task">Task</a></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="TaskDefinition"></a><span class="code-item" id=2153>TaskDefinition</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A structure that defines a task kind in the system.
The value must be JSON-stringifyable.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="TaskDefinition.type"></a><span class="ts" id=2154 data-target="#details-2154" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">type</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2154">
<div class="comment"><p>The task definition describing the task provided by an extension.
Usually a task provider defines more properties to identify
a task. They need to be defined in the package.json of the
extension under the &#39;taskDefinitions&#39; extension point. The npm
task definition for example looks like this</p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="typescript" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">interface</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0;--shiki-light:#267F99"> NpmTaskDefinition</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF"> extends</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0;--shiki-light:#267F99"> TaskDefinition</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">  script</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">: </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0;--shiki-light:#267F99">string</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span></code></pre>
<p>Note that type identifier starting with a &#39;$&#39; are reserved for internal
usages and shouldn&#39;t be used by extensions.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="TaskEndEvent"></a><span class="code-item" id=2264>TaskEndEvent</span>

<a name="TaskPresentationOptions.clear"></a><span class="ts" id=2140 data-target="#details-2140" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">clear</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>

</div>
</div>



<a name="TaskPresentationOptions.echo"></a><span class="ts" id=2136 data-target="#details-2136" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">echo</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>

</div>
</div>



<a name="TaskPresentationOptions.focus"></a><span class="ts" id=2137 data-target="#details-2137" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">focus</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>

</div>



<a name="TaskPresentationOptions.panel"></a><span class="ts" id=2138 data-target="#details-2138" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">panel</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TaskPanelKind">TaskPanelKind</a></span>

<a name="TaskPresentationOptions.reveal"></a><span class="ts" id=2135 data-target="#details-2135" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">reveal</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TaskRevealKind">TaskRevealKind</a></span>

<a name="TaskPresentationOptions.showReuseMessage"></a><span class="ts" id=2139 data-target="#details-2139" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">showReuseMessage</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>

<a name="TaskProcessEndEvent.execution"></a><span class="ts" id=2270 data-target="#details-2270" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">execution</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TaskExecution">TaskExecution</a></span>

### <a name="TaskProvider"></a><span class="code-item" id=2249>TaskProvider&lt;T&gt;</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A task provider allows to add tasks to the task service.
A task provider is registered via <a href="#tasks.registerTaskProvider">tasks.registerTaskProvider</a>.</p>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="TaskProvider.provideTasks"></a><span class="ts" id=2252 data-target="#details-2252" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">provideTasks</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>[]&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2252">
<div class="comment"><p>Provides tasks.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>[]&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>an array of tasks</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TaskProvider.resolveTask"></a><span class="ts" id=2255 data-target="#details-2255" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">resolveTask</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">task</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2255">
<div class="comment"><p>Resolves a task that has no <a href="#Task.execution">execution</a> set. Tasks are
often created from information found in the <code>tasks.json</code>-file. Such tasks miss
the information on how to execute them and a task provider must fill in
the missing information in the <code>resolveTask</code>-method. This method will not be
called for tasks returned from the above <code>provideTasks</code> method since those
tasks are always fully resolved. A valid default implementation for the
<code>resolveTask</code> method is to return <code>undefined</code>.</p>
<p>Note that when filling in the properties of <code>task</code>, you <em>must</em> be sure to
use the exact same <code>TaskDefinition</code> and not create a new one. Other properties
may be changed.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>

### <a name="TaskRevealKind"></a><span class="code-item" id=2126>TaskRevealKind</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Controls the behaviour of the terminal&#39;s visibility.</p>
</div>

#### Enumeration Members



<a name="TaskRevealKind.Always"></a><span class="ts" id=2127 data-target="#details-2127" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Always</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">1</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2127">
<div class="comment"><p>Always brings the terminal to front if the task is executed.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TaskRevealKind.Silent"></a><span class="ts" id=2128 data-target="#details-2128" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Silent</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">2</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2128">
<div class="comment"><p>Only brings the terminal to front if a problem is detected executing the task
(e.g. the task couldn&#39;t be started because).</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TaskRevealKind.Never"></a><span class="ts" id=2129 data-target="#details-2129" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Never</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">3</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2129">
<div class="comment"><p>The terminal never comes to front when the task is executed.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="TelemetryLogger"></a><span class="code-item" id=4746>TelemetryLogger</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A telemetry logger which can be used by extensions to log usage and error telemetry.</p>
<p>A logger wraps around an <a href="#TelemetrySender">sender</a> but it guarantees that</p>
<ul>
<li>user settings to disable or tweak telemetry are respected, and that</li>
<li>potential sensitive data is removed</li>
</ul>
<p>It also enables an &quot;echo UI&quot; that prints whatever data is send and it allows the editor
to forward unhandled errors to the respective extensions.</p>
<p>To get an instance of a <code>TelemetryLogger</code>, use
<a href="#env.createTelemetryLogger"><code>createTelemetryLogger</code></a>.</p>
</div>

#### Events



<a name="TelemetryLogger.onDidChangeEnableStates"></a><span class="ts" id=4747 data-target="#details-4747" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeEnableStates</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#TelemetryLogger">TelemetryLogger</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4747">
<div class="comment"><p>An <a href="#Event">Event</a> which fires when the enablement state of usage or error telemetry changes.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="TelemetryLogger.isErrorsEnabled"></a><span class="ts" id=4749 data-target="#details-4749" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">isErrorsEnabled</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4749">
<div class="comment"><p>Whether or not error telemetry is enabled for this logger.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TelemetryLogger.isUsageEnabled"></a><span class="ts" id=4748 data-target="#details-4748" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">isUsageEnabled</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4748">
<div class="comment"><p>Whether or not usage telemetry is enabled for this logger.</p>
</div>
</div>

<a name="TelemetryLogger.logError"></a><span class="ts" id=4755 data-target="#details-4755" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">logError</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">eventName</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">data</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref-ts">Record</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="type-intrinsic">any</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#TelemetryTrustedValue&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">TelemetryTrustedValue</a>&gt;<span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span></span>

</div></td></tr>

### <a name="TelemetrySender"></a><span class="code-item" id=4763>TelemetrySender</span>



<div class="comment"><p>The telemetry sender is the contract between a telemetry logger and some telemetry service. <strong>Note</strong> that extensions must NOT
call the methods of their sender directly as the logger provides extra guards and cleaning.</p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="js" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">const</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4FC1FF;--shiki-light:#0070C1"> sender</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">: </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0;--shiki-light:#267F99">vscode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4EC9B0;--shiki-light:#267F99">TelemetrySender</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> = {...};</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">const</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4FC1FF;--shiki-light:#0070C1"> logger</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> = </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">vscode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">env</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">createTelemetryLogger</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">sender</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#6A9955;--shiki-light:#008000">// GOOD - uses the logger</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">logger</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">logUsage</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'myEvent'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">, { </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">myData:</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515"> 'myValue'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> });</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#6A9955;--shiki-light:#008000">// BAD - uses the sender directly: no data cleansing, ignores user settings, no echoing to the telemetry output channel etc</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">sender</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">logEvent</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'myEvent'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">, { </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">myData:</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515"> 'myValue'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> });</span></span></code></pre>
</div>

### <a name="TelemetryTrustedValue"></a><span class="code-item" id=4739>TelemetryTrustedValue&lt;T&gt;</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A special value wrapper denoting a value that is safe to not clean.
This is to be used when you can guarantee no identifiable information is contained in the value and the cleaning is improperly redacting it.</p>
</div>

</div>

<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">value</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A value to trust</p>
</div></td></tr>

<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#TelemetryTrustedValue&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">TelemetryTrustedValue</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

<a name="Terminal.shellIntegration"></a><span class="ts" id=1941 data-target="#details-1941" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">shellIntegration</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TerminalShellIntegration">TerminalShellIntegration</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1941">
<div class="comment"><p>An object that contains <a href="https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/terminal/shell-integration">shell integration</a>-powered
features for the terminal. This will always be <code>undefined</code> immediately after the terminal
is created. Listen to <a href="#window.onDidChangeTerminalShellIntegration">window.onDidChangeTerminalShellIntegration</a> to be notified
when shell integration is activated for a terminal.</p>
<p>Note that this object may remain undefined if shell integration never activates. For
example Command Prompt does not support shell integration and a user&#39;s shell setup could
conflict with the automatic shell integration activation.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="TerminalEditorLocationOptions"></a><span class="code-item" id=1956>TerminalEditorLocationOptions</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Assumes a <a href="#TerminalLocation">TerminalLocation</a> of editor and allows specifying a <a href="#ViewColumn">ViewColumn</a> and
<a href="#TerminalEditorLocationOptions.preserveFocus">preserveFocus </a> property</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="TerminalEditorLocationOptions.preserveFocus"></a><span class="ts" id=1958 data-target="#details-1958" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">preserveFocus</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>

<a name="TerminalEditorLocationOptions.viewColumn"></a><span class="ts" id=1957 data-target="#details-1957" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">viewColumn</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ViewColumn">ViewColumn</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1957">
<div class="comment"><p>A view column in which the <a href="#Terminal">terminal</a> should be shown in the editor area.
The default is the <a href="#ViewColumn.Active">active</a>. Columns that do not exist
will be created as needed up to the maximum of <a href="#ViewColumn.Nine">ViewColumn.Nine</a>.
Use <a href="#ViewColumn.Beside">ViewColumn.Beside</a> to open the editor to the side of the currently
active one.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="TerminalExitStatus"></a><span class="code-item" id=3084>TerminalExitStatus</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Represents how a terminal exited.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="TerminalExitStatus.code"></a><span class="ts" id=3085 data-target="#details-3085" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">code</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3085">
<div class="comment"><p>The exit code that a terminal exited with, it can have the following values:</p>
<ul>
<li>Zero: the terminal process or custom execution succeeded.</li>
<li>Non-zero: the terminal process or custom execution failed.</li>
<li><code>undefined</code>: the user forcibly closed the terminal or a custom execution exited
without providing an exit code.</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>

</div>
</div>

<a name="TerminalLinkProvider.provideTerminalLinks"></a><span class="ts" id=2003 data-target="#details-2003" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">provideTerminalLinks</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">context</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TerminalLinkContext">TerminalLinkContext</a>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>[]&gt;</span>

</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>[]&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A list of terminal links for the given line.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

<div class="comment"><p>The location of the terminal.</p>
</div>

### <a name="TerminalOptions"></a><span class="code-item" id=3040>TerminalOptions</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Value-object describing what options a terminal should use.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="TerminalOptions.color"></a><span class="ts" id=3053 data-target="#details-3053" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">color</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ThemeColor">ThemeColor</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3053">
<div class="comment"><p>The icon <a href="#ThemeColor">ThemeColor</a> for the terminal.
The <code>terminal.ansi*</code> theme keys are
recommended for the best contrast and consistency across themes.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TerminalOptions.cwd"></a><span class="ts" id=3044 data-target="#details-3044" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">cwd</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3044">
<div class="comment"><p>A path or Uri for the current working directory to be used for the terminal.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TerminalOptions.env"></a><span class="ts" id=3045 data-target="#details-3045" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">env</span><span>?</span><span>: </span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3045">
<div class="comment"><p>Object with environment variables that will be added to the editor process.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TerminalOptions.hideFromUser"></a><span class="ts" id=3050 data-target="#details-3050" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">hideFromUser</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3050">
<div class="comment"><p>When enabled the terminal will run the process as normal but not be surfaced to the user
until <code>Terminal.show</code> is called. The typical usage for this is when you need to run
something that may need interactivity but only want to tell the user about it when
interaction is needed. Note that the terminals will still be exposed to all extensions
as normal. The hidden terminals will not be restored when the workspace is next opened.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TerminalOptions.iconPath"></a><span class="ts" id=3052 data-target="#details-3052" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">iconPath</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#IconPath">IconPath</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3052">
<div class="comment"><p>The icon path or <a href="#ThemeIcon">ThemeIcon</a> for the terminal.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TerminalOptions.isTransient"></a><span class="ts" id=3055 data-target="#details-3055" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">isTransient</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3055">
<div class="comment"><p>Opt-out of the default terminal persistence on restart and reload.
This will only take effect when <code>terminal.integrated.enablePersistentSessions</code> is enabled.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TerminalOptions.location"></a><span class="ts" id=3054 data-target="#details-3054" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">location</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TerminalEditorLocationOptions">TerminalEditorLocationOptions</a> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#TerminalSplitLocationOptions">TerminalSplitLocationOptions</a> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#TerminalLocation">TerminalLocation</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3054">
<div class="comment"><p>The <a href="#TerminalLocation">TerminalLocation</a> or <a href="#TerminalEditorLocationOptions">TerminalEditorLocationOptions</a> or <a href="#TerminalSplitLocationOptions">TerminalSplitLocationOptions</a> for the terminal.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TerminalOptions.message"></a><span class="ts" id=3051 data-target="#details-3051" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">message</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3051">
<div class="comment"><p>A message to write to the terminal on first launch, note that this is not sent to the
process but, rather written directly to the terminal. This supports escape sequences such
a setting text style.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TerminalOptions.name"></a><span class="ts" id=3041 data-target="#details-3041" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">name</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3041">
<div class="comment"><p>A human-readable string which will be used to represent the terminal in the UI.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TerminalOptions.shellArgs"></a><span class="ts" id=3043 data-target="#details-3043" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">shellArgs</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3043">
<div class="comment"><p>Args for the custom shell executable. A string can be used on Windows only which allows
specifying shell args in <a href="https://msdn.microsoft.com/en-au/08dfcab2-eb6e-49a4-80eb-87d4076c98c6">command-line format</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TerminalOptions.shellIntegrationNonce"></a><span class="ts" id=3056 data-target="#details-3056" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">shellIntegrationNonce</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3056">
<div class="comment"><p>The nonce to use to verify shell integration sequences are coming from a trusted source.
An example impact of UX of this is if the command line is reported with a nonce, it will
not need to verify with the user that the command line is correct before rerunning it
via the <a href="https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/terminal/shell-integration#_command-decorations-and-the-overview-ruler">shell integration command decoration</a>.</p>
<p>This should be used if the terminal includes <a href="https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/terminal/shell-integration#_supported-escape-sequences">custom shell integration support</a>.
It should be set to a random GUID which will then set the <code>VSCODE_NONCE</code> environment
variable. Inside the shell, this should then be removed from the environment so as to
protect it from general access. Once that is done it can be passed through in the
relevant sequences to make them trusted.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TerminalOptions.shellPath"></a><span class="ts" id=3042 data-target="#details-3042" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">shellPath</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3042">
<div class="comment"><p>A path to a custom shell executable to be used in the terminal.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TerminalOptions.strictEnv"></a><span class="ts" id=3049 data-target="#details-3049" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">strictEnv</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3049">
<div class="comment"><p>Whether the terminal process environment should be exactly as provided in
<code>TerminalOptions.env</code>. When this is false (default), the environment will be based on the
window&#39;s environment and also apply configured platform settings like
<code>terminal.integrated.env.windows</code> on top. When this is true, the complete environment
must be provided as nothing will be inherited from the process or any configuration.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="TerminalShellExecution"></a><span class="code-item" id=1972>TerminalShellExecution</span>

<a name="TerminalShellExecution.commandLine"></a><span class="ts" id=1973 data-target="#details-1973" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">commandLine</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TerminalShellExecutionCommandLine">TerminalShellExecutionCommandLine</a></span>

<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">}</span></span></code></pre>

<a name="TerminalShellExecution.cwd"></a><span class="ts" id=1974 data-target="#details-1974" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">cwd</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1974">
<div class="comment"><p>The working directory that was reported by the shell when this command executed. This
<a href="#Uri">Uri</a> may represent a file on another machine (eg. ssh into another machine). This
requires the shell integration to support working directory reporting.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="TerminalShellExecution.read"></a><span class="ts" id=1976 data-target="#details-1976" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">read</span><span>(</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref-ts">AsyncIterable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1976">
<div class="comment"><p>Creates a stream of raw data (including escape sequences) that is written to the
terminal. This will only include data that was written after <code>read</code> was called for
the first time, ie. you must call <code>read</code> immediately after the command is executed via
<a href="#TerminalShellIntegration.executeCommand">TerminalShellIntegration.executeCommand</a> or
<a href="#window.onDidStartTerminalShellExecution">window.onDidStartTerminalShellExecution</a> to not miss any data.</p>
<p><strong>Example</strong></p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="ts" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#6A9955;--shiki-light:#008000">// Log all data written to the terminal for a command</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">const</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4FC1FF;--shiki-light:#0070C1"> command</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> = </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">term</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">shellIntegration</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">executeCommand</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">({ </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">commandLine:</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515"> 'echo "Hello world"'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">const</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4FC1FF;--shiki-light:#0070C1"> stream</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> = </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">command</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">read</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">();</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#C586C0;--shiki-light:#AF00DB">for</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#C586C0;--shiki-light:#AF00DB"> await</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> (</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">const</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4FC1FF;--shiki-light:#0070C1"> data</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF"> of</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080"> stream</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">  console</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">log</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">data</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">}</span></span>
