### <a name="TerminalShellExecutionCommandLine"></a><span class="code-item" id=1977>TerminalShellExecutionCommandLine</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A command line that was executed in a terminal.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="TerminalShellExecutionCommandLine.confidence"></a><span class="ts" id=1980 data-target="#details-1980" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">confidence</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TerminalShellExecutionCommandLineConfidence">TerminalShellExecutionCommandLineConfidence</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1980">
<div class="comment"><p>The confidence of the command line value which is determined by how the value was
obtained. This depends upon the implementation of the shell integration script.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TerminalShellExecutionCommandLine.isTrusted"></a><span class="ts" id=1979 data-target="#details-1979" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">isTrusted</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1979">
<div class="comment"><p>Whether the command line value came from a trusted source and is therefore safe to
execute without user additional confirmation, such as a notification that asks &quot;Do you
want to execute (command)?&quot;. This verification is likely only needed if you are going to
execute the command again.</p>
<p>This is <code>true</code> only when the command line was reported explicitly by the shell
integration script (ie. <a href="#TerminalShellExecutionCommandLineConfidence.High">high confidence</a>)
and it used a nonce for verification.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TerminalShellExecutionCommandLine.value"></a><span class="ts" id=1978 data-target="#details-1978" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">value</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1978">
<div class="comment"><p>The full command line that was executed, including both the command and its arguments.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="TerminalShellExecutionCommandLineConfidence"></a><span class="code-item" id=1981>TerminalShellExecutionCommandLineConfidence</span>



<div class="comment"><p>The confidence of a <a href="#TerminalShellExecutionCommandLine">TerminalShellExecutionCommandLine</a> value.</p>
</div>

#### Enumeration Members



<a name="TerminalShellExecutionCommandLineConfidence.Low"></a><span class="ts" id=1982 data-target="#details-1982" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Low</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">0</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1982">
<div class="comment"><p>The command line value confidence is low. This means that the value was read from the
terminal buffer using markers reported by the shell integration script. Additionally one
of the following conditions will be met:</p>
<ul>
<li>The command started on the very left-most column which is unusual, or</li>
<li>The command is multi-line which is more difficult to accurately detect due to line
continuation characters and right prompts.</li>
<li>Command line markers were not reported by the shell integration script.</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TerminalShellExecutionCommandLineConfidence.Medium"></a><span class="ts" id=1983 data-target="#details-1983" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Medium</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">1</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1983">
<div class="comment"><p>The command line value confidence is medium. This means that the value was read from the
terminal buffer using markers reported by the shell integration script. The command is
single-line and does not start on the very left-most column (which is unusual).</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TerminalShellExecutionCommandLineConfidence.High"></a><span class="ts" id=1984 data-target="#details-1984" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">High</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">2</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1984">
<div class="comment"><p>The command line value confidence is high. This means that the value was explicitly sent
from the shell integration script or the command was executed via the
<a href="#TerminalShellIntegration.executeCommand">TerminalShellIntegration.executeCommand</a> API.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="TerminalShellExecutionEndEvent"></a><span class="code-item" id=1992>TerminalShellExecutionEndEvent</span>



<div class="comment"><p>An event signalling that an execution has ended in a terminal.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="TerminalShellExecutionEndEvent.execution"></a><span class="ts" id=1995 data-target="#details-1995" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">execution</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TerminalShellExecution">TerminalShellExecution</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1995">
<div class="comment"><p>The terminal shell execution that has ended.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TerminalShellExecutionEndEvent.exitCode"></a><span class="ts" id=1996 data-target="#details-1996" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">exitCode</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1996">
<div class="comment"><p>The exit code reported by the shell.</p>
<p>When this is <code>undefined</code> it can mean several things:</p>
<ul>
<li>The shell either did not report an exit  code (ie. the shell integration script is
misbehaving)</li>
<li>The shell reported a command started before the command finished (eg. a sub-shell was
opened).</li>
<li>The user canceled the command via ctrl+c.</li>
<li>The user pressed enter when there was no input.</li>
</ul>
<p>Generally this should not happen. Depending on the use case, it may be best to treat this
as a failure.</p>
<p><strong>Example</strong></p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="ts" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">const</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4FC1FF;--shiki-light:#0070C1"> execution</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> = </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">shellIntegration</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">executeCommand</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">({</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">  command:</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515"> 'echo'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">  args:</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> [</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'Hello world'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">]</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">});</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">window</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">onDidEndTerminalShellExecution</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">event</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF"> =></span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#C586C0;--shiki-light:#AF00DB">  if</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> (</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">event</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">execution</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> === </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">execution</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#C586C0;--shiki-light:#AF00DB">    if</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> (</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">event</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">exitCode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> === </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">undefined</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">      console</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">log</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'Command finished but exit code is unknown'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">    } </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#C586C0;--shiki-light:#AF00DB">else</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#C586C0;--shiki-light:#AF00DB"> if</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> (</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">event</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">exitCode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> === </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#B5CEA8;--shiki-light:#098658">0</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">) {</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">    } </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#C586C0;--shiki-light:#AF00DB">else</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">      console</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">log</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'Command failed'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">});</span></span>

### <a name="TerminalShellIntegration"></a><span class="code-item" id=1964>TerminalShellIntegration</span>



<div class="comment"><p><a href="https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/terminal/shell-integration">Shell integration</a>-powered capabilities owned by a terminal.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="TerminalShellIntegration.cwd"></a><span class="ts" id=1965 data-target="#details-1965" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">cwd</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1965">
<div class="comment"><p>The current working directory of the terminal. This <a href="#Uri">Uri</a> may represent a file on
another machine (eg. ssh into another machine). This requires the shell integration to
support working directory reporting.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="TerminalShellIntegration.executeCommand"></a><span class="ts" id=1967 data-target="#details-1967" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">executeCommand</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">commandLine</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TerminalShellExecution">TerminalShellExecution</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1967">
<div class="comment"><p>Execute a command, sending ^C as necessary to interrupt any running command if needed.</p>
<ul>
<li><em>throws</em> - When run on a terminal doesn&#39;t support this API, such as task terminals.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Example</strong></p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="ts" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#6A9955;--shiki-light:#008000">// Execute a command in a terminal immediately after being created</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">const</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4FC1FF;--shiki-light:#0070C1"> myTerm</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> = </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">window</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">createTerminal</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">();</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">window</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">onDidChangeTerminalShellIntegration</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">async</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> ({ </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">terminal</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">, </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">shellIntegration</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> }) </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">=></span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#C586C0;--shiki-light:#AF00DB">  if</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> (</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">terminal</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> === </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">myTerm</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">) {</span></span>

### <a name="TerminalSplitLocationOptions"></a><span class="code-item" id=1959>TerminalSplitLocationOptions</span>

</div>

#### Properties



<a name="TerminalSplitLocationOptions.parentTerminal"></a><span class="ts" id=1960 data-target="#details-1960" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">parentTerminal</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Terminal">Terminal</a></span>

### <a name="TerminalState"></a><span class="code-item" id=1961>TerminalState</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Represents the state of a <a href="#Terminal">Terminal</a>.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="TerminalState.isInteractedWith"></a><span class="ts" id=1962 data-target="#details-1962" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">isInteractedWith</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1962">
<div class="comment"><p>Whether the <a href="#Terminal">Terminal</a> has been interacted with. Interaction means that the
terminal has sent data to the process which depending on the terminal&#39;s <em>mode</em>. By
default input is sent when a key is pressed or when a command or extension sends text,
but based on the terminal&#39;s mode it can also happen on:</p>
<ul>
<li>a pointer click event</li>
<li>a pointer scroll event</li>
<li>a pointer move event</li>
<li>terminal focus in/out</li>
</ul>
<p>For more information on events that can send data see &quot;DEC Private Mode Set (DECSET)&quot; on
<a href="https://invisible-island.net/xterm/ctlseqs/ctlseqs.html">https://invisible-island.net/xterm/ctlseqs/ctlseqs.html</a></p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TerminalState.shell"></a><span class="ts" id=1963 data-target="#details-1963" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">shell</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1963">
<div class="comment"><p>The detected shell type of the <a href="#Terminal">Terminal</a>. This will be <code>undefined</code> when there is
not a clear signal as to what the shell is, or the shell is not supported yet. This
value should change to the shell type of a sub-shell when launched (for example, running
<code>bash</code> inside <code>zsh</code>).</p>
<p>Note that the possible values are currently defined as any of the following:
&#39;bash&#39;, &#39;cmd&#39;, &#39;csh&#39;, &#39;fish&#39;, &#39;gitbash&#39;, &#39;julia&#39;, &#39;ksh&#39;, &#39;node&#39;, &#39;nu&#39;, &#39;pwsh&#39;, &#39;python&#39;,
&#39;sh&#39;, &#39;wsl&#39;, &#39;xonsh&#39;, &#39;zsh&#39;.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="TestController"></a><span class="code-item" id=4462>TestController</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Entry point to discover and execute tests. It contains <a href="#TestController.items">TestController.items</a> which
are used to populate the editor UI, and is associated with
<a href="#TestController.createRunProfile">run profiles</a> to allow
for tests to be executed.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="TestController.id"></a><span class="ts" id=4463 data-target="#details-4463" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">id</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4463">
<div class="comment"><p>The id of the controller passed in <a href="#tests.createTestController">tests.createTestController</a>.
This must be globally unique.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TestController.items"></a><span class="ts" id=4465 data-target="#details-4465" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">items</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TestItemCollection">TestItemCollection</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4465">
<div class="comment"><p>A collection of &quot;top-level&quot; <a href="#TestItem">TestItem</a> instances, which can in
turn have their own <a href="#TestItem.children">children</a> to form the
&quot;test tree.&quot;</p>
<p>The extension controls when to add tests. For example, extensions should
add tests for a file when <a href="#workspace.onDidOpenTextDocument">workspace.onDidOpenTextDocument</a>
fires in order for decorations for tests within a file to be visible.</p>
<p>However, the editor may sometimes explicitly request children using the
<a href="#TestController.resolveHandler">resolveHandler</a> See the documentation on that method for more details.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TestController.label"></a><span class="ts" id=4464 data-target="#details-4464" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">label</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4464">
<div class="comment"><p>Human-readable label for the test controller.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TestController.refreshHandler"></a><span class="ts" id=4482 data-target="#details-4482" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">refreshHandler</span><span>: </span>(token: <a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a>) =&gt; <span class="type-intrinsic">void</span> &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4482">
<div class="comment"><p>If this method is present, a refresh button will be present in the
UI, and this method will be invoked when it&#39;s clicked. When called,
the extension should scan the workspace for any new, changed, or
removed tests.</p>
<p>It&#39;s recommended that extensions try to update tests in realtime, using
a <a href="#FileSystemWatcher">FileSystemWatcher</a> for example, and use this method as a fallback.</p>
</div>
<div class="comment"></div>
<div class="signature variable-declaration-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span> &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A thenable that resolves when tests have been refreshed.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TestController.resolveHandler"></a><span class="ts" id=4478 data-target="#details-4478" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">resolveHandler</span><span>?</span><span>: </span>(item: <a class="type-ref" href="#TestItem">TestItem</a>) =&gt; <span class="type-intrinsic">void</span> &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4478">
<div class="comment"><p>A function provided by the extension that the editor may call to request
children of a test item, if the <a href="#TestItem.canResolveChildren">TestItem.canResolveChildren</a> is
<code>true</code>. When called, the item should discover children and call
<a href="#TestController.createTestItem">TestController.createTestItem</a> as children are discovered.</p>
<p>Generally the extension manages the lifecycle of test items, but under
certain conditions the editor may request the children of a specific
item to be loaded. For example, if the user requests to re-run tests
after reloading the editor, the editor may need to call this method
to resolve the previously-run tests.</p>
<p>The item in the explorer will automatically be marked as &quot;busy&quot; until
the function returns or the returned thenable resolves.</p>
</div>
<div class="comment"></div>
<div class="signature variable-declaration-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">item</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TestItem">TestItem</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>An unresolved test item for which children are being
requested, or <code>undefined</code> to resolve the controller&#39;s initial <a href="#TestController.items">items</a>.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span> &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="TestController.createRunProfile"></a><span class="ts" id=4467 data-target="#details-4467" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">createRunProfile</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">label</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">kind</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TestRunProfileKind">TestRunProfileKind</a>, <span class="ident">runHandler</span><span>: </span>(request: <a class="type-ref" href="#TestRunRequest">TestRunRequest</a>, token: <a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a>) =&gt; <span class="type-intrinsic">void</span> &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;, <span class="ident">isDefault</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>, <span class="ident">tag</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TestTag">TestTag</a>, <span class="ident">supportsContinuousRun</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TestRunProfile">TestRunProfile</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4467">
<div class="comment"><p>Creates a profile used for running tests. Extensions must create
at least one profile in order for tests to be run.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">label</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A human-readable label for this profile.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">kind</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TestRunProfileKind">TestRunProfileKind</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Configures what kind of execution this profile manages.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">runHandler</span><span>: </span>(request: <a class="type-ref" href="#TestRunRequest">TestRunRequest</a>, token: <a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a>) =&gt; <span class="type-intrinsic">void</span> &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>Function called to start a test run.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">isDefault</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Whether this is the default action for its kind.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">tag</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TestTag">TestTag</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Profile test tag.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">supportsContinuousRun</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Whether the profile supports continuous running.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#TestRunProfile">TestRunProfile</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>An instance of a <a href="#TestRunProfile">TestRunProfile</a>, which is automatically
associated with this controller.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TestController.createTestItem"></a><span class="ts" id=4492 data-target="#details-4492" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">createTestItem</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">id</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">label</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">uri</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TestItem">TestItem</a></span>

</div></td></tr>

</div></td></tr>

</div></td></tr>

<a name="TestController.createTestRun"></a><span class="ts" id=4487 data-target="#details-4487" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">createTestRun</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">request</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TestRunRequest">TestRunRequest</a>, <span class="ident">name</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">persist</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TestRun">TestRun</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4487">
<div class="comment"><p>Creates a <a href="#TestRun">TestRun</a>. This should be called by the
<a href="#TestRunProfile">TestRunProfile</a> when a request is made to execute tests, and may
also be called if a test run is detected externally. Once created, tests
that are included in the request will be moved into the queued state.</p>
<p>All runs created using the same <code>request</code> instance will be grouped
together. This is useful if, for example, a single suite of tests is
run on multiple platforms.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">request</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TestRunRequest">TestRunRequest</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Test run request. Only tests inside the <code>include</code> may be
modified, and tests in its <code>exclude</code> are ignored.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">name</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The human-readable name of the run. This can be used to
disambiguate multiple sets of results in a test run. It is useful if
tests are run across multiple platforms, for example.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">persist</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Whether the results created by the run should be
persisted in the editor. This may be false if the results are coming from
a file already saved externally, such as a coverage information file.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#TestRun">TestRun</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>An instance of the <a href="#TestRun">TestRun</a>. It will be considered &quot;running&quot;
from the moment this method is invoked until <a href="#TestRun.end">TestRun.end</a> is called.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TestController.dispose"></a><span class="ts" id=4500 data-target="#details-4500" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">dispose</span><span>(</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4500">

and unpersisted results.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>

<a name="TestController.invalidateTestResults"></a><span class="ts" id=4497 data-target="#details-4497" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">invalidateTestResults</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">items</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TestItem">TestItem</a> &#124; readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#TestItem">TestItem</a>[]<span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4497">
<div class="comment"><p>Marks an item&#39;s results as being outdated. This is commonly called when
code or configuration changes and previous results should no longer
be considered relevant. The same logic used to mark results as outdated
may be used to drive <a href="#TestRunRequest.continuous">continuous test runs</a>.</p>
<p>If an item is passed to this method, test results for the item and all of
its children will be marked as outdated. If no item is passed, then all
test owned by the TestController will be marked as outdated.</p>
<p>Any test runs started before the moment this method is called, including
runs which may still be ongoing, will be marked as outdated and deprioritized
in the editor&#39;s UI.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">items</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TestItem">TestItem</a> &#124; readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#TestItem">TestItem</a>[]</td><td><div class="comment"><p>Item to mark as outdated. If undefined, all the controller&#39;s items are marked outdated.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="TestCoverageCount"></a><span class="code-item" id=4611>TestCoverageCount</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A class that contains information about a covered resource. A count can
be give for lines, branches, and declarations in a file.</p>
</div>

#### Constructors



<a name="TestCoverageCount.TestCoverageCount"></a><span class="ts" id=4613 data-target="#details-4613" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">TestCoverageCount</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">covered</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span>, <span class="ident">total</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TestCoverageCount">TestCoverageCount</a></span>

</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">total</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Value for <a href="#TestCoverageCount.total">TestCoverageCount.total</a></p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>

</table>
</div>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="TestCoverageCount.covered"></a><span class="ts" id=4616 data-target="#details-4616" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">covered</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4616">

<a name="TestCoverageCount.total"></a><span class="ts" id=4617 data-target="#details-4617" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">total</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></span>

<div class="comment"><p>Total number of covered items in the file.</p>

### <a name="TestItem"></a><span class="code-item" id=4574>TestItem</span>



<div class="comment"><p>An item shown in the &quot;test explorer&quot; view.</p>
<p>A <code>TestItem</code> can represent either a test suite or a test itself, since
they both have similar capabilities.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="TestItem.busy"></a><span class="ts" id=4581 data-target="#details-4581" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">busy</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4581">
<div class="comment"><p>Controls whether the item is shown as &quot;busy&quot; in the Test Explorer view.
This is useful for showing status while discovering children.</p>
<p>Defaults to <code>false</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TestItem.canResolveChildren"></a><span class="ts" id=4580 data-target="#details-4580" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">canResolveChildren</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4580">
<div class="comment"><p>Indicates whether this test item may have children discovered by resolving.</p>
<p>If true, this item is shown as expandable in the Test Explorer view and
expanding the item will cause <a href="#TestController.resolveHandler">TestController.resolveHandler</a>
to be invoked with the item.</p>
<p>Default to <code>false</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TestItem.children"></a><span class="ts" id=4577 data-target="#details-4577" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">children</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TestItemCollection">TestItemCollection</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4577">
<div class="comment"><p>The children of this test item. For a test suite, this may contain the
individual test cases or nested suites.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TestItem.description"></a><span class="ts" id=4583 data-target="#details-4583" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">description</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4583">
<div class="comment"><p>Optional description that appears next to the label.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TestItem.error"></a><span class="ts" id=4586 data-target="#details-4586" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">error</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#MarkdownString">MarkdownString</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4586">
<div class="comment"><p>Optional error encountered while loading the test.</p>
<p>Note that this is not a test result and should only be used to represent errors in
test discovery, such as syntax errors.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TestItem.id"></a><span class="ts" id=4575 data-target="#details-4575" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">id</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4575">
<div class="comment"><p>Identifier for the <code>TestItem</code>. This is used to correlate
test results and tests in the document with those in the workspace
(test explorer). This cannot change for the lifetime of the <code>TestItem</code>,
and must be unique among its parent&#39;s direct children.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TestItem.label"></a><span class="ts" id=4582 data-target="#details-4582" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">label</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4582">
<div class="comment"><p>Display name describing the test case.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TestItem.parent"></a><span class="ts" id=4578 data-target="#details-4578" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">parent</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TestItem">TestItem</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4578">
<div class="comment"><p>The parent of this item. It&#39;s set automatically, and is undefined
top-level items in the <a href="#TestController.items">TestController.items</a> and for items that
aren&#39;t yet included in another item&#39;s <a href="#TestItem.children">children</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TestItem.range"></a><span class="ts" id=4585 data-target="#details-4585" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">range</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4585">
<div class="comment"><p>Location of the test item in its <a href="#TestItem.uri">uri</a>.</p>
<p>This is only meaningful if the <code>uri</code> points to a file.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TestItem.sortText"></a><span class="ts" id=4584 data-target="#details-4584" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">sortText</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4584">
<div class="comment"><p>A string that should be used when comparing this item
with other items. When <code>falsy</code> the <a href="#TestItem.label">label</a>
is used.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TestItem.tags"></a><span class="ts" id=4579 data-target="#details-4579" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">tags</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#TestTag">TestTag</a>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4579">
<div class="comment"><p>Tags associated with this test item. May be used in combination with
<a href="#TestRunProfile.tag">tags</a>, or simply as an organizational feature.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TestItem.uri"></a><span class="ts" id=4576 data-target="#details-4576" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">uri</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4576">
<div class="comment"><p>URI this <code>TestItem</code> is associated with. May be a file or directory.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="TestItemCollection"></a><span class="code-item" id=4552>TestItemCollection</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Collection of test items, found in <a href="#TestItem.children">TestItem.children</a> and
<a href="#TestController.items">TestController.items</a>.</p>
</div>

<a name="TestItemCollection.size"></a><span class="ts" id=4553 data-target="#details-4553" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">size</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4553">
<div class="comment"><p>Gets the number of items in the collection.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Methods

### <a name="TestMessage"></a><span class="code-item" id=4596>TestMessage</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Message associated with the test state. Can be linked to a specific
source range -- useful for assertion failures, for example.</p>
</div>

#### Static



<a name="TestMessage.diff"></a><span class="ts" id=4598 data-target="#details-4598" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">diff</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">message</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#MarkdownString">MarkdownString</a>, <span class="ident">expected</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">actual</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TestMessage">TestMessage</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4598">
<div class="comment"><p>Creates a new TestMessage that will present as a diff in the editor.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">message</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#MarkdownString">MarkdownString</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Message to display to the user.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">expected</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Expected output.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">actual</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Actual output.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#TestMessage">TestMessage</a></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

#### Constructors



<a name="TestMessage.TestMessage"></a><span class="ts" id=4603 data-target="#details-4603" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">TestMessage</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">message</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#MarkdownString">MarkdownString</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TestMessage">TestMessage</a></span>

<tr><td><span class="ident">message</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#MarkdownString">MarkdownString</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The message to show to the user.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#TestMessage">TestMessage</a></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="TestMessage.actualOutput"></a><span class="ts" id=4607 data-target="#details-4607" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">actualOutput</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4607">
<div class="comment"><p>Actual test output. If given with <a href="#TestMessage.expectedOutput">expectedOutput </a>, a diff view will be shown.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TestMessage.contextValue"></a><span class="ts" id=4609 data-target="#details-4609" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">contextValue</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4609">
<div class="comment"><p>Context value of the test item. This can be used to contribute message-
specific actions to the test peek view. The value set here can be found
in the <code>testMessage</code> property of the following <code>menus</code> contribution points:</p>
<ul>
<li><code>testing/message/context</code> - context menu for the message in the results tree</li>
<li><code>testing/message/content</code> - a prominent button overlaying editor content where
 the message is displayed.</li>
</ul>
<p>For example:</p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="json" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">"contributes"</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">: {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#0451A5">  "menus"</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">: {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#0451A5">    "testing/message/content"</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">: [</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">      {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#0451A5">        "command"</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">: </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">"extension.deleteCommentThread"</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#0451A5">        "when"</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">: </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">"testMessage == canApplyRichDiff"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">      }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">    ]</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">}</span></span></code></pre>
<p>The command will be called with an object containing:</p>
<ul>
<li><code>test</code>: the <a href="#TestItem">TestItem</a> the message is associated with, <em>if</em> it
 is still present in the <a href="#TestController.items">TestController.items</a> collection.</li>
<li><code>message</code>: the <a href="#TestMessage">TestMessage</a> instance.</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>

<div class="details collapse" id="details-4606">
<div class="comment"><p>Expected test output. If given with <a href="#TestMessage.actualOutput">actualOutput </a>, a diff view will be shown.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TestMessage.location"></a><span class="ts" id=4608 data-target="#details-4608" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">location</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Location">Location</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4608">
<div class="comment"><p>Associated file location.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TestMessage.message"></a><span class="ts" id=4605 data-target="#details-4605" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">message</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#MarkdownString">MarkdownString</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4605">
<div class="comment"><p>Human-readable message text to display.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TestMessage.stackTrace"></a><span class="ts" id=4610 data-target="#details-4610" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">stackTrace</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TestMessageStackFrame">TestMessageStackFrame</a>[]</span>

### <a name="TestMessageStackFrame"></a><span class="code-item" id=4587>TestMessageStackFrame</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A stack frame found in the <a href="#TestMessage.stackTrace">TestMessage.stackTrace</a>.</p>
</div>

#### Constructors

### <a name="TestRun"></a><span class="code-item" id=4514>TestRun</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A TestRun represents an in-progress or completed test run and
provides methods to report the state of individual tests in the run.</p>
</div>

#### Events



<a name="TestRun.onDidDispose"></a><span class="ts" id=4551 data-target="#details-4551" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidDispose</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4551">
<div class="comment"><p>An event fired when the editor is no longer interested in data
associated with the test run.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="TestRun.isPersisted"></a><span class="ts" id=4517 data-target="#details-4517" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">isPersisted</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4517">
<div class="comment"><p>Whether the test run will be persisted across reloads by the editor.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TestRun.name"></a><span class="ts" id=4515 data-target="#details-4515" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">name</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4515">
<div class="comment"><p>The human-readable name of the run. This can be used to
disambiguate multiple sets of results in a test run. It is useful if
tests are run across multiple platforms, for example.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TestRun.token"></a><span class="ts" id=4516 data-target="#details-4516" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4516">
<div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token which will be triggered when the test run is
canceled from the UI.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="TestRun.addCoverage"></a><span class="ts" id=4547 data-target="#details-4547" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">addCoverage</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">fileCoverage</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#FileCoverage">FileCoverage</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span></span>

</div>



<a name="TestRun.appendOutput"></a><span class="ts" id=4542 data-target="#details-4542" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">appendOutput</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">output</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">location</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Location">Location</a>, <span class="ident">test</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TestItem">TestItem</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4542">
<div class="comment"><p>Appends raw output from the test runner. On the user&#39;s request, the
output will be displayed in a terminal. ANSI escape sequences,
such as colors and text styles, are supported. New lines must be given
as CRLF (<code>\r\n</code>) rather than LF (<code>\n</code>).</p>
</div>

location.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">test</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TestItem">TestItem</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Test item to associate the output with.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

</div>

<a name="TestRun.errored"></a><span class="ts" id=4533 data-target="#details-4533" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">errored</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">test</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TestItem">TestItem</a>, <span class="ident">message</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TestMessage">TestMessage</a> &#124; readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#TestMessage">TestMessage</a>[], <span class="ident">duration</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span></span>

</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">duration</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>How long the test took to execute, in milliseconds.</p>

### <a name="TestRunProfile"></a><span class="code-item" id=4432>TestRunProfile</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A TestRunProfile describes one way to execute tests in a <a href="#TestController">TestController</a>.</p>
</div>

#### Events



<a name="TestRunProfile.onDidChangeDefault"></a><span class="ts" id=4436 data-target="#details-4436" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeDefault</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4436">
<div class="comment"><p>Fired when a user has changed whether this is a default profile. The
event contains the new value of <a href="#TestRunProfile.isDefault">isDefault</a></p>
</div>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="TestRunProfile.configureHandler"></a><span class="ts" id=4439 data-target="#details-4439" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">configureHandler</span><span>: </span>() =&gt; <span class="type-intrinsic">void</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4439">
<div class="comment"><p>If this method is present, a configuration gear will be present in the
UI, and this method will be invoked when it&#39;s clicked. When called,
you can take other editor actions, such as showing a quick pick or
opening a configuration file.</p>
</div>
<div class="comment"></div>
<div class="signature variable-declaration-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TestRunProfile.isDefault"></a><span class="ts" id=4435 data-target="#details-4435" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">isDefault</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4435">
<div class="comment"><p>Controls whether this profile is the default action that will
be taken when its kind is actioned. For example, if the user clicks
the generic &quot;run all&quot; button, then the default profile for
<a href="#TestRunProfileKind.Run">TestRunProfileKind.Run</a> will be executed, although the
user can configure this.</p>
<p>Changes the user makes in their default profiles will be reflected
in this property after a <a href="#TestRunProfile.onDidChangeDefault">onDidChangeDefault</a> event.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TestRunProfile.kind"></a><span class="ts" id=4434 data-target="#details-4434" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">kind</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TestRunProfileKind">TestRunProfileKind</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4434">
<div class="comment"><p>Configures what kind of execution this profile controls. If there
are no profiles for a kind, it will not be available in the UI.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TestRunProfile.label"></a><span class="ts" id=4433 data-target="#details-4433" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">label</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4433">
<div class="comment"><p>Label shown to the user in the UI.</p>
<p>Note that the label has some significance if the user requests that
tests be re-run in a certain way. For example, if tests were run
normally and the user requests to re-run them in debug mode, the editor
will attempt use a configuration with the same label of the <code>Debug</code>
kind. If there is no such configuration, the default will be used.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TestRunProfile.loadDetailedCoverage"></a><span class="ts" id=4447 data-target="#details-4447" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">loadDetailedCoverage</span><span>?</span><span>: </span>(testRun: <a class="type-ref" href="#TestRun">TestRun</a>, fileCoverage: <a class="type-ref" href="#FileCoverage">FileCoverage</a>, token: <a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a>) =&gt; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#FileCoverageDetail">FileCoverageDetail</a>[]&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4447">
<div class="comment"><p>An extension-provided function that provides detailed statement and
function-level coverage for a file. The editor will call this when more
detail is needed for a file, such as when it&#39;s opened in an editor or
expanded in the <strong>Test Coverage</strong> view.</p>
<p>The <a href="#FileCoverage">FileCoverage</a> object passed to this function is the same instance
emitted on <a href="#TestRun.addCoverage">TestRun.addCoverage</a> calls associated with this profile.</p>
</div>
<div class="comment"></div>
<div class="signature variable-declaration-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">testRun</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TestRun">TestRun</a></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">fileCoverage</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#FileCoverage">FileCoverage</a></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#FileCoverageDetail">FileCoverageDetail</a>[]&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TestRunProfile.loadDetailedCoverageForTest"></a><span class="ts" id=4453 data-target="#details-4453" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">loadDetailedCoverageForTest</span><span>?</span><span>: </span>(testRun: <a class="type-ref" href="#TestRun">TestRun</a>, fileCoverage: <a class="type-ref" href="#FileCoverage">FileCoverage</a>, fromTestItem: <a class="type-ref" href="#TestItem">TestItem</a>, token: <a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a>) =&gt; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#FileCoverageDetail">FileCoverageDetail</a>[]&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4453">
<div class="comment"><p>An extension-provided function that provides detailed statement and
function-level coverage for a single test in a file. This is the per-test
sibling of <a href="#TestRunProfile.loadDetailedCoverage">TestRunProfile.loadDetailedCoverage</a>, called only if
a test item is provided in <a href="#FileCoverage.includesTests">FileCoverage.includesTests</a> and only
for files where such data is reported.</p>
<p>Often <a href="#TestRunProfile.loadDetailedCoverage">TestRunProfile.loadDetailedCoverage</a> will be called first
when a user opens a file, and then this method will be called if they
drill down into specific per-test coverage information. This method
should then return coverage data only for statements and declarations
executed by the specific test during the run.</p>
<p>The <a href="#FileCoverage">FileCoverage</a> object passed to this function is the same
instance emitted on <a href="#TestRun.addCoverage">TestRun.addCoverage</a> calls associated with this profile.</p>
</div>
<div class="comment"></div>
<div class="signature variable-declaration-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">testRun</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TestRun">TestRun</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The test run that generated the coverage data.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">fileCoverage</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#FileCoverage">FileCoverage</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The file coverage object to load detailed coverage for.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">fromTestItem</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TestItem">TestItem</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The test item to request coverage information for.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token that indicates the operation should be cancelled.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#FileCoverageDetail">FileCoverageDetail</a>[]&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TestRunProfile.runHandler"></a><span class="ts" id=4442 data-target="#details-4442" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">runHandler</span><span>: </span>(request: <a class="type-ref" href="#TestRunRequest">TestRunRequest</a>, token: <a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a>) =&gt; <span class="type-intrinsic">void</span> &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4442">
<div class="comment"><p>Handler called to start a test run. When invoked, the function should call
<a href="#TestController.createTestRun">TestController.createTestRun</a> at least once, and all test runs
associated with the request should be created before the function returns
or the returned promise is resolved.</p>
<p>If <a href="#TestRunProfile.supportsContinuousRun">supportsContinuousRun</a> is set, then <a href="#TestRunRequest.continuous">TestRunRequest.continuous</a>
may be <code>true</code>. In this case, the profile should observe changes to
source code and create new test runs by calling <a href="#TestController.createTestRun">TestController.createTestRun</a>,
until the cancellation is requested on the <code>token</code>.</p>
</div>
<div class="comment"></div>
<div class="signature variable-declaration-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">request</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TestRunRequest">TestRunRequest</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Request information for the test run.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Token that signals the used asked to abort the
test run. If cancellation is requested on this token, all <a href="#TestRun">TestRun</a>
instances associated with the request will be
automatically cancelled as well.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span> &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TestRunProfile.supportsContinuousRun"></a><span class="ts" id=4437 data-target="#details-4437" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">supportsContinuousRun</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4437">
<div class="comment"><p>Whether this profile supports continuous running of requests. If so,
then <a href="#TestRunRequest.continuous">TestRunRequest.continuous</a> may be set to <code>true</code>. Defaults
to false.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TestRunProfile.tag"></a><span class="ts" id=4438 data-target="#details-4438" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">tag</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TestTag">TestTag</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4438">
<div class="comment"><p>Associated tag for the profile. If this is set, only <a href="#TestItem">TestItem</a>
instances with the same tag will be eligible to execute in this profile.</p>
</div>
</div>

</table>

</div>

### <a name="TestRunProfileKind"></a><span class="code-item" id=4423>TestRunProfileKind</span>



<div class="comment"><p>The kind of executions that <a href="#TestRunProfile">TestRunProfiles</a> control.</p>
</div>

#### Enumeration Members



<a name="TestRunProfileKind.Run"></a><span class="ts" id=4424 data-target="#details-4424" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Run</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">1</span></span>

<a name="TestRunProfileKind.Debug"></a><span class="ts" id=4425 data-target="#details-4425" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Debug</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">2</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4425">
<div class="comment"><p>The <code>Debug</code> test profile kind.</p>
</div>

<a name="TestRunProfileKind.Coverage"></a><span class="ts" id=4426 data-target="#details-4426" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Coverage</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">3</span></span>
