### <a name="TestRunRequest"></a><span class="code-item" id=4501>TestRunRequest</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A TestRunRequest is a precursor to a <a href="#TestRun">TestRun</a>, which in turn is
created by passing a request to <a href="#TestController.createTestRun">TestController.createTestRun</a>. The
TestRunRequest contains information about which tests should be run, which
should not be run, and how they are run (via the <a href="#TestRunRequest.profile">profile</a>).</p>
<p>In general, TestRunRequests are created by the editor and pass to
<a href="#TestRunProfile.runHandler">TestRunProfile.runHandler</a>, however you can also create test
requests and runs outside of the <code>runHandler</code>.</p>
</div>

#### Constructors



<a name="TestRunRequest.TestRunRequest"></a><span class="ts" id=4503 data-target="#details-4503" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">TestRunRequest</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">include</span><span>?</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#TestItem">TestItem</a>[], <span class="ident">exclude</span><span>?</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#TestItem">TestItem</a>[], <span class="ident">profile</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TestRunProfile">TestRunProfile</a>, <span class="ident">continuous</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>, <span class="ident">preserveFocus</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TestRunRequest">TestRunRequest</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4503">
<div class="comment"></div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">include</span><span>?</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#TestItem">TestItem</a>[]</td><td><div class="comment"><p>Array of specific tests to run, or undefined to run all tests</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">exclude</span><span>?</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#TestItem">TestItem</a>[]</td><td><div class="comment"><p>An array of tests to exclude from the run.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">profile</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TestRunProfile">TestRunProfile</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The run profile used for this request.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">continuous</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Whether to run tests continuously as source changes.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">preserveFocus</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Whether to preserve the user&#39;s focus when the run is started</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#TestRunRequest">TestRunRequest</a></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="TestRunRequest.continuous"></a><span class="ts" id=4512 data-target="#details-4512" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">continuous</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4512">
<div class="comment"><p>Whether the profile should run continuously as source code changes. Only
relevant for profiles that set <a href="#TestRunProfile.supportsContinuousRun">TestRunProfile.supportsContinuousRun</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TestRunRequest.exclude"></a><span class="ts" id=4510 data-target="#details-4510" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">exclude</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#TestItem">TestItem</a>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4510">
<div class="comment"><p>An array of tests the user has marked as excluded from the test included
in this run; exclusions should apply after inclusions.</p>
<p>May be omitted if no exclusions were requested. Test controllers should
not run excluded tests or any children of excluded tests.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TestRunRequest.include"></a><span class="ts" id=4509 data-target="#details-4509" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">include</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#TestItem">TestItem</a>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4509">
<div class="comment"><p>A filter for specific tests to run. If given, the extension should run
all of the included tests and all their children, excluding any tests
that appear in <a href="#TestRunRequest.exclude">TestRunRequest.exclude</a>. If this property is
undefined, then the extension should simply run all tests.</p>
<p>The process of running tests should resolve the children of any test
items who have not yet been resolved.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TestRunRequest.preserveFocus"></a><span class="ts" id=4513 data-target="#details-4513" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">preserveFocus</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4513">
<div class="comment"><p>Controls how test Test Results view is focused.  If true, the editor
will keep the maintain the user&#39;s focus. If false, the editor will
prefer to move focus into the Test Results view, although
this may be configured by users.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TestRunRequest.profile"></a><span class="ts" id=4511 data-target="#details-4511" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">profile</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TestRunProfile">TestRunProfile</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4511">
<div class="comment"><p>The profile used for this request. This will always be defined
for requests issued from the editor UI, though extensions may
programmatically create requests not associated with any profile.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="TestTag"></a><span class="code-item" id=4427>TestTag</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Tags can be associated with <a href="#TestItem">TestItems</a> and
<a href="#TestRunProfile">TestRunProfiles</a>. A profile with a tag can only
execute tests that include that tag in their <a href="#TestItem.tags">TestItem.tags</a> array.</p>
</div>

#### Constructors



<a name="TestTag.TestTag"></a><span class="ts" id=4429 data-target="#details-4429" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">TestTag</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">id</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TestTag">TestTag</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4429">
<div class="comment"><p>Creates a new TestTag instance.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">id</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>ID of the test tag.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#TestTag">TestTag</a></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="TestTag.id"></a><span class="ts" id=4431 data-target="#details-4431" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">id</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-4431">
<div class="comment"><p>ID of the test tag. <code>TestTag</code> instances with the same ID are considered
to be identical.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="TextDocument"></a><span class="code-item" id=15>TextDocument</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Represents a text document, such as a source file. Text documents have
<a href="#TextLine">lines</a> and knowledge about an underlying resource like a file.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="TextDocument.encoding"></a><span class="ts" id=20 data-target="#details-20" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">encoding</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-20">
<div class="comment"><p>The file encoding of this document that will be used when the document is saved.</p>
<p>Use the <a href="#workspace.onDidChangeTextDocument">onDidChangeTextDocument</a>-event to
get notified when the document encoding changes.</p>
<p>Note that the possible encoding values are currently defined as any of the following:
&#39;utf8&#39;, &#39;utf8bom&#39;, &#39;utf16le&#39;, &#39;utf16be&#39;, &#39;windows1252&#39;, &#39;iso88591&#39;, &#39;iso88593&#39;,
&#39;iso885915&#39;, &#39;macroman&#39;, &#39;cp437&#39;, &#39;windows1256&#39;, &#39;iso88596&#39;, &#39;windows1257&#39;,
&#39;iso88594&#39;, &#39;iso885914&#39;, &#39;windows1250&#39;, &#39;iso88592&#39;, &#39;cp852&#39;, &#39;windows1251&#39;,
&#39;cp866&#39;, &#39;cp1125&#39;, &#39;iso88595&#39;, &#39;koi8r&#39;, &#39;koi8u&#39;, &#39;iso885913&#39;, &#39;windows1253&#39;,
&#39;iso88597&#39;, &#39;windows1255&#39;, &#39;iso88598&#39;, &#39;iso885910&#39;, &#39;iso885916&#39;, &#39;windows1254&#39;,
&#39;iso88599&#39;, &#39;windows1258&#39;, &#39;gbk&#39;, &#39;gb18030&#39;, &#39;cp950&#39;, &#39;big5hkscs&#39;, &#39;shiftjis&#39;,
&#39;eucjp&#39;, &#39;euckr&#39;, &#39;windows874&#39;, &#39;iso885911&#39;, &#39;koi8ru&#39;, &#39;koi8t&#39;, &#39;gb2312&#39;,
&#39;cp865&#39;, &#39;cp850&#39;, &#39;cp857&#39;.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TextDocument.eol"></a><span class="ts" id=26 data-target="#details-26" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">eol</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#EndOfLine">EndOfLine</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-26">
<div class="comment"><p>The <a href="#EndOfLine">end of line</a> sequence that is predominately
used in this document.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TextDocument.fileName"></a><span class="ts" id=17 data-target="#details-17" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">fileName</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-17">
<div class="comment"><p>The file system path of the associated resource. Shorthand
notation for <a href="#TextDocument.uri">TextDocument.uri.fsPath</a>. Independent of the uri scheme.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TextDocument.isClosed"></a><span class="ts" id=23 data-target="#details-23" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">isClosed</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-23">
<div class="comment"><p><code>true</code> if the document has been closed. A closed document isn&#39;t synchronized anymore
and won&#39;t be re-used when the same resource is opened again.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TextDocument.isDirty"></a><span class="ts" id=22 data-target="#details-22" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">isDirty</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-22">
<div class="comment"><p><code>true</code> if there are unpersisted changes.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TextDocument.isUntitled"></a><span class="ts" id=18 data-target="#details-18" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">isUntitled</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-18">
<div class="comment"><p>Is this document representing an untitled file which has never been saved yet. <em>Note</em> that
this does not mean the document will be saved to disk, use <a href="#Uri.scheme">Uri.scheme</a>
to figure out where a document will be <a href="#FileSystemProvider">saved</a>, e.g. <code>file</code>, <code>ftp</code> etc.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TextDocument.languageId"></a><span class="ts" id=19 data-target="#details-19" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">languageId</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-19">
<div class="comment"><p>The identifier of the language associated with this document.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TextDocument.lineCount"></a><span class="ts" id=27 data-target="#details-27" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">lineCount</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-27">
<div class="comment"><p>The number of lines in this document.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TextDocument.uri"></a><span class="ts" id=16 data-target="#details-16" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">uri</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-16">
<div class="comment"><p>The associated uri for this document.</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that most documents use the <code>file</code>-scheme, which means they are files on disk. However, <strong>not</strong> all documents are
saved on disk and therefore the <code>scheme</code> must be checked before trying to access the underlying file or siblings on disk.</p>
<p><em>See also</em></p>
<ul>
<li><a href="#FileSystemProvider">FileSystemProvider</a></li>
<li><a href="#TextDocumentContentProvider">TextDocumentContentProvider</a></li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TextDocument.version"></a><span class="ts" id=21 data-target="#details-21" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">version</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-21">
<div class="comment"><p>The version number of this document (it will strictly increase after each
change, including undo/redo).</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="TextDocument.getText"></a><span class="ts" id=40 data-target="#details-40" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">getText</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">range</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-40">
<div class="comment"><p>Get the text of this document. A substring can be retrieved by providing
a range. The range will be <a href="#TextDocument.validateRange">adjusted</a>.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">range</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Include only the text included by the range.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The text inside the provided range or the entire text.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TextDocument.getWordRangeAtPosition"></a><span class="ts" id=43 data-target="#details-43" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">getWordRangeAtPosition</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">position</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a>, <span class="ident">regex</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref-ts">RegExp</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-43">
<div class="comment"><p>Get a word-range at the given position. By default words are defined by
common separators, like space, -, _, etc. In addition, per language custom
[word definitions] can be defined. It
is also possible to provide a custom regular expression.</p>
<ul>
<li><em>Note 1:</em> A custom regular expression must not match the empty string and
if it does, it will be ignored.</li>
<li><em>Note 2:</em> A custom regular expression will fail to match multiline strings
and in the name of speed regular expressions should not match words with
spaces. Use <a href="#TextLine.text">TextLine.text</a> for more complex, non-wordy, scenarios.</li>
</ul>
<p>The position will be <a href="#TextDocument.validatePosition">adjusted</a>.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">position</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A position.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">regex</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref-ts">RegExp</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Optional regular expression that describes what a word is.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A range spanning a word, or <code>undefined</code>.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TextDocument.lineAt"></a><span class="ts" id=29 data-target="#details-29" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">lineAt</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">line</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextLine">TextLine</a></span>

<a name="TextDocument.lineAt"></a><span class="ts" id=31 data-target="#details-31" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">lineAt</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">position</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextLine">TextLine</a></span>

<a name="TextDocument.offsetAt"></a><span class="ts" id=34 data-target="#details-34" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">offsetAt</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">position</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></span>

### <a name="TextDocumentChangeEvent"></a><span class="code-item" id=3286>TextDocumentChangeEvent</span>



<div class="comment"><p>An event describing a transactional <a href="#TextDocument">document</a> change.</p>

<a name="TextDocumentChangeEvent.contentChanges"></a><span class="ts" id=3288 data-target="#details-3288" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">contentChanges</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocumentContentChangeEvent">TextDocumentContentChangeEvent</a>[]</span>

### <a name="TextDocumentContentProvider"></a><span class="code-item" id=497>TextDocumentContentProvider</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A text document content provider allows to add readonly documents
to the editor, such as source from a dll or generated html from md.</p>
<p>Content providers are <a href="#workspace.registerTextDocumentContentProvider">registered</a>
for a <a href="#Uri.scheme">uri-scheme</a>. When a uri with that scheme is to
be <a href="#workspace.openTextDocument">loaded</a> the content provider is
asked.</p>
</div>

#### Events



<a name="TextDocumentContentProvider.onDidChange"></a><span class="ts" id=498 data-target="#details-498" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChange</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-498">
<div class="comment"><p>An event to signal a resource has changed.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="TextDocumentContentProvider.provideTextDocumentContent"></a><span class="ts" id=500 data-target="#details-500" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">provideTextDocumentContent</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">uri</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-500">
<div class="comment"><p>Provide textual content for a given uri.</p>
<p>The editor will use the returned string-content to create a readonly
<a href="#TextDocument">document</a>. Resources allocated should be released when
the corresponding document has been <a href="#workspace.onDidCloseTextDocument">closed</a>.</p>
<p><strong>Note</strong>: The contents of the created <a href="#TextDocument">document</a> might not be
identical to the provided text due to end-of-line-sequence normalization.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">uri</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>An uri which scheme matches the scheme this provider was <a href="#workspace.registerTextDocumentContentProvider">registered</a> for.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A string or a thenable that resolves to such.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="TextDocumentSaveReason"></a><span class="code-item" id=3290>TextDocumentSaveReason</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Represents reasons why a text document is saved.</p>
</div>

#### Enumeration Members



<a name="TextDocumentSaveReason.Manual"></a><span class="ts" id=3291 data-target="#details-3291" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Manual</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">1</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3291">
<div class="comment"><p>Manually triggered, e.g. by the user pressing save, by starting debugging,
or by an API call.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TextDocumentSaveReason.AfterDelay"></a><span class="ts" id=3292 data-target="#details-3292" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">AfterDelay</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">2</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3292">
<div class="comment"><p>Automatic after a delay.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TextDocumentSaveReason.FocusOut"></a><span class="ts" id=3293 data-target="#details-3293" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">FocusOut</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">3</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3293">
<div class="comment"><p>When the editor lost focus.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="TextDocumentShowOptions"></a><span class="code-item" id=222>TextDocumentShowOptions</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Represents options to configure the behavior of showing a <a href="#TextDocument">document</a> in an <a href="#TextEditor">editor</a>.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="TextDocumentShowOptions.preserveFocus"></a><span class="ts" id=224 data-target="#details-224" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">preserveFocus</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-224">
<div class="comment"><p>An optional flag that when <code>true</code> will stop the <a href="#TextEditor">editor</a> from taking focus.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TextDocumentShowOptions.preview"></a><span class="ts" id=225 data-target="#details-225" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">preview</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-225">
<div class="comment"><p>An optional flag that controls if an <a href="#TextEditor">editor</a>-tab shows as preview. Preview tabs will
be replaced and reused until set to stay - either explicitly or through editing.</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that the flag is ignored if a user has disabled preview editors in settings.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TextDocumentShowOptions.selection"></a><span class="ts" id=226 data-target="#details-226" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">selection</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-226">
<div class="comment"><p>An optional selection to apply for the document in the <a href="#TextEditor">editor</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TextDocumentShowOptions.viewColumn"></a><span class="ts" id=223 data-target="#details-223" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">viewColumn</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ViewColumn">ViewColumn</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-223">
<div class="comment"><p>An optional view column in which the <a href="#TextEditor">editor</a> should be shown.
The default is the <a href="#ViewColumn.Active">active</a>. Columns that do not exist
will be created as needed up to the maximum of <a href="#ViewColumn.Nine">ViewColumn.Nine</a>.
Use <a href="#ViewColumn.Beside">ViewColumn.Beside</a> to open the editor to the side of the currently
active one.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="TextDocumentWillSaveEvent"></a><span class="code-item" id=3294>TextDocumentWillSaveEvent</span>



<div class="comment"><p>An event that is fired when a <a href="#TextDocument">document</a> will be saved.</p>
<p>To make modifications to the document before it is being saved, call the
<a href="#TextDocumentWillSaveEvent.waitUntil">waitUntil</a>-function with a thenable
that resolves to an array of <a href="#TextEdit">text edits</a>.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="TextDocumentWillSaveEvent.document"></a><span class="ts" id=3295 data-target="#details-3295" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3295">
<div class="comment"><p>The document that will be saved.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TextDocumentWillSaveEvent.reason"></a><span class="ts" id=3296 data-target="#details-3296" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">reason</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocumentSaveReason">TextDocumentSaveReason</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3296">
<div class="comment"><p>The reason why save was triggered.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="TextDocumentWillSaveEvent.waitUntil"></a><span class="ts" id=3298 data-target="#details-3298" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">waitUntil</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">thenable</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#TextEdit">TextEdit</a>[]&gt;<span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3298">
<div class="comment"><p>Allows to pause the event loop and to apply <a href="#TextEdit">pre-save-edits</a>.
Edits of subsequent calls to this function will be applied in order. The
edits will be <em>ignored</em> if concurrent modifications of the document happened.</p>
<p><em>Note:</em> This function can only be called during event dispatch and not
in an asynchronous manner:</p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="ts" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">workspace</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">onWillSaveTextDocument</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">event</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF"> =></span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#6A9955;--shiki-light:#008000">  // async, will *throw* an error</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">  setTimeout</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(() </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">=></span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080"> event</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">waitUntil</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">promise</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">));</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#6A9955;--shiki-light:#008000">  // sync, OK</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">  event</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">waitUntil</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">promise</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">});</span></span>
<span class="line"></span></code></pre>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">

### <a name="TextEditor"></a><span class="code-item" id=334>TextEditor</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Represents an editor that is attached to a <a href="#TextDocument">document</a>.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="TextEditor.document"></a><span class="ts" id=335 data-target="#details-335" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-335">
<div class="comment"><p>The document associated with this text editor. The document will be the same for the entire lifetime of this text editor.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TextEditor.options"></a><span class="ts" id=339 data-target="#details-339" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">options</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextEditorOptions">TextEditorOptions</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-339">
<div class="comment"><p>Text editor options.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TextEditor.selection"></a><span class="ts" id=336 data-target="#details-336" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">selection</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Selection">Selection</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-336">
<div class="comment"><p>The primary selection on this text editor. Shorthand for <code>TextEditor.selections[0]</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TextEditor.selections"></a><span class="ts" id=337 data-target="#details-337" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">selections</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#Selection">Selection</a>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-337">
<div class="comment"><p>The selections in this text editor. The primary selection is always at index 0.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TextEditor.viewColumn"></a><span class="ts" id=340 data-target="#details-340" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">viewColumn</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ViewColumn">ViewColumn</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-340">
<div class="comment"><p>The column in which this editor shows. Will be <code>undefined</code> in case this
isn&#39;t one of the main editors, e.g. an embedded editor, or when the editor
column is larger than three.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TextEditor.visibleRanges"></a><span class="ts" id=338 data-target="#details-338" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">visibleRanges</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-338">
<div class="comment"><p>The current visible ranges in the editor (vertically).
This accounts only for vertical scrolling, and not for horizontal scrolling.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="TextEditor.edit"></a><span class="ts" id=342 data-target="#details-342" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">edit</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">callback</span><span>: </span>(editBuilder: <a class="type-ref" href="#TextEditorEdit">TextEditorEdit</a>) =&gt; <span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>, <span class="ident">options</span><span>?</span><span>: </span>{undoStopAfter: <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>, undoStopBefore: <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>}<span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-342">
<div class="comment"><p>Perform an edit on the document associated with this text editor.</p>
<p>The given callback-function is invoked with an <a href="#TextEditorEdit">edit-builder</a> which must
be used to make edits. Note that the edit-builder is only valid while the
callback executes.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">callback</span><span>: </span>(editBuilder: <a class="type-ref" href="#TextEditorEdit">TextEditorEdit</a>) =&gt; <span class="type-intrinsic">void</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A function which can create edits using an <a href="#TextEditorEdit">edit-builder</a>.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">options</span><span>?</span><span>: </span>{undoStopAfter: <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>, undoStopBefore: <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>}</td><td><div class="comment"><p>The undo/redo behavior around this edit. By default, undo stops will be created before and after this edit.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A promise that resolves with a value indicating if the edits could be applied.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

<a name="TextEditor.insertSnippet"></a><span class="ts" id=352 data-target="#details-352" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">insertSnippet</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">snippet</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#SnippetString">SnippetString</a>, <span class="ident">location</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a> &#124; readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a>[] &#124; readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a>[], <span class="ident">options</span><span>?</span><span>: </span>{keepWhitespace: <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>, undoStopAfter: <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>, undoStopBefore: <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>}<span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-352">
<div class="comment"><p>Insert a <a href="#SnippetString">snippet</a> and put the editor into snippet mode. &quot;Snippet mode&quot;

<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>

</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">location</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a> &#124; readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a>[] &#124; readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a>[]</td><td><div class="comment"><p>Position or range at which to insert the snippet, defaults to the current editor selection or selections.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">options</span><span>?</span><span>: </span>{keepWhitespace: <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>, undoStopAfter: <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>, undoStopBefore: <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>}</td><td><div class="comment"><p>The undo/redo behavior around this edit. By default, undo stops will be created before and after this edit.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A promise that resolves with a value indicating if the snippet could be inserted. Note that the promise does not signal
that the snippet is completely filled-in or accepted.</p>

</table>

sharing the same <a href="#DecorationRenderOptions">styling options</a> in a <a href="#TextEditor">text editor</a>.</p>

<a href="#window.createTextEditorDecorationType">createTextEditorDecorationType</a>.</p>
</div>

### <a name="TextEditorEdit"></a><span class="code-item" id=376>TextEditorEdit</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A complex edit that will be applied in one transaction on a TextEditor.
This holds a description of the edits and if the edits are valid (i.e. no overlapping regions, document was not changed in the meantime, etc.)
they can be applied on a <a href="#TextDocument">document</a> associated with a <a href="#TextEditor">text editor</a>.</p>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="TextEditorEdit.delete"></a><span class="ts" id=386 data-target="#details-386" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">delete</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">location</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#Selection">Selection</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-386">
<div class="comment"><p>Delete a certain text region.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">location</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#Selection">Selection</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The range this operation should remove.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TextEditorEdit.insert"></a><span class="ts" id=382 data-target="#details-382" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">insert</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">location</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a>, <span class="ident">value</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-382">
<div class="comment"><p>Insert text at a location.
You can use <code>\r\n</code> or <code>\n</code> in <code>value</code> and they will be normalized to the current <a href="#TextDocument">document</a>.
Although the equivalent text edit can be made with <a href="#TextEditorEdit.replace">replace</a>, <code>insert</code> will produce a different resulting selection (it will get moved).</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">location</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The position where the new text should be inserted.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">value</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The new text this operation should insert.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TextEditorEdit.replace"></a><span class="ts" id=378 data-target="#details-378" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">replace</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">location</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#Selection">Selection</a>, <span class="ident">value</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-378">
<div class="comment"><p>Replace a certain text region with a new value.
You can use <code>\r\n</code> or <code>\n</code> in <code>value</code> and they will be normalized to the current <a href="#TextDocument">document</a>.</p>

<div class="signature callable-signature">

<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>

</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">value</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The new text this operation should insert after removing <code>location</code>.</p>

</table>

</div>

### <a name="TextEditorOptions"></a><span class="code-item" id=197>TextEditorOptions</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Represents a <a href="#TextEditor">text editor</a>&#39;s <a href="#TextEditor.options">options</a>.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="TextEditorOptions.cursorStyle"></a><span class="ts" id=201 data-target="#details-201" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">cursorStyle</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextEditorCursorStyle">TextEditorCursorStyle</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-201">
<div class="comment"><p>The rendering style of the cursor in this editor.
When getting a text editor&#39;s options, this property will always be present.
When setting a text editor&#39;s options, this property is optional.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TextEditorOptions.indentSize"></a><span class="ts" id=199 data-target="#details-199" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">indentSize</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-199">
<div class="comment"><p>The number of spaces to insert when <a href="#TextEditorOptions.insertSpaces">insertSpaces</a> is true.</p>
<p>When getting a text editor&#39;s options, this property will always be a number (resolved).
When setting a text editor&#39;s options, this property is optional and it can be a number or <code>&quot;tabSize&quot;</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TextEditorOptions.insertSpaces"></a><span class="ts" id=200 data-target="#details-200" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">insertSpaces</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-200">
<div class="comment"><p>When pressing Tab insert <a href="#TextEditorOptions.tabSize">n</a> spaces.
When getting a text editor&#39;s options, this property will always be a boolean (resolved).
When setting a text editor&#39;s options, this property is optional and it can be a boolean or <code>&quot;auto&quot;</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TextEditorOptions.lineNumbers"></a><span class="ts" id=202 data-target="#details-202" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">lineNumbers</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextEditorLineNumbersStyle">TextEditorLineNumbersStyle</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-202">
<div class="comment"><p>Render relative line numbers w.r.t. the current line number.
When getting a text editor&#39;s options, this property will always be present.
When setting a text editor&#39;s options, this property is optional.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TextEditorOptions.tabSize"></a><span class="ts" id=198 data-target="#details-198" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">tabSize</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-198">
<div class="comment"><p>The size in spaces a tab takes. This is used for two purposes:</p>
<ul>
<li>the rendering width of a tab character;</li>
<li>the number of spaces to insert when <a href="#TextEditorOptions.insertSpaces">insertSpaces</a> is true
and <code>indentSize</code> is set to <code>&quot;tabSize&quot;</code>.</li>
</ul>
<p>When getting a text editor&#39;s options, this property will always be a number (resolved).
When setting a text editor&#39;s options, this property is optional and it can be a number or <code>&quot;auto&quot;</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="TextEditorRevealType"></a><span class="code-item" id=207>TextEditorRevealType</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Represents different <a href="#TextEditor.revealRange">reveal</a> strategies in a text editor.</p>
</div>

#### Enumeration Members



<a name="TextEditorRevealType.Default"></a><span class="ts" id=208 data-target="#details-208" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Default</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">0</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-208">
<div class="comment"><p>The range will be revealed with as little scrolling as possible.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TextEditorRevealType.InCenter"></a><span class="ts" id=209 data-target="#details-209" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">InCenter</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">1</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-209">
<div class="comment"><p>The range will always be revealed in the center of the viewport.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TextEditorRevealType.InCenterIfOutsideViewport"></a><span class="ts" id=210 data-target="#details-210" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">InCenterIfOutsideViewport</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">2</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-210">
<div class="comment"><p>If the range is outside the viewport, it will be revealed in the center of the viewport.
Otherwise, it will be revealed with as little scrolling as possible.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TextEditorRevealType.AtTop"></a><span class="ts" id=211 data-target="#details-211" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">AtTop</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">3</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-211">
<div class="comment"><p>The range will always be revealed at the top of the viewport.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="TextLine"></a><span class="code-item" id=8>TextLine</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Represents a line of text, such as a line of source code.</p>
<p>TextLine objects are <strong>immutable</strong>. When a <a href="#TextDocument">document</a> changes,
previously retrieved lines will not represent the latest state.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="TextLine.firstNonWhitespaceCharacterIndex"></a><span class="ts" id=13 data-target="#details-13" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">firstNonWhitespaceCharacterIndex</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-13">
<div class="comment"><p>The offset of the first character which is not a whitespace character as defined
by <code>/\s/</code>. <strong>Note</strong> that if a line is all whitespace the length of the line is returned.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TextLine.isEmptyOrWhitespace"></a><span class="ts" id=14 data-target="#details-14" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">isEmptyOrWhitespace</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-14">
<div class="comment"><p>Whether this line is whitespace only, shorthand
for <a href="#TextLine.firstNonWhitespaceCharacterIndex">TextLine.firstNonWhitespaceCharacterIndex</a> === <a href="#TextLine.text">TextLine.text.length</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TextLine.lineNumber"></a><span class="ts" id=9 data-target="#details-9" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">lineNumber</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-9">
<div class="comment"><p>The zero-based line number.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TextLine.range"></a><span class="ts" id=11 data-target="#details-11" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">range</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Range">Range</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-11">
<div class="comment"><p>The range this line covers without the line separator characters.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="ThemeColor"></a><span class="code-item" id=238>ThemeColor</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A reference to one of the workbench colors as defined in <a href="https://code.visualstudio.com/api/references/theme-color">https://code.visualstudio.com/api/references/theme-color</a>.
Using a theme color is preferred over a custom color as it gives theme authors and users the possibility to change the color.</p>
</div>

#### Constructors



<a name="ThemeColor.ThemeColor"></a><span class="ts" id=240 data-target="#details-240" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">ThemeColor</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">id</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ThemeColor">ThemeColor</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-240">
<div class="comment"><p>Creates a reference to a theme color.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">id</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>of the color. The available colors are listed in <a href="https://code.visualstudio.com/api/references/theme-color">https://code.visualstudio.com/api/references/theme-color</a>.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ThemeColor">ThemeColor</a></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

#### Properties

<div class="details collapse" id="details-242">
<div class="comment"><p>The id of this color.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="ThemeIcon"></a><span class="code-item" id=243>ThemeIcon</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A reference to a named icon. Currently, <a href="#ThemeIcon.File">File</a>, <a href="#ThemeIcon.Folder">Folder</a>,
and <a href="https://code.visualstudio.com/api/references/icons-in-labels#icon-listing">ThemeIcon ids</a> are supported.
Using a theme icon is preferred over a custom icon as it gives product theme authors the possibility to change the icons.</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that theme icons can also be rendered inside labels and descriptions. Places that support theme icons spell this out
and they use the <code>$(&lt;name&gt;)</code>-syntax, for instance <code>quickPick.label = &quot;Hello World $(globe)&quot;</code>.</p>
</div>

#### Static



<a name="ThemeIcon.File"></a><span class="ts" id=244 data-target="#details-244" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">File</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ThemeIcon">ThemeIcon</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-244">
<div class="comment"><p>Reference to an icon representing a file. The icon is taken from the current file icon theme or a placeholder icon is used.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="ThemeIcon.Folder"></a><span class="ts" id=245 data-target="#details-245" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Folder</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ThemeIcon">ThemeIcon</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-245">
<div class="comment"><p>Reference to an icon representing a folder. The icon is taken from the current file icon theme or a placeholder icon is used.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Constructors



<a name="ThemeIcon.ThemeIcon"></a><span class="ts" id=247 data-target="#details-247" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">ThemeIcon</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">id</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">color</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ThemeColor">ThemeColor</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ThemeIcon">ThemeIcon</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-247">
<div class="comment"><p>Creates a reference to a theme icon.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">id</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>id of the icon. The available icons are listed in <a href="https://code.visualstudio.com/api/references/icons-in-labels#icon-listing">https://code.visualstudio.com/api/references/icons-in-labels#icon-listing</a>.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">color</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ThemeColor">ThemeColor</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>optional <code>ThemeColor</code> for the icon. The color is currently only used in <a href="#TreeItem">TreeItem</a>.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>

</div>

### <a name="TreeDataProvider"></a><span class="code-item" id=2990>TreeDataProvider&lt;T&gt;</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A data provider that provides tree data</p>
</div>

#### Events



<a name="TreeDataProvider.onDidChangeTreeData"></a><span class="ts" id=2992 data-target="#details-2992" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeTreeData</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span> &#124; <span class="type-ref">T</span> &#124; <span class="type-ref">T</span>[]&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2992">
<div class="comment"><p>An optional event to signal that an element or root has changed.
This will trigger the view to update the changed element/root and its children recursively (if shown).
To signal that root has changed, do not pass any argument or pass <code>undefined</code> or <code>null</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="TreeDataProvider.getChildren"></a><span class="ts" id=2997 data-target="#details-2997" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">getChildren</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">element</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>[]&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2997">
<div class="comment"><p>Get the children of <code>element</code> or root if no element is passed.</p>
<p><em>Note:</em> The result is not mutated by the API consumer; readonly arrays may be cast to <code>T[]</code>.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">element</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The element from which the provider gets children. Can be <code>undefined</code>.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>[]&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>Children of <code>element</code> or root if no element is passed.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TreeDataProvider.getParent"></a><span class="ts" id=3000 data-target="#details-3000" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">getParent</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">element</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt;</span>

Return <code>null</code> or <code>undefined</code> if <code>element</code> is a child of root.</p>
<p><strong>NOTE:</strong> This method should be implemented in order to access <a href="#TreeView.reveal">reveal</a> API.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">element</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The element for which the parent has to be returned.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>Parent of <code>element</code>.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TreeDataProvider.getTreeItem"></a><span class="ts" id=2994 data-target="#details-2994" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">getTreeItem</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">element</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TreeItem">TreeItem</a> &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#TreeItem">TreeItem</a>&gt;</span>

<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">element</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The element for which <a href="#TreeItem">TreeItem</a> representation is asked for.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#TreeItem">TreeItem</a> &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#TreeItem">TreeItem</a>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>TreeItem representation of the element.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>

<a name="TreeDataProvider.resolveTreeItem"></a><span class="ts" id=3003 data-target="#details-3003" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">resolveTreeItem</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">item</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TreeItem">TreeItem</a>, <span class="ident">element</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#TreeItem">TreeItem</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3003">
<div class="comment"><p>Called on hover to resolve the <a href="#TreeItem.tooltip">TreeItem</a> property if it is undefined.
Called on tree item click/open to resolve the <a href="#TreeItem.command">TreeItem</a> property if it is undefined.
Only properties that were undefined can be resolved in <code>resolveTreeItem</code>.
Functionality may be expanded later to include being called to resolve other missing
properties on selection and/or on open.</p>
<p>Will only ever be called once per TreeItem.</p>
<p>onDidChangeTreeData should not be triggered from within resolveTreeItem.</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that this function is called when tree items are already showing in the UI.
Because of that, no property that changes the presentation (label, description, etc.)
can be changed.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">item</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TreeItem">TreeItem</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Undefined properties of <code>item</code> should be set then <code>item</code> should be returned.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">element</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The object associated with the TreeItem.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#TreeItem">TreeItem</a>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>The resolved tree item or a thenable that resolves to such. It is OK to return the given
<code>item</code>. When no result is returned, the given <code>item</code> will be used.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="TreeDragAndDropController"></a><span class="code-item" id=2947>TreeDragAndDropController&lt;T&gt;</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Provides support for drag and drop in <code>TreeView</code>.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="TreeDragAndDropController.dragMimeTypes"></a><span class="ts" id=2950 data-target="#details-2950" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">dragMimeTypes</span><span>: </span>readonly <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2950">
<div class="comment"><p>The mime types that the <a href="#TreeDragAndDropController.handleDrag"><code>handleDrag</code></a> method of this <code>TreeDragAndDropController</code> may add to the tree data transfer.
This could be well-defined, existing, mime types, and also mime types defined by the extension.</p>
<p>The recommended mime type of the tree (<code>application/vnd.code.tree.&lt;treeidlowercase&gt;</code>) will be automatically added.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TreeDragAndDropController.dropMimeTypes"></a><span class="ts" id=2949 data-target="#details-2949" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">dropMimeTypes</span><span>: </span>readonly <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2949">
<div class="comment"><p>The mime types that the <a href="#TreeDragAndDropController.handleDrop"><code>handleDrop</code></a> method of this <code>DragAndDropController</code> supports.
This could be well-defined, existing, mime types, and also mime types defined by the extension.</p>
<p>To support drops from trees, you will need to add the mime type of that tree.
This includes drops from within the same tree.
The mime type of a tree is recommended to be of the format <code>application/vnd.code.tree.&lt;treeidlowercase&gt;</code>.</p>
<p>Use the special <code>files</code> mime type to support all types of dropped files <a href="#DataTransferFile">files</a>, regardless of the file&#39;s actual mime type.</p>
<p>To learn the mime type of a dragged item:</p>
<ol>
<li>Set up your <code>DragAndDropController</code></li>
<li>Use the Developer: Set Log Level... command to set the level to &quot;Debug&quot;</li>
<li>Open the developer tools and drag the item with unknown mime type over your tree. The mime types will be logged to the developer console</li>
</ol>
<p>Note that mime types that cannot be sent to the extension will be omitted.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="TreeDragAndDropController.handleDrag"></a><span class="ts" id=2952 data-target="#details-2952" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">handleDrag</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">source</span><span>: </span>readonly <span class="type-ref">T</span>[], <span class="ident">dataTransfer</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DataTransfer">DataTransfer</a>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span> &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2952">
<div class="comment"><p>When the user starts dragging items from this <code>DragAndDropController</code>, <code>handleDrag</code> will be called.
Extensions can use <code>handleDrag</code> to add their <a href="#DataTransferItem"><code>DataTransferItem</code></a> items to the drag and drop.</p>
<p>Mime types added in <code>handleDrag</code> won&#39;t be available outside the application.</p>
<p>When the items are dropped on <strong>another tree item</strong> in <strong>the same tree</strong>, your <code>DataTransferItem</code> objects
will be preserved. Use the recommended mime type for the tree (<code>application/vnd.code.tree.&lt;treeidlowercase&gt;</code>) to add
tree objects in a data transfer. See the documentation for <code>DataTransferItem</code> for how best to take advantage of this.</p>
<p>To add a data transfer item that can be dragged into the editor, use the application specific mime type &quot;text/uri-list&quot;.
The data for &quot;text/uri-list&quot; should be a string with <code>toString()</code>ed Uris separated by <code>\r\n</code>. To specify a cursor position in the file,
set the Uri&#39;s fragment to <code>L3,5</code>, where 3 is the line number and 5 is the column number.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">source</span><span>: </span>readonly <span class="type-ref">T</span>[]</td><td><div class="comment"><p>The source items for the drag and drop operation.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">dataTransfer</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DataTransfer">DataTransfer</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The data transfer associated with this drag.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token indicating that drag has been cancelled.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span> &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TreeDragAndDropController.handleDrop"></a><span class="ts" id=2957 data-target="#details-2957" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">handleDrop</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">target</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span>, <span class="ident">dataTransfer</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DataTransfer">DataTransfer</a>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span> &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2957">
<div class="comment"><p>Called when a drag and drop action results in a drop on the tree that this <code>DragAndDropController</code> belongs to.</p>
<p>Extensions should fire <a href="#TreeDataProvider.onDidChangeTreeData">onDidChangeTreeData</a> for any elements that need to be refreshed.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">target</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The target tree element that the drop is occurring on. When undefined, the target is the root.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">dataTransfer</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#DataTransfer">DataTransfer</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The data transfer items of the source of the drag.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token indicating that the drop has been cancelled.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span> &#124; <span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="TreeItem"></a><span class="code-item" id=3007>TreeItem</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A tree item is an UI element of the tree. Tree items are created by the <a href="#TreeDataProvider">data provider</a>.</p>
</div>

#### Constructors

Default is <a href="#TreeItemCollapsibleState.None">TreeItemCollapsibleState.None</a></p>

<a name="TreeItem.TreeItem"></a><span class="ts" id=3012 data-target="#details-3012" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">TreeItem</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">resourceUri</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a>, <span class="ident">collapsibleState</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TreeItemCollapsibleState">TreeItemCollapsibleState</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TreeItem">TreeItem</a></span>

Default is <a href="#TreeItemCollapsibleState.None">TreeItemCollapsibleState.None</a></p>
