#### Properties



<a name="TreeItem.accessibilityInformation"></a><span class="ts" id=3024 data-target="#details-3024" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">accessibilityInformation</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#AccessibilityInformation">AccessibilityInformation</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3024">
<div class="comment"><p>Accessibility information used when screen reader interacts with this tree item.
Generally, a TreeItem has no need to set the <code>role</code> of the accessibilityInformation;
however, there are cases where a TreeItem is not displayed in a tree-like way where setting the <code>role</code> may make sense.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TreeItem.checkboxState"></a><span class="ts" id=3025 data-target="#details-3025" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">checkboxState</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TreeItemCheckboxState">TreeItemCheckboxState</a> &#124; {accessibilityInformation: <a class="type-ref" href="#AccessibilityInformation">AccessibilityInformation</a>, state: <a class="type-ref" href="#TreeItemCheckboxState">TreeItemCheckboxState</a>, tooltip: <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>}</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3025">
<div class="comment"><p><a href="#TreeItemCheckboxState">TreeItemCheckboxState</a> of the tree item.
<a href="#TreeDataProvider.onDidChangeTreeData">onDidChangeTreeData</a> should be fired when <a href="#TreeItem.checkboxState">checkboxState</a> changes.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TreeItem.collapsibleState"></a><span class="ts" id=3022 data-target="#details-3022" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">collapsibleState</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TreeItemCollapsibleState">TreeItemCollapsibleState</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3022">
<div class="comment"><p><a href="#TreeItemCollapsibleState">TreeItemCollapsibleState</a> of the tree item.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TreeItem.command"></a><span class="ts" id=3021 data-target="#details-3021" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">command</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Command">Command</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3021">
<div class="comment"><p>The <a href="#Command">Command</a> that should be executed when the tree item is selected.</p>
<p>Please use <code>vscode.open</code> or <code>vscode.diff</code> as command IDs when the tree item is opening
something in the editor. Using these commands ensures that the resulting editor will
appear consistent with how other built-in trees open editors.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TreeItem.contextValue"></a><span class="ts" id=3023 data-target="#details-3023" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">contextValue</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3023">
<div class="comment"><p>Context value of the tree item. This can be used to contribute item specific actions in the tree.
For example, a tree item is given a context value as <code>folder</code>. When contributing actions to <code>view/item/context</code>
using <code>menus</code> extension point, you can specify context value for key <code>viewItem</code> in <code>when</code> expression like <code>viewItem == folder</code>.</p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="json" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">"contributes"</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">: {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#0451A5">  "menus"</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">: {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#0451A5">    "view/item/context"</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">: [</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">      {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#0451A5">        "command"</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">: </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">"extension.deleteFolder"</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#0451A5">        "when"</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">: </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">"viewItem == folder"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">      }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">    ]</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">}</span></span></code></pre>
<p>This will show action <code>extension.deleteFolder</code> only for items with <code>contextValue</code> is <code>folder</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TreeItem.description"></a><span class="ts" id=3018 data-target="#details-3018" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">description</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3018">
<div class="comment"><p>A human-readable string which is rendered less prominent.
When <code>true</code>, it is derived from <a href="#TreeItem.resourceUri">resourceUri</a> and when <code>falsy</code>, it is not shown.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TreeItem.iconPath"></a><span class="ts" id=3017 data-target="#details-3017" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">iconPath</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#IconPath">IconPath</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3017">
<div class="comment"><p>The icon path or <a href="#ThemeIcon">ThemeIcon</a> for the tree item.
When <code>falsy</code>, <a href="#ThemeIcon.Folder">Folder Theme Icon</a> is assigned, if item is collapsible otherwise <a href="#ThemeIcon.File">File Theme Icon</a>.
When a file or folder <a href="#ThemeIcon">ThemeIcon</a> is specified, icon is derived from the current file icon theme for the specified theme icon using <a href="#TreeItem.resourceUri">resourceUri</a> (if provided).</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TreeItem.id"></a><span class="ts" id=3016 data-target="#details-3016" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">id</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3016">
<div class="comment"><p>Optional id for the tree item that has to be unique across tree. The id is used to preserve the selection and expansion state of the tree item.</p>
<p>If not provided, an id is generated using the tree item&#39;s label. <strong>Note</strong> that when labels change, ids will change and that selection and expansion state cannot be kept stable anymore.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TreeItem.label"></a><span class="ts" id=3015 data-target="#details-3015" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">label</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#TreeItemLabel">TreeItemLabel</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3015">
<div class="comment"><p>A human-readable string describing this item. When <code>falsy</code>, it is derived from <a href="#TreeItem.resourceUri">resourceUri</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TreeItem.resourceUri"></a><span class="ts" id=3019 data-target="#details-3019" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">resourceUri</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3019">
<div class="comment"><p>A <a href="#Uri">Uri</a> representing the resource associated with this item.</p>
<p>When set, this property is used to automatically derive several item properties if they are not explicitly provided:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Label</strong>: Derived from the resource&#39;s file name when <a href="#TreeItem.label">label</a> is not provided.</li>
<li><strong>Description</strong>: Derived from the resource&#39;s path when <a href="#TreeItem.description">description</a> is set to <code>true</code>.</li>
<li><strong>Icon</strong>: Derived from the current file icon theme when <a href="#TreeItem.iconPath">iconPath</a> is set to
<a href="#ThemeIcon.File">ThemeIcon.File</a> or <a href="#ThemeIcon.Folder">ThemeIcon.Folder</a>.</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>

<a name="TreeView.reveal"></a><span class="ts" id=2981 data-target="#details-2981" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">reveal</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">element</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span>, <span class="ident">options</span><span>?</span><span>: </span>{expand: <span class="type-intrinsic">number</span> &#124; <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>, focus: <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>, select: <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>}<span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2981">
<div class="comment"><p>Reveals the given element in the tree view.
If the tree view is not visible then the tree view is shown and element is revealed.</p>
<p>By default revealed element is selected.
In order to not to select, set the option <code>select</code> to <code>false</code>.
In order to focus, set the option <code>focus</code> to <code>true</code>.
In order to expand the revealed element, set the option <code>expand</code> to <code>true</code>. To expand recursively set <code>expand</code> to the number of levels to expand.</p>
<ul>
<li><em>NOTE:</em> You can expand only to 3 levels maximum.</li>
<li><em>NOTE:</em> The <a href="#TreeDataProvider">TreeDataProvider</a> that the <code>TreeView</code> <a href="#window.createTreeView">is registered with</a> with must implement <a href="#TreeDataProvider.getParent">getParent</a> method to access this API.</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">element</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">options</span><span>?</span><span>: </span>{expand: <span class="type-intrinsic">number</span> &#124; <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>, focus: <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>, select: <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>}</td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="TreeViewOptions"></a><span class="code-item" id=2897>TreeViewOptions&lt;T&gt;</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Options for creating a <a href="#TreeView">TreeView</a></p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="TreeViewOptions.canSelectMany"></a><span class="ts" id=2901 data-target="#details-2901" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">canSelectMany</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2901">
<div class="comment"><p>Whether the tree supports multi-select. When the tree supports multi-select and a command is executed from the tree,
the first argument to the command is the tree item that the command was executed on and the second argument is an
array containing all selected tree items.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TreeViewOptions.dragAndDropController"></a><span class="ts" id=2902 data-target="#details-2902" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">dragAndDropController</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TreeDragAndDropController&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">TreeDragAndDropController</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2902">
<div class="comment"><p>An optional interface to implement drag and drop in the tree view.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TreeViewOptions.manageCheckboxStateManually"></a><span class="ts" id=2903 data-target="#details-2903" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">manageCheckboxStateManually</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2903">
<div class="comment"><p>By default, when the children of a tree item have already been fetched, child checkboxes are automatically managed based on the checked state of the parent tree item.
If the tree item is collapsed by default (meaning that the children haven&#39;t yet been fetched) then child checkboxes will not be updated.
To override this behavior and manage child and parent checkbox state in the extension, set this to <code>true</code>.</p>
<p>Examples where <a href="#TreeViewOptions.manageCheckboxStateManually">TreeViewOptions.manageCheckboxStateManually</a> is false, the default behavior:</p>
<ol>
<li><p>A tree item is checked, then its children are fetched. The children will be checked.</p>
</li>
<li><p>A tree item&#39;s parent is checked. The tree item and all of it&#39;s siblings will be checked.</p>
</li>
</ol>
<ul>
<li><input disabled="" type="checkbox"> Parent<ul>
<li><input disabled="" type="checkbox"> Child 1</li>
<li><input disabled="" type="checkbox"> Child 2
When the user checks Parent, the tree will look like this:</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><input checked="" disabled="" type="checkbox"> Parent<ul>
<li><input checked="" disabled="" type="checkbox"> Child 1</li>
<li><input checked="" disabled="" type="checkbox"> Child 2</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<ol start="3">
<li>A tree item and all of it&#39;s siblings are checked. The parent will be checked.</li>
</ol>
<ul>
<li><input disabled="" type="checkbox"> Parent<ul>
<li><input disabled="" type="checkbox"> Child 1</li>
<li><input disabled="" type="checkbox"> Child 2
When the user checks Child 1 and Child 2, the tree will look like this:</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><input checked="" disabled="" type="checkbox"> Parent<ul>
<li><input checked="" disabled="" type="checkbox"> Child 1</li>
<li><input checked="" disabled="" type="checkbox"> Child 2</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<ol start="4">
<li>A tree item is unchecked. The parent will be unchecked.</li>
</ol>
<ul>
<li><input checked="" disabled="" type="checkbox"> Parent<ul>
<li><input checked="" disabled="" type="checkbox"> Child 1</li>
<li><input checked="" disabled="" type="checkbox"> Child 2
When the user unchecks Child 1, the tree will look like this:</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><input disabled="" type="checkbox"> Parent<ul>
<li><input disabled="" type="checkbox"> Child 1</li>
<li><input checked="" disabled="" type="checkbox"> Child 2</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TreeViewOptions.showCollapseAll"></a><span class="ts" id=2900 data-target="#details-2900" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">showCollapseAll</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2900">
<div class="comment"><p>Whether to show collapse all action or not.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="TypeHierarchyProvider"></a><span class="code-item" id=1529>TypeHierarchyProvider</span>



<div class="comment"><p>The type hierarchy provider interface describes the contract between extensions
and the type hierarchy feature.</p>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="TypeHierarchyProvider.prepareTypeHierarchy"></a><span class="ts" id=1531 data-target="#details-1531" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">prepareTypeHierarchy</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a>, <span class="ident">position</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#TypeHierarchyItem">TypeHierarchyItem</a> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#TypeHierarchyItem">TypeHierarchyItem</a>[]&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1531">
<div class="comment"><p>Bootstraps type hierarchy by returning the item that is denoted by the given document
and position. This item will be used as entry into the type graph. Providers should
return <code>undefined</code> or <code>null</code> when there is no item at the given location.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">document</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TextDocument">TextDocument</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The document in which the command was invoked.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">position</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Position">Position</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The position at which the command was invoked.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#TypeHierarchyItem">TypeHierarchyItem</a> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#TypeHierarchyItem">TypeHierarchyItem</a>[]&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>One or multiple type hierarchy items or a thenable that resolves to such. The lack of a result can be
signaled by returning <code>undefined</code>, <code>null</code>, or an empty array.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TypeHierarchyProvider.provideTypeHierarchySubtypes"></a><span class="ts" id=1540 data-target="#details-1540" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">provideTypeHierarchySubtypes</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">item</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TypeHierarchyItem">TypeHierarchyItem</a>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#TypeHierarchyItem">TypeHierarchyItem</a>[]&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1540">
<div class="comment"><p>Provide all subtypes for an item, e.g all types which are derived/inherited from the given item. In
graph terms this describes directed and annotated edges inside the type graph, e.g the given item is the starting
node and the result is the nodes that can be reached.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">item</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TypeHierarchyItem">TypeHierarchyItem</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The hierarchy item for which subtypes should be computed.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#TypeHierarchyItem">TypeHierarchyItem</a>[]&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A set of direct subtypes or a thenable that resolves to such. The lack of a result can be
signaled by returning <code>undefined</code> or <code>null</code>.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="TypeHierarchyProvider.provideTypeHierarchySupertypes"></a><span class="ts" id=1536 data-target="#details-1536" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">provideTypeHierarchySupertypes</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">item</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TypeHierarchyItem">TypeHierarchyItem</a>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#TypeHierarchyItem">TypeHierarchyItem</a>[]&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1536">
<div class="comment"><p>Provide all supertypes for an item, e.g all types from which a type is derived/inherited. In graph terms this describes directed
and annotated edges inside the type graph, e.g the given item is the starting node and the result is the nodes
that can be reached.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">item</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#TypeHierarchyItem">TypeHierarchyItem</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The hierarchy item for which super types should be computed.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#TypeHierarchyItem">TypeHierarchyItem</a>[]&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A set of direct supertypes or a thenable that resolves to such. The lack of a result can be
signaled by returning <code>undefined</code> or <code>null</code>.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="Uri"></a><span class="code-item" id=391>Uri</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A universal resource identifier representing either a file on disk
or another resource, like untitled resources.</p>
</div>

#### Static



<a name="Uri.file"></a><span class="ts" id=397 data-target="#details-397" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">file</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">path</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-397">
<div class="comment"><p>Create an URI from a file system path. The <a href="#Uri.scheme">scheme</a>
will be <code>file</code>.</p>
<p>The <em>difference</em> between <a href="#Uri.parse">Uri.parse</a> and <a href="#Uri.file">Uri.file</a> is that the latter treats the argument
as path, not as stringified-uri. E.g. <code>Uri.file(path)</code> is <em>not</em> the same as
<code>Uri.parse(&#39;file://&#39; + path)</code> because the path might contain characters that are
interpreted (# and ?). See the following sample:</p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="ts" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">const</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4FC1FF;--shiki-light:#0070C1"> good</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> = </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4FC1FF;--shiki-light:#0070C1">URI</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">file</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'/coding/c#/project1'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">good</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">scheme</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> === </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'file'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">good</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">fragment</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> === </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">''</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">const</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4FC1FF;--shiki-light:#0070C1"> bad</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> = </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4FC1FF;--shiki-light:#0070C1">URI</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">parse</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'file://'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> + </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'/coding/c#/project1'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">);</span></span>

<tr><td><span class="ident">path</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A file system or UNC path.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A new Uri instance.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="Uri.from"></a><span class="ts" id=404 data-target="#details-404" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">from</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">components</span><span>: </span>{authority: <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, fragment: <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, path: <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, query: <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, scheme: <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>}<span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-404">
<div class="comment"><p>Create an URI from its component parts</p>
<p><em>See also</em>
<a href="#Uri.toString">Uri.toString</a></p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">components</span><span>: </span>{authority: <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, fragment: <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, path: <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, query: <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, scheme: <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>}</td><td><div class="comment"><p>The component parts of an Uri.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A new Uri instance.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>

<a name="Uri.joinPath"></a><span class="ts" id=400 data-target="#details-400" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">joinPath</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">base</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a>, <span>...</span><span class="ident">pathSegments</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>[]<span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-400">
<div class="comment"><p>Create a new uri which path is the result of joining
the path of the base uri with the provided path segments.</p>
<ul>
<li>Note 1: <code>joinPath</code> only affects the path component
and all other components (scheme, authority, query, and fragment) are
left as they are.</li>
<li>Note 2: The base uri must have a path; an error is thrown otherwise.</li>
</ul>
<p>The path segments are normalized in the following ways:</p>
<ul>
<li>sequences of path separators (<code>/</code> or <code>\</code>) are replaced with a single separator</li>
<li>for <code>file</code>-uris on windows, the backslash-character (``) is considered a path-separator</li>
<li>the <code>..</code>-segment denotes the parent segment, the <code>.</code> denotes the current segment</li>
<li>paths have a root which always remains, for instance on windows drive-letters are roots
so that is true: <code>joinPath(Uri.file(&#39;file:///c:/root&#39;), &#39;../../other&#39;).fsPath === &#39;c:/other&#39;</code></li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">base</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>An uri. Must have a path.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span>...</span><span class="ident">pathSegments</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>[]</td><td><div class="comment"><p>One more more path fragments</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A new uri which path is joined with the given fragments</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="Uri.parse"></a><span class="ts" id=393 data-target="#details-393" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">parse</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">value</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">strict</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-393">
<div class="comment"><p>Create an URI from a string, e.g. <code>http://www.example.com/some/path</code>,
<code>file:///usr/home</code>, or <code>scheme:with/path</code>.</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that for a while uris without a <code>scheme</code> were accepted. That is not correct
as all uris should have a scheme. To avoid breakage of existing code the optional
<code>strict</code>-argument has been added. We <em>strongly</em> advise to use it, e.g. <code>Uri.parse(&#39;my:uri&#39;, true)</code></p>
<p><em>See also</em>
<a href="#Uri.toString">Uri.toString</a></p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">value</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The string value of an Uri.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">strict</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Throw an error when <code>value</code> is empty or when no <code>scheme</code> can be parsed.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A new Uri instance.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="Uri.authority"></a><span class="ts" id=420 data-target="#details-420" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">authority</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-420">
<div class="comment"><p>Authority is the <code>www.example.com</code> part of <code>http://www.example.com/some/path?query#fragment</code>.
The part between the first double slashes and the next slash.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="Uri.fragment"></a><span class="ts" id=423 data-target="#details-423" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">fragment</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-423">
<div class="comment"><p>Fragment is the <code>fragment</code> part of <code>http://www.example.com/some/path?query#fragment</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="Uri.fsPath"></a><span class="ts" id=424 data-target="#details-424" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">fsPath</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-424">
<div class="comment"><p>The string representing the corresponding file system path of this Uri.</p>
<p>Will handle UNC paths and normalize windows drive letters to lower-case. Also
uses the platform specific path separator.</p>
<ul>
<li>Will <em>not</em> validate the path for invalid characters and semantics.</li>
<li>Will <em>not</em> look at the scheme of this Uri.</li>
<li>The resulting string shall <em>not</em> be used for display purposes but
for disk operations, like <code>readFile</code> et al.</li>
</ul>
<p>The <em>difference</em> to the <a href="#Uri.path">path</a>-property is the use of the platform specific
path separator and the handling of UNC paths. The sample below outlines the difference:</p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="ts" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">const</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4FC1FF;--shiki-light:#0070C1"> u</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> = </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4FC1FF;--shiki-light:#0070C1">URI</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">parse</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'file://server/c$/folder/file.txt'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">u</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">authority</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> === </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'server'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">u</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">path</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> === </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'/c$/folder/file.txt'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">u</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">fsPath</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> === </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D7BA7D;--shiki-light:#EE0000">\\</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">serverc$</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D7BA7D;--shiki-light:#EE0000">\f</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">older</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D7BA7D;--shiki-light:#EE0000">\f</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">ile.txt'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>



<a name="Uri.path"></a><span class="ts" id=421 data-target="#details-421" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">path</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-421">
<div class="comment"><p>Path is the <code>/some/path</code> part of <code>http://www.example.com/some/path?query#fragment</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="Uri.query"></a><span class="ts" id=422 data-target="#details-422" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">query</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-422">
<div class="comment"><p>Query is the <code>query</code> part of <code>http://www.example.com/some/path?query#fragment</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="Uri.scheme"></a><span class="ts" id=419 data-target="#details-419" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">scheme</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-419">
<div class="comment"><p>Scheme is the <code>http</code> part of <code>http://www.example.com/some/path?query#fragment</code>.
The part before the first colon.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="Uri.toJSON"></a><span class="ts" id=438 data-target="#details-438" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">toJSON</span><span>(</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">any</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-438">
<div class="comment"><p>Returns a JSON representation of this Uri.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">

<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>

<a name="Uri.toString"></a><span class="ts" id=435 data-target="#details-435" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">toString</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">skipEncoding</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-435">
<div class="comment"><p>Returns a string representation of this Uri. The representation and normalization
of a URI depends on the scheme.</p>
<ul>
<li>The resulting string can be safely used with <a href="#Uri.parse">Uri.parse</a>.</li>
<li>The resulting string shall <em>not</em> be used for display purposes.</li>
</ul>
<p><em>Note</em> that the implementation will encode <em>aggressive</em> which often leads to unexpected,
but not incorrect, results. For instance, colons are encoded to <code>%3A</code> which might be unexpected
in file-uri. Also <code>&amp;</code> and <code>=</code> will be encoded which might be unexpected for http-uris. For stability
reasons this cannot be changed anymore. If you suffer from too aggressive encoding you should use
the <code>skipEncoding</code>-argument: <code>uri.toString(true)</code>.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">skipEncoding</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Do not percentage-encode the result, defaults to <code>false</code>. Note that
    the <code>#</code> and <code>?</code> characters occurring in the path will always be encoded.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A string representation of this Uri.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="Uri.with"></a><span class="ts" id=426 data-target="#details-426" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">with</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">change</span><span>: </span>{authority: <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, fragment: <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, path: <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, query: <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, scheme: <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>}<span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></span>

<div class="comment"><p>Derive a new Uri from this Uri.</p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="ts" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">let</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080"> file</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> = </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">Uri</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">parse</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'before:some/file/path'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">let</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080"> other</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> = </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">file</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">with</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">({ </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">scheme:</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515"> 'after'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">assert</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">ok</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">other</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">toString</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">() === </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'after:some/file/path'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span></code></pre>
</div>

To unset components use <code>null</code> or
 the empty string.</p>
</div></td></tr>

### <a name="ViewColumn"></a><span class="code-item" id=1827>ViewColumn</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Denotes a location of an editor in the window. Editors can be arranged in a grid
and each column represents one editor location in that grid by counting the editors
in order of their appearance.</p>
</div>

#### Enumeration Members



<a name="ViewColumn.Beside"></a><span class="ts" id=1829 data-target="#details-1829" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Beside</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">-2</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1829">
<div class="comment"><p>A <em>symbolic</em> editor column representing the column to the side of the active one. This value
can be used when opening editors, but the <em>resolved</em> <a href="#TextEditor.viewColumn">viewColumn</a>-value
of editors will always be <code>One</code>, <code>Two</code>, <code>Three</code>,... or <code>undefined</code> but never <code>Beside</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="ViewColumn.Active"></a><span class="ts" id=1828 data-target="#details-1828" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">Active</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">-1</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1828">
<div class="comment"><p>A <em>symbolic</em> editor column representing the currently active column. This value
can be used when opening editors, but the <em>resolved</em> <a href="#TextEditor.viewColumn">viewColumn</a>-value
of editors will always be <code>One</code>, <code>Two</code>, <code>Three</code>,... or <code>undefined</code> but never <code>Active</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="ViewColumn.One"></a><span class="ts" id=1830 data-target="#details-1830" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">One</span><span>: </span><span class="type-literal">1</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1830">
<div class="comment"><p>The first editor column.</p>

### <a name="Webview"></a><span class="code-item" id=2433>Webview</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Displays html content, similarly to an iframe.</p>
</div>

#### Events



<a name="Webview.onDidReceiveMessage"></a><span class="ts" id=2436 data-target="#details-2436" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidReceiveMessage</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">any</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2436">
<div class="comment"><p>Fired when the webview content posts a message.</p>
<p>Webview content can post strings or json serializable objects back to an extension. They cannot
post <code>Blob</code>, <code>File</code>, <code>ImageData</code> and other DOM specific objects since the extension that receives the
message does not run in a browser environment.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="Webview.cspSource"></a><span class="ts" id=2443 data-target="#details-2443" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">cspSource</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2443">
<div class="comment"><p>Content security policy source for webview resources.</p>
<p>This is the origin that should be used in a content security policy rule:</p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="ts" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">`img-src https: </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">${</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">webview</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000FF">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">cspSource</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">}</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515"> ...;`</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>



<a name="Webview.html"></a><span class="ts" id=2435 data-target="#details-2435" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">html</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2435">
<div class="comment"><p>HTML contents of the webview.</p>
<p>This should be a complete, valid html document. Changing this property causes the webview to be reloaded.</p>
<p>Webviews are sandboxed from normal extension process, so all communication with the webview must use
message passing. To send a message from the extension to the webview, use <a href="#Webview.postMessage">postMessage</a>.
To send message from the webview back to an extension, use the <code>acquireVsCodeApi</code> function inside the webview
to get a handle to the editor&#39;s api and then call <code>.postMessage()</code>:</p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="html" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#808080;--shiki-light:#800000">&#x3C;</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#800000">script</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#808080;--shiki-light:#800000">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">    const</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4FC1FF;--shiki-light:#0070C1"> vscode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> =</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26"> acquireVsCodeApi</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000FF">(); </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#6A9955;--shiki-light:#008000">// acquireVsCodeApi can only be invoked once</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">    vscode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000FF">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">postMessage</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000FF">({ </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">message:</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515"> 'hello!'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000FF"> });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#808080;--shiki-light:#800000">&#x3C;/</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#800000">script</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#808080;--shiki-light:#800000">></span></span></code></pre>
<p>To load a resources from the workspace inside a webview, use the <a href="#Webview.asWebviewUri">asWebviewUri</a> method
and ensure the resource&#39;s directory is listed in <a href="#WebviewOptions.localResourceRoots">WebviewOptions.localResourceRoots</a>.</p>
<p>Keep in mind that even though webviews are sandboxed, they still allow running scripts and loading arbitrary content,
so extensions must follow all standard web security best practices when working with webviews. This includes
properly sanitizing all untrusted input (including content from the workspace) and
setting a <a href="https://aka.ms/vscode-api-webview-csp">content security policy</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="Webview.options"></a><span class="ts" id=2434 data-target="#details-2434" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">options</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#WebviewOptions">WebviewOptions</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2434">
<div class="comment"><p>Content settings for the webview.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="Webview.asWebviewUri"></a><span class="ts" id=2441 data-target="#details-2441" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">asWebviewUri</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">localResource</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2441">
<div class="comment"><p>Convert a uri for the local file system to one that can be used inside webviews.</p>
<p>Webviews cannot directly load resources from the workspace or local file system using <code>file:</code> uris. The
<code>asWebviewUri</code> function takes a local <code>file:</code> uri and converts it into a uri that can be used inside of
a webview to load the same resource:</p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="ts" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">webview</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">html</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> = </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">`&#x3C;img src="</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">${</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">webview</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000FF">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">asWebviewUri</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000FF">(</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">  vscode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000FF">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">Uri</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000FF">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">file</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000FF">(</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'/Users/codey/workspace/cat.gif'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000FF">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000FF">)</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">}</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">">`</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span></code></pre>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">localResource</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="Webview.postMessage"></a><span class="ts" id=2438 data-target="#details-2438" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">postMessage</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">message</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">any</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2438">
<div class="comment"><p>Post a message to the webview content.</p>
<p>Messages are only delivered if the webview is live (either visible or in the
background with <code>retainContextWhenHidden</code>).</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">message</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">any</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Body of the message. This must be a string or other json serializable object.</p>
<p>  For older versions of vscode, if an <code>ArrayBuffer</code> is included in <code>message</code>,
  it will not be serialized properly and will not be received by the webview.
  Similarly any TypedArrays, such as a <code>Uint8Array</code>, will be very inefficiently
  serialized and will also not be recreated as a typed array inside the webview.</p>
<p>  However if your extension targets vscode 1.57+ in the <code>engines</code> field of its
  <code>package.json</code>, any <code>ArrayBuffer</code> values that appear in <code>message</code> will be more
  efficiently transferred to the webview and will also be correctly recreated inside
  of the webview.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>A promise that resolves when the message is posted to a webview or when it is
dropped because the message was not deliverable.</p>
<p>  Returns <code>true</code> if the message was posted to the webview. Messages can only be posted to
live webviews (i.e. either visible webviews or hidden webviews that set <code>retainContextWhenHidden</code>).</p>
<p>  A response of <code>true</code> does not mean that the message was actually received by the webview.
  For example, no message listeners may be have been hooked up inside the webview or the webview may
  have been destroyed after the message was posted but before it was received.</p>
<p>  If you want confirm that a message as actually received, you can try having your webview posting a
  confirmation message back to your extension.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="WebviewOptions"></a><span class="code-item" id=2427>WebviewOptions</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Content settings for a webview.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="WebviewOptions.enableCommandUris"></a><span class="ts" id=2430 data-target="#details-2430" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">enableCommandUris</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span> &#124; readonly <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2430">
<div class="comment"><p>Controls whether command uris are enabled in webview content or not.</p>
<p>Defaults to <code>false</code> (command uris are disabled).</p>
<p>If you pass in an array, only the commands in the array are allowed.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="WebviewOptions.enableForms"></a><span class="ts" id=2429 data-target="#details-2429" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">enableForms</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2429">
<div class="comment"><p>Controls whether forms are enabled in the webview content or not.</p>
<p>Defaults to true if <a href="#WebviewOptions.enableScripts">scripts are enabled</a>. Otherwise defaults to false.
Explicitly setting this property to either true or false overrides the default.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="WebviewOptions.enableScripts"></a><span class="ts" id=2428 data-target="#details-2428" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">enableScripts</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2428">
<div class="comment"><p>Controls whether scripts are enabled in the webview content or not.</p>
<p>Defaults to false (scripts-disabled).</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="WebviewOptions.localResourceRoots"></a><span class="ts" id=2431 data-target="#details-2431" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">localResourceRoots</span><span>?</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2431">
<div class="comment"><p>Root paths from which the webview can load local (filesystem) resources using uris from <code>asWebviewUri</code></p>
<p>Default to the root folders of the current workspace plus the extension&#39;s install directory.</p>
<p>Pass in an empty array to disallow access to any local resources.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="WebviewOptions.portMapping"></a><span class="ts" id=2432 data-target="#details-2432" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">portMapping</span><span>?</span><span>: </span>readonly <a class="type-ref" href="#WebviewPortMapping">WebviewPortMapping</a>[]</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2432">
<div class="comment"><p>Mappings of localhost ports used inside the webview.</p>
<p>Port mapping allow webviews to transparently define how localhost ports are resolved. This can be used
to allow using a static localhost port inside the webview that is resolved to random port that a service is
running on.</p>
<p>If a webview accesses localhost content, we recommend that you specify port mappings even if
the <code>webviewPort</code> and <code>extensionHostPort</code> ports are the same.</p>
<p><em>Note</em> that port mappings only work for <code>http</code> or <code>https</code> urls. Websocket urls (e.g. <code>ws://localhost:3000</code>)
cannot be mapped to another port.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="WebviewPanel"></a><span class="code-item" id=2447>WebviewPanel</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A panel that contains a <a href="#Webview">Webview</a>.</p>
</div>

#### Events



<a name="WebviewPanel.onDidChangeViewState"></a><span class="ts" id=2456 data-target="#details-2456" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidChangeViewState</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<a class="type-ref" href="#WebviewPanelOnDidChangeViewStateEvent">WebviewPanelOnDidChangeViewStateEvent</a>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2456">
<div class="comment"><p>Fired when the panel&#39;s view state changes.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="WebviewPanel.onDidDispose"></a><span class="ts" id=2457 data-target="#details-2457" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">onDidDispose</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Event&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">Event</a>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2457">
<div class="comment"><p>Fired when the panel is disposed.</p>
<p>This may be because the user closed the panel or because <a href="#WebviewPanel.dispose">dispose</a> was
called on it.</p>
<p>Trying to use the panel after it has been disposed throws an exception.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="WebviewPanel.active"></a><span class="ts" id=2454 data-target="#details-2454" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">active</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>

<div class="comment"><p>Whether the panel is active (focused by the user).</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="WebviewPanel.iconPath"></a><span class="ts" id=2450 data-target="#details-2450" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">iconPath</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#IconPath">IconPath</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2450">
<div class="comment"><p>Icon for the panel shown in UI.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="WebviewPanel.options"></a><span class="ts" id=2452 data-target="#details-2452" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">options</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#WebviewPanelOptions">WebviewPanelOptions</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2452">
<div class="comment"><p>Content settings for the webview panel.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="WebviewPanel.title"></a><span class="ts" id=2449 data-target="#details-2449" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">title</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2449">
<div class="comment"><p>Title of the panel shown in UI.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="WebviewPanel.viewColumn"></a><span class="ts" id=2453 data-target="#details-2453" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">viewColumn</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ViewColumn">ViewColumn</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2453">
<div class="comment"><p>Editor position of the panel. This property is only set if the webview is in
one of the editor view columns.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="WebviewPanel.viewType"></a><span class="ts" id=2448 data-target="#details-2448" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">viewType</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2448">
<div class="comment"><p>Identifies the type of the webview panel, such as <code>&#39;markdown.preview&#39;</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="WebviewPanel.visible"></a><span class="ts" id=2455 data-target="#details-2455" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">visible</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2455">
<div class="comment"><p>Whether the panel is visible.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="WebviewPanel.webview"></a><span class="ts" id=2451 data-target="#details-2451" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">webview</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Webview">Webview</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2451">
<div class="comment"><p><a href="#Webview">Webview</a> belonging to the panel.</p>
</div>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="WebviewPanel.dispose"></a><span class="ts" id=2463 data-target="#details-2463" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">dispose</span><span>(</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">any</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2463">
<div class="comment"><p>Dispose of the webview panel.</p>
<p>This closes the panel if it showing and disposes of the resources owned by the webview.
Webview panels are also disposed when the user closes the webview panel. Both cases
fire the <a href="#WebviewPanel.onDidDispose">onDidDispose</a> event.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-intrinsic">any</span></td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="WebviewPanelOptions"></a><span class="code-item" id=2444>WebviewPanelOptions</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Content settings for a webview panel.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="WebviewPanelOptions.enableFindWidget"></a><span class="ts" id=2445 data-target="#details-2445" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">enableFindWidget</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2445">
<div class="comment"><p>Controls if the find widget is enabled in the panel.</p>
<p>Defaults to <code>false</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="WebviewPanelOptions.retainContextWhenHidden"></a><span class="ts" id=2446 data-target="#details-2446" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">retainContextWhenHidden</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2446">
<div class="comment"><p>Controls if the webview panel&#39;s content (iframe) is kept around even when the panel
is no longer visible.</p>
<p>Normally the webview panel&#39;s html context is created when the panel becomes visible
and destroyed when it is hidden. Extensions that have complex state
or UI can set the <code>retainContextWhenHidden</code> to make the editor keep the webview
context around, even when the webview moves to a background tab. When a webview using
<code>retainContextWhenHidden</code> becomes hidden, its scripts and other dynamic content are suspended.
When the panel becomes visible again, the context is automatically restored
in the exact same state it was in originally. You cannot send messages to a
hidden webview, even with <code>retainContextWhenHidden</code> enabled.</p>
<p><code>retainContextWhenHidden</code> has a high memory overhead and should only be used if
your panel&#39;s context cannot be quickly saved and restored.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="WebviewPanelSerializer"></a><span class="code-item" id=2466>WebviewPanelSerializer&lt;T&gt;</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Restore webview panels that have been persisted when vscode shuts down.</p>
<p>There are two types of webview persistence:</p>
<ul>
<li>Persistence within a session.</li>
<li>Persistence across sessions (across restarts of the editor).</li>
</ul>
<p>A <code>WebviewPanelSerializer</code> is only required for the second case: persisting a webview across sessions.</p>
<p>Persistence within a session allows a webview to save its state when it becomes hidden
and restore its content from this state when it becomes visible again. It is powered entirely
by the webview content itself. To save off a persisted state, call <code>acquireVsCodeApi().setState()</code> with
any json serializable object. To restore the state again, call <code>getState()</code></p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="js" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#6A9955;--shiki-light:#008000">// Within the webview</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">const</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4FC1FF;--shiki-light:#0070C1"> vscode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> = </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">acquireVsCodeApi</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">();</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#6A9955;--shiki-light:#008000">// Get existing state</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">const</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4FC1FF;--shiki-light:#0070C1"> oldState</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> = </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">vscode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">getState</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">() || { </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">value:</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#B5CEA8;--shiki-light:#098658"> 0</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> };</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#6A9955;--shiki-light:#008000">// Update state</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">setState</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">({ </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">value:</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080"> oldState</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">value</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> + </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#B5CEA8;--shiki-light:#098658">1</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> });</span></span>
<span class="line"></span></code></pre>
<p>A <code>WebviewPanelSerializer</code> extends this persistence across restarts of the editor. When the editor is shutdown,
it will save off the state from <code>setState</code> of all webviews that have a serializer. When the
webview first becomes visible after the restart, this state is passed to <code>deserializeWebviewPanel</code>.
The extension can then restore the old <code>WebviewPanel</code> from this state.</p>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="WebviewPanelSerializer.deserializeWebviewPanel"></a><span class="ts" id=2469 data-target="#details-2469" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">deserializeWebviewPanel</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">webviewPanel</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#WebviewPanel">WebviewPanel</a>, <span class="ident">state</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2469">
<div class="comment"><p>Restore a webview panel from its serialized <code>state</code>.</p>
<p>Called when a serialized webview first becomes visible.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">webviewPanel</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#WebviewPanel">WebviewPanel</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Webview panel to restore. The serializer should take ownership of this panel. The
serializer must restore the webview&#39;s <code>.html</code> and hook up all webview events.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">state</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Persisted state from the webview content.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>Thenable indicating that the webview has been fully restored.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>
