### <a name="WebviewViewResolveContext"></a><span class="code-item" id=2484>WebviewViewResolveContext&lt;T&gt;</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Additional information the webview view being resolved.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="WebviewViewResolveContext.state"></a><span class="ts" id=2486 data-target="#details-2486" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">state</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-2486">
<div class="comment"><p>Persisted state from the webview content.</p>
<p>To save resources, the editor normally deallocates webview documents (the iframe content) that are not visible.
For example, when the user collapse a view or switches to another top level activity in the sidebar, the
<a href="#WebviewView">WebviewView</a> itself is kept alive but the webview&#39;s underlying document is deallocated. It is recreated when
the view becomes visible again.</p>
<p>You can prevent this behavior by setting [WebviewOptions.retainContextWhenHidden retainContextWhenHidden](#WebviewOptions.retainContextWhenHidden retainContextWhenHidden) in the <a href="#WebviewOptions">WebviewOptions</a>.
However this increases resource usage and should be avoided wherever possible. Instead, you can use
persisted state to save off a webview&#39;s state so that it can be quickly recreated as needed.</p>
<p>To save off a persisted state, inside the webview call <code>acquireVsCodeApi().setState()</code> with
any json serializable object. To restore the state again, call <code>getState()</code>. For example:</p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="js" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#6A9955;--shiki-light:#008000">// Within the webview</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">const</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4FC1FF;--shiki-light:#0070C1"> vscode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> = </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">acquireVsCodeApi</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">();</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#6A9955;--shiki-light:#008000">// Get existing state</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#569CD6;--shiki-light:#0000FF">const</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#4FC1FF;--shiki-light:#0070C1"> oldState</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> = </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">vscode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">getState</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">() || { </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">value:</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#B5CEA8;--shiki-light:#098658"> 0</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> };</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#6A9955;--shiki-light:#008000">// Update state</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA;--shiki-light:#795E26">setState</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">({ </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">value:</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080"> oldState</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">value</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> + </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#B5CEA8;--shiki-light:#098658">1</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> });</span></span>
<span class="line"></span></code></pre>
<p>The editor ensures that the persisted state is saved correctly when a webview is hidden and across
editor restarts.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="WorkspaceConfiguration"></a><span class="code-item" id=1701>WorkspaceConfiguration</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Represents the configuration. It is a merged view of</p>
<ul>
<li><em>Default Settings</em></li>
<li><em>Global (User) Settings</em></li>
<li><em>Workspace settings</em></li>
<li><em>Workspace Folder settings</em> - From one of the <a href="#workspace.workspaceFolders">Workspace Folders</a> under which requested resource belongs to.</li>
<li><em>Language settings</em> - Settings defined under requested language.</li>
</ul>
<p>The <em>effective</em> value (returned by <a href="#WorkspaceConfiguration.get">get</a>) is computed by overriding or merging the values in the following order:</p>
<ol>
<li><code>defaultValue</code> (if defined in <code>package.json</code> otherwise derived from the value&#39;s type)</li>
<li><code>globalValue</code> (if defined)</li>
<li><code>workspaceValue</code> (if defined)</li>
<li><code>workspaceFolderValue</code> (if defined)</li>
<li><code>defaultLanguageValue</code> (if defined)</li>
<li><code>globalLanguageValue</code> (if defined)</li>
<li><code>workspaceLanguageValue</code> (if defined)</li>
<li><code>workspaceFolderLanguageValue</code> (if defined)</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>Note:</strong> Only <code>object</code> value types are merged and all other value types are overridden.</p>
<p>Example 1: Overriding</p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="ts" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">defaultValue</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> = </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'on'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">globalValue</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> = </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'relative'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">workspaceFolderValue</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> = </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'off'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">value</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> = </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'off'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span></code></pre>
<p>Example 2: Language Values</p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="ts" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">defaultValue</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> = </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'on'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">globalValue</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> = </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'relative'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">workspaceFolderValue</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> = </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'off'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">globalLanguageValue</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> = </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'on'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">value</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> = </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#CE9178;--shiki-light:#A31515">'on'</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span></code></pre>
<p>Example 3: Object Values</p>
<pre class="shiki" data-lang="ts" shiki-themes dark-plus light-plus" style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000;--shiki-dark-bg:#1E1E1E;--shiki-light-bg:#FFFFFF" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">defaultValue</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> = { </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">a:</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#B5CEA8;--shiki-light:#098658"> 1</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">, </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">b:</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#B5CEA8;--shiki-light:#098658"> 2</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> };</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">globalValue</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> = { </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">b:</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#B5CEA8;--shiki-light:#098658"> 3</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">, </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">c:</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#B5CEA8;--shiki-light:#098658"> 4</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> };</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">value</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> = { </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">a:</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#B5CEA8;--shiki-light:#098658"> 1</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">, </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">b:</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#B5CEA8;--shiki-light:#098658"> 3</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">, </span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">c:</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#B5CEA8;--shiki-light:#098658"> 4</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000"> };</span></span>

<p><em>Note:</em> Workspace and Workspace Folder configurations contains <code>launch</code> and <code>tasks</code> settings. Their basename will be
part of the section identifier. The following snippets shows how to retrieve all configurations

<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">  vscode</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">workspace</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">.</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">workspaceFolders</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">[</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#B5CEA8;--shiki-light:#098658">0</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">].</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE;--shiki-light:#001080">uri</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4;--shiki-light:#000000">);</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-dark:#6A9955;--shiki-light:#008000">// retrieve values</span></span>

<a name="WorkspaceConfiguration.inspect"></a><span class="ts" id=1714 data-target="#details-1714" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">inspect</span><span>&lt;</span>T<span>&gt;</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">section</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span><span>)</span><span>: </span>{defaultLanguageValue: <span class="type-ref">T</span>, defaultValue: <span class="type-ref">T</span>, globalLanguageValue: <span class="type-ref">T</span>, globalValue: <span class="type-ref">T</span>, key: <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, languageIds: <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>[], workspaceFolderLanguageValue: <span class="type-ref">T</span>, workspaceFolderValue: <span class="type-ref">T</span>, workspaceLanguageValue: <span class="type-ref">T</span>, workspaceValue: <span class="type-ref">T</span>}</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1714">
<div class="comment"><p>Retrieve all information about a configuration setting. A configuration value
often consists of a <em>default</em> value, a global or installation-wide value,
a workspace-specific value, folder-specific value
and language-specific values (if <a href="#WorkspaceConfiguration">WorkspaceConfiguration</a> is scoped to a language).</p>
<p>Also provides all language ids under which the given configuration setting is defined.</p>
<p><em>Note:</em> The configuration name must denote a leaf in the configuration tree
(<code>editor.fontSize</code> vs <code>editor</code>) otherwise no result is returned.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">section</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Configuration name, supports <em>dotted</em> names.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td>{defaultLanguageValue: <span class="type-ref">T</span>, defaultValue: <span class="type-ref">T</span>, globalLanguageValue: <span class="type-ref">T</span>, globalValue: <span class="type-ref">T</span>, key: <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, languageIds: <span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>[], workspaceFolderLanguageValue: <span class="type-ref">T</span>, workspaceFolderValue: <span class="type-ref">T</span>, workspaceLanguageValue: <span class="type-ref">T</span>, workspaceValue: <span class="type-ref">T</span>}</td><td><div class="comment"><p>Information about a configuration setting or <code>undefined</code>.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="WorkspaceConfiguration.update"></a><span class="ts" id=1729 data-target="#details-1729" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">update</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">section</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">value</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">any</span>, <span class="ident">configurationTarget</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#ConfigurationTarget">ConfigurationTarget</a>, <span class="ident">overrideInLanguage</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1729">
<div class="comment"><p>Update a configuration value. The updated configuration values are persisted.</p>
<p>A value can be changed in</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="#ConfigurationTarget.Global">Global settings</a>: Changes the value for all instances of the editor.</li>
<li><a href="#ConfigurationTarget.Workspace">Workspace settings</a>: Changes the value for current workspace, if available.</li>
<li><a href="#ConfigurationTarget.WorkspaceFolder">Workspace folder settings</a>: Changes the value for settings from one of the <a href="#workspace.workspaceFolders">Workspace Folders</a> under which the requested resource belongs to.</li>
<li>Language settings: Changes the value for the requested languageId.</li>
</ul>
<p><em>Note:</em> To remove a configuration value use <code>undefined</code>, like so: <code>config.update(&#39;somekey&#39;, undefined)</code></p>
<ul>
<li><em>throws</em> - error while updating<ul>
<li>configuration which is not registered.</li>
<li>window configuration to workspace folder</li>
<li>configuration to workspace or workspace folder when no workspace is opened.</li>
<li>configuration to workspace folder when there is no workspace folder settings.</li>
<li>configuration to workspace folder when <a href="#WorkspaceConfiguration">WorkspaceConfiguration</a> is not scoped to a resource.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">section</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Configuration name, supports <em>dotted</em> names.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">value</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">any</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The new value.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">configurationTarget</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span> &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#ConfigurationTarget">ConfigurationTarget</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The <a href="#ConfigurationTarget">configuration target</a> or a boolean value.
    - If <code>true</code> updates <a href="#ConfigurationTarget.Global">Global settings</a>.
    - If <code>false</code> updates <a href="#ConfigurationTarget.Workspace">Workspace settings</a>.
    - If <code>undefined</code> or <code>null</code> updates to <a href="#ConfigurationTarget.WorkspaceFolder">Workspace folder settings</a> if configuration is resource specific,
    otherwise to <a href="#ConfigurationTarget.Workspace">Workspace settings</a>.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">overrideInLanguage</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Whether to update the value in the scope of requested languageId or not.
    - If <code>true</code> updates the value under the requested languageId.
    - If <code>undefined</code> updates the value under the requested languageId only if the configuration is defined for the language.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="type-ref">Thenable</span>&lt;<span class="type-intrinsic">void</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"></div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="WorkspaceEdit"></a><span class="code-item" id=976>WorkspaceEdit</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A workspace edit is a collection of textual and files changes for
multiple resources and documents.</p>
<p>Use the <a href="#workspace.applyEdit">applyEdit</a>-function to apply a workspace edit.</p>
</div>

<a name="WorkspaceEdit.createFile"></a><span class="ts" id=1017 data-target="#details-1017" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">createFile</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">uri</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a>, <span class="ident">options</span><span>?</span><span>: </span>{contents: <span class="type-ref-ts">Uint8Array</span>&lt;<span class="type-ref-ts">ArrayBufferLike</span>&gt; &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#DataTransferFile">DataTransferFile</a>, ignoreIfExists: <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>, overwrite: <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>}, <span class="ident">metadata</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#WorkspaceEditEntryMetadata">WorkspaceEditEntryMetadata</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">void</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-1017">
<div class="comment"><p>Create a regular file.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">uri</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>Uri of the new file.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">options</span><span>?</span><span>: </span>{contents: <span class="type-ref-ts">Uint8Array</span>&lt;<span class="type-ref-ts">ArrayBufferLike</span>&gt; &#124; <a class="type-ref" href="#DataTransferFile">DataTransferFile</a>, ignoreIfExists: <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>, overwrite: <span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span>}</td><td><div class="comment"><p>Defines if an existing file should be overwritten or be
ignored. When <code>overwrite</code> and <code>ignoreIfExists</code> are both set <code>overwrite</code> wins.
When both are unset and when the file already exists then the edit cannot
be applied successfully. The <code>content</code>-property allows to set the initial contents
the file is being created with.</p>

### <a name="WorkspaceEditEntryMetadata"></a><span class="code-item" id=969>WorkspaceEditEntryMetadata</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Additional data for entries of a workspace edit. Supports to label entries and marks entries
as needing confirmation by the user. The editor groups edits with equal labels into tree nodes,
for instance all edits labelled with &quot;Changes in Strings&quot; would be a tree node.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="WorkspaceEditEntryMetadata.description"></a><span class="ts" id=972 data-target="#details-972" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">description</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-972">
<div class="comment"><p>A human-readable string which is rendered less prominent on the same line.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="WorkspaceEditEntryMetadata.iconPath"></a><span class="ts" id=973 data-target="#details-973" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">iconPath</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#IconPath">IconPath</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-973">
<div class="comment"><p>The icon path or <a href="#ThemeIcon">ThemeIcon</a> for the edit.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="WorkspaceEditEntryMetadata.label"></a><span class="ts" id=971 data-target="#details-971" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">label</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-971">
<div class="comment"><p>A human-readable string which is rendered prominent.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="WorkspaceEditEntryMetadata.needsConfirmation"></a><span class="ts" id=970 data-target="#details-970" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">needsConfirmation</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-970">
<div class="comment"><p>A flag which indicates that user confirmation is needed.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="WorkspaceEditMetadata"></a><span class="code-item" id=974>WorkspaceEditMetadata</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Additional data about a workspace edit.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="WorkspaceEditMetadata.isRefactoring"></a><span class="ts" id=975 data-target="#details-975" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">isRefactoring</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-975">
<div class="comment"><p>Signal to the editor that this edit is a refactoring.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="WorkspaceFolder"></a><span class="code-item" id=3341>WorkspaceFolder</span>



<div class="comment"><p>A workspace folder is one of potentially many roots opened by the editor. All workspace folders
are equal which means there is no notion of an active or primary workspace folder.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="WorkspaceFolder.index"></a><span class="ts" id=3344 data-target="#details-3344" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">index</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">number</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3344">
<div class="comment"><p>The ordinal number of this workspace folder.</p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="WorkspaceFolder.name"></a><span class="ts" id=3343 data-target="#details-3343" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">name</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3343">
<div class="comment"><p>The name of this workspace folder. Defaults to
the basename of its <a href="#Uri.path">uri-path</a></p>
</div>
</div>



<a name="WorkspaceFolder.uri"></a><span class="ts" id=3342 data-target="#details-3342" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">uri</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#Uri">Uri</a></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-3342">
<div class="comment"><p>The associated uri for this workspace folder.</p>
<p><em>Note:</em> The <a href="#Uri">Uri</a>-type was intentionally chosen such that future releases of the editor can support
workspace folders that are not stored on the local disk, e.g. <code>ftp://server/workspaces/foo</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="WorkspaceFolderPickOptions"></a><span class="code-item" id=527>WorkspaceFolderPickOptions</span>



<div class="comment"><p>Options to configure the behavior of the <a href="#WorkspaceFolder">workspace folder</a> pick UI.</p>
</div>

#### Properties



<a name="WorkspaceFolderPickOptions.ignoreFocusOut"></a><span class="ts" id=529 data-target="#details-529" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">ignoreFocusOut</span><span>?</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">boolean</span></span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-529">
<div class="comment"><p>Set to <code>true</code> to keep the picker open when focus moves to another part of the editor or to another window.
This setting is ignored on iPad and is always <code>false</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>

### <a name="WorkspaceSymbolProvider"></a><span class="code-item" id=873>WorkspaceSymbolProvider&lt;T&gt;</span>



<div class="comment"><p>The workspace symbol provider interface defines the contract between extensions and
the <a href="https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/editingevolved#_open-symbol-by-name">symbol search</a>-feature.</p>
</div>

#### Methods



<a name="WorkspaceSymbolProvider.provideWorkspaceSymbols"></a><span class="ts" id=876 data-target="#details-876" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">provideWorkspaceSymbols</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">query</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>[]&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-876">
<div class="comment"><p>Project-wide search for a symbol matching the given query string.</p>
<p>The <code>query</code>-parameter should be interpreted in a <em>relaxed way</em> as the editor will apply its own highlighting
and scoring on the results. A good rule of thumb is to match case-insensitive and to simply check that the
characters of <em>query</em> appear in their order in a candidate symbol. Don&#39;t use prefix, substring, or similar
strict matching.</p>
<p>To improve performance implementors can implement <code>resolveWorkspaceSymbol</code> and then provide symbols with partial
<a href="#SymbolInformation.location">location</a>-objects, without a <code>range</code> defined. The editor will then call
<code>resolveWorkspaceSymbol</code> for selected symbols only, e.g. when opening a workspace symbol.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">query</span><span>: </span><span class="type-intrinsic">string</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A query string, can be the empty string in which case all symbols should be returned.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>[]&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>An array of document highlights or a thenable that resolves to such. The lack of a result can be
signaled by returning <code>undefined</code>, <code>null</code>, or an empty array.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



<a name="WorkspaceSymbolProvider.resolveWorkspaceSymbol"></a><span class="ts" id=880 data-target="#details-880" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" tabIndex="0" aria-expanded="false"><span class="ident">resolveWorkspaceSymbol</span><span>(</span><span class="ident">symbol</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span>, <span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a><span>)</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt;</span>
<div class="details collapse" id="details-880">
<div class="comment"><p>Given a symbol fill in its <a href="#SymbolInformation.location">location</a>. This method is called whenever a symbol
is selected in the UI. Providers can implement this method and return incomplete symbols from
<a href="#WorkspaceSymbolProvider.provideWorkspaceSymbols">provideWorkspaceSymbols</a> which often helps to improve
performance.</p>
</div>
<div class="signature callable-signature">
<table class="table table-bordered">
<tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">symbol</span><span>: </span><span class="type-ref">T</span></td><td><div class="comment"><p>The symbol that is to be resolved. Guaranteed to be an instance of an object returned from an
earlier call to <code>provideWorkspaceSymbols</code>.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="ident">token</span><span>: </span><a class="type-ref" href="#CancellationToken">CancellationToken</a></td><td><div class="comment"><p>A cancellation token.</p>
</div></td></tr>
<tr><th>Returns</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><a class="type-ref" href="#ProviderResult&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;">ProviderResult</a>&lt;<span class="type-ref">T</span>&gt;</td><td><div class="comment"><p>The resolved symbol or a thenable that resolves to that. When no result is returned,
the given <code>symbol</code> is used.</p>
</div></td></tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>



## API Patterns

These are some of the common patterns we use in the VS Code API.

### Promises

The VS Code API represents asynchronous operations with [promises](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Promise). From extensions, __any__ type of promise can be returned, like ES6, WinJS, A+, etc.

Being independent of a specific promise library is expressed in the API by the `Thenable`-type. `Thenable` represents the common denominator which is the [then](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Promise/then) method.

In most cases the use of promises is optional and when VS Code calls into an extension, it can handle the _result type_ as well as a `Thenable` of the _result type_. When the use of a promise is optional, the API indicates this by returning `or`-types.

```typescript
provideNumber(): number | Thenable<number>
```

### Cancellation Tokens

Often operations are started on volatile state which changes before operations can finish. For instance, computing IntelliSense starts and the user continues to type making the result of that operation obsolete.

APIs that are exposed to such behavior will get passed a `CancellationToken` on which you can check for cancellation (`isCancellationRequested`) or get notified when cancellation occurs (`onCancellationRequested`). The cancellation token is usually the last parameter of a function call and optional.

### Disposables

The VS Code API uses the [dispose pattern](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dispose_pattern) for resources that are obtained from VS Code. This applies to event listening, commands, interacting with the UI, and various language contributions.

For instance, the `setStatusBarMessage(value: string)` function returns a `Disposable` which upon calling `dispose` removes the message again.

### Events

Events in the VS Code API are exposed as functions which you call with a listener-function to subscribe. Calls to subscribe return a `Disposable` which removes the event listener upon dispose.

```javascript
var listener = function(event) {
    console.log("It happened", event);
};

// start listening
var subscription = fsWatcher.onDidDelete(listener);

// do more stuff

subscription.dispose(); // stop listening
```

Names of events follow the `on[Will|Did]VerbNoun?` pattern. The name signals if the event is going to happen *(onWill)* or already happened *(onDid)*, what happened *(verb)*, and the context *(noun)* unless obvious from the context.

An example from the VS Code API is `window.onDidChangeActiveTextEditor` which is an event fired when the active text editor *(noun)* has been (*onDid*) changed (*verb*).

### Strict null

The VS Code API uses the `undefined` and `null` TypeScript types where appropriate to support [strict null checking](https://github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/pull/7140).
